title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
title_zh: 检索增强生成的组合性

paragraphs.en: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce lasagna , an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5 5 K to 200 200 K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a + 47 % +47\% combined improvement but deliver only + 17 % +17\% when used together. Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other. Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale. These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack. We call on researchers to do so and supply lasagna to simplify these experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）将大语言模型建立在外部知识的基础上。 现代流水线结合了嵌入、分块、检索、重排序、查询增强、上下文压缩和基于智能体的验证，但这些技术通常只是被逐一评估。 目前尚不清楚这些技术各自带来的增益在组合后是否仍然成立，检索质量与答案忠实度是否偏好相同的设计选择，以及在小语料上得出的结论是否适用于大规模场景。 我们预先声明了三个假设，并介绍了 lasagna，这是一个用于受控 RAG 评估的开源框架。 我们在八个基准以及规模从 5 5 K 到 200 200 K 篇文档不等的语料上测试了 450 450 种配置。研究得出三项发现。 第一，来自 RAG 流水线不同阶段的单项强技术不一定能组合生效：三种检索技术预测合计可带来 + 47 % +47\% 的提升，但组合使用时仅带来 + 17 % +17\%。 第二，各组件的增益对检索和忠实度的叠加方式不同，优化其中一项可能会损害另一项。 第三，最优组合会随语料规模增长而变化：在小语料上胜出的组合未必在大规模场景下仍然最优。 这些发现表明，孤立测得的增益并不能可靠地预测真实场景下的性能，新的 RAG 技术应当在完整的周边技术栈中进行测试。 我们呼吁研究者这样做，并提供 lasagna 以简化这些实验。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Gao et al., 2023b ; Fan et al., 2024 ) combines choices across many pipeline stages. Our study covers eight stages that span the dominant design axes in modern RAG ( Fig. 1 b; full catalog in Appendix K ): embedding, chunking, index-time enrichment, retrieval, query augmentation, reranking, context compression, and agentic quality gates. Most new techniques are proposed and evaluated one stage at a time, in isolation from the surrounding pipeline, or from several representative pipelines that would test whether findings generalize ( Yu et al., 2024 ) . Adding to the complexity, RAG systems are evaluated for two goals ( Saad-Falcon et al., 2024 ; Friel et al., 2024 ) : retrieving the right content (NDCG@10) and producing a faithful answer from it ( Es et al., 2024 , RAGAS;) . It is unclear whether isolated gains persist under composition. It is also unclear whether the same design choices optimize both retrieval quality (which documents are retrieved) and answer faithfulness (whether the answer is grounded in those documents), two goals RAG evaluation typically reports separately. We pre-declare three hypotheses. H1. Components often fail to compose: isolated gains from single-component ablations do not necessarily persist when components are combined. H2. A simple RAG pipeline can be near-optimal in many settings, while more elaborate configurations tend to specialize to narrower ones. Most RAG ablations in the literature run at 5K to 50K documents, whereas the applications RAG can serve run at corpora an order of magnitude larger; H3. composition rankings shift with corpus scale, so conclusions from small-corpus benchmarks may not hold at larger scales. Prior work has explored combinations through configuration sweeps and heuristic search ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Rau et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) ; these approaches can identify strong configurations but do not directly measure interaction effects: whether the benefit of one component depends on the other components in the pipeline. These interactions, and how they change with corpus scale, remain largely unquantified.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）( Gao et al., 2023b ; Fan et al., 2024 ) 组合了众多流水线阶段中的各种选择。 我们的研究涵盖了构成现代 RAG 主要设计轴的八个阶段（图 1b；完整目录见附录 K）：嵌入、分块、索引时增强、检索、查询增强、重排序、上下文压缩，以及智能体质量门控。 大多数新技术都是一次只针对一个阶段被提出和评估的，与周围的流水线相隔离，或者未能与若干具有代表性的流水线进行对比，以检验其结论能否泛化 ( Yu et al., 2024 ) 。 更复杂的是，RAG 系统的评估针对两个目标 ( Saad-Falcon et al., 2024 ; Friel et al., 2024 ) ：检索到正确的内容（NDCG@10），并据此生成忠实的答案 ( Es et al., 2024 , RAGAS;) 。 目前尚不清楚在组合使用的情况下，这些孤立的收益能否持续存在。 同样不清楚的是，相同的设计选择能否同时优化检索质量（检索到哪些文档）和答案忠实度（答案是否立足于这些文档），而 RAG 评估通常将这两个目标分开报告。 我们预先声明了三个假设。H1。 各组件常常无法良好组合：单一组件消融实验带来的孤立收益在组件组合后未必能持续存在。H2。 简单的 RAG 流水线在许多设置下可以接近最优，而更复杂的配置往往只在更狭窄的设置下表现更优。 文献中的大多数 RAG 消融实验在 5K 到 50K 文档的规模上运行，而 RAG 所能服务的应用其语料库规模要大一个数量级；H3. 组合排名会随语料库规模而变化，因此来自小语料库基准的结论在更大规模上可能不成立。 已有工作通过配置扫描和启发式搜索探索了各种组合 ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Rau et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) ；这些方法可以找出强大的配置，但并未直接度量交互效应，即某一组件的收益是否取决于流水线中的其他组件。 这些交互效应，以及它们如何随语料库规模变化，在很大程度上仍未被量化。

paragraphs.en: Testing these hypotheses requires a framework that isolates pipeline stages and supports reproducible evaluation across benchmarks. We created lasagna , an open-source RAG framework, to provide this ( Fig. 1a , Section 3 ). Each stage sits behind a fixed interface, so swapping one method cannot silently change the implementation at another. Adding a new technique is a single line of code; the framework tests it inside a complete modern pipeline without reimplementing the surrounding stack.
paragraphs.zh: 检验这些假设需要一个能够隔离流水线各阶段并支持跨基准可复现评估的框架。 我们创建了 lasagna 这一开源 RAG 框架来提供此能力（图 1a、第 3 节）。 每个阶段都位于固定接口之后，因此替换某个方法不会悄然改变另一阶段的实现。 添加新技术只需一行代码；该框架可在完整的现代化流水线中对其进行测试，而无需重新实现周边的技术栈。

paragraphs.en: We use lasagna to study RAG composition with a 167-configuration D-optimal design ( Fedorov et al., 1972 ; Atkinson et al., 2007 ) across eight configurable stages of a modern RAG pipeline ( Table 10 ), eight benchmarks ( Fig. 5 ), and corpus sizes from 5K to 200K documents, complemented by 138 non-factorial ablation configurations across 24 targeted experiments ( Appendix F ). Across the factorial, ablation suite, and scaling sweep, the central finding is that techniques that perform well separately do not consistently retain their gains inside a full pipeline, and the pattern differs between retrieval and faithfulness. Retrieval gains compose sub-additively: the three largest single-component improvements sum to a predicted + 47 % +47\% NDCG@10 gain, but the composed pipeline realizes only + 17 % +17\% ( Section D.14 ). Faithfulness gains compose near-additively: separately measured improvements approximately transfer to the full pipeline ( Table 47 ). Pipeline and generator also partly substitute: a stronger generator helps the lightest pipeline far more than the heaviest, so a heavier stack buys less when the generator is already strong ( Section F.9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用千层面（lasagna）研究 RAG 组合效应，采用 167 种配置的 D-最优设计（Fedorov et al., 1972; Atkinson et al., 2007），覆盖现代 RAG 流水线的八个可配置阶段（表 10）、八个基准（图 5），以及从 5K 到 200K 文档的语料库规模，并辅以跨 24 个针对性实验的 138 种非因子式消融配置（附录 F）。 在因子实验、消融套件和规模扫描中，核心发现是：单独表现良好的技术在完整流水线中并不总能保持其增益，且该模式在检索与忠实度之间有所不同。 检索增益呈次可加性组合：三个最大的单组件改进之和预测可带来 +47% 的 NDCG@10 增益，但组合后的流水线仅实现了 +17%（第 D.14 节）。 忠实度增益接近可加组合：单独测量的改进大致可以迁移到完整流水线中（表 47）。 流水线与生成器之间还存在部分替代关系：更强的生成器对最轻量流水线的帮助远大于对最重量级流水线的帮助，因此当生成器已经很强时，更重的技术堆栈带来的收益更少（第 F.9 节）。

paragraphs.en: Three practical implications follow. First, the components that improve retrieval are not the same as those that improve faithfulness, and optimizing one metric can hurt the other. Second, the four complete RAG profiles expose a Pareto tradeoff on retrieval quality, faithfulness, and response time, with no universal winner. Adding an agentic loop to a strong retrieval stack yields only a negligible faithfulness gain while hurting retrieval quality and latency. Across three other benchmarks at 100K–200K documents, lighter pipelines retain similar measured quality at 10 10 – 20 × 20\times lower latency ( Sections 5 and D.8 ). Third, corpus size shifts profile rankings: the design leading at small corpora trails by 13.7 % 13.7\% NDCG@10 at 200K, with a rank flip visible from 25K ( Fig. 4(a) ). Small-corpus rankings should therefore be rechecked at the intended scale. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 由此得出三点实践启示。 首先，能提升检索质量的组件与能提升忠实度的组件并不相同，优化其中一个指标可能会损害另一个。 其次，四种完整的 RAG 配置在检索质量、忠实度和响应时间上呈现出帕累托权衡，没有普遍的赢家。 在强大的检索组件之上添加智能体循环，仅带来可忽略的忠实度提升，同时损害检索质量并增加延迟。 在另外三个包含 10 万至 20 万文档的基准测试中，更轻量的流水线以低 10 到 20 倍的延迟保持了相近的实测质量（见第 5 节和 D.8 节）。 第三，语料库规模会改变配置排名：在小语料库上领先的方案在 20 万规模时 NDCG@10 落后 13.7%，且排名反转从 2.5 万规模起就已显现（图 4(a)）。 因此，应在目标规模下重新验证小语料库上的排名。我们的贡献如下：

sents.zh: 其次，四种完整的 RAG 配置在检索质量、忠实度和响应时间上呈现出帕累托权衡，没有普遍的赢家。

sents.en: Adding an agentic loop to a strong retrieval stack yields only a negligible faithfulness gain while hurting retrieval quality and latency.
sents.zh: 在强大的检索组件之上添加智能体循环，仅带来可忽略的忠实度提升，同时损害检索质量并增加延迟。

sents.en: Across three other benchmarks at 100K–200K documents, lighter pipelines retain similar measured quality at 10 10 – 20 × 20\times lower latency ( Sections 5 and D.8 ).
sents.zh: 在另外三个包含 10 万至 20 万文档的基准测试中，更轻量的流水线以低 10 到 20 倍的延迟保持了相近的实测质量（见第 5 节和 D.8 节）。

sents.en: Third, corpus size shifts profile rankings: the design leading at small corpora trails by 13.7 % 13.7\% NDCG@10 at 200K, with a rank flip visible from 25K ( Fig. 4(a) ).
sents.zh: 第三，语料库规模会改变配置排名：在小语料库上领先的方案在 20 万规模时 NDCG@10 落后 13.7%，且排名反转从 2.5 万规模起就已显现（图 4(a)）。

paragraphs.en: How RAG components compose. A compositional study of RAG across eight configurable stages, eight benchmarks, and corpora scales from 5K to 200K documents: 167 configurations from a D-optimal factorial plus 138 non-factorial configurations across 24 targeted ablations. The four operational RAG profiles that emerge ( speed , standard , balanced , max-reliable ) are calibrated to cost, latency, and performance.
paragraphs.zh: RAG 各组件如何组合。 一项针对 RAG 的组合式研究，涵盖八个可配置阶段、八个基准测试以及从 5K 到 20 万文档规模的语料库：包括来自 D 最优因子设计的 167 种配置，以及跨 24 项针对性消融实验的 138 种非因子配置。 由此浮现的四种运营型 RAG 档位（speed、standard、balanced、max-reliable）均针对成本、延迟和性能进行了校准。

paragraphs.en: lasagna . The open-source framework built to conduct and reproduce this study. It provides a modular, stage-isolated RAG pipeline and an evaluation harness that lets researchers add a method and test it with the surrounding stack ( Sections C.1 and F ).
paragraphs.zh: 千层面。 用于开展并复现本研究的开源框架。 它提供了一个模块化、阶段隔离的 RAG 流水线和一个评估工具，让研究人员能够添加一种方法，并用周围的整套组件进行测试（见 C.1 节和 F 节）。

sents.en: lasagna .
sents.zh: 千层面。

sents.en: The open-source framework built to conduct and reproduce this study.
sents.zh: 用于开展并复现本研究的开源框架。

sents.en: It provides a modular, stage-isolated RAG pipeline and an evaluation harness that lets researchers add a method and test it with the surrounding stack ( Sections C.1 and F ).
sents.zh: 它提供了一个模块化、阶段隔离的 RAG 流水线和一个评估工具，让研究人员能够添加一种方法，并用周围的整套组件进行测试（见 C.1 节和 F 节）。

paragraphs.en: Modern RAG spans a layered design space with plausible interaction points at every stage (full method catalog in Appendix K ). On retrieval , sparse baselines (BM25 ( Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009 ) ) coexist with dense encoders (BGE-M3 ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , E5 ( Wang et al., 2022 ) ), learned sparse encoders (SPLADE ( Formal et al., 2021 ) ), and late-interaction models (ColBERT ( Khattab & Zaharia, 2020 ) ), fused by reciprocal-rank fusion (RRF) ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) or learned hybrids. Reranking spans cross-encoder scorers trained on MS-MARCO ( Nogueira & Cho, 2019 ) , ensemble rerankers, and diversity-driven selection (MMR; Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998 ). Context compression is either token-budget aware (LLMLingua ( Jiang et al., 2023a ) ) or positional (lost-in-the-middle-aware selection ( Liu et al., 2024 ) ). Query augmentation rewrites the query before retrieval: HyDE ( Gao et al., 2023a ) drafts a hypothetical answer, RAG-Fusion ( Rackauckas, 2024 ) fans out multi-query variants, decomposition ( Khattab et al., 2024 ) splits multi-hop questions into sub-questions, and step-back prompting ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) abstracts before retrieving. Index-time processing enriches chunks before retrieval with document summaries (RAPTOR ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) ), contextual prefixes ( Anthropic, 2024 ) , or entity-graph indexes (GraphRAG ( Edge et al., 2024 ) ). Generation-time control adds correction and gating loops around the answer model (CRAG ( Yan et al., 2024 ) , Self-RAG ( Asai et al., 2024 ) , Speculative-RAG ( Wang et al., 2025 ) ). Each of these stages has been shown to help in isolation on some benchmark, but they compose along more edges than a single-component ablation can enumerate. We study how these choices combine once deployed together, and lasagna lets others ask compositionality questions in the same environment by registering a new component and evaluating it against a full modern pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 现代RAG涵盖一个分层的设计空间，在每个阶段都有合理的交互点（完整方法目录见附录K）。 在检索方面，稀疏基线（BM25（Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009））与稠密编码器（BGE-M3（Chen et al., 2024a）、E5（Wang et al., 2022））、学习型稀疏编码器（SPLADE（Formal et al., 2021））以及迟交互模型（ColBERT（Khattab & Zaharia, 2020））并存，并通过倒数排名融合（RRF）（Cormack et al., 2009）或学习型混合方法进行融合。 重排序涵盖在MS-MARCO上训练的交叉编码器打分器（Nogueira & Cho, 2019）、集成重排序器，以及多样性驱动的选择（MMR；Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998）。 上下文压缩要么是感知令牌预算的（LLMLingua（Jiang et al., 2023a）），要么是基于位置的（针对迷失在中间问题进行感知的选择（Liu et al., 2024））。 查询增强在检索前对查询进行改写：HyDE（Gao et al., 2023a）起草假设性答案，RAG-Fusion（Rackauckas, 2024）扇出多查询变体，分解法（Khattab et al., 2024）将多跳问题拆分为子问题，而后退提示（Zheng et al., 2024）在检索前先进行抽象。 索引时处理在检索前对文本块进行增强，包括文档摘要（RAPTOR（Sarthi et al., 2024））、上下文前缀（Anthropic, 2024）或实体图索引（GraphRAG（Edge et al., 2024））。 生成时控制在答案模型周围添加纠正与门控循环（CRAG（Yan et al., 2024）、Self-RAG（Asai et al., 2024）、Speculative-RAG（Wang et al., 2025））。 已有研究表明，这些阶段中的每一个在某些基准上单独使用时都有帮助，但它们之间的组合方式之多，远非单组件消融实验所能列举。 我们研究这些选择在共同部署后如何组合，而lasagna让其他人可以在同一环境中提出组合性问题：只需注册一个新组件，并将其与完整的现代流水线进行对比评估。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 positions lasagna against prior work that studies RAG beyond isolated components. Best-practice studies ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Barnett et al., 2024 ) search greedily for strong end-to-end configurations but do not estimate interaction effects. Benchmarking libraries such as BERGEN ( Rau et al., 2024 ) and FlashRAG ( Jin et al., 2025 ) support composition in a shared codebase but do not enforce the stage isolation that controlled interaction estimation requires, so measured differences cannot be cleanly attributed to the component being varied (a positional smoke run against both is reported in Section G.4 ). Automated configuration search ( Kim et al., 2024 ) optimizes over configurations but reports only the winning setting, not the interaction structure that produced it, so the resulting guidance does not transfer when any assumption changes. Evaluation suites ( Krishna et al., 2025 ) and domain benchmarks ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) supply metrics and tasks but not a common pipeline in which those metrics can be compared across controlled compositions. Generation-time controls ( Yan et al., 2024 ) strengthen the agentic layer but are usually tested with retrieval fixed, leaving composition with a tuned stack untested.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 将 lasagna 与研究超出孤立组件之外的 RAG 的先前工作进行了对比。 最佳实践研究（Wang et al., 2024；Barnett et al., 2024）贪心地搜索强大的端到端配置，但不估计交互效应。 诸如 BERGEN（Rau et al., 2024）和 FlashRAG（Jin et al., 2025）之类的基准测试库在共享代码库中支持组合，但不强制执行受控交互估计所需的阶段隔离，因此测得的差异无法干净地归因于被变化的组件（针对两者的位置性冒烟测试见第 G.4 节）。 自动化配置搜索（Kim et al., 2024）对配置进行优化，但只报告获胜的设置，而不是产生它的交互结构，因此当任何假设发生变化时，所得的指导无法迁移。 评估套件（Krishna et al., 2025）和领域基准（Xiong et al., 2024）提供了指标和任务，但没有提供可以在受控组合之间比较这些指标的通用流程。 生成时控制（Yan et al., 2024）增强了智能体层，但通常在检索固定的情况下进行测试，使得与调优后的技术栈的组合未经测试。

paragraphs.en: lasagna is an open-source framework for evaluating new RAG components inside a complete modern pipeline. A researcher proposing a new reranker, chunker, or agentic loop today must either compare against a stripped-down baseline that does not reflect a modern pipeline, or reimplement the surrounding stack. The first biases the conclusion by mixing implementation differences with algorithmic ones; the second is prohibitively expensive and rarely attempted. lasagna provides a configurable end-to-end pipeline ( Fig. 1a ) with a fixed interface per stage that the framework enforces, so a new component drops into one stage and is measured against the same surrounding stack used by every reported configuration (full code patterns in Sections H.2.2 , H.2.3 and H.2.4 ). The workflow spans nine processing stages: document processing, chunking, index-time enrichment, embedding and indexing, query augmentation, retrieval, reranking, context compression, and answer generation with optional agentic verification. Every pipeline component is a subclass of a typed abstract base class: eight component types are supported ( embedder , chunker , reranker , retriever , document_processor , query_enhancer , agentic_pipeline , and generator ), each stage’s inputs and outputs are typed dataclass contracts, and behavioral tests check that swapping one implementation does not mutate a neighboring stage’s state. A single @registry.register("<stage>", "<name>") decorator suffices to make a new component discoverable at YAML-config time. The framework ships with 53 built-in components, the 30 methods across the eight factorial dimensions ( Table 10 ; full catalog in Appendix K ), six vector backends (Milvus, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch), and adapters for the eight benchmarks used here (five BEIR retrieval sets and three long-form QA sets; Section B.2 ). Five automated isolation tests ( Section H.1 ) check that toggling one component does not silently change another, including that two sessions with opposite settings each keep their own configuration; this supports attributing the interaction estimates in Section 5 to the components we vary rather than to cross-stage leakage. A new component becomes a publishable comparison in three steps ( Fig. 2 ): register with a decorator, declare a factorial sweep in YAML, and run end-to-end to receive a paired statistical test against the same surrounding stack that produced every reported number.
paragraphs.zh: lasagna 是一个开源框架，用于在完整的现代化流水线中评估新的 RAG 组件。 如今，提出新重排序器、分块器或智能体循环的研究者，要么只能与不能反映现代流水线的简化基线进行比较，要么必须重新实现周边的整套技术栈。 前者将实现差异与算法差异混在一起，从而使结论产生偏差；后者的代价过高，很少有人尝试。lasagna 提供了一个可配置的端到端流水线（图 1a），其中每个阶段都有由框架强制执行的固定接口，因此新组件只需放入其中一个阶段，即可在与所有已报告配置相同的周边技术栈上进行度量（完整代码模式见 H.2.2、H.2.3 和 H.2.4 节）。 该工作流涵盖九个处理阶段：文档处理、分块、索引期增强、嵌入与索引、查询增强、检索、重排序、上下文压缩，以及带有可选智能体验证的答案生成。 每个流水线组件都是一个类型化抽象基类的子类：框架支持八种组件类型（embedder、chunker、reranker、retriever、document_processor、query_enhancer、agentic_pipeline 和 generator），每个阶段的输入与输出均为类型化 dataclass 契约，并且通过行为测试来检查替换某个实现不会改变相邻阶段的状态。 只需一个 @registry.register("<stage>", "<name>") 装饰器，即可让新组件在 YAML 配置时被自动发现。 该框架自带 53 个内置组件，覆盖八个析因维度上的 30 个方法（表 10；完整目录见附录 K）、六个向量后端（Milvus、Pinecone、Qdrant、Weaviate、pgvector、OpenSearch），以及本文使用的八个基准的适配器（五个 BEIR 检索数据集和三个长文本问答数据集；见 B.2 节）。 五项自动化隔离测试（H.1 节）用于检查切换某个组件不会悄悄改变另一个组件，其中包括验证两个设置相反的会话各自保持自己的配置；这支持将第 5 节中的交互效应估计归因于我们所变化的组件，而非跨阶段泄漏。 新组件只需三步即可成为可发表的对比结果（图 2）：用装饰器注册、在 YAML 中声明析因扫描，然后运行端到端流程，即可获得针对同一周边技术栈的配对统计检验，而所有已报告的数字都产生自该技术栈。

sents.en: lasagna is an open-source framework for evaluating new RAG components inside a complete modern pipeline.
sents.zh: lasagna 是一个开源框架，用于在完整的现代化流水线中评估新的 RAG 组件。

sents.en: A researcher proposing a new reranker, chunker, or agentic loop today must either compare against a stripped-down baseline that does not reflect a modern pipeline, or reimplement the surrounding stack.
sents.zh: 如今，提出新重排序器、分块器或智能体循环的研究者，要么只能与不能反映现代流水线的简化基线进行比较，要么必须重新实现周边的整套技术栈。

sents.en: The first biases the conclusion by mixing implementation differences with algorithmic ones; the second is prohibitively expensive and rarely attempted. lasagna provides a configurable end-to-end pipeline ( Fig. 1a ) with a fixed interface per stage that the framework enforces, so a new component drops into one stage and is measured against the same surrounding stack used by every reported configuration (full code patterns in Sections H.2.2 , H.2.3 and H.2.4 ).
sents.zh: 前者将实现差异与算法差异混在一起，从而使结论产生偏差；后者的代价过高，很少有人尝试。lasagna 提供了一个可配置的端到端流水线（图 1a），其中每个阶段都有由框架强制执行的固定接口，因此新组件只需放入其中一个阶段，即可在与所有已报告配置相同的周边技术栈上进行度量（完整代码模式见 H.2.2、H.2.3 和 H.2.4 节）。

sents.en: The workflow spans nine processing stages: document processing, chunking, index-time enrichment, embedding and indexing, query augmentation, retrieval, reranking, context compression, and answer generation with optional agentic verification.
sents.zh: 该工作流涵盖九个处理阶段：文档处理、分块、索引期增强、嵌入与索引、查询增强、检索、重排序、上下文压缩，以及带有可选智能体验证的答案生成。

sents.en: Every pipeline component is a subclass of a typed abstract base class: eight component types are supported ( embedder , chunker , reranker , retriever , document_processor , query_enhancer , agentic_pipeline , and generator ), each stage’s inputs and outputs are typed dataclass contracts, and behavioral tests check that swapping one implementation does not mutate a neighboring stage’s state.
sents.zh: 每个流水线组件都是一个类型化抽象基类的子类：框架支持八种组件类型（embedder、chunker、reranker、retriever、document_processor、query_enhancer、agentic_pipeline 和 generator），每个阶段的输入与输出均为类型化 dataclass 契约，并且通过行为测试来检查替换某个实现不会改变相邻阶段的状态。

sents.en: A single @registry.register("<stage>", "<name>") decorator suffices to make a new component discoverable at YAML-config time.
sents.zh: 只需一个 @registry.register("<stage>", "<name>") 装饰器，即可让新组件在 YAML 配置时被自动发现。

sents.en: The framework ships with 53 built-in components, the 30 methods across the eight factorial dimensions ( Table 10 ; full catalog in Appendix K ), six vector backends (Milvus, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch), and adapters for the eight benchmarks used here (five BEIR retrieval sets and three long-form QA sets; Section B.2 ).
sents.zh: 该框架自带 53 个内置组件，覆盖八个析因维度上的 30 个方法（表 10；完整目录见附录 K）、六个向量后端（Milvus、Pinecone、Qdrant、Weaviate、pgvector、OpenSearch），以及本文使用的八个基准的适配器（五个 BEIR 检索数据集和三个长文本问答数据集；见 B.2 节）。

sents.en: Five automated isolation tests ( Section H.1 ) check that toggling one component does not silently change another, including that two sessions with opposite settings each keep their own configuration; this supports attributing the interaction estimates in Section 5 to the components we vary rather than to cross-stage leakage.
sents.zh: 五项自动化隔离测试（H.1 节）用于检查切换某个组件不会悄悄改变另一个组件，其中包括验证两个设置相反的会话各自保持自己的配置；这支持将第 5 节中的交互效应估计归因于我们所变化的组件，而非跨阶段泄漏。

sents.en: A new component becomes a publishable comparison in three steps ( Fig. 2 ): register with a decorator, declare a factorial sweep in YAML, and run end-to-end to receive a paired statistical test against the same surrounding stack that produced every reported number.
sents.zh: 新组件只需三步即可成为可发表的对比结果（图 2）：用装饰器注册、在 YAML 中声明析因扫描，然后运行端到端流程，即可获得针对同一周边技术栈的配对统计检验，而所有已报告的数字都产生自该技术栈。

paragraphs.en: The complete study, factorial plus 138 non-factorial ablations plus the 5K–200K scaling sweep, cost approximately $5,200 in cloud compute and 310 wall-clock hours ( Section A.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 完整的研究，包括因子实验加上 138 个非因子消融实验以及 5K–200K 的缩放扫描，大约花费了 5,200 美元的云计算费用和 310 小时的实际运行时间（第 A.7 节）。

paragraphs.en: A dimension is one of the eight experimental factors ( Table 10 ); default_standard is the framework’s stock RAG pipeline (a simple, lowest-cost setting on each dimension) that serves as the starting baseline for our experiments; a profile is one of the four operational RAG compositions we distill from our factorial and ablation sweeps as the best-observed configurations targeting distinct points on the retrieval-faithfulness-latency envelope ( speed , standard , balanced , max-reliable ; full specifications in Section I.1 ); a track is one of the two evaluation surfaces (retrieval or end-to-end). We evaluate on both tracks because retrieval quality (whether the right documents are retrieved) and answer faithfulness (whether the generated answer is grounded in the retrieved context) measure distinct properties of a RAG pipeline, and different applications weight them differently. We report the joint quality-latency envelope as a hypervolume HV ⁡ ( L ref ) = NDCG ​ @ ​ 10 × Faith × max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − latency / L ref ) \mathrm{HV}(L_{\mathrm{ref}})=\mathrm{NDCG@10}\times\mathrm{Faith}\times\max(0,1-\mathrm{latency}/L_{\mathrm{ref}}) ( Zitzler et al., 2003 ) at L ref = 30 L_{\mathrm{ref}}{=}30 s (a fixed response-time reference; Table 2 ); HV values under other fixed references are in Table 39 . We report marginal effect sizes as η 2 \eta^{2} ; larger values indicate stronger associations with variation in the metric (full statistics in Sections D.2 and D.11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 维度（dimension）是八个实验因子之一（表 10）；default_standard 是该框架自带的 RAG 流水线（在各维度上采用简单、最低成本的设置），作为我们实验的起始基线；画像（profile）是我们从因子扫描和消融扫描中提炼出的四种可运行 RAG 组合之一，它们是在检索—忠实性—延迟包络上针对不同目标点观察到的最优配置（speed、standard、balanced、max-reliable；完整规格见第 I.1 节）；赛道（track）是两个评估面之一（检索或端到端）。 我们在两条赛道上都进行评估，因为检索质量（是否检索到正确的文档）与答案忠实性（生成的答案是否立足于检索到的上下文）衡量的是 RAG 流水线的不同属性，而不同应用对二者的权重各不相同。 我们以超体积 HV(L_ref) = NDCG@10 × Faith × max(0, 1 − latency / L_ref)（Zitzler 等，2003）报告质量—延迟联合包络，其中 L_ref = 30 秒（固定的响应时间参考值；表 2）；其他固定参考值下的 HV 数值见表 39。 我们以 η² 报告边际效应量；数值越大表示与指标变化的关联越强（完整统计结果见第 D.2 节和第 D.11 节）。

paragraphs.en: The configuration space spans eight experimental dimensions, with 2–5 levels each ( Fig. 1 b, Table 10 ). The full factorial of 4 × 4 × 4 × 3 × 5 × 4 × 2 × 4 = 30,720 4{\times}4{\times}4{\times}3{\times}5{\times}4{\times}2{\times}4=30{,}720 configurations would exceed ∼ \sim 40,000 GPU-hours and ∼ \sim $600,000 in LLM API costs (extrapolating from the executed 167-configuration budget of 247 GPU-hours and $5,200; Section A.7 ), roughly two orders of magnitude beyond our resources, so we draw a 242-run D-optimal subset via Fedorov coordinate exchange ( Fedorov et al., 1972 ) , sized to keep all main effects and all 28 dimension-pair interactions estimable under our budget. Of the 242 planned runs, 167 were executed: 63 GraphRAG-enriched runs were dropped after an isolated ablation showed no measurable NDCG@10 change despite the ∼ 2 × {\sim}2\times latency the enrichment added ( Table 11 ), and 12 failed on timeout limits. Design-matrix construction, aliasing diagnostics, and the identifiability audit for the pre-declared joint 28-two-way test appear in Sections A.4 , A.5 and D.3 . Each dimension uses a simple, lowest-cost baseline; pre-registration deviations appear in Table 12 .
paragraphs.zh: 该配置空间涵盖八个实验维度，每个维度有 2–5 个水平（图 1b、表 10）。 4 × 4 × 4 × 3 × 5 × 4 × 2 × 4 = 30,720 4{\times}4{\times}4{\times}3{\times}5{\times}4{\times}2{\times}4=30{,}720 个配置的全因子实验将耗费约 ∼ \sim 40,000 GPU 小时和约 ∼ \sim 600,000 美元的大语言模型 API 成本（根据已执行的 167 个配置所用的 247 GPU 小时和 5,200 美元外推；见第 A.7 节），大约超出我们资源两个数量级，因此我们通过 Fedorov 坐标交换法（Fedorov 等人，1972）抽取了一个 242 次运行的 D-最优子集，其规模确保在预算范围内所有主效应及全部 28 个维度两两交互项均可估计。 在计划的 242 次运行中，实际执行了 167 次：在单独的消融实验显示富集带来的约 2 倍延迟并未产生可测量的 NDCG@10 变化后，63 次 GraphRAG 富集运行被舍弃（表 11），另有 12 次因超时限制而失败。 设计矩阵构建、混杂诊断，以及针对预先声明的 28 个两两交互联合检验的可辨识性审计见第 A.4、A.5 和 D.3 节。 每个维度采用简单的最低成本基线；与预注册的偏差见表 12。

paragraphs.en: Production RAG deployments operate against heterogeneous knowledge bases where a single retriever must disambiguate biomedical, financial, scientific, argumentative, and multi-hop queries from one shared vector store. Per-benchmark evaluation (the BEIR default; Thakur et al., 2021 ) under-tests this cross-domain distractor pressure. We therefore unify our eight evaluation benchmarks into one corpus: five BEIR sets cover retrieval (NFCorpus, Boteva et al., 2016 ; FiQA, Maia et al., 2018 ; SciFact, Wadden et al., 2020 ; ArguAna, Wachsmuth et al., 2018 ; HotpotQA, Yang et al., 2018 ) and three QA sets cover generation (SQuAD v2, Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ; MuSiQue, Trivedi et al., 2022 ), yielding 149 stratified queries per configuration ( Sections B.2 , B.1 , 17 , 16 and 15 ). Each configuration is evaluated on two tracks: retrieval (BEIR qrels over 5,132 documents, 93 queries) and end-to-end generation (the same corpus augmented with gold passages, 5,566 documents, 56 queries). Beyond the 167-run factorial, we additionally ran 138 non-factorial ablation configurations across 24 targeted experiments spanning rerankers, embeddings, chunkers, query augmentation, and the number of agentic verification iterations ( Appendix F ). Together with the corpus-scaling sweep ( 5 5 K– 200 200 K), the study records approximately 358,215 individual query evaluations, including repeated RAGAS evaluation tasks for the same queries ( Section A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 生产级 RAG 部署面向异构知识库运行，单一检索器必须从同一个共享向量库中区分生物医学、金融、科学、论辩以及多跳查询。 按单个基准进行评估（BEIR 的默认做法；Thakur et al., 2021）低估了这种跨域干扰项带来的压力。 因此，我们将八个评估基准统一到一个语料库中：五个 BEIR 数据集覆盖检索（NFCorpus, Boteva et al., 2016；FiQA, Maia et al., 2018；SciFact, Wadden et al., 2020；ArguAna, Wachsmuth et al., 2018；HotpotQA, Yang et al., 2018），三个问答数据集覆盖生成（SQuAD v2, Rajpurkar et al., 2018；MuSiQue, Trivedi et al., 2022），每种配置共产生 149 个分层查询（第 B.2、B.1、17、16 和 15 节）。 每种配置在两条轨道上评估：检索（基于 5,132 篇文档、93 个查询的 BEIR qrels）和端到端生成（同一语料库并加入金标准段落，共 5,566 篇文档、56 个查询）。 在 167 次运行的因子实验之外，我们还额外运行了 138 个非因子消融配置，涵盖 24 项目标实验，涉及重排序器、嵌入、分块器、查询增强以及智能体验证迭代次数（附录 F）。 连同语料库规模扫描（5 5 K–200 200 K），本研究共记录了约 358,215 次单个查询评估，其中包括对相同查询的重复 RAGAS 评估任务（第 A.1 节）。

sents.en: Production RAG deployments operate against heterogeneous knowledge bases where a single retriever must disambiguate biomedical, financial, scientific, argumentative, and multi-hop queries from one shared vector store.

sents.en: Per-benchmark evaluation (the BEIR default; Thakur et al., 2021 ) under-tests this cross-domain distractor pressure.
sents.zh: 按单个基准进行评估（BEIR 的默认做法；Thakur et al., 2021）低估了这种跨域干扰项带来的压力。

sents.en: We therefore unify our eight evaluation benchmarks into one corpus: five BEIR sets cover retrieval (NFCorpus, Boteva et al., 2016 ; FiQA, Maia et al., 2018 ; SciFact, Wadden et al., 2020 ; ArguAna, Wachsmuth et al., 2018 ; HotpotQA, Yang et al., 2018 ) and three QA sets cover generation (SQuAD v2, Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ; MuSiQue, Trivedi et al., 2022 ), yielding 149 stratified queries per configuration ( Sections B.2 , B.1 , 17 , 16 and 15 ).
sents.zh: 因此，我们将八个评估基准统一到一个语料库中：五个 BEIR 数据集覆盖检索（NFCorpus, Boteva et al., 2016；FiQA, Maia et al., 2018；SciFact, Wadden et al., 2020；ArguAna, Wachsmuth et al., 2018；HotpotQA, Yang et al., 2018），三个问答数据集覆盖生成（SQuAD v2, Rajpurkar et al., 2018；MuSiQue, Trivedi et al., 2022），每种配置共产生 149 个分层查询（第 B.2、B.1、17、16 和 15 节）。

sents.en: Each configuration is evaluated on two tracks: retrieval (BEIR qrels over 5,132 documents, 93 queries) and end-to-end generation (the same corpus augmented with gold passages, 5,566 documents, 56 queries).
sents.zh: 每种配置在两条轨道上评估：检索（基于 5,132 篇文档、93 个查询的 BEIR qrels）和端到端生成（同一语料库并加入金标准段落，共 5,566 篇文档、56 个查询）。

sents.en: Beyond the 167-run factorial, we additionally ran 138 non-factorial ablation configurations across 24 targeted experiments spanning rerankers, embeddings, chunkers, query augmentation, and the number of agentic verification iterations ( Appendix F ).
sents.zh: 在 167 次运行的因子实验之外，我们还额外运行了 138 个非因子消融配置，涵盖 24 项目标实验，涉及重排序器、嵌入、分块器、查询增强以及智能体验证迭代次数（附录 F）。

sents.en: Together with the corpus-scaling sweep ( 5 5 K– 200 200 K), the study records approximately 358,215 individual query evaluations, including repeated RAGAS evaluation tasks for the same queries ( Section A.1 ).
sents.zh: 连同语料库规模扫描（5 5 K–200 200 K），本研究共记录了约 358,215 次单个查询评估，其中包括对相同查询的重复 RAGAS 评估任务（第 A.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end generation runs report faithfulness and answer relevance (RAGAS v0.4 ( Es et al., 2024 ) judged by GPT-5.1); NDCG@10, exact match, token-level F1, and p50/p95 latency and $/query; GPT-5.1 also generates answers for all configurations. NDCG@10 follows the BEIR convention ( Thakur et al., 2021 ) : retrieved chunks are de-duplicated by parent document ID before scoring, so the metric matches the document-level qrel grain. A two-annotator human evaluation validates RAGAS faithfulness ( Sections C.4 , C.5 and 29 ), and a two-judge sensitivity analysis (GPT-5.1 vs. Claude Sonnet 4.5) shows that judge choice shifts absolute faithfulness but preserves profile ranking, so we treat single-judge point estimates as approximate and rely on ordinal comparisons for all headline claims ( Section F.7 ). Its moderate agreement with the primary judge (Pearson r = 0.44 r{=}0.44 , Cohen’s κ = 0.35 \kappa{=}0.35 ) supports the same conclusion: relative trends persist, although exact faithfulness scores depend on the judge. paragraphs.en: Most published RAG ablations tune one component at a time on a single benchmark at ≤ 50 \leq 50 K corpus, and report the resulting gain as a recommended configuration. We pre-declared ( van Miltenburg et al., 2021 ; Forde & Paganini, 2019 ) three hypotheses that together test whether this methodology is sound, by asking whether RAG pipelines can be designed compositionally: H1 tests additivity (the assumption behind isolated single-component ablations), H2 tests profile generality (the assumption that a single balanced recipe deploys across targets), and H3 tests scale invariance (the assumption that rankings measured on small corpora persist at larger corpus scales). The full pre-registration (operational definitions, statistical thresholds, exclusion criteria, post-hoc corrections) is reproduced in Section A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 大多数已发表的 RAG 消融研究都在单个不超过 50 \leq 50 K 规模的语料库上一次只调优一个组件，并将由此得到的收益作为推荐配置加以报告。 我们预先声明（van Miltenburg et al., 2021；Forde & Paganini, 2019）了三个假设，通过询问 RAG 流水线能否以组合方式设计，共同检验这种方法论是否可靠：H1 检验可加性（孤立的单组件消融背后的假设），H2 检验配置的通用性（即单一均衡配方可跨目标部署的假设），H3 检验规模不变性（即在小语料库上测得的排序在更大语料库规模下依然成立的假设）。 完整的预注册内容（操作性定义、统计阈值、排除标准、事后校正）复现于 A.2 节。

paragraphs.en: Components do not necessarily combine additively. H1 tests whether two-way interactions among the eight experimental dimensions explain at least 20 % 20\% of faithfulness variance. If they do, gains measured in isolation cannot be assumed to persist when components are combined.
paragraphs.zh: 各组件的组合未必是简单相加的。 H1 检验八个实验维度之间的双向交互作用是否能解释至少 20% 的忠实度方差。 如果能解释，则不能假设单独测量所得的收益在组件组合后仍然保持。

paragraphs.en: A single RAG composition can span multiple deployment targets. RAG designs face a Pareto tradeoff: retrieval quality, faithfulness, and response time cannot be maximized jointly, so practitioners typically re-run configuration search per deployment. H2 asks whether an intermediate RAG composition sweeps a wider quality / latency / cost hypervolume than adding more advanced components does, on a majority of datasets, covering enough of the Pareto surface that one published recipe serves multiple targets. Rejecting H2 means each deployment must hand-tune its own operating point (formalism and correction: Section A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 单一的 RAG 组合可以跨越多个部署目标。 RAG 设计面临帕累托权衡：检索质量、忠实度与响应时间无法同时最大化，因此从业者通常需要针对每个部署重新运行配置搜索。 H2 询问的是：在大多数数据集上，一个中间的 RAG 组合所扫过的质量 / 延迟 / 成本超体积，是否比添加更先进的组件所扫过的更宽，从而足够覆盖帕累托曲面，使得一个已发表的方案可以服务于多个目标。 拒绝 H2 意味着每个部署都必须手动调整自己的工作点（形式化与修正见附录 A.2）。

sents.en: A single RAG composition can span multiple deployment targets.
sents.zh: 单一的 RAG 组合可以跨越多个部署目标。

paragraphs.en: Composition rankings shift with corpus scale. Most RAG ablations in the literature run at 5K to 50K documents, but production deployments often serve corpora an order of magnitude larger. H3 asks whether the ranking of RAG compositions at 5K matches their ranking at 200K on the same corpus; if it does not, small-corpus rankings do not transfer across scale, and design decisions measured at one scale must be revalidated at the target scale. Confirming H3 means small-corpus benchmarks are methodologically suspect as scale-invariant selectors of RAG designs; rejecting it validates them as predictive across the scales tested (per-composition log-linear fits, slope-range threshold, bootstrap CIs, and Kendall’s τ \tau rank-flip test in Section A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 构成方式的排名随语料库规模而变化。 文献中的大多数 RAG 消融实验都在 5K 到 50K 篇文档的规模上进行，但生产环境部署所服务的语料库往往要大一个数量级。 H3 询问的是：在同一语料库上，RAG 各构成方式在 5K 规模下的排名是否与它们在 200K 规模下的排名一致；如果不一致，那么小语料库上的排名就无法跨规模迁移，且在某一规模下测得的设计决策必须在目标规模下重新验证。 证实 H3 意味着小语料库基准作为 RAG 设计的规模不变性选择工具在方法上是可疑的；否定 H3 则验证了它们在所测试的规模范围内具有预测力（各构成方式的对数线性拟合、斜率范围阈值、自助法置信区间，以及 A.2 节中的 Kendall's τ \tau 排名翻转检验）。

sents.en: Composition rankings shift with corpus scale.

paragraphs.en: Across the factorial and targeted tests, some techniques reinforce one another, some add roughly as expected, and others overlap or interfere ( Fig. 3 ). Thus, improvements measured by changing one pipeline stage at a time do not reliably add up in a complete RAG pipeline. We quantify this by comparing the gain predicted from separately measured improvements with the gain the combined pipeline actually delivers. This needs only the configurations the study already runs, whereas estimating all 28 28 pairwise interactions directly requires 232 232 parameters, more than a design of this size can support ( Section D.3 ). The three largest separately measured retrieval gains, from cross-encoder reranking, disabling MMR, and document-awareness prefixes, predict a + 46.6 % +46.6\% lift over the default_standard baseline (NDCG@10 = 0.412 =0.412 ; Table 32 ). On this same split a BM25-only retriever scores 0.403 0.403 and a recommended off-the-shelf dense encoder 0.436 0.436 ( Table 60 ), so this is a realistic starting point, not a weak one. The balanced pipeline, which combines these techniques, realizes only + 17.2 % +17.2\% , a 63 % 63\% shortfall relative to the three-technique prediction. Including all five separately positive retrieval techniques raises the shortfall to 72 % 72\% ( Fig. 9 ); across 17 tested combinations, it ranges from 7 % 7\% to 72 % 72\% , with a median of 41 % 41\% ( Sections D.14 and D.12 ). The ablations suggest partial functional overlap: reranking already provides some of the filtering benefit obtained by disabling MMR, leaving less room for the two techniques to help when combined. The target metric matters as well: embedding, enrichment, and reranking dominate the retrieval-quality metric, whereas query augmentation and agentic gating dominate the answer-faithfulness metric, which measures whether generated claims are supported by the retrieved context. Across matched pipeline configurations, the two metrics are essentially unrelated ( Fig. 7 ; pooled Pearson r = − 0.01 r=-0.01 , p = 0.91 p=0.91 ): 5 % 5\% of configurations combine high faithfulness with low retrieval quality, and 6 % 6\% show high retrieval quality with low faithfulness. The same near-zero relationship appears when each benchmark is examined separately, removing the concern that the near-zero correlation is caused by pooling benchmarks ( Section D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在全因子测试和定向测试中，一些技术相互增强，一些大致按预期叠加，另一些则相互重叠或干扰（图3）。 因此，通过一次只改变一个流水线阶段所测得的改进，并不能可靠地在完整的RAG流水线中叠加。 我们通过比较由单独测量的改进所预测的增益与组合流水线实际交付的增益来量化这一点。 这只需要该研究已经在运行的配置，而直接估计所有28个成对交互需要232个参数，超出了这种规模的设计所能支持的范围（D.3节）。 三个最大的单独测得的检索增益——来自交叉编码器重排序、禁用MMR以及文档感知前缀——预测相对于default_standard基线（NDCG@10 = 0.412；表32）有 +46.6% 的提升。 在同一数据划分上，仅用BM25的检索器得分为0.403，一个推荐的现成稠密编码器得分为0.436（表60），因此这是一个现实的起点，而非薄弱起点。 结合这些技术的均衡流水线仅实现了 +17.2%，相对于三种技术的预测有 63% 的缺口。 把五个单独为正的检索技术全部纳入后，缺口扩大到 72%（图9）；在17个测试过的组合中，缺口介于 7% 到 72% 之间，中位数为 41%（D.14节和D.12节）。 消融实验表明存在部分功能重叠：重排序已经提供了禁用MMR所能获得的部分过滤收益，使得两种技术组合使用时的提升空间变小。 目标指标也很重要：嵌入、增强和重排序主导检索质量指标，而查询扩充和智能体门控主导答案忠实度指标，后者衡量生成的论断是否得到检索上下文的支持。 在匹配的流水线配置中，这两个指标基本不相关（图7；合并后的 Pearson r = −0.01，p = 0.91）：5% 的配置兼具高忠实度和低检索质量，6% 的配置呈现高检索质量但低忠实度。 当单独考察每个基准时，也出现同样的近零关系，从而排除了近零相关是由合并基准所致的担忧（D.2节）。

sents.en: We quantify this by comparing the gain predicted from separately measured improvements with the gain the combined pipeline actually delivers.
sents.zh: 我们通过比较由单独测量的改进所预测的增益与组合流水线实际交付的增益来量化这一点。

sents.en: This needs only the configurations the study already runs, whereas estimating all 28 28 pairwise interactions directly requires 232 232 parameters, more than a design of this size can support ( Section D.3 ).
sents.zh: 这只需要该研究已经在运行的配置，而直接估计所有28个成对交互需要232个参数，超出了这种规模的设计所能支持的范围（D.3节）。

sents.en: The three largest separately measured retrieval gains, from cross-encoder reranking, disabling MMR, and document-awareness prefixes, predict a + 46.6 % +46.6\% lift over the default_standard baseline (NDCG@10 = 0.412 =0.412 ; Table 32 ).
sents.zh: 三个最大的单独测得的检索增益——来自交叉编码器重排序、禁用MMR以及文档感知前缀——预测相对于default_standard基线（NDCG@10 = 0.412；表32）有 +46.6% 的提升。

sents.en: On this same split a BM25-only retriever scores 0.403 0.403 and a recommended off-the-shelf dense encoder 0.436 0.436 ( Table 60 ), so this is a realistic starting point, not a weak one.
sents.zh: 在同一数据划分上，仅用BM25的检索器得分为0.403，一个推荐的现成稠密编码器得分为0.436（表60），因此这是一个现实的起点，而非薄弱起点。

sents.en: The balanced pipeline, which combines these techniques, realizes only + 17.2 % +17.2\% , a 63 % 63\% shortfall relative to the three-technique prediction.
sents.zh: 结合这些技术的均衡流水线仅实现了 +17.2%，相对于三种技术的预测有 63% 的缺口。

sents.en: Including all five separately positive retrieval techniques raises the shortfall to 72 % 72\% ( Fig. 9 ); across 17 tested combinations, it ranges from 7 % 7\% to 72 % 72\% , with a median of 41 % 41\% ( Sections D.14 and D.12 ).
sents.zh: 把五个单独为正的检索技术全部纳入后，缺口扩大到 72%（图9）；在17个测试过的组合中，缺口介于 7% 到 72% 之间，中位数为 41%（D.14节和D.12节）。

sents.en: The ablations suggest partial functional overlap: reranking already provides some of the filtering benefit obtained by disabling MMR, leaving less room for the two techniques to help when combined.
sents.zh: 消融实验表明存在部分功能重叠：重排序已经提供了禁用MMR所能获得的部分过滤收益，使得两种技术组合使用时的提升空间变小。

sents.en: The target metric matters as well: embedding, enrichment, and reranking dominate the retrieval-quality metric, whereas query augmentation and agentic gating dominate the answer-faithfulness metric, which measures whether generated claims are supported by the retrieved context.
sents.zh: 目标指标也很重要：嵌入、增强和重排序主导检索质量指标，而查询扩充和智能体门控主导答案忠实度指标，后者衡量生成的论断是否得到检索上下文的支持。

sents.en: Across matched pipeline configurations, the two metrics are essentially unrelated ( Fig. 7 ; pooled Pearson r = − 0.01 r=-0.01 , p = 0.91 p=0.91 ): 5 % 5\% of configurations combine high faithfulness with low retrieval quality, and 6 % 6\% show high retrieval quality with low faithfulness.
sents.zh: 在匹配的流水线配置中，这两个指标基本不相关（图7；合并后的 Pearson r = −0.01，p = 0.91）：5% 的配置兼具高忠实度和低检索质量，6% 的配置呈现高检索质量但低忠实度。

sents.en: The same near-zero relationship appears when each benchmark is examined separately, removing the concern that the near-zero correlation is caused by pooling benchmarks ( Section D.2 ).
sents.zh: 当单独考察每个基准时，也出现同样的近零关系，从而排除了近零相关是由合并基准所致的担忧（D.2节）。

paragraphs.en: This indicates that RAG pipeline selection must evaluate both metrics: selecting a pipeline based only on the retrieval metric can yield strong retrieval but weakly grounded answers, while selecting one based only on the faithfulness metric can hide poor retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 这表明 RAG 流水线的选择必须同时评估这两项指标：仅基于检索指标选择流水线可能会带来很强的检索效果，但答案的依据性较弱；而仅基于忠实度指标选择流水线则可能掩盖检索不佳的问题。

paragraphs.en: On the retrieval track ( Fig. 3 , upper triangle; n = 167 n{=}167 configurations), the largest marginal associations are embedding ( η 2 = 0.164 \eta^{2}=0.164 ), enrichment ( η 2 = 0.144 \eta^{2}=0.144 ), and reranking ( η 2 = 0.090 \eta^{2}=0.090 ). These unadjusted values are used for exploratory screening and are not additive because the D-optimal design is unbalanced and the effects share variance. Compression and agentic gate contribute negligibly ( η 2 < 0.01 \eta^{2}<0.01 each). Two two-way interactions survive both Bonferroni and Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction: Embedding × \times Enrichment ( η 2 = 0.102 \eta^{2}=0.102 ) and Embedding × \times Reranking ( η 2 = 0.110 \eta^{2}=0.110 ). Both survivors involve the embedding model. We attribute Embedding × \times Enrichment to representation capacity: stronger embedders can encode added context without diluting the original passage. We attribute Embedding × \times Reranking to candidate-set quality: rerankers have less room to help when the initial embedding already retrieves strong candidates ( Sections J.3.1 and J.3.2 ). MMR reduces NDCG@10 by 3.6 % 3.6\% relative on average, opposite its usual benefit on broad, heterogeneous corpora ( Table 44 ). We hypothesize that on focused-domain corpora passages with high lexical and semantic overlap are often the same supporting evidence, so MMR’s diversity penalty demotes them in favor of topically distant ones (see Sections D.12 and D.13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在检索赛道（图 3，上三角；n = 167 \n{=}167 种配置）中，边际关联最大的是嵌入（\eta^{2}=0.164）、富集（\eta^{2}=0.144）和重排序（\eta^{2}=0.090）。 这些未经调整的数值用于探索性筛选，由于 D 最优设计不均衡且各效应共享方差，它们不具有可加性。 压缩和智能体门控的贡献可忽略不计（各自的 \eta^{2}<0.01）。 有两个双向交互在 Bonferroni 校正和 Benjamini–Hochberg FDR 校正下均存活：嵌入 × 富集（\eta^{2}=0.102）和嵌入 × 重排序（\eta^{2}=0.110）。 这两个存活项都涉及嵌入模型。 我们将嵌入 × 富集归因于表示能力：更强的嵌入模型可以在不稀释原始段落的情况下编码新增的上下文。 我们将嵌入 × 重排序归因于候选集质量：当初始嵌入已经检索到强候选时，重排序器可发挥的空间更小（见 J.3.1 节和 J.3.2 节）。 MMR 平均使 NDCG@10 相对下降 3.6\%，这与它在宽泛、异质语料库上通常带来的收益相反（表 44）。 我们假设，在聚焦领域的语料库中，词汇和语义高度重叠的段落往往就是同一份支撑证据，因此 MMR 的多样性惩罚会降低它们的排名，转而偏向主题相距较远的段落（见 D.12 节和 D.13 节）。

paragraphs.en: On the faithfulness track ( Fig. 3 , lower triangle), query augmentation ( η 2 = 0.224 \eta^{2}=0.224 ) and agentic gating ( η 2 = 0.217 \eta^{2}=0.217 ) have the largest marginal associations; embedding and enrichment, the strongest retrieval drivers, are negligible on faithfulness ( η 2 < 0.02 \eta^{2}<0.02 each). We attribute this contrast to pipeline stage: query augmentation changes retrieved evidence, whereas agentic gating filters or verifies it before generation. We test how these stages compose across all 5 × 4 5{\times}4 combinations of query augmentation and agentic gating ( Section D.10 ). The interaction effect is partial η 2 = 0.033 \eta^{2}=0.033 ; 10 of 20 combinations depart from additivity by at least two percentage points. Under Speculative-RAG, decomposition is 4.7 4.7 points above the additive prediction, while query expansion is 4.1 4.1 below it. We hypothesize that decomposition supplies distinct subproblems for draft-and-verify, whereas broader expansion can introduce overlapping or competing evidence. Thus, isolated gains do not reliably predict composition; these stages should be evaluated jointly ( Table 42 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在忠实度维度（图3，下三角）上，查询增强（η²=0.224）与智能体门控（η²=0.217）具有最大的边际关联；而作为最强检索驱动因素的嵌入与丰富化，在忠实度上却可忽略不计（各自η²<0.02）。 我们将这种对比归因于流水线阶段的不同：查询增强改变检索到的证据，而智能体门控则在生成之前对其进行过滤或验证。 我们测试了这些阶段在查询增强与智能体门控的全部5×4种组合（见附录D.10）中如何组合。 交互效应的偏η²为0.033；20种组合中有10种偏离可加性至少两个百分点。 在Speculative-RAG下，分解比可加性预测高出4.7分，而查询扩展则比其低4.1分。 我们假设分解为草稿-验证机制提供了各不相同的子问题，而更宽泛的扩展则可能引入重叠或相互竞争的证据。 因此，孤立阶段的增益无法可靠地预测组合效果；这些阶段应当被联合评估（表42）。

paragraphs.en: Faithfulness shows a different additivity pattern. A one-factor-at-a-time estimate based on BGE-large embeddings, hierarchical chunking, hybrid-BM25 retrieval, and Speculative-RAG gating predicts a + 28 % +28\% gain over a reference configuration, while the best full RAG pipeline improves by + 32 % +32\% over the same reference. This suggests that some faithfulness gains may combine approximately as measured. We hypothesize that this occurs when techniques act at complementary pipeline stages and duplicate less of one another’s function ( Table 47 ). Full pairwise results are in Table 33 .
paragraphs.zh: 忠实性呈现出不同的可加性模式。 基于 BGE-large 嵌入、分层分块、混合 BM25 检索和 Speculative-RAG 门控的单因素变化估计预测，相比参考配置可获得 +28% 的提升，而最佳完整 RAG 流水线相比同一参考配置提升了 +32%。 这表明某些忠实性收益可能近似按测量值叠加。 我们假设，当各技术在流水线的互补阶段发挥作用、彼此功能重复较少时，就会出现这种情况（表 47）。 完整的两两对比结果见表 33。

paragraphs.en: We extend the 5,132-document base corpus with scaling increments (15K/25K/50K/100K/200K) under the same proportional sampling protocol, with no distractor overlapping any evaluation query’s relevant set. For 25K–200K, repeated seeded executions resample retrieval and generation stochasticity but not corpus composition; distractors are sampled from the same five BEIR source domains as the base corpus (full protocol in Section B.3 ). NDCG@10 across six corpus sizes separates into two regimes ( Fig. 4(a) ): speed and standard degrade log-linearly, while balanced and max-reliable are approximately flat. The regimes cross between 15K and 25K. standard leads at the small sizes (5K, 15K); balanced leads from 25K onward. At 200K, balanced exceeds standard by 13.7 % 13.7\% relative ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 ; full per-size table in Section E.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在5,132篇文档的基础语料库上，按照相同的比例采样协议加入规模化增量（15K/25K/50K/100K/200K），并确保没有干扰文档与任何评测查询的相关集合重叠。 对于25K–200K，多次带随机种子的重复执行会重新采样检索与生成的随机性，但不改变语料库构成；干扰文档从与基础语料库相同的五个BEIR来源领域采样（完整协议见第B.3节）。 六种语料库规模下的NDCG@10呈现出两种不同的状态（图4(a)）：speed和standard呈对数线性下降，而balanced和max-reliable则大致保持平稳。 两种状态在15K与25K之间发生交叉。standard在小规模（5K、15K）时领先；从25K起balanced领先。 在200K时，balanced相对standard高出13.7%（p=0.003；完整的分规模表格见第E.1节）。

sents.en: We extend the 5,132-document base corpus with scaling increments (15K/25K/50K/100K/200K) under the same proportional sampling protocol, with no distractor overlapping any evaluation query’s relevant set.

sents.zh: 六种语料库规模下的NDCG@10呈现出两种不同的状态（图4(a)）：speed和standard呈对数线性下降，而balanced和max-reliable则大致保持平稳。

sents.en: The regimes cross between 15K and 25K. standard leads at the small sizes (5K, 15K); balanced leads from 25K onward.
sents.zh: 两种状态在15K与25K之间发生交叉。standard在小规模（5K、15K）时领先；从25K起balanced领先。

sents.en: At 200K, balanced exceeds standard by 13.7 % 13.7\% relative ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 ; full per-size table in Section E.1 ).
sents.zh: 在200K时，balanced相对standard高出13.7%（p=0.003；完整的分规模表格见第E.1节）。

paragraphs.en: We attribute the flatter retrieval-NDCG degradation at scale of balanced to several retrieval-stage additions relative to standard : broader chunk retention, hierarchical document partitioning, and post-retrieval merging (full list in Section I.1 ). Together, these sustain a denser, higher-signal top- k k as distractors dilute the pool. The extractive compression and document-awareness prefixes that balanced additionally enables act post-retrieval and pre-generation respectively; they primarily support faithfulness rather than the NDCG@10 gap ( Section D.12 ; examples in document awareness and the 50K crossover ). speed degrades fastest, which we hypothesize reflects MiniLM-L6’s limited discriminative capacity (384-dim) operating without the lexical anchoring that BM25 would provide under hybrid retrieval, see example and Table 23 for results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 balanced 在大规模下检索NDCG下降更为平缓归因于相较于标准方案在检索阶段的多项改进：更广泛的分块保留、分层文档切分，以及检索后合并（完整列表见第 I.1 节）。 当干扰项稀释候选池时，这些改进共同维持了一个更稠密、信号更强的 top-k k 集合。 balanced 额外启用的抽取式压缩与文档感知前缀分别作用于检索后与生成前阶段；它们主要提升忠实度，而非缩小 NDCG@10 的差距（见第 D.12 节；示例见文档感知与 50K 交叉点部分）。速度下降最快，我们推测这反映了 MiniLM-L6（384 维）在缺乏 BM25 在混合检索下所能提供的词法锚定时判别能力有限，结果见示例与表 23。

sents.en: We attribute the flatter retrieval-NDCG degradation at scale of balanced to several retrieval-stage additions relative to standard : broader chunk retention, hierarchical document partitioning, and post-retrieval merging (full list in Section I.1 ).
sents.zh: 我们将 balanced 在大规模下检索NDCG下降更为平缓归因于相较于标准方案在检索阶段的多项改进：更广泛的分块保留、分层文档切分，以及检索后合并（完整列表见第 I.1 节）。

sents.en: The extractive compression and document-awareness prefixes that balanced additionally enables act post-retrieval and pre-generation respectively; they primarily support faithfulness rather than the NDCG@10 gap ( Section D.12 ; examples in document awareness and the 50K crossover ). speed degrades fastest, which we hypothesize reflects MiniLM-L6’s limited discriminative capacity (384-dim) operating without the lexical anchoring that BM25 would provide under hybrid retrieval, see example and Table 23 for results.

paragraphs.en: Despite NDCG@10 falling as gold passages dilute among distractors, faithfulness does not decline with corpus scale. We hypothesize that a larger corpus expands information coverage, so that even when the gold document falls below the top- k k , other documents contain overlapping or paraphrased content sufficient to ground a faithful answer; the 100K → \to 200K recovery across all three profiles is consistent with this mechanism. Full per-profile slopes and 1M projections in Tables 23 , 22 , 11 and 49 ; latency scaling at each corpus size in Fig. 10 .

paragraphs.en: At the fixed 30 30 s response-time reference, standard has the highest joint hypervolume ( 0.523 0.523 ). Within the agentic pair, balanced improves NDCG@10 by 4.5 % 4.5\% and response time by 13 % 13\% , with only a 0.005 0.005 faithfulness difference. We attribute part of this tradeoff to the execution route: direct generation favors response time, while iterative verification favors faithfulness. Thus, additional components can improve one metric without improving the complete RAG pipeline, so all three metrics should be evaluated jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 在固定的 30 30 秒响应时间参考点下，standard 具有最高的联合超体积（0.523 0.523）。 在智能体组合中，balanced 将 NDCG@10 提升了 4.5 % 4.5\%，将响应时间提升了 13 % 13\%，而忠实度仅有 0.005 0.005 的差异。 我们将这种权衡的部分原因归结于执行路径：直接生成有利于响应时间，而迭代验证有利于忠实度。 因此，额外的组件可以在不改进完整 RAG 流水线的情况下改进某一指标，所以应当联合评估这三个指标。

paragraphs.en: A sweep of 138 configurations across 24 targeted experiments yields several practical findings ( Appendix F ). Across 20 configurations, chunker choice spans 0.126 0.126 NDCG@10, a 36 % 36\% relative difference larger than most factorial main effects ( Table 55 ). Thus, preprocessing choices should also be tested within the complete pipeline. The 2019 MS-MARCO MiniLM-L6 cross-encoder ( Nogueira & Cho, 2019 ) ranks above all four recent rerankers tested ( Table 51 ); we speculate that its training aligns especially well with our focused domains. Matryoshka truncation of BGE-M3 to 768 dimensions ( Kusupati et al., 2022 ) reduces vector storage and search cost by 25 % 25\% while improving NDCG@10 by 2.3 % 2.3\% ( Table 52 ). We attribute the gain to the Matryoshka training objective, which concentrates useful signal in leading dimensions; encoder cost is unchanged because the full vector is computed first. On generation, faithfulness is highest with hallucination and answer-quality gates disabled: gate-triggered refinement can remove supporting evidence, including 14 of 15 chunks in one multi-hop example ( Table 54 ). HyDE raises NDCG@10 by 3.1 % 3.1\% but doubles first-hop latency, reducing the latency-adjusted gain to 0.9 % 0.9\% , so its value depends on the latency budget ( Section I.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对 138 种配置进行的扫描与 24 组针对性实验得出了若干实用结论（附录 F）。 在 20 种配置中，分块器的选择使 NDCG@10 的差异跨度为 0.126，即 36% 的相对差异，大于大多数析因主效应（表 55）。 因此，预处理选择也应在完整流水线内进行测试。 2019 年的 MS-MARCO MiniLM-L6 交叉编码器（Nogueira & Cho，2019）的排名高于所测试的四个近期重排序器（表 51）；我们推测其训练与我们的聚焦领域特别契合。 将 BGE-M3 进行 Matryoshka 截断至 768 维（Kusupati et al.，2022）可将向量存储与搜索成本降低 25%，同时使 NDCG@10 提升 2.3%（表 52）。 我们将这一增益归因于 Matryoshka 训练目标，它将有用信号集中于前部维度；编码器成本不变，因为仍需先计算完整向量。 在生成方面，当幻觉门控与答案质量门控均被禁用时，忠实度最高：门控触发的精炼可能移除支持性证据，包括某个多跳示例中 15 个块中的 14 个（表 54）。 HyDE 将 NDCG@10 提升 3.1%，但使首跳延迟翻倍，将经延迟调整后的增益降至 0.9%，因此其价值取决于延迟预算（第 I.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We study how modern RAG techniques compose across pipeline stages, metrics, and corpus scales using lasagna , a stage-isolated framework, and 450 450 configurations across eight benchmarks from 5K to 200K documents. Gains measured one component at a time do not necessarily persist in complete pipelines; retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor different choices; and the best composition changes with corpus scale. New techniques should be tested in representative complete pipelines, on both metrics, and at the intended scale. We release lasagna to make such studies practical and reproducible, and to establish compositional evaluation as the reporting standard for new RAG techniques rather than the isolated single-component ablations common today.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 lasagna——一个阶段隔离的框架——以及覆盖 5K 到 200K 文档规模的八个基准上的 450 450 种配置，研究现代 RAG 技术如何在不同流水线阶段、指标和语料库规模之间组合。 逐一测量单个组件所获得的收益不一定能在完整流水线中保持；检索质量与答案忠实性偏好不同的选择；最佳组合会随语料库规模而变化。 新技术应在具有代表性的完整流水线中、在两类指标上、并按预期的规模进行测试。 我们开源 lasagna，以使此类研究切实可行且可复现，并将组合式评估确立为新技术 RAG 的报告标准，以取代当今常见的孤立单组件消融实验。

paragraphs.en: LASAGNA is an evaluation framework operating over publicly released retrieval benchmarks; no human subjects, personal data, or private corpora were used. LLM API calls totalled approximately $5,200 and 310 wall-clock hours ( Section A.7 ); we report per-configuration cost and latency to enable reproducibility on constrained budgets. Because the framework lowers the cost of composing RAG pipelines, users deploying it in domain applications requiring corpus-specific validation should re-validate our profile candidates on their own corpus before deployment. Our headline profile comparisons rest on one constructed English multi-domain test bed with ≤ 93 \leq 93 retrieval and ≤ 200 \leq 200 generation queries per experiment, so the profiles are best interpreted as candidates for further validation, not prescriptions.
paragraphs.zh: LASAGNA 是一个基于公开发布的检索基准运行的评估框架；未使用任何人类受试者、个人数据或私有语料库。 LLM API 调用总计约 5,200 美元和 310 小时的实际运行时间（见 A.7 节）；我们报告了每种配置的成本和延迟，以便在有限预算下实现可复现性。 由于该框架降低了组合 RAG 流水线的成本，在需要语料库特定验证的领域应用中部署该框架的用户，应在部署前在自己的语料库上重新验证我们提出的候选画像。 我们的核心画像比较基于一个构建的英文多领域测试平台，每个实验包含不超过 93 \leq 93 个检索查询和不超过 200 \leq 200 个生成查询，因此这些画像最好被理解为供进一步验证的候选方案，而非固定处方。

paragraphs.en: The lasagna framework code is released at https://github.com/dolev31/lasagna . The paper-specific artifacts cited by path in the appendices (the D-optimal design matrix, per-configuration profiles, per-query raw scores, and analysis scripts) are not part of that release and are available from the authors on request. Appendices A , B and C document experimental design and pre-registration; the per-experiment provenance manifest ( Table 58 ), conformance test verifying stage isolation ( Section H.1 ), and full compute accounting ( Section A.7 ) support end-to-end reproducibility. paragraphs.en: Our evaluation uses one constructed English multi-domain test bed ( ≤ 93 \leq 93 retrieval queries, ≤ 200 \leq 200 generation queries per experiment) and does not test: multilingual corpora, real enterprise or private data, open-weight generators (all headline results use proprietary APIs; see Reproducibility Statement), or cross-organizational large corpora. Faithfulness is now measured under two generator models rather than one ( Section F.9 ), which is a sensitivity check on generator choice and not a sweep: both models are proprietary, and the ordering of the two closest profiles is not stable across them. Findings should be interpreted as case-study evidence for the methodological framework, and derived profiles as candidates for further validation rather than prescriptions for high-stakes deployments. The benchmarks are concentrated in five focused domains (biomedical, financial, scientific, argumentative, and multi-hop QA over Wikipedia), and the corpus-scaling protocol injects controlled distractors drawn from those same five domains. On the evaluation side, our cross-judge (LLM and humans) agreement supports profile rankings across LLM judges, but absolute faithfulness scores still live in a single judge’s calibration. The confirmatory faithfulness experiment (E1, Section D.10 ) meets its pre-registered three-seed replication ( n runs = 3 n_{\text{runs}}=3 ) but uses 43 43 unique queries rather than the pre-registered 200 200 , due to GPT-5.1 rate-limit budget cuts ( Appendix A ); magnitude estimates should be read under this reduced query sampling. A controlled length-variant rerun ( Section C.3 ) further shows that raw faithfulness is partly length-driven, and that the concise-over-verbose gap reverses under length control; we therefore report both raw and length-residualized faithfulness for any cross-regime claim. The within-regime results in the main tables are unaffected because they hold prompt length constant. Our component inventory is also a January-2026 snapshot of a literature that ships new techniques actively. Scaling degradations should be read as an upper bound: a formal n = 100 n{=}100 distractor-relevance audit ( Section B.3.5 ) finds a 0 % 0\% false-negative rate and a 9 % 9\% partial-relevance rate, so the H3 rank-flip is robust to distractor mis-labeling but true degradation is likely smaller than reported.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估使用了一个构建的英语多领域测试床（每次实验 ≤ 93 \leq 93 个检索查询、≤ 200 \leq 200 个生成查询），并未测试：多语言语料库、真实的企业或私有数据、开放权重生成器（所有核心结果均使用专有 API，见可复现性声明），以及跨组织的大规模语料库。 忠实度现在在两个生成器模型而非一个模型下测量（见 F.9 节），这是对生成器选择的一项敏感性检查而非扫描：两个模型都是专有的，且两个最接近的配置之间的排序在不同模型间并不稳定。 研究结果应被解读为对方法学框架的案例研究证据，所导出的配置应被视作有待进一步验证的候选方案，而非面向高风险部署的处方。 这些基准集中在五个聚焦领域（生物医学、金融、科学、论辩，以及基于维基百科的多跳问答），且语料库扩展协议注入的受控干扰项也来自这同样的五个领域。 在评估方面，我们的跨评审者（LLM 与人类）一致性支持跨 LLM 评审者的配置排名，但绝对忠实度分数仍依赖于单一评审者的校准。 验证性忠实度实验（E1，见 D.10 节）达到了预先注册的三种子复现（ n runs = 3 n_{\text{runs}}=3 ），但由于 GPT-5.1 的速率限制预算削减（见附录 A），仅使用了 43 43 个唯一查询而非预先注册的 200 200 个；幅度估计应在这种减少的查询采样背景下解读。 一项受控的长度变体重跑（见 C.3 节）进一步表明，原始忠实度部分由长度驱动，且在长度控制下“简洁优于冗长”的差距会发生反转；因此，对于任何跨机制的结论，我们同时报告原始忠实度和去除长度残差的忠实度。 主表中机制内的结果不受影响，因为它们在提示长度保持恒定的条件下成立。 我们的组件清单也只是对这一积极推出新技术的文献在 2026 年 1 月的一个快照。 扩展退化应被解读为上界：一项正式的 n = 100 n{=}100 干扰项相关性审计（见 B.3.5 节）发现假阴性率为 0 % 0\% 、部分相关性率为 9 % 9\% ，因此 H3 的排名翻转对干扰项的误标注是稳健的，但真实退化很可能小于所报告的数值。

paragraphs.en: In one sentence: we commit, before collecting data, to testing whether a practitioner can build a good Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline by tuning components one at a time on a small corpus, the way the literature implicitly assumes. The study commits to three confirmatory hypotheses (Section A.2.2 ), a 242-configuration D-optimal fractional factorial design spanning 8 pipeline dimensions, 5 benchmark datasets (2,300 queries per configuration), and a three-track evaluation protocol covering retrieval, end-to-end generation, and hallucination resistance. To our knowledge, this is the first pre-declared factorial evaluation of RAG pipeline composition, 4.6 × 4.6\times the scale of the largest prior controlled RAG study ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . We publish this document before experimental data collection to establish hypothesis commitment and invite community feedback on model selection, benchmark composition, and statistical methodology.
paragraphs.zh: 一句话概括：我们承诺，在收集数据之前，检验实践者能否按照文献中隐含假设的方式，通过在小语料库上一次调整一个组件来构建一个良好的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线。 本研究承诺三项验证性假设（第 A.2.2 节）、一个涵盖 8 个流水线维度的 242 种配置的 D 最优部分因子设计、5 个基准数据集（每种配置 2,300 个查询），以及覆盖检索、端到端生成和抗幻觉能力的三轨评估协议。 据我们所知，这是首个预先声明的 RAG 流水线组合因子评估，规模是此前最大的受控 RAG 研究（Jin et al., 2025）的 4.6 × 4.6\times 倍。 我们在实验数据收集之前发布本文档，以确立假设承诺，并邀请社区就模型选择、基准数据集构成和统计方法提供反馈。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) has become the dominant paradigm for grounding large language models in external knowledge. A rich toolkit of individually validated techniques, dense retrieval, hybrid sparse–dense fusion, cross-encoder reranking, HyDE ( Gao et al., 2023a ) , CRAG ( Yan et al., 2024 ) , Self-RAG ( Asai et al., 2024 ) , is available to practitioners, yet each technique is evaluated in isolation against a simple baseline. Practitioners who combine several techniques simultaneously have no empirical basis for predicting whether their gains add, cancel, or amplify.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（Lewis et al., 2020）已成为将大语言模型与外部知识相连接的主流范式。 目前从业者拥有一套丰富的、经过单独验证的技术工具箱，包括稠密检索、稀疏—稠密混合融合、交叉编码器重排序、HyDE（Gao et al., 2023a）、CRAG（Yan et al., 2024）、Self-RAG（Asai et al., 2024），然而每项技术都是针对简单基线进行孤立评估的。 同时组合多种技术的从业者没有实证依据来预测这些技术的收益是相互叠加、相互抵消还是相互放大。

sents.en: Practitioners who combine several techniques simultaneously have no empirical basis for predicting whether their gains add, cancel, or amplify.
sents.zh: 同时组合多种技术的从业者没有实证依据来预测这些技术的收益是相互叠加、相互抵消还是相互放大。

paragraphs.en: This is not merely a reporting gap. Wang et al. (2024) observe that end-to-end RAG performance depends on coordinated pipeline design rather than any single component; Chen et al. (2026) confirm the presence of interaction effects by showing that jointly optimized RAG components outperform independently tuned ones. Yet neither work measures the sign, magnitude, or domain-dependence of these interactions under controlled factorial conditions, precisely the question a practitioner faces when choosing a configuration for production.
paragraphs.zh: 这不仅仅是一个报告缺失的问题。Wang et al. （2024）观察到，端到端 RAG 性能取决于协调一致的流水线设计，而非任何单一组件；Chen et al. （2026）通过证明联合优化的 RAG 组件优于独立调优的组件，确认了交互效应的存在。 然而，这两项工作都没有在受控析因条件下度量这些交互效应的符号、大小或领域依赖性，而这正是从业者在为生产环境选择配置时面临的问题。

paragraphs.en: Pre-registration prevents post-hoc hypothesis mining, a known problem in ML benchmarking ( Dodge et al., 2019 ; Bouthillier et al., 2021 ) . By committing to hypotheses, analysis plans, and exclusion criteria before data collection, we ensure that our confirmatory findings are distinguishable from exploratory ones. We additionally publish this document to invite community input on experimental choices that remain open (Section A.2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 预注册可以防止事后挖掘假设，这是机器学习基准测试中一个已知的问题（Dodge et al., 2019；Bouthillier et al., 2021）。 通过在数据收集之前预先确定假设、分析计划和排除标准，我们确保验证性发现能够与探索性发现区分开来。 我们还发布本文档，以邀请社区对仍然开放的实验选择提出意见（第 A.2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We pre-register three hypotheses that together ask whether RAG pipelines can be designed compositionally. H1 asks the structural question: do the eight pipeline components combine additively, or do they interact non-trivially? If they interact, the implicit assumption behind every single-component ablation in the literature fails. H2 asks the design question: assuming components do interact, can a single fixed configuration still serve practitioners across the (faithfulness, latency, cost) tradeoff space, or must each deployment hand-tune for its own operating point? H3 asks the scaling question: do the answers to H1 and H2 survive a 40 × 40\times scale-up of the corpus, or are small-corpus best practices misleading at production scale?
paragraphs.zh: 我们预先注册了三个假设，共同探讨 RAG 流水线是否可以组合式地设计。 H1 提出的是结构性问题：八个流水线组件是否以相加的方式结合，还是存在非平凡的相互作用？ 如果它们确实存在相互作用，那么文献中所有单组件消融实验背后的隐含假设就都不成立了。 H2 提出的是设计问题：假设组件之间确实存在相互作用，那么单一固定配置是否仍能在（忠实度、延迟、成本）权衡空间中满足从业者，还是每次部署都必须针对自身的运行点进行手工调优？ H3 提出的是扩展性问题：H1 和 H2 的结论在语料库扩大 40 倍后是否仍然成立，还是小语料库的最佳实践在生产规模下会产生误导？

paragraphs.en: Pre-registered claim. Two-way interactions between the eight factorial dimensions explain ≥ 20 % \geq 20\% of the variance in faithfulness (RAGAS, 0–1 scale) after main effects are removed. Variance is reported as partial η 2 \eta^{2} , the share of residual variance (after main effects) attributed to interaction terms, in a Type-III ANOVA , an ANOVA decomposition that estimates each term’s contribution after partialling out all others and is robust to unbalanced designs. The pre-registered 20% bar is stricter than Cohen’s conventional “large effect” reference of η partial 2 ≈ 0.14 \eta^{2}_{\mathrm{partial}}\approx 0.14 ( Cohen, 2013 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 预注册声明。 八个因子维度的双向交互作用在去除主效应后，可解释忠实度（RAGAS，0–1 量表）方差的 ≥ 20% \geq 20\%。 方差以偏 η 2 \eta^{2} 报告，即在 III 型方差分析（Type-III ANOVA，一种在剔除所有其他项后估计各项贡献、且对非平衡设计稳健的方差分析分解方法）中，交互作用项所占残余方差（去除主效应后）的比例。 预注册的 20% 门槛比 Cohen 传统的“大效应”参考值 η partial 2 ≈ 0.14 \eta^{2}_{\mathrm{partial}}\approx 0.14（Cohen, 2013）更为严格。

sents.en: Pre-registered claim.
sents.zh: 预注册声明。

paragraphs.en: What confirming and rejecting mean. Confirming H1 falsifies the additivity assumption behind most single-component RAG ablations in the literature: a designer cannot tune one component in isolation and trust the gain to compose with another. Rejecting H1 (interaction terms contribute < < 5% of variance) means RAG components are approximately additive within the precision of our 242-config sweep, and isolated ablations remain a defensible practice.
paragraphs.zh: 确认与拒绝分别意味着什么。 确认 H1 将证伪文献中大多数单组件 RAG 消融实验背后的可加性假设：设计者无法孤立地调整某个组件，并指望其增益能与另一个组件的增益叠加。 拒绝 H1（交互项对方差的贡献 < < 5%）意味着 RAG 各组件在我们 242 种配置的扫描精度范围内近似可加，孤立的消融实验仍然是一种可辩护的做法。

paragraphs.en: Research question. Given that components interact, can a single fixed configuration sweep a wider region of the (faithfulness, latency, cost) tradeoff space than a quality-only configuration, or must practitioners give up an axis to gain another?

paragraphs.en: Pre-registered claim. The balanced operational profile exhibits a strictly higher hypervolume indicator (HV) than the max-reliable profile on ≥ 3 \geq 3 of the 5 benchmark datasets. Hypervolume is the multi-objective generalization of area-under-the-curve: the volume of the ( faithfulness ↑ , latency ↓ , cost ↓ ) (\text{faithfulness}{\uparrow},\text{latency}{\downarrow},\text{cost}{\downarrow}) region dominated by the profile’s per-query tradeoff cloud, with larger meaning a better envelope.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册声明。 平衡型运行配置在 5 个基准数据集中至少 3 \geq 3 个上，其超体积指标（HV）严格高于最大可靠型配置。 超体积是曲线下面积在多目标上的推广：即由该配置在逐查询权衡点云所支配的（忠实度 ↑ , 延迟 ↓ , 成本 ↓ ) (\text{faithfulness}{\uparrow},\text{latency}{\downarrow},\text{cost}{\downarrow}) 区域的体积，数值越大表示包络越优。

sents.en: Pre-registered claim.
sents.zh: 预注册声明。

sents.en: The balanced operational profile exhibits a strictly higher hypervolume indicator (HV) than the max-reliable profile on ≥ 3 \geq 3 of the 5 benchmark datasets.
sents.zh: 平衡型运行配置在 5 个基准数据集中至少 3 \geq 3 个上，其超体积指标（HV）严格高于最大可靠型配置。

sents.en: Hypervolume is the multi-objective generalization of area-under-the-curve: the volume of the ( faithfulness ↑ , latency ↓ , cost ↓ ) (\text{faithfulness}{\uparrow},\text{latency}{\downarrow},\text{cost}{\downarrow}) region dominated by the profile’s per-query tradeoff cloud, with larger meaning a better envelope.

paragraphs.en: Pre-registered test. Wilcoxon signed-rank, a non-parametric paired-sample test that does not assume normality, on per-query faithfulness scores (paired by query), Bonferroni-corrected across the 5 datasets ( α = 0.05 / 5 = 0.01 \alpha=0.05/5=0.01 per dataset). HV is computed with the exact 3D algorithm; objectives are normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] before the volume integration.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册测试。 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，一种不假设正态性的非参数配对样本检验，作用于每个查询的忠实度得分（按查询配对），并在 5 个数据集上进行 Bonferroni 校正（每个数据集 α = 0.05 / 5 = 0.01 \alpha=0.05/5=0.01）。 HV 使用精确的 3D 算法计算；目标值在体积积分之前被归一化到 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1]。

sents.en: Pre-registered test.
sents.zh: 预注册测试。

sents.en: Wilcoxon signed-rank, a non-parametric paired-sample test that does not assume normality, on per-query faithfulness scores (paired by query), Bonferroni-corrected across the 5 datasets ( α = 0.05 / 5 = 0.01 \alpha=0.05/5=0.01 per dataset).

paragraphs.en: What confirming and rejecting mean. Confirming H2 says a single fixed configuration can serve practitioners who do not want to give up an axis: published profile recipes (e.g., balanced ) generalize across deployments. Rejecting H2 ( max-reliable dominates in ≥ 4 / 5 \geq 4/5 datasets) means production RAG requires per-deployment tuning to its own tradeoff preference, and our published profile recipes will not generalize.
paragraphs.zh: 确认与拒绝意味着什么。 确认 H2 表示单一固定配置可以服务于不愿放弃某一维度的从业者：已发布的配置文件方案（例如 balanced）可以跨部署泛化。 拒绝 H2（max-reliable 在 ≥ 4 / 5 \geq 4/5 个数据集中占优）意味着生产级 RAG 需要针对每个部署自身的权衡偏好进行调优，而我们已发布的配置文件方案将无法泛化。

paragraphs.en: Pre-registered claim. Fitting NDCG@10 as a power law NDCG@10 ​ ( N ) = a ⋅ N b \text{NDCG@10}(N)=a\cdot N^{b} separately for each of the four operational profiles ( speed , standard , balanced , max-reliable ), the cross-profile range b max − b min b_{\max}-b_{\min} exceeds 0.05 0.05 per decade of corpus growth (i.e., the steepest- and shallowest-degrading profiles differ by at least 5 % 5\% relative NDCG@10 per 10 × 10\times corpus increase), analogous to the saturation behavior observed in neural scaling laws ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) . paragraphs.en: What confirming and rejecting mean. Confirming H3 means small-corpus ablations cannot reliably predict production-scale deployment choices: profile selection requires re-validation at the deployment’s target corpus size, and the field’s reliance on ≤ 50 \leq 50 K-corpus benchmarks is methodologically suspect for deployment decisions. Rejecting H3 (slope range ≤ 0.02 \leq 0.02 per decade, τ = 1 \tau=1 on every benchmark) means small-corpus benchmarks generalize, and the small-corpus best practice is also the large-corpus best practice.
paragraphs.zh: 确认与拒绝分别意味着什么。 确认 H3 意味着小语料库的消融实验无法可靠地预测生产规模部署时的选择：配置（profile）的选择需要在部署的目标语料库规模下重新验证，且该领域在部署决策上依赖不超过 50 \leq 50 K 语料库的基准测试在方法论上是可疑的。 拒绝 H3（每十年斜率范围不超过 0.02 \leq 0.02，在每个基准测试上 \tau = 1 \tau=1）意味着小语料库基准测试具有泛化性，小语料库的最佳实践同时也是大语料库的最佳实践。

paragraphs.en: lasagna is a stage-isolated RAG evaluation platform: each pipeline stage is implemented behind an abstract base class, and configuration changes to one stage do not affect the execution of any other stage. This architectural invariant guarantees that the output of stage i i is a deterministic function of the output of stage i − 1 i{-}1 and the configuration parameters 𝜽 i \bm{\theta}_{i} alone, eliminating the coupling confounds that invalidate factorial interpretation in conventional RAG implementations.
paragraphs.zh: lasagna 是一个阶段隔离的 RAG 评估平台：每个流水线阶段都在抽象基类之后实现，对某一阶段的配置更改不会影响任何其他阶段的执行。 这一架构不变量保证了阶段 i 的输出仅是阶段 i − 1 的输出与配置参数 𝜽ᵢ 的确定性函数，从而消除了在传统 RAG 实现中导致因子化解释失效的耦合混淆因素。

paragraphs.en: We welcome suggestions on model selection before experiments begin. In particular, we are open to: (1) alternative generator models that would increase reproducibility (e.g., open-weight models), (2) additional judge models for cross-validation of faithfulness scores, and (3) embedding models that would expand the capacity range.

paragraphs.en: Fedorov coordinate exchange ( Fedorov et al., 1972 ; Atkinson et al., 2007 ) is a greedy row-exchange algorithm that starts from a random 242-row subset of the 30,720-row full-factorial candidate set and iteratively swaps one in-design row for the candidate row that most increases the D-criterion
paragraphs.zh: Fedorov 坐标交换算法（Fedorov et al., 1972; Atkinson et al., 2007）是一种贪心行交换算法，它从包含 30,720 行的完全析因候选集中随机选取一个 242 行的子集作为起点，然后迭代地将设计中的某一行替换为最能提升 D 准则的候选行。

paragraphs.en: terminating when no single-row swap raises the determinant. The model matrix 𝐗 \mathbf{X} is 242 × 232 242\times 232 and encodes one intercept, 22 main-effect contrasts, and 209 two-way interaction contrasts under effect coding (factor levels mapped to ± 1 \pm 1 rather than the 0 / 1 0/1 of dummy coding, so main effects are orthogonal to the intercept). A custom Python implementation ( experiments/design/generate_design_matrix.py , available from the authors on request) reproduces the matrix bit-identically at seed = 42 =42 .

paragraphs.en: Before committing GraphRAG to the 242-run factorial we ran an isolated four-configuration retrieval ablation (private_eval/retrieval, small corpus, March 2026).
paragraphs.zh: 在将 GraphRAG 提交至 242 次运行的因子实验之前，我们进行了一项独立的四配置检索消融实验（private_eval/retrieval，小型语料库，2026 年 3 月）。

paragraphs.en: No graph configuration improves over the baseline, and NDCG@10 decreases monotonically as graph-hop depth grows (1-hop → \to 3-hop, − 0.011 -0.011 ). One plausible explanation, consistent with the retrieval–faithfulness asymmetry observed in the full factorial ( Section 5 ), is that graph-derived structural context may aid answer grounding while diluting passage-level similarity signals on these domain-focused corpora, where lexical and semantic retrieval already locate the gold evidence. We did not evaluate the generation-track faithfulness effect, so this is a hypothesis rather than a claim. Given the lack of NDCG@10 signal and the ∼ {\sim} 14-hour per-combo ingestion cost, we excluded GraphRAG from the 167-run factorial ( Table 10 , D3) and the scaling runs ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何图配置优于基线，且随着图跳数深度增加（1-hop → \to 3-hop），NDCG@10 单调下降（− 0.011 -0.011）。 一种合理的解释是，与全因子实验（第 5 节）中观察到的检索–忠实度不对称现象一致：图衍生的结构上下文可能有助于答案落地，但在这些领域专注型语料库上稀释了段落级相似性信号——在这些语料库上，词面与语义检索已经能够定位黄金证据。 我们并未评估生成侧的忠实度效应，因此这是一个假设而非结论。 鉴于 NDCG@10 缺乏信号，以及每种组合约 ∼ {\sim} 14 小时的摄取成本，我们将 GraphRAG 从 167 次运行的因子实验（表 10，D3）和扩展实验（第 5 节）中排除。

paragraphs.en: The original 242-config factorial assumed access to a dedicated GPU cluster and a corpus pipeline capable of ingesting up to 1M documents. During execution, two constraints materialized: (1) all LLM inference was routed through an enterprise API gateway to GPT-5.1, which imposed rate limits that made concurrent large-scale runs infeasible, and (2) our Milvus Lite instance required fresh database resets between embedding-model groups to avoid dimension-mismatch errors. We executed 167 of 242 planned configurations (69%) across all 8 dimensions, 4 embedding models, 4 chunking strategies, 3 of 4 enrichment levels (GraphRAG excluded due to entity-extraction cost of ∼ {\sim} 14 hours per ingestion combo), 3 retrieval modes, 5 query augmentation strategies, 4 reranking modes, 2 compression settings, and 4 agentic gate levels. The 167-configuration subset preserves all 22 main effects and enables estimation of all 28 two-way interactions via ANOVA, though with reduced power for the missing GraphRAG enrichment level. Twelve additional configurations failed due to Milvus Lite query-limit errors and are excluded. For the joint 28-interaction fit we compute SS int {}_{\text{int}} as a nested-SSR difference (SSR mains − {}_{\text{mains}}- SSR full {}_{\text{full}} ) rather than as an additive sum of per-pair Type-II SS: the latter double-counts shared variance across rank-deficient interactions (df sum 172 + 226 > n − 1 = 338 172{+}226{>}n{-}1{=}338 , arithmetically impossible) and inflated the reported η 2 \eta^{2} from 0.428 0.428 to 0.546 0.546 .
paragraphs.zh: 最初的242种配置的全因子实验设计假设可以使用专用GPU集群，以及能够摄取多达100万篇文档的语料库流水线。 在执行过程中出现了两个限制条件：(1) 所有LLM推理都通过企业API网关路由至GPT-5.1，该网关施加的速率限制使得大规模并发运行不可行；(2) 我们的Milvus Lite实例在嵌入模型组之间需要重新重置数据库，以避免维度不匹配错误。 我们在全部8个维度上执行了242个计划配置中的167个（69%）：4种嵌入模型、4种分块策略、4种富化级别中的3种（GraphRAG因每次摄取组合约14小时的实体抽取成本而被排除）、3种检索模式、5种查询增强策略、4种重排序模式、2种压缩设置以及4种智能体门控级别。 这167个配置的子集保留了全部22个主效应，并能够通过方差分析（ANOVA）估计全部28个双向交互效应，尽管对于缺失的GraphRAG富化级别检验效能有所降低。 另有12个配置因Milvus Lite查询限制错误而失败，已被排除。 对于联合28个交互项的拟合，我们将SS_int计算为嵌套SSR差值（SSR_mains − SSR_full），而不是各配对Type-II SS的加总：后者会重复计算秩亏交互效应之间的共享方差（自由度之和 172 + 226 > n − 1 = 338，在算术上不可能成立），并且会将报告的η²从0.428夸大到0.546。

sents.en: For the joint 28-interaction fit we compute SS int {}_{\text{int}} as a nested-SSR difference (SSR mains − {}_{\text{mains}}- SSR full {}_{\text{full}} ) rather than as an additive sum of per-pair Type-II SS: the latter double-counts shared variance across rank-deficient interactions (df sum 172 + 226 > n − 1 = 338 172{+}226{>}n{-}1{=}338 , arithmetically impossible) and inflated the reported η 2 \eta^{2} from 0.428 0.428 to 0.546 0.546 .
sents.zh: 对于联合28个交互项的拟合，我们将SS_int计算为嵌套SSR差值（SSR_mains − SSR_full），而不是各配对Type-II SS的加总：后者会重复计算秩亏交互效应之间的共享方差（自由度之和 172 + 226 > n − 1 = 338，在算术上不可能成立），并且会将报告的η²从0.428夸大到0.546。

paragraphs.en: H2 corpus scope : the pre-registered H2 Pareto protocol specified a multi-benchmark hypervolume comparison; the executed H2 headline reports a joint NDCG@10, faithfulness, and response-time comparison on one SQuAD v2 / MuSiQue / HotpotQA mixture ( 43 43 generation / 56 56 retrieval queries per seed, three seeded runs). This mixture emerged as the practical H2 test after the MS MARCO / CUAD substitution above eliminated the two pre-registered benchmarks that would have anchored the multi-benchmark comparison. The executed comparison therefore does not confirm the pre-registered cross-benchmark claim; the original multi-benchmark grid is fully specified in Section D.7 but was not executed. A separate post-hoc replication of the H2 pattern on the same three benchmark families at 100K and 200K is reported descriptively in Section D.8 ; it is supplementary and does not substitute for the pre-registered multi-benchmark grid. The balanced profile should therefore be read as a candidate starting point pending validation on the target corpus, exactly as the H2 verdict box states.
paragraphs.zh: H2 语料范围：预注册的 H2 Pareto 协议规定进行多基准超体积比较；实际执行的 H2 主报告则在同一个 SQuAD v2 / MuSiQue / HotpotQA 混合语料上报告了 NDCG@10、忠实度与响应时间的联合比较（每个种子 43 条生成查询 / 56 条检索查询，共三次种子运行）。 在上文的 MS MARCO / CUAD 替换淘汰了本可作为多基准比较锚点的两个预注册基准之后，该混合语料成为实际可行的 H2 测试。 因此，实际执行的比较并未证实预注册的跨基准主张；原始的多基准网格在 D.7 节中已完整说明，但并未执行。 关于在相同三个基准族上于 100K 和 200K 规模下对 H2 模式进行的另一次事后复现，D.8 节以描述性方式予以报告；它仅作补充之用，不能替代预注册的多基准网格。 因此，均衡型配置应被视为有待在目标语料上验证的候选起点，正如 H2 结论框所述。

paragraphs.en: Scaling-fit form : preregistered power-law fit a ⋅ N b a\cdot N^{b} → \rightarrow executed log-linear fit a ⋅ log 10 ⁡ ( N ) + b a\cdot\log_{10}(N)+b (see the “Deviation from the pre-registered fit form” paragraph in Section B.3.9 ).
