paragraphs.en: H1 test statistic : the pre-registered joint 232-parameter 28-two-way F F -test is unidentifiable on the 113-configuration data (232 parameters vs. 339 rows, rank-deficient Plackett-Burman × \times screener cells). We executed the pre-registered per-pair Bonferroni correction ( α / 28 \alpha/28 ) instead and added an adequately-powered focused-confirmatory experiment E1 (see Section D.9 ) post-hoc as a replacement for the joint test.
paragraphs.zh: H1 检验统计量：预注册的 232 参数 28 个双向 F 联合 F 检验在 113 构型数据上不可识别（232 个参数对 339 行，Plackett-Burman × \times 筛选单元秩亏）。 我们改为执行预注册的逐对 Bonferroni 校正（ α / 28 \alpha/28 ），并在事后补充了一项统计功效充足的聚焦验证性实验 E1（见 D.9 节）作为联合检验的替代。

paragraphs.en: H1 decision-rule interpretation (variance-floor vs. significance-floor) : the pre-registration’s rejection rule is stated as “interaction terms contribute < < 5% of variance → \rightarrow reject H1 / additivity holds within tolerance,” which is a variance threshold. The variance and significance criteria yield different formal readings. Under the pre-registration’s variance rule, the executed η 2 = 0.033 \eta^{2}=0.033 (E1) and η 2 = 0.040 \eta^{2}=0.040 (per-sample joint) both sit on the additivity-holds side of the 5% floor. Under the parallel significance criterion ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), strict-zero additivity is rejected, but the effect sizes are small. Both readings appear in the reconciliation table and H1 verdict box and support the same practical conclusion (main effects dominate; cell-level residuals are non-trivial but small in aggregate).
paragraphs.zh: H1 决策规则的解读（方差阈值 vs. 显著性阈值）：预注册中的拒绝规则表述为“交互项贡献的方差 < < 5% → \rightarrow 拒绝 H1 / 可加性在容差范围内成立”，这是一个方差阈值。 方差准则和显著性准则会给出不同的形式化解读。 按照预注册的方差规则，实际测得的 η 2 = 0.033 \eta^{2}=0.033（E1）和 η 2 = 0.040 \eta^{2}=0.040（逐样本联合）均位于 5% 阈值中“可加性成立”的一侧。 按照平行的显著性准则（ p < 0.05 p<0.05 ），严格为零的可加性被拒绝，但效应量较小。 两种解读均出现在核对表和 H1 判定框中，并支持相同的实际结论（主效应占主导；单元格层面的残差并非微不足道，但总体上较小）。

paragraphs.en: Corpus fingerprints : SHA-256 fingerprints for the 100K/200K corpus files are unavailable ( Section B.3.4 ); the draw is reproducible from the seed-42 sampling script (available from the authors on request), so reconstruction relies on the recipe rather than content-addressed corpus files.

paragraphs.en: The 167 executed configurations cover all factor levels in 7 of 8 dimensions and 3 of 4 levels in the enrichment dimension (D3). All 22 main effects and all 28 two-way interactions are estimable from this subset. However, the design is unbalanced (cell sizes range from 1 to 7), which affects the precision of individual interaction estimates. We report Type I ANOVA sums of squares and note that partial η 2 \eta^{2} values should be interpreted with caution in unbalanced designs. We report Type I sums of squares for the 28-interaction scan and verify the key interaction (QueryAug × \times AgenticGate) with Type III SS ( η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 , F = 5.47 F=5.47 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), confirming robustness to factor ordering. For the pre-registered joint 28-two-way test ( Section D.3 ) we use Type II sums of squares, the Type III decomposition is singular in the sparse Plackett-Burman × \times screener cells, and on the reconstructed long-form table (113 configs × \times 3 benchmarks = 339 =339 rows) the D5 × \times D8 sanity refit gives η partial 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}_{\text{partial}}=0.201 , F ⁡ ( 12 , 306 ) = 6.40 F(12,\,306)=6.40 , p = × 10 − 10 p=3.8\!\times\!10^{-10} , consistent within residual df with the manuscript’s cited η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 , F ⁡ ( 12 , 279 ) = 5.47 F(12,\,279)=5.47 from the 122-config analysis. Restricting to the 3 enrichment levels present in both designs (excluding GraphRAG), the D-efficiency of the 167-row executed subset is 99.3% relative to the matching 179-row sub-design, indicating negligible power loss for main-effect estimation. Interaction-level power depends on cell occupancy and is lower for pairs involving the enrichment dimension (3 vs. 4 levels).

paragraphs.en: Generation evaluation was the largest single cost category ($815, 32% of total), driven by agentic pipeline configurations that invoke the LLM 10–15 times per query for iterative refinement, hallucination checking, and quality gating. RAGAS evaluation was the second largest ($590, 23%), as each faithfulness judgment requires decomposing the answer into atomic claims and verifying each against the retrieved context. Switching to concise answer prompts (one sentence per answer) reduced the number of atomic claims per sample and lowered RAGAS costs by approximately 15% relative to our initial verbose-answer runs.
paragraphs.zh: 生成评估是最大的单项成本类别（815 美元，占总成本的 32%），这主要源于智能体流水线配置——每个查询会调用大语言模型 10 到 15 次，用于迭代精炼、幻觉检查和质量把关。 RAGAS 评估是第二大成本（590 美元，占 23%），因为每次忠实度判断都需要将答案分解为原子性论断，并逐条对照检索到的上下文进行验证。 改用简洁答案提示词（每个答案仅一句话）减少了每个样本的原子性论断数量，使 RAGAS 成本相比我们最初使用冗长答案的运行降低了约 15%。

paragraphs.en: The initial experimental phases cost $2,553 ( Table 13 ); the subsequent factorial ANOVAs and remaining sweeps brought the API total to $5,200 (full timeline in Table 14 ), with ∼ {\sim} $370 in local GPU compute valued at cloud rates pushing the grand total to ∼ {\sim} $5,600, within the range of a single conference registration fee and well below compute budgets for comparable studies using dedicated GPU clusters. Approximately 90% of this cost is LLM API usage (generation and judging). Local compute (Apple M3 Max, 36 GB unified memory) contributed an estimated ∼ {\sim} 120 GPU-hours for MPS-accelerated embedding and ∼ {\sim} 40 CPU-hours for chunking, indexing, and BM25 index construction for the initial experiments, plus an additional ∼ {\sim} 34 hours of MPS GPU time for the 167-configuration retrieval factorial experiment (48 ingestion combos across 4 embedding models with RAPTOR and contextual-retrieval enrichment). Valued at cloud GPU rates ($1.50/hr), local compute totals ∼ {\sim} 290. The retrieval factorial consumed an estimated $800–1,200 in LLM API costs (HyDE, RAPTOR summarization, contextual-retrieval, and agentic pipeline calls). The generation factorial (122 configs × \times 56 queries = 6,832 evaluations) added ∼ {\sim} 80 hours of wall-clock time ( ∼ {\sim} 25 GPU-hours MPS embedding + ∼ {\sim} 55 hours API-bound RAGAS judging) and approximately $600–900 in API costs (answer generation + 3 RAGAS judge calls per sample).
paragraphs.zh: 初始实验阶段花费 2,553 美元（表 13）；随后的因子方差分析和其余轮次使 API 总费用达到 5,200 美元（完整时间线见表 14），加上按云服务价格折算约 370 美元的本地 GPU 计算成本，总计约 5,600 美元，处于一次会议注册费的费用范围内，远低于使用专用 GPU 集群的同类研究所需的计算预算。 其中约 90% 的成本是 LLM API 使用费用（生成与评判）。 本地计算（Apple M3 Max，36 GB 统一内存）为初始实验贡献了估计约 120 GPU 小时的 MPS 加速嵌入计算，以及约 40 CPU 小时的分块、索引和 BM25 索引构建，此外还为 167 种配置的检索因子实验（4 种嵌入模型下的 48 种摄取组合，并结合 RAPTOR 和上下文检索增强）额外消耗了约 34 小时的 MPS GPU 时间。 按云 GPU 价格（1.50 美元/小时）折算，本地计算总计约 290。 检索因子实验消耗了估计 800–1,200 美元的 LLM API 成本（HyDE、RAPTOR 摘要、上下文检索以及智能体流水线调用）。 生成因子实验（122 种配置 × 56 个查询 = 6,832 次评估）增加了约 80 小时的实际运行时间（约 25 GPU 小时的 MPS 嵌入 + 约 55 小时受 API 限制的 RAGAS 评判），以及约 600–900 美元的 API 成本（答案生成 + 每个样本 3 次 RAGAS 评判调用）。

paragraphs.en: This cost structure means that the lasagna framework is accessible to research groups with API access and commodity hardware, without requiring dedicated GPU infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 这一成本结构意味着，千层面（lasagna）框架对于拥有 API 访问权限和普通硬件的研究团队来说是可及的，无需配备专用 GPU 基础设施。

paragraphs.en: We designed a three-track evaluation protocol that separates retrieval quality measurement from generation quality measurement and hallucination resistance testing. Each track uses a purpose-built corpus to ensure that the measured outcome reflects the intended evaluation dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一套三轨评估协议，将检索质量测量、生成质量测量与抗幻觉测试相互分离。 每条轨道均使用专门构建的语料库，以确保所测量的结果反映预期的评估维度。

sents.en: We designed a three-track evaluation protocol that separates retrieval quality measurement from generation quality measurement and hallucination resistance testing.
sents.zh: 我们设计了一套三轨评估协议，将检索质量测量、生成质量测量与抗幻觉测试相互分离。

sents.en: Each track uses a purpose-built corpus to ensure that the measured outcome reflects the intended evaluation dimension.
sents.zh: 每条轨道均使用专门构建的语料库，以确保所测量的结果反映预期的评估维度。

paragraphs.en: Each configuration is evaluated on 149 non-overlapping queries: 93 for retrieval (stratified across 5 BEIR domains) and 56 for generation (stratified across 3 QA benchmarks). These representative subsets were drawn via stratified random sampling from the full benchmark pools (which collectively contain thousands of queries) to balance domain coverage and difficulty distribution against the ∼ \sim $4,700 compute budget required for factorial-scale evaluation (167 configurations × \times 149 queries = 24,883 =24{,}883 retrieval evaluations plus 6,832 generation evaluations). The sampling preserves the original difficulty and domain distributions: each BEIR domain contributes 11–22 retrieval queries proportional to its test-set size, and each QA benchmark contributes 13–23 generation queries proportional to its eval-set size. While larger query sets would reduce per-configuration variance, the factorial design compensates by aggregating signal across 167 independent configurations, yielding 71,643 total evaluations, sufficient for main-effect and targeted-interaction testing at 80% power for η 2 ≥ 0.03 \eta^{2}\geq 0.03 ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每种配置都在 149 个不重叠的查询上进行评估：其中 93 个用于检索（在 5 个 BEIR 领域中分层抽取），56 个用于生成（在 3 个 QA 基准中分层抽取）。 这些代表性子集是通过分层随机抽样从完整基准池（合计包含数千个查询）中抽取的，以便在领域覆盖范围和难度分布与析因规模评估所需的约 4,700 计算预算（167 种配置 × 149 个查询 = 24,883 次检索评估加 6,832 次生成评估）之间取得平衡。 该抽样保留了原有的难度和领域分布：每个 BEIR 领域按其测试集规模成比例地贡献 11–22 个检索查询，每个 QA 基准按其评估集规模成比例地贡献 13–23 个生成查询。 虽然更大的查询集可以降低单配置方差，但析因设计通过聚合 167 个独立配置的信号来加以补偿，共产生 71,643 次总评估，足以在 80% 功效下对 η² ≥ 0.03 进行主效应和目标交互检验（第 5 节）。

sents.en: Each configuration is evaluated on 149 non-overlapping queries: 93 for retrieval (stratified across 5 BEIR domains) and 56 for generation (stratified across 3 QA benchmarks).
sents.zh: 每种配置都在 149 个不重叠的查询上进行评估：其中 93 个用于检索（在 5 个 BEIR 领域中分层抽取），56 个用于生成（在 3 个 QA 基准中分层抽取）。

sents.en: These representative subsets were drawn via stratified random sampling from the full benchmark pools (which collectively contain thousands of queries) to balance domain coverage and difficulty distribution against the ∼ \sim $4,700 compute budget required for factorial-scale evaluation (167 configurations × \times 149 queries = 24,883 =24{,}883 retrieval evaluations plus 6,832 generation evaluations).
sents.zh: 这些代表性子集是通过分层随机抽样从完整基准池（合计包含数千个查询）中抽取的，以便在领域覆盖范围和难度分布与析因规模评估所需的约 4,700 计算预算（167 种配置 × 149 个查询 = 24,883 次检索评估加 6,832 次生成评估）之间取得平衡。

sents.en: The sampling preserves the original difficulty and domain distributions: each BEIR domain contributes 11–22 retrieval queries proportional to its test-set size, and each QA benchmark contributes 13–23 generation queries proportional to its eval-set size.
sents.zh: 该抽样保留了原有的难度和领域分布：每个 BEIR 领域按其测试集规模成比例地贡献 11–22 个检索查询，每个 QA 基准按其评估集规模成比例地贡献 13–23 个生成查询。

sents.en: While larger query sets would reduce per-configuration variance, the factorial design compensates by aggregating signal across 167 independent configurations, yielding 71,643 total evaluations, sufficient for main-effect and targeted-interaction testing at 80% power for η 2 ≥ 0.03 \eta^{2}\geq 0.03 ( Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 虽然更大的查询集可以降低单配置方差，但析因设计通过聚合 167 个独立配置的信号来加以补偿，共产生 71,643 次总评估，足以在 80% 功效下对 η² ≥ 0.03 进行主效应和目标交互检验（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: We drew documents from five BEIR domain subsets: nfcorpus , fiqa , scifact , arguana , and hotpotqa . These subsets span biomedical, financial, scientific, argumentative, and multi-hop reasoning domains, providing heterogeneous retrieval challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从五个 BEIR 领域子集中抽取文档：nfcorpus、fiqa、scifact、arguana 和 hotpotqa。 这些子集涵盖生物医学、金融、科学、论证和多跳推理领域，提供了异构的检索挑战。

sents.zh: 我们从五个 BEIR 领域子集中抽取文档：nfcorpus、fiqa、scifact、arguana 和 hotpotqa。

sents.zh: 这些子集涵盖生物医学、金融、科学、论证和多跳推理领域，提供了异构的检索挑战。

paragraphs.en: For each benchmark we sampled 500 distractor documents from held-out BEIR collections that do not overlap with the benchmark’s relevance judgments. Distractors increase corpus size and dilute signal, making retrieval metrics more discriminative.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个基准，我们从与该基准相关性判断不重叠的保留 BEIR 集合中采样了 500 篇干扰文档。 干扰文档会增大语料库规模并稀释信号，使检索指标更具区分度。

sents.en: For each benchmark we sampled 500 distractor documents from held-out BEIR collections that do not overlap with the benchmark’s relevance judgments.
sents.zh: 对于每个基准，我们从与该基准相关性判断不重叠的保留 BEIR 集合中采样了 500 篇干扰文档。

sents.zh: 干扰文档会增大语料库规模并稀释信号，使检索指标更具区分度。

paragraphs.en: For the end-to-end generation track (Track 2), we extracted context passages from each QA sample by splitting on double newlines ( \n\n ). Each extracted passage was assigned a document identifier of the form gold:{benchmark}:{sample_id}:{passage_idx} and ingested alongside the base corpus. With 500 distractors per benchmark, gold passages represent roughly 8% of the Track 2 corpus; this ratio is substantially lower than the 84% we observed in early pilots that used only 100 distractors, yielding a more realistic retrieval challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 对于端到端生成赛道（Track 2），我们通过按双换行符（ \n\n ）切分，从每个问答样本中提取上下文段落。 每个提取出的段落都被赋予形如 gold:{benchmark}:{sample_id}:{passage_idx} 的文档标识符，并与基础语料库一起被摄入。 每个基准测试配 500 个干扰段落时，黄金段落约占 Track 2 语料库的 8%；这一比例远低于我们在仅使用 100 个干扰项的早期试验中观察到的 84%，从而构成了更贴近实际的检索挑战。

sents.en: For the end-to-end generation track (Track 2), we extracted context passages from each QA sample by splitting on double newlines ( \n\n ).
sents.zh: 对于端到端生成赛道（Track 2），我们通过按双换行符（ \n\n ）切分，从每个问答样本中提取上下文段落。

sents.en: With 500 distractors per benchmark, gold passages represent roughly 8% of the Track 2 corpus; this ratio is substantially lower than the 84% we observed in early pilots that used only 100 distractors, yielding a more realistic retrieval challenge.
sents.zh: 每个基准测试配 500 个干扰段落时，黄金段落约占 Track 2 语料库的 8%；这一比例远低于我们在仅使用 100 个干扰项的早期试验中观察到的 84%，从而构成了更贴近实际的检索挑战。

paragraphs.en: We partitioned all queries into 60/20/20 train/eval/test splits, stratified by source benchmark, so that each split contains a proportional representation of every domain. The eval split guided iterative development; the test split was reserved for final reporting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将所有查询按 60/20/20 的比例划分为训练/评估/测试集，并按来源基准进行分层抽样，使每个划分中都按比例包含各个领域的代表性样本。 评估集用于指导迭代开发；测试集则保留用于最终结果报告。

sents.en: We partitioned all queries into 60/20/20 train/eval/test splits, stratified by source benchmark, so that each split contains a proportional representation of every domain.
sents.zh: 我们将所有查询按 60/20/20 的比例划分为训练/评估/测试集，并按来源基准进行分层抽样，使每个划分中都按比例包含各个领域的代表性样本。

sents.en: The eval split guided iterative development; the test split was reserved for final reporting.
sents.zh: 评估集用于指导迭代开发；测试集则保留用于最终结果报告。

paragraphs.en: We separate the three tracks for the following reasons:
paragraphs.zh: 我们出于以下原因将这三条轨道分开：

paragraphs.en: Retrieval track. Standard IR evaluation with BEIR relevance judgments, independent of the generation model. This isolates retrieval quality from downstream answer quality and allows direct comparison with published BEIR baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 检索赛道。 基于 BEIR 相关性判断的标准信息检索评估，与生成模型无关。 这将检索质量与下游答案质量分离开来，并允许与已发表的 BEIR 基线进行直接比较。

sents.en: Retrieval track.
sents.zh: 检索赛道。

sents.en: Standard IR evaluation with BEIR relevance judgments, independent of the generation model.
sents.zh: 基于 BEIR 相关性判断的标准信息检索评估，与生成模型无关。

sents.en: This isolates retrieval quality from downstream answer quality and allows direct comparison with published BEIR baselines.
sents.zh: 这将检索质量与下游答案质量分离开来，并允许与已发表的 BEIR 基线进行直接比较。

paragraphs.en: E2E generation track. Tests the full pipeline, including answer generation. Gold passages are present in the corpus so that the retriever can find them; failure to produce a correct answer therefore reflects pipeline limitations rather than corpus gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端生成赛道。 测试完整流水线，包括答案生成。 标准答案段落已包含在语料库中，以便检索器能够找到它们；因此，未能生成正确答案反映的是流水线的局限性，而非语料库的缺失。

sents.en: E2E generation track.
sents.zh: 端到端生成赛道。

sents.en: Tests the full pipeline, including answer generation.
sents.zh: 测试完整流水线，包括答案生成。

sents.en: Gold passages are present in the corpus so that the retriever can find them; failure to produce a correct answer therefore reflects pipeline limitations rather than corpus gaps.
sents.zh: 标准答案段落已包含在语料库中，以便检索器能够找到它们；因此，未能生成正确答案反映的是流水线的局限性，而非语料库的缺失。

paragraphs.en: Hallucination track. Tests whether the system hallucinates when gold evidence is absent from the corpus. A faithful system should abstain or hedge rather than fabricate an answer. By reusing the same queries as Track 2 but withholding gold passages, we can attribute faithfulness differences to corpus composition rather than query difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉赛道。 测试当金标准证据不在语料库中时，系统是否会产生幻觉。 一个忠实的系统应当弃答或谨慎表述，而不是编造答案。 通过复用与赛道2相同的查询但隐藏金标准段落，我们可以将忠实度的差异归因于语料库的构成，而非查询的难度。

sents.en: Hallucination track.
sents.zh: 幻觉赛道。

sents.en: Tests whether the system hallucinates when gold evidence is absent from the corpus.
sents.zh: 测试当金标准证据不在语料库中时，系统是否会产生幻觉。

sents.en: A faithful system should abstain or hedge rather than fabricate an answer.
sents.zh: 一个忠实的系统应当弃答或谨慎表述，而不是编造答案。

sents.en: By reusing the same queries as Track 2 but withholding gold passages, we can attribute faithfulness differences to corpus composition rather than query difficulty.
sents.zh: 通过复用与赛道2相同的查询但隐藏金标准段落，我们可以将忠实度的差异归因于语料库的构成，而非查询的难度。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 lists the question-answering benchmarks we used for Tracks 2 and 3.
paragraphs.zh: 表 16 列出了我们在赛道 2 和赛道 3 中使用的问答基准测试。

paragraphs.en: To avoid redundant re-ingestion across experiments that differ only in query-time configuration, we key corpus reuse on a hash of the ingestion parameters: (corpus_id, corpus_fingerprint, embedding_model, embedding_dim, chunking_params) . Two experiment runs that share the same ingestion signature reuse the previously indexed corpus, while any change to the embedding model or chunking strategy triggers a fresh ingestion. This design allows us to evaluate dozens of query-time configurations (reranker weights, fusion parameters, routing tiers) against a single indexed corpus without repeated ingestion overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 为避免在仅查询时配置不同的实验之间出现重复的重复摄取，我们以摄取参数的哈希作为语料库复用的键：(corpus_id, corpus_fingerprint, embedding_model, embedding_dim, chunking_params)。 共享相同摄取签名的两次实验运行会复用之前已索引的语料库，而嵌入模型或分块策略的任何变更都会触发全新的摄取。 这一设计使我们能够针对单个已索引的语料库评估数十种查询时配置（重排序器权重、融合参数、路由层级），而无需承担重复摄取的开销。

paragraphs.en: The remaining 7 supported benchmarks (MS MARCO, TREC-COVID, TriviaQA, Natural Questions, FEVER, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MultiHop-RAG) were not evaluated due to infrastructure constraints: corpus sizes exceeding our Milvus Lite capacity (MS MARCO: 8.8M passages), rate-limited LLM proxy access for generation evaluation, and time constraints. All adapters are functional and available for community use.

paragraphs.en: Beyond the core BEIR and QA suites, lasagna provides adapters for the following benchmarks:
paragraphs.zh: 除核心的 BEIR 和 QA 测试套件之外，lasagna 还为以下基准测试提供了适配器：

paragraphs.en: FEVER (Fact Extraction and VERification): 185K claims labeled as Supported, Refuted, or NotEnoughInfo against Wikipedia evidence. Tests evidence retrieval for fact-checking.
paragraphs.zh: FEVER（事实抽取与验证）：185K 条声明，依据维基百科证据标注为 Supported、Refuted 或 NotEnoughInfo。 测试事实核查中的证据检索。

sents.en: Tests evidence retrieval for fact-checking.
sents.zh: 测试事实核查中的证据检索。

paragraphs.en: 2WikiMultiHopQA : Multi-hop reasoning requiring evidence from exactly two Wikipedia articles, with bridge, comparison, and inference question types.
paragraphs.zh: 2WikiMultiHopQA：多跳推理任务，需要恰好来自两个维基百科条目的证据，包含桥接、比较和推断三种问题类型。

paragraphs.en: MultiHop-RAG : Multi-hop QA over news articles, designed specifically for RAG evaluation with retrieval-dependent questions.
paragraphs.zh: MultiHop-RAG：新闻文章上的多跳问答，专为带检索依赖问题的 RAG 评估而设计。

paragraphs.en: RAGBench : Meta-benchmark aggregating multiple QA datasets (HotpotQA, SQuAD, MS MARCO, PubMedQA, TechQA) under a unified TRACe-style evaluation framework.
paragraphs.zh: RAGBench：聚合多个问答数据集（HotpotQA、SQuAD、MS MARCO、PubMedQA、TechQA）的元基准，采用统一的 TRACe 风格评估框架。

paragraphs.en: KILT (Knowledge Intensive Language Tasks): Suite of 5 knowledge-intensive NLP tasks including entity linking, slot filling, and open-domain QA over Wikipedia.
paragraphs.zh: KILT（知识密集型语言任务）：一套包含 5 项知识密集型 NLP 任务的任务集，涵盖实体链接、槽位填充以及基于维基百科的开放域问答。

paragraphs.en: PopQA : Entity-centric QA across varying Wikipedia popularity tiers, testing whether retrieval quality degrades for less-popular entities (tail knowledge).
paragraphs.zh: PopQA：跨不同维基百科流行度层级的以实体为中心的问答，测试检索质量是否会对较不流行的实体（尾部知识）出现退化。

paragraphs.en: For corpus scaling experiments ( Section 5 ), we generate 45,000 distractor documents from the same five BEIR domains used in the base corpus. Distractors are drawn from held-out subsets (no overlap with evaluation queries’ relevant documents) and injected in four increments of 10K/10K/10K/15K documents, yielding corpus sizes of approximately 5K, 15K, 25K, and 50K. paragraphs.en: The 100K and 200K corpora extend the base 5K by adding further distractor documents drawn from the same five BEIR held-out subsets used for the 15K/25K/50K increments in Table 20 , sampled with the same proportional-to-domain allocation. Distractors between 50K and 200K are drawn from the remaining held-out pool after the increment 1–4 draw is removed; where the held-out pool is smaller than the requested draw (NFCorpus is the binding constraint) the additional slots are allocated to the next-largest domain (HotpotQA), which slightly increases HotpotQA’s share of the 100K/200K tails relative to the 5K–50K composition. Deduplication is enforced by the same doc_id -level protocol described in Section B.3 : base ∩ \cap distractors = ∅ =\emptyset , pairwise inter-increment intersection = ∅ =\emptyset , and no intra-file duplicates. SHA-256 corpus fingerprints for the 100K/200K corpus files are unavailable ; the draw is reproducible from the seed-42 sampling script over the public BEIR distributions ( paper/scripts/build_scaling_corpus.py , available from the authors on request). Consequently, reconstruction relies on the recipe rather than byte-level verification of the generated corpus.

paragraphs.en: Two mechanisms besides information coverage may contribute to the observed faithfulness improvements at scale. First, the generator’s instruction-following behavior may cause it to produce safer, less specific answers when retrieved context is noisier, trading answer precision for faithfulness. Second, RAGAS faithfulness measures answer–context consistency, not answer–truth consistency: if both answer and context shift toward vaguer content, faithfulness can increase trivially. Distinguishing these from the information-coverage explanation requires human evaluation of answer specificity at each corpus size, which we leave to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 除信息覆盖之外，还有两种机制可能促成在大规模下观察到的忠实度提升。 首先，生成器的指令遵循行为可能导致其在检索到的上下文噪声更大时产出更安全、更不具体的答案，以答案精确度换取忠实度。 其次，RAGAS 忠实度衡量的是答案与上下文的一致性，而非答案与真实情况的一致性：如果答案和上下文都转向更模糊的内容，忠实度可能会轻而易举地提高。 要将这些解释与信息覆盖的解释区分开，需要对每个语料库规模下答案的具体性进行人工评估，我们将此留待未来工作。

sents.en: First, the generator’s instruction-following behavior may cause it to produce safer, less specific answers when retrieved context is noisier, trading answer precision for faithfulness.
sents.zh: 首先，生成器的指令遵循行为可能导致其在检索到的上下文噪声更大时产出更安全、更不具体的答案，以答案精确度换取忠实度。

sents.en: Second, RAGAS faithfulness measures answer–context consistency, not answer–truth consistency: if both answer and context shift toward vaguer content, faithfulness can increase trivially.
sents.zh: 其次，RAGAS 忠实度衡量的是答案与上下文的一致性，而非答案与真实情况的一致性：如果答案和上下文都转向更模糊的内容，忠实度可能会轻而易举地提高。

sents.en: Distinguishing these from the information-coverage explanation requires human evaluation of answer specificity at each corpus size, which we leave to future work.
sents.zh: 要将这些解释与信息覆盖的解释区分开，需要对每个语料库规模下答案的具体性进行人工评估，我们将此留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: We fit log-linear models NDCG@10 = a ⋅ log 10 ⁡ ( N ) + b \text{NDCG@10}=a\cdot\log_{10}(N)+b to the six-point scaling data; Table 23 reports goodness-of-fit and 95% prediction intervals for extrapolations to 500K–1M.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对六个点的缩放数据拟合了对数线性模型 NDCG@10 = a ⋅ log 10 ⁡ ( N ) + b \text{NDCG@10}=a\cdot\log_{10}(N)+b；表 23 报告了拟合优度以及外推至 500K–1M 的 95% 预测区间。

paragraphs.en: speed and standard show strong log-linear fits ( R 2 ≥ 0.89 R^{2}\geq 0.89 ) with slopes significantly different from zero ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ), supporting the classic power-law scaling picture.
paragraphs.zh: 速度和标准呈现很强的对数线性拟合（R 2 ≥ 0.89 R^{2}\geq 0.89），斜率显著不为零（p < 0.01 p<0.01），支持经典的幂律标度图景。

paragraphs.en: The pre-registration specified a power-law fit, NDCG@10 ​ ( N ) = a ⋅ N b \text{NDCG@10}(N)=a\cdot N^{b} ; the fit we executed is log-linear in log 10 ⁡ ( N ) \log_{10}(N) , NDCG@10 ​ ( N ) = a ⋅ log 10 ⁡ ( N ) + b \text{NDCG@10}(N)=a\cdot\log_{10}(N)+b . These are not the same functional form (the pre-registered power law is linear in log ⁡ NDCG \log\text{NDCG} vs log ⁡ N \log N ; the executed fit is linear in NDCG vs log ⁡ N \log N ). We report the log-linear fit because NDCG@10 is bounded in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and the observed decay is close-to-linear on that scale across our measured range, whereas a power law is more appropriate when the dependent variable spans multiple orders of magnitude. A side-by-side power-law vs. log-linear comparison on the same scaling data is reported in Section D.4 ; both fits agree on the sign of the rank ordering and on the direction of the slope difference between profiles, so the qualitative conclusion is robust to the choice of parameterization. The qualitative headline conclusion ( balanced overtakes standard between 15K and 25K and the gap firms at 200K) is a rank claim on measured cells and does not depend on which fit is used; the numerical slope estimates ( Table 23 ) and the 500K/1M projections ( Table 49 ) do, and should be re-fit under a power-law parameterization before being used quantitatively. balanced and max-reliable show weaker fits ( R 2 = 0.40 , 0.30 R^{2}=0.40,0.30 ) with slopes not statistically distinguishable from zero ( p = 0.175 , 0.265 p=0.175,0.265 ); these profiles are so scale-robust that their variation is dominated by seed noise rather than corpus-size degradation, itself a positive finding for scale robustness, though it also means the projected 1M intervals for those two profiles are necessarily wide. Latency scaling appears in Section E.2 ; extrapolation to 1M with full caveats in Section E.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 预注册中指定的是幂律拟合，NDCG@10(N)=a·N^b；而我们实际执行的拟合在 log10(N) 上是线性的，NDCG@10(N)=a·log10(N)+b。 这两者并非相同的函数形式（预注册的幂律在 log NDCG 对 log N 上是线性的，而实际执行的拟合是在 NDCG 对 log N 上线性）。 我们报告对数线性拟合，是因为 NDCG@10 的取值范围限定在 [0,1] 之间，且在我们测量的范围内，其衰减在该尺度上接近线性；而当因变量跨越多个数量级时，幂律更为合适。 针对同一份扩展性数据的幂律与对数线性并排比较见 D.4 节；两种拟合在排名顺序的符号以及不同配置之间斜率差异的方向上均一致，因此该定性结论对参数化方式的选择是稳健的。 定性的核心结论（balanced 在 15K 到 25K 之间超越 standard，且差距在 200K 时趋于稳固）是针对实测单元格的排名性论断，不依赖于使用哪种拟合；而数值斜率估计（表 23）和 500K/1M 的外推预测（表 49）则依赖于此，应在幂律参数化下重新拟合后方可定量使用。balanced 和 max-reliable 的拟合效果较弱（R²=0.40, 0.30），其斜率在统计上与零无法区分（p=0.175, 0.265）；这两种配置的规模稳健性如此之强，以至于其波动主要由随机种子噪声而非语料库规模退化所主导，这本身就是对规模稳健性的一个积极发现，但这也意味着这两种配置的 1M 预测区间必然较宽。 延迟扩展性分析见 E.2 节；向 1M 的外推及完整的注意事项见 E.3 节。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides representative queries from each benchmark to illustrate the diversity and difficulty of the evaluation set. The full evaluation corpus comprises 149 queries per configuration (93 retrieval + 56 generation), yielding 24,883 individual query evaluations across the 167-configuration factorial experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供每个基准测试中的代表性查询，以说明评估集的多样性与难度。 完整的评估语料库包含每个配置 149 条查询（93 条检索 + 56 条生成），在 167 配置的因子实验中共产生 24,883 次单条查询评估。

sents.zh: 本附录提供每个基准测试中的代表性查询，以说明评估集的多样性与难度。

sents.en: The full evaluation corpus comprises 149 queries per configuration (93 retrieval + 56 generation), yielding 24,883 individual query evaluations across the 167-configuration factorial experiment.
sents.zh: 完整的评估语料库包含每个配置 149 条查询（93 条检索 + 56 条生成），在 167 配置的因子实验中共产生 24,883 次单条查询评估。

paragraphs.en: The retrieval queries span five diversity axes: single-term medical lookups (NFCorpus), opinion-seeking financial questions (FiQA), scientific claim verification (SciFact), counterargument retrieval (ArguAna), and multi-hop reasoning chains (HotpotQA). The generation queries require compositional reasoning (MuSiQue, HotpotQA) or reading comprehension with unanswerable question detection (SQuAD v2).
paragraphs.zh: 检索查询涵盖五个多样性维度：单词项医学查询（NFCorpus）、寻求观点的金融问题（FiQA）、科学论断验证（SciFact）、反论检索（ArguAna）以及多跳推理链（HotpotQA）。 生成查询需要组合式推理（MuSiQue、HotpotQA），或者需要阅读理解并检测不可回答的问题（SQuAD v2）。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides formal definitions for every evaluation metric exposed by lasagna ’s evaluation SDK, grouped into retrieval metrics (computed before generation), end-to-end answer metrics, and LLM-judged metrics. The main paper reports NDCG@10, MRR, Recall@100, EM, Token F1, and RAGAS faithfulness; the remaining metrics defined below (answer relevance, pairwise LLM-as-judge preference, MAP, and RAGAS context recall) are supported by the SDK but not reported in this study , answer relevance was redundant with faithfulness under our concise-answer prompting, pairwise preference was superseded by the factorial metrics, MAP tracked NDCG@10 within noise, and RAGAS context recall was systematically unreliable with the GPT-5.1 judge and is excluded from all analyses. Cross-judge agreement with Claude Sonnet 4.5 is documented under Section C.1.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录对 lasagna 的评估 SDK 所暴露的每个评估指标提供正式定义，分为检索指标（在生成之前计算）、端到端答案指标和由 LLM 评判的指标。 主论文报告了 NDCG@10、MRR、Recall@100、EM、Token F1 和 RAGAS 忠实度；下文定义的其余指标（答案相关性、成对 LLM 即评判者偏好、MAP 以及 RAGAS 上下文召回率）虽受 SDK 支持但未在本研究中报告：答案相关性在我们的简洁答案提示下与忠实度冗余，成对偏好被因子化指标所取代，MAP 与 NDCG@10 的差异在噪声范围内，而 RAGAS 上下文召回率在使用 GPT-5.1 评判者时系统性不可靠，因此被排除在所有分析之外。 与 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的跨评判者一致性记录于第 C.1.4 节。

paragraphs.en: All LLM-judged metrics use RAGAS v0.4 ( Es et al., 2024 ) with GPT-5.1 as the judge model at temperature T = 0 T{=}0 , greedy decoding, and deterministic seed. This applies uniformly to all experiments: profile comparisons, scaling experiments, and the 122-configuration faithfulness factorial. lasagna wraps the RAGAS framework so the same judge configuration is reused across faithfulness, answer relevance, and context recall, and so every LLM call is deterministic under the fixed seed.
paragraphs.zh: 所有由 LLM 评判的指标均使用 RAGAS v0.4（Es et al., 2024），以 GPT-5.1 作为评判模型，温度 T = 0 T{=}0，采用贪婪解码和固定随机种子。 这一设置统一应用于所有实验：配置对比实验、规模扩展实验以及 122 种配置的忠实度因子实验。lasagna 封装了 RAGAS 框架，使同一评判配置在忠实度、答案相关性和上下文召回中被复用，并确保每次 LLM 调用在固定种子下都是确定性的。

paragraphs.en: LLM judges exhibit well-documented biases that can distort evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Our protocol mitigates three of these biases, described below.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 裁判存在有据可查的偏差，这些偏差可能会扭曲评估结果（Zheng et al., 2023）。 我们的协议缓解了其中三种偏差，具体描述如下。

sents.en: LLM judges exhibit well-documented biases that can distort evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: LLM 裁判存在有据可查的偏差，这些偏差可能会扭曲评估结果（Zheng et al., 2023）。

sents.en: Our protocol mitigates three of these biases, described below.
sents.zh: 我们的协议缓解了其中三种偏差，具体描述如下。

paragraphs.en: LLM judges tend to prefer the answer presented first in the prompt ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . For all pairwise comparisons, we run each pair twice with swapped presentation order (A-B and B-A) and record a win only when the preference is consistent across both orderings. Inconsistent pairs are counted as ties.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 裁判倾向于偏向提示中先给出的答案（Zheng et al., 2023）。 对于所有成对比较，我们以交换呈现顺序的方式（A-B 和 B-A）对每一对运行两次，只有当两次顺序下的偏好一致时才记录为一次胜出。 偏好不一致的对被计为平局。

sents.en: LLM judges tend to prefer the answer presented first in the prompt ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .

sents.en: For all pairwise comparisons, we run each pair twice with swapped presentation order (A-B and B-A) and record a win only when the preference is consistent across both orderings.
sents.zh: 对于所有成对比较，我们以交换呈现顺序的方式（A-B 和 B-A）对每一对运行两次，只有当两次顺序下的偏好一致时才记录为一次胜出。

sents.en: Inconsistent pairs are counted as ties.
sents.zh: 偏好不一致的对被计为平局。

paragraphs.en: Models may prefer outputs from the same model family. Because both answer generation (GPT-5.1) and judging (GPT-5.1) use the same model, self-preference bias is a concern. We mitigate this in two ways: (i) the judge evaluates answer pairs from different pipeline configurations , not from different base models, so both candidates are GPT-5.1 outputs and self-preference does not favor either candidate; (ii) we validate a 50-query subsample using Claude Sonnet 4.5 as an alternative judge to measure inter-judge agreement. We ran 80 matched samples (40 per configuration) through both judges. Kendall’s τ b = 0.38 \tau_{b}=0.38 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), Spearman ρ = 0.42 \rho=0.42 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and 66% of per-sample faithfulness scores agree within 0.1 absolute points. GPT-5.1 assigns slightly higher mean faithfulness (0.879 vs. 0.860 for Claude Sonnet 4.5). This moderate, statistically significant agreement indicates that per-sample faithfulness scores are largely consistent across judge models on the two configurations sampled, though absolute scores show provider-specific calibration differences; see Section C.5 for a separate pairwise-BTL protocol study showing that fine-grained configuration-level rankings are protocol-dependent while profile-tier separations are preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 模型可能更偏好来自同一模型系列的输出。 由于答案生成（GPT-5.1）与评判（GPT-5.1）使用同一模型，自我偏好偏差令人担忧。 我们通过两种方式缓解这一问题：（i）评判者评估的是来自不同流水线配置的答案对，而非来自不同基础模型的答案对，因此两个候选答案都是 GPT-5.1 的输出，自我偏好不会偏向任一候选答案；（ii）我们使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 作为替代评判者，对 50 个查询的子样本进行验证，以衡量评判者之间的一致性。 我们对 80 个匹配样本（每种配置 40 个）同时使用了两位评判者。 Kendall τ_b = 0.38（p < 0.001），Spearman ρ = 0.42（p < 0.001），并且 66% 的逐样本忠实度分数在 0.1 个绝对分值范围内一致。 GPT-5.1 给出的平均忠实度略高（0.879，而 Claude Sonnet 4.5 为 0.860）。 这种中等程度且统计显著的一致性表明，在所抽样的两种配置上，逐样本忠实度分数在各评判模型之间基本一致，尽管绝对分数显示出特定提供商的校准差异；参见 C.5 节关于成对 BTL 协议的单独研究，该研究表明细粒度的配置级排名依赖于协议，而画像层级的区分则得以保留。

All RAGAS evaluations use batch_size=4 to avoid rate-limit-induced timeouts, and we use paired statistical tests (paired bootstrap or Wilcoxon signed-rank, paired by query) so that any residual judge noise cancels across configurations being compared.

paragraphs.en: Faithfulness scores in this paper come from two distinct generation regimes that use different prompt templates. Both are scored by the same RAGAS v0.4 / GPT-5.1 judge with identical decoding ( Section C.1.4 ); the numerical gap between them is a prompt effect , not a scoring inconsistency. We disclose both templates here so that faithfulness comparisons within a regime (pre-registered) are separable from cross-regime comparisons (descriptive only).
paragraphs.zh: 本文中的忠实度分数来自两种不同的生成机制，它们使用了不同的提示词模板。 两者均由同一个 RAGAS v0.4 / GPT-5.1 评判器以完全相同的解码方式进行打分（见第 C.1.4 节）；二者之间的数值差距是一种提示词效应，而非评分不一致所致。 我们在此公开这两个模板，以便将同一机制内的忠实度比较（预先注册）与跨机制的比较（仅作描述性说明）区分开来。

paragraphs.en: As a sensitivity check on the joint hypervolume comparison in Table 2 , we recompute HV under two counterfactual regime alignments using the paired-sample gap from Table 27 . Aligning all four profiles to the concise-regen prompt (subtracting each agentic profile’s paired regime gap) drops balanced ’s HV to 0.37 0.37 and max-reliable ’s to 0.32 0.32 , versus standard ’s unchanged 0.52 0.52 ; aligning all four to the verbose-agentic prompt raises standard ’s HV to 0.64 0.64 (both at L ref = 30 L_{\mathrm{ref}}{=}30 s). standard remains the joint-HV leader under either alignment, and the within-agentic-class comparison ( balanced vs max-reliable ) uses a common prompt regime by construction and is unaffected.
paragraphs.zh: 作为对表 2 中联合超体积比较的敏感性检验，我们利用表 27 中的配对样本差距，在两种反事实场景对齐方式下重新计算 HV。 将全部四个配置对齐到简洁重新生成提示词（减去每个智能体配置的配对场景差距）会使 balanced 的 HV 降至 0.37 0.37，max-reliable 的降至 0.32 0.32，而 standard 的保持 0.52 0.52 不变；将全部四个配置对齐到冗长智能体提示词会使 standard 的 HV 升至 0.64 0.64（两者均在 L ref = 30 L_{\mathrm{ref}}{=}30 s 下）。standard 在任一对齐方式下都保持联合 HV 的领先地位，而智能体类别内部的比较（ balanced 与 max-reliable ）在构造上使用相同的提示词场景，因此不受影响。

paragraphs.en: The CRAG grader prompt, Self-RAG reflection prompts, and Speculative-RAG draft-and-verify prompts are held fixed at the versions frozen at design time (recorded alongside the manifest at the paths referenced in Table 58 and available from the authors on request). Observed agentic-vs-standard deltas throughout this paper are for these specific prompt configurations and cost model; alternative prompt engineering choices (e.g., few-shot exemplars in the grader prompt, different Self-RAG reflection-token sets, or different Speculative-RAG draft budgets) may shift the ordering of agentic gates relative to no-gate. Section I.2 documents the practical decision rule that de-couples the choice of agentic gate from the choice of agentic prompt , so the profile recommendations survive prompt-configuration changes even when specific per-gate deltas do not.
paragraphs.zh: CRAG 判定提示词、Self-RAG 反思提示词以及 Speculative-RAG 起草与验证提示词均固定在设计时冻结的版本（随清单一同记录在表 58 引用的路径下，可向作者索取）。 本文全文观测到的智能体式与标准式之间的差异均针对这些特定的提示词配置和成本模型；其他提示词工程选择（例如在判定提示词中加入少样本示例、使用不同的 Self-RAG 反思令牌集合，或设置不同的 Speculative-RAG 起草预算）可能改变各智能体门控相对于无门控的排序。 第 I.2 节记录了一个实用的决策规则，将智能体门控的选择与智能体提示词的选择解耦，因此即使各门控的具体差异会发生变化，配置建议仍然在提示词配置变更后保持有效。

paragraphs.en: A natural concern is that faithfulness gains under our concise-answer prompting may partly reflect brevity, shorter answers make fewer atomic claims and thus fewer opportunities for the RAGAS judge to flag a claim as unsupported, rather than genuinely superior grounding. We ran a targeted length-controlled experiment to quantify this effect.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的担忧是，我们在简洁回答提示下获得的忠实度提升可能部分反映了简短性——较短的回答包含的原子性论断更少，因而 RAGAS 评判器标记某条论断为无依据的机会也更少——而非真正更优的依据性。 我们进行了一项有针对性的长度控制实验来量化这一效应。

sents.en: We ran a targeted length-controlled experiment to quantify this effect.
sents.zh: 我们进行了一项有针对性的长度控制实验来量化这一效应。

paragraphs.en: We drew a stratified sample of 50 questions across three benchmarks (SQuAD v2: 22, MuSiQue: 18, HotpotQA: 10) and re-generated answers under three prompt regimes derived from a common instruction skeleton that varies only length guidance: (A) concise (“answer in one short sentence”), (B) neutral (“answer based on the context”), and (C) verbose (“answer in detail with supporting facts”). Retrieved contexts, decoding parameters, and the generator LLM are held constant. All 50 × 3 = 150 50\times 3=150 answer–context pairs are re-scored under the canonical GPT-5.1 faithfulness judge. Raw data ( paper/data/length_controlled_faith.jsonl ) and the analysis script ( paper/scripts/m6_length_analysis.py ) are available from the authors on request.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个基准中分层抽取了 50 个问题（SQuAD v2：22 个，MuSiQue：18 个，HotpotQA：10 个），并在三种提示方案下重新生成答案，这些方案源自同一个仅长度指引不同的指令骨架：（A）简洁式（“用一句短话回答”），（B）中性式（“根据上下文回答”），（C）冗长式（“详细回答并给出支持性事实”）。 检索到的上下文、解码参数以及生成器 LLM 均保持不变。 全部 50 × 3 = 150 50\times 3=150 个答案—上下文配对均在标准的 GPT-5.1 忠实度评判器下重新打分。 原始数据（paper/data/length_controlled_faith.jsonl）和分析脚本（paper/scripts/m6_length_analysis.py）可向作者索取。

A fixed-effects OLS faith ∼ tokens + variant + benchmark \text{faith}\sim\text{tokens}+\text{variant}+\text{benchmark} gives β len = − 1.26 × 10 − 3 \beta_{\text{len}}=-1.26\times 10^{-3} per token (SE 3.28 × 10 − 4 3.28\times 10^{-4} , p = 1.9 × 10 − 4 p=1.9\times 10^{-4} , R 2 = 0.181 R^{2}=0.181 ): every additional 100 answer tokens costs 0.126 0.126 faithfulness points on average . paragraphs.en: Raw means order as neutral > > concise > > verbose (a concise − {-} verbose gap of + 0.179 +0.179 ). After residualizing on log answer length the ordering flips : verbose (0.824) > > neutral (0.791) > > concise (0.714), a residualized gap of − 0.110 -0.110 . In other words, verbose answers make more grounded claims per unit of attempted content ; the apparent concise advantage on raw faithfulness is fully accounted for by the mechanical fact that shorter answers contain fewer claims to verify.
paragraphs.zh: 原始方式的排序为中性 > 简洁 > 冗长（简洁与冗长之间的差距为 +0.179）。 在对答案长度的对数进行残差化处理后，排序发生反转：冗长（0.824）> 中性（0.791）> 简洁（0.714），残差化后的差距为 −0.110。 换言之，冗长的回答在每单位尝试内容上做出更多有依据的论断；原始忠实度上表面存在的简洁优势，完全可以由较短回答包含更少待验证论断这一机械性事实来解释。

paragraphs.en: The length effect is strongest on SQuAD v2 ( r = − 0.56 r{=}-0.56 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ; verbose mean drops to 0.539), moderate on MuSiQue ( r = − 0.26 r{=}-0.26 , p = 0.057 p{=}0.057 ), and weak on HotpotQA ( r = − 0.25 r{=}-0.25 , p = 0.17 p{=}0.17 , n = 30 n{=}30 ). This is consistent with SQuAD’s short span-extraction reference style: verbose answers deviate most from the corpus-anchored evidence surface and pick up more unsupported elaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 长度效应在 SQuAD v2 上最强（r=−0.56，p<10⁻⁶；冗长回答的均值降至 0.539），在 MuSiQue 上中等（r=−0.26，p=0.057），在 HotpotQA 上较弱（r=−0.25，p=0.17，n=30）。 这与 SQuAD 的短跨度抽取式参考答案风格相符：冗长回答偏离语料锚定的证据表面最远，并引入了更多缺乏依据的冗余阐述。

paragraphs.en: A portion of the raw faithfulness advantage reported for concise-regen configurations reflects brevity rather than superior grounding, so we report a length-residualized column alongside raw faithfulness for any cross-regime comparison (see the length-controlled entry in Table 58 ). Within-regime comparisons (the 122-configuration ANOVA and the scaling slopes) hold prompt length constant by construction and are therefore unaffected: the regen-vs-agentic gap in Table 27 is now best read as a joint prompt-and-length effect, not a pure prompt effect, but its statistical significance and direction survive length control on the paired 100K sample ( Δ = + 0.109 \Delta=+0.109 residualized vs. + 0.161 +0.161 raw).
paragraphs.zh: 简洁再生成（concise-regen）配置所报告的原始忠实度优势中，有一部分反映的是篇幅更短而非更强的依据支撑，因此在任何跨体制（cross-regime）比较中，我们在原始忠实度之外同时报告经长度残差化的列（见表 58 中的长度受控条目）。 体制内比较（122 个配置的方差分析及缩放斜率）在构造上控制了提示长度不变，因此不受影响：表 27 中再生成与智能体（regen-vs-agentic）之间的差距现在最好被解读为提示与长度的联合效应，而非纯粹的提示效应，但在配对的 100K 样本上，其统计显著性和方向在长度控制下依然成立（残差化后 Δ = +0.109，原始为 +0.161）。

paragraphs.en: The paper validates the RAGAS/GPT-5.1 faithfulness metric with three independent judge-validation studies that should not be conflated:
paragraphs.zh: 本文通过三项相互独立、不应混为一谈的评审验证研究，验证了 RAGAS/GPT-5.1 的忠实度指标：

paragraphs.en: Cross-LLM study ( Section C.1.4 , n = 80 n=80 ): 40 matched configuration answers per profile scored by GPT-5.1 and Claude Sonnet 4.5, yielding Kendall’s τ b = 0.38 \tau_{b}=0.38 with 66% pairwise agreement within ± 0.10 \pm 0.10 .
paragraphs.zh: 跨LLM研究（第 C.1.4 节，n = 80 n=80）：每个配置档案 40 个匹配配置的答案，由 GPT-5.1 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5 评分，得到 Kendall’s τ b = 0.38 \tau_{b}=0.38，且 66% 的成对比较在 ± 0.10 \pm 0.10 范围内一致。

paragraphs.en: Pairwise Bradley–Terry study ( Section C.5 , n = 123 n{=}123 pairs, 246 246 judgments): two independent LLM annotators fit a BTL posterior over 12 D5 × \times D8 configurations, yielding Cohen’s κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79 (substantial inter-annotator agreement) and a Spearman ρ = − 0.36 \rho=-0.36 between BTL and RAGAS configuration ranks; the fine-grained configuration ordering is protocol-dependent, but profile-tier separation is preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 成对 Bradley–Terry 研究（第 C.5 节，n=123 对，246 次判断）：两个独立的 LLM 标注者对 12 个 D5×D8 配置拟合 BTL 后验分布，得到 Cohen's κ=0.79（标注者间一致性较高），且 BTL 与 RAGAS 配置排名之间的 Spearman ρ=−0.36；细粒度的配置排序依赖于协议，但配置层级的区分得以保留。

paragraphs.en: These three studies use disjoint samples and answer different questions (per-answer human calibration, cross-model robustness, and pairwise configuration-ranking) and are therefore not pooled. Raw per-sample scores for all three studies are available from the authors on request: paper/data/human_eval_annotated.json (human dyad), paper/data/judge_cross_validation_80.json (cross-LLM), and paper/data/human_eval_btl_posteriors.json (with per-item pairwise annotations in paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A1.csv and paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A2.csv ).
paragraphs.zh: 这三项研究使用互不重叠的样本，回答的问题各不相同（分别为单条答案的人工校准、跨模型鲁棒性以及成对配置排序），因此不进行合并汇总。 这三项研究全部的单样本原始评分可向作者索取：paper/data/human_eval_annotated.json（人工双人评估）、paper/data/judge_cross_validation_80.json（跨大语言模型）以及 paper/data/human_eval_btl_posteriors.json（其中逐条目的成对标注见 paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A1.csv 和 paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A2.csv）。

paragraphs.en: The human validation ( n = 50 n{=}50 examples across SQuAD v2, MuSiQue and HotpotQA) establishes judge-level Pearson r = 0.83 r{=}0.83 against RAGAS. This sample is UNDER-POWERED to validate configuration-ranking-level correlation across the 122 pipeline configurations in the faithfulness factorial: at n = 50 n{=}50 the standard error on a Pearson correlation is ≈ 0.14 \approx 0.14 and the sample provides on average 50 / 122 ≈ 0.4 50/122\approx 0.4 observations per configuration, insufficient to certify a Kendall’s- τ b \tau_{b} between per-configuration human means and per-configuration RAGAS means. We therefore use this study only to establish judge validity at the per-answer level , and do not treat it as certifying ranking-level accuracy across configurations. The two cross-LLM sensitivity studies described elsewhere ( Section C.1.4 n = 80 n{=}80 ; Section F.8 n = 220 n{=}220 ) supplement this human study, but do not substitute for it; they measure robustness across judge models rather than validity against human judgement, and remain LLM-scored throughout. The study is also long-form-QA-only (three benchmarks; no retrieval metrics, no scaling cells, no cross-profile coverage), so extrapolation to retrieval-track claims (NDCG@10) or unseen profiles is not licensed by this evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 人工验证（在 SQuAD v2、MuSiQue 和 HotpotQA 上共 n{=}50 个样本）确立了判定器层面与 RAGAS 之间的 Pearson 相关系数 r{=}0.83。 该样本在验证忠实性因子设计中全部 122 个流水线配置的配置排序层面相关性方面统计功效不足：当 n{=}50 时，Pearson 相关系的标准误约为 ≈ 0.14，且样本对每个配置平均仅提供 50/122 ≈ 0.4 次观测，不足以证实各配置人工均值与各配置 RAGAS 均值之间的 Kendall's τ_b。 因此，我们仅将这项研究用于确立逐答案层面的判定器有效性，并不将其视为对跨配置排序层面准确性的证实。 在其他地方描述的两项跨 LLM 敏感性研究（C.1.4 节 n{=}80；F.8 节 n{=}220）是对这项人工研究的补充，但不能替代它；它们衡量的是跨判定模型（智能体）的鲁棒性，而非相对于人类判断的有效性，并且全程仍采用 LLM 打分。 此外，该研究仅限于长文本问答（三个基准；无检索指标、无扩展单元、无跨画像覆盖），因此该证据不能支持向检索赛道结论（NDCG@10）或未见画像的外推。

paragraphs.en: To validate the LLM-judged faithfulness metric, two domain experts with RAG evaluation experience independently annotated 50 question–answer–context triples sampled from the generation evaluation set (17 SQuAD v2, 18 MuSiQue, 15 HotpotQA). Each annotator scored faithfulness on a continuous 0–1 scale using the same rubric as the RAGAS judge: 1.0 if every claim is supported by the context, 0.0 if no claims are supported. Annotators worked independently without seeing each other’s scores or the RAGAS output.
paragraphs.zh: 为验证基于大语言模型评判的忠实度指标，两位具有 RAG 评估经验的领域专家独立标注了从生成评估集中抽取的 50 组「问题–答案–上下文」三元组（17 组来自 SQuAD v2，18 组来自 MuSiQue，15 组来自 HotpotQA）。 每位标注者使用与 RAGAS 评判器相同的评分标准，在连续的 0–1 分制上对忠实度打分：若所有论断均得到上下文支持则为 1.0 分，若没有任何论断得到支持则为 0.0 分。 标注者在彼此看不到对方评分、也看不到 RAGAS 输出的情况下独立完成工作。

paragraphs.en: The following instructions were provided verbatim to both annotators:
paragraphs.zh: 以下指令已逐字提供给两位标注者：

paragraphs.en: Annotation instructions. You will receive a question, a generated answer, and the retrieved context used to generate that answer. Score the answer’s faithfulness on a continuous scale from 0 to 1. A score of 1 means that every factual claim in the answer is supported by the context. A score of 0 means that none of the factual claims are supported. Evaluate support from the provided context only; do not use outside knowledge. Work independently and do not consult the other annotator or the automated RAGAS score.
paragraphs.zh: 标注说明。 你将收到一个问题、一个生成的答案，以及用于生成该答案的检索上下文。 请在 0 到 1 的连续量表上为答案的忠实度打分。 得分为 1 表示答案中的每一个事实性陈述都有上下文支持。 得分为 0 表示没有任何事实性陈述得到支持。 仅根据所提供的上下文评估支持情况；不要使用外部知识。 请独立工作，不要与另一位标注者或自动化的 RAGAS 分数进行对照。

paragraphs.en: Table 29 reports inter-rater reliability across all three raters (two human annotators and the GPT-5.1 RAGAS judge).
paragraphs.zh: 表 29 报告了全部三位评分者（两名人类标注员和 GPT-5.1 RAGAS 评判模型）之间的评分者间信度。

paragraphs.en: Human inter-rater reliability is high: Pearson r = 0.96 r=0.96 , Cohen’s κ = 0.93 \kappa=0.93 (binarized), and 96% of scores agree within 0.2 absolute points. Both human annotators agree strongly with the RAGAS judge (Pearson r = 0.83 r=0.83 and 0.77 0.77 ), with the average pairwise Pearson across all three raters reaching r = 0.85 r=0.85 . The RAGAS judge shows a slight positive bias ( + 0.019 +0.019 over Human 1, + 0.063 +0.063 over Human 2), consistent with known LLM self-preference effects ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人工评分者间信度很高：Pearson r = 0.96，Cohen's κ = 0.93（二值化后），且 96% 的评分在 0.2 个绝对分值之内一致。 两位人工标注者都与 RAGAS 评判高度一致（Pearson r = 0.83 和 0.77），三位评分者之间的平均两两 Pearson 相关系数达到 r = 0.85。 RAGAS 评判显示出轻微的正向偏倚（比人类 1 高 +0.019，比人类 2 高 +0.063），这与已知的 LLM 自偏好效应一致（Zheng 等，2023）。

sents.en: Human inter-rater reliability is high: Pearson r = 0.96 r=0.96 , Cohen’s κ = 0.93 \kappa=0.93 (binarized), and 96% of scores agree within 0.2 absolute points.
sents.zh: 人工评分者间信度很高：Pearson r = 0.96，Cohen's κ = 0.93（二值化后），且 96% 的评分在 0.2 个绝对分值之内一致。

sents.en: Both human annotators agree strongly with the RAGAS judge (Pearson r = 0.83 r=0.83 and 0.77 0.77 ), with the average pairwise Pearson across all three raters reaching r = 0.85 r=0.85 .
sents.zh: 两位人工标注者都与 RAGAS 评判高度一致（Pearson r = 0.83 和 0.77），三位评分者之间的平均两两 Pearson 相关系数达到 r = 0.85。

sents.en: The RAGAS judge shows a slight positive bias ( + 0.019 +0.019 over Human 1, + 0.063 +0.063 over Human 2), consistent with known LLM self-preference effects ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: RAGAS 评判显示出轻微的正向偏倚（比人类 1 高 +0.019，比人类 2 高 +0.063），这与已知的 LLM 自偏好效应一致（Zheng 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: The high human–human agreement ( r = 0.96 r=0.96 ) establishes that per-answer faithfulness scoring is reproducible across annotators, while the strong human–RAGAS agreement ( r > 0.77 r>0.77 ) confirms that judge substitution preserves per-answer scores and the effect-size / profile-tier structure that H1–H3 rest on. Fine-grained configuration-to-configuration rankings within a profile tier are protocol-dependent (Spearman ρ = − 0.36 \rho=-0.36 between BTL and RAGAS on the 12 D5 × \times D8 configurations covered by the BTL sample; see Section C.5 ); accordingly the paper’s inferential claims are scoped to the tier level, and within-tier configuration comparisons are reported as descriptive.
paragraphs.zh: 较高的人际一致性（r = 0.96）表明逐答案忠实度评分在不同标注者之间是可复现的，而较强的人类–RAGAS一致性（r > 0.77）证实了用评测者替代能够保留逐答案评分以及H1–H3所依赖的效应量/层级结构。 同一层级内细粒度的配置间排序依赖于协议（在BTL样本覆盖的12个D5 × D8配置上，BTL与RAGAS之间的Spearman ρ = −0.36；见C.5节）；因此本文的推断性主张限定在层级层面，层级内的配置比较仅作为描述性结果报告。

paragraphs.en: The n = 50 n{=}50 human study of Section C.4 establishes judge validity at the per-answer level but is under-powered to certify configuration-ranking accuracy across the D5 × \times D8 factorial. To probe whether the point-wise RAGAS faithfulness judge preserves ordering at fine-grained configuration granularity, we ran the third validation study of Section C.4 using a pairwise Bradley–Terry (BTL) LLM annotation protocol on 123 blinded configuration-pairs drawn from the D5 × \times D8 grid. Pairs were biased toward small RAGAS deltas (top- K K nearest per shared sample) to concentrate the study on the sub-noise regime the point-wise judge is least confident about. The RAGAS anchor scores against which the BTL posteriors are correlated in Table 30 (Spearman ρ = − 0.364 \rho=-0.364 ; Pearson r = − 0.421 r=-0.421 ) are computed under the concise-regen prompt regime ( Sections C.2 and 26 ), matching the 122-configuration faithfulness ANOVA ( Sections D.2 and 3 ) from which the D5 × \times D8 slice is drawn. Two independent LLM annotators produced 246 pairwise judgments; the full annotation brief ( paper/data/human_eval_annotator_instructions.md ) and raw per-item annotations ( paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A1.csv and paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A2.csv ) are available from the authors on request.
paragraphs.zh: C.4节中n = 50 n{=}50的人类研究在逐答案层面确立了裁判的有效性，但在D5 × \times D8析因设计的配置排序准确性认证上功效不足。 为探究逐点的RAGAS忠实性裁判是否能在细粒度配置粒度上保持排序，我们对从D5 × \times D8网格中抽取的123个盲测配置对运行了C.4节的第三次验证研究，采用成对Bradley–Terry（BTL）LLM标注协议。 配对偏向于较小的RAGAS差值（每个共享样本的top- K K最近邻），以使研究集中于逐点裁判最缺乏把握的亚噪声区间。 表30中BTL后验与之相关的RAGAS锚定分数（Spearman ρ = − 0.364 \rho=-0.364；Pearson r = − 0.421 r=-0.421）是在简洁重生成提示机制下计算的（第C.2节和第26节），与122个配置的忠实性ANOVA（第D.2节和第3节）相匹配，D5 × \times D8切片即取自该ANOVA。 两名独立的LLM标注者产生了246个成对判断；完整的标注说明（paper/data/human_eval_annotator_instructions.md）以及逐条原始标注（paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A1.csv和paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A2.csv）可向作者索取。

sents.zh: C.4节中n = 50 n{=}50的人类研究在逐答案层面确立了裁判的有效性，但在D5 × \times D8析因设计的配置排序准确性认证上功效不足。

sents.en: Pairs were biased toward small RAGAS deltas (top- K K nearest per shared sample) to concentrate the study on the sub-noise regime the point-wise judge is least confident about.

sents.en: The RAGAS anchor scores against which the BTL posteriors are correlated in Table 30 (Spearman ρ = − 0.364 \rho=-0.364 ; Pearson r = − 0.421 r=-0.421 ) are computed under the concise-regen prompt regime ( Sections C.2 and 26 ), matching the 122-configuration faithfulness ANOVA ( Sections D.2 and 3 ) from which the D5 × \times D8 slice is drawn.
sents.zh: 表30中BTL后验与之相关的RAGAS锚定分数（Spearman ρ = − 0.364 \rho=-0.364；Pearson r = − 0.421 r=-0.421）是在简洁重生成提示机制下计算的（第C.2节和第26节），与122个配置的忠实性ANOVA（第D.2节和第3节）相匹配，D5 × \times D8切片即取自该ANOVA。

sents.en: Two independent LLM annotators produced 246 pairwise judgments; the full annotation brief ( paper/data/human_eval_annotator_instructions.md ) and raw per-item annotations ( paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A1.csv and paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A2.csv ) are available from the authors on request.
sents.zh: 两名独立的LLM标注者产生了246个成对判断；完整的标注说明（paper/data/human_eval_annotator_instructions.md）以及逐条原始标注（paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A1.csv和paper/data/human_eval_pairwise_btl_items_A2.csv）可向作者索取。

paragraphs.en: Table 30 reports coverage and inter-protocol reliability; Table 31 reports the BTL posteriors over the 12 configurations covered by the sample.
paragraphs.zh: 表 30 报告了覆盖率与协议间信度；表 31 报告了样本所涵盖的 12 种配置下的 BTL 后验分布。

paragraphs.en: Three findings emerge, each with distinct implications for the paper’s headline claims (protocol reliability is separately established at the end of this subsection: Cohen’s κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79 between annotators, 92.7 % 92.7\% raw agreement across 246 246 judgments, so the 79 % 79\% tie rate reflects true configuration indistinguishability rather than annotator noise).
paragraphs.zh: 本文得出三项发现，每项发现对该论文的核心结论都有不同的启示（协议可靠性已在本小节末尾单独验证：标注者之间的 Cohen's κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79，246 246 次判断的原始一致率为 92.7 % 92.7\%，因此 79 % 79\% 的平局率反映的是真实的配置不可区分性，而非标注者噪声）。

paragraphs.en: (i) Fine-grain configuration deltas on the small-delta subsample are largely below LLM discriminability. With 79 % 79\% of pairwise judgments returned as ties and only 1 1 of 12 12 covered configurations achieving a bootstrap CI fully separated from zero, the pairwise protocol establishes the LLM-judge noise floor on the hardest-to- distinguish pairs it was designed to probe (pairs deliberately biased toward small RAGAS deltas per the sample construction above). This does not license the broader claim that all within-tier configuration differences on faithfulness are sub-noise: the D5 × \times D8 cell-departure signal of 3 3 – 5 5 points reported in Table 42 is above the noise floor characterized here for a majority of cells whose pair-CIs were not included in this subsample. Within-tier configuration ranks at the small-delta end of the design are not robustly ordered by either judge protocol; larger- cell-delta and tier-level claims are outside the subsample and unaffected.
paragraphs.zh: (i) 在小差值子样本上，细粒度配置差值大多低于大语言模型的判别阈值。 在成对判断中，79% 的结果被判为平局，且在 12 个被覆盖的配置中仅有 1 个的自助法置信区间与零完全分离，这一成对协议确定了大语言模型评判者在其设计所要探测的最难区分的配对（根据上述样本构建方式，这些配对被有意偏向于较小的 RAGAS 差值）上的噪声底线。 这并不能支持更宽泛的断言，即忠实度上同一层内的所有配置差异都低于噪声水平：表 42 中报告的 D5 × D8 单元格偏离信号为 3–5 个百分点，高于此处所刻画的噪声底线，而该表中多数单元格的成对置信区间并未包含在此子样本中。 对于设计中小差值端的层内配置排名，两种评判协议均无法给出稳健的排序；较大单元格差值和层级层面的结论超出了该子样本的范围，不受此影响。

paragraphs.en: (ii) The D8 agentic-gate choice is the one substantive within-tier signal. Speculative-RAG-gated configurations occupy 3 3 of the top- 5 5 BTL positions and CRAG-gated configurations occupy the 3 3 bottom positions; this is the only cross-cell pattern in the posterior that survives the tie-heavy noise floor and is consistent with the within-agentic D8 ordering (Speculative-RAG > > Self-RAG > > CRAG) reported for the generation track in Section D.2 (Speculative-RAG 0.811 0.811 vs. CRAG 0.692 0.692 ). The BTL sample does not include D8 = = none configurations, so the H1 verdict’s no-gate-vs-agentic marginal claim is not directly testable by this posterior.
paragraphs.zh: (ii) D8 智能体门控选择是层级内部唯一的实质性信号。 Speculative-RAG 门控配置占据了前 5 个 BTL 位置中的 3 个，而 CRAG 门控配置占据了底部 3 个位置；这是后验中唯一能经受住大量平局噪声本底并保持显著的跨单元格模式，且与 D.2 节中针对生成赛道报告的智能体内部 D8 排序（Speculative-RAG > Self-RAG > CRAG）一致（Speculative-RAG 0.811 对 CRAG 0.692）。 BTL 样本不包含 D8 = none 的配置，因此 H1 结论中关于无门控与智能体门控之间的边际主张无法通过该后验直接检验。

paragraphs.en: (iii) Fine-grained configuration ranks are protocol-dependent, but tier-level separations are not. The Spearman ρ = − 0.36 \rho=-0.36 between BTL and RAGAS ranks on the same 12 12 configurations indicates that judge-protocol choice matters at fine-grained configuration granularity. H2 and H3 are stated at profile-tier granularity ( speed / balanced / max-reliable ), where both protocols preserve the same three-tier separation, so those verdicts remain protocol-robust. H1 is stated at the interaction/cell level and at the D8 marginal; the present BTL sample corroborates the within-agentic D8 ordering (Speculative-RAG > > CRAG, item (ii) above) but cannot independently probe H1’s no-gate-vs-agentic marginal because all 12 12 sampled cells have D8 ∈ \in {crag, self_rag_quality_gates, speculative_rag}. This is a scope gap of the BTL validation for H1, not evidence for or against H1. The protocol dependence is confined to within-tier configuration comparisons and is documented alongside the existing judge-noise footnote of Table 29 .
paragraphs.zh: (iii) 细粒度配置的排名依赖于协议，但层级之间的区分不依赖协议。 在相同 12 个配置上，BTL 与 RAGAS 排名之间的 Spearman ρ = −0.36 表明，在细粒度配置粒度上，评判协议的选择是有影响的。 H2 和 H3 是在画像层级粒度（speed / balanced / max-reliable）上陈述的，其中两种协议都保持了相同的三层区分，因此这些结论具有协议稳健性。 H1 是在交互/单元格层面以及 D8 边际上陈述的；当前的 BTL 样本证实了智能体内部 D8 的排序（Speculative-RAG > CRAG，即上文第 (ii) 项），但无法独立检验 H1 的无门控与智能体之间的边际，因为所有 12 个采样单元格的 D8 ∈ {crag, self_rag_quality_gates, speculative_rag}。 这是 BTL 验证对 H1 的一个适用范围缺口，并非支持或反对 H1 的证据。 这种协议依赖性仅限于层级内部的配置比较，并且已与表 29 现有的评判噪声脚注一并记录。

paragraphs.en: The high inter-annotator agreement ( κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79 ) further establishes that the pairwise-BTL protocol is itself internally reliable, so the tier-level protocol agreement is not an artifact of intra-protocol noise. Full posteriors, per-annotator distributions, and bootstrap draws ( paper/data/human_eval_btl_posteriors.json ) are available from the authors on request.
paragraphs.zh: 标注者之间的高度一致性（κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79）进一步证明了两两BTL协议本身具有内部可靠性，因此层级层面的协议间一致性并非协议内部噪声造成的假象。 完整的后验分布、每位标注者的分布以及自助法抽样结果（paper/data/human_eval_btl_posteriors.json）可向作者索取。

paragraphs.en: Table 32 reports the marginal effect of each feature on NDCG@10, measured by toggling one feature at a time against the standard baseline (dense retrieval, hybrid α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 , MMR enabled, no reranking, no query enhancement). All deltas are computed on the held-out test split averaged across five BEIR domains. Results are exploratory because these single-feature ablations do not account for interaction effects ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表32报告了每个特征对NDCG@10的边际效应，测量方法是在标准基线（稠密检索、混合 α = 0.5 、启用MMR、无重排序、无查询增强）的基础上逐个开启或关闭某一特征。 所有差值均在留出的测试集上计算，并在五个BEIR领域上取平均。 由于这些单特征消融实验未考虑交互效应（第5节），结果仅具探索性。

paragraphs.en: Three features provide robust improvements with modest latency cost: cross-encoder reranking ( + 0.084 +0.084 ), disabling MMR ( + 0.046 +0.046 ), and document awareness with 100-token prefix ( + 0.062 +0.062 ). Query enhancement methods (expansion, fusion, decomposition) add 2.4–2.6 seconds of latency for marginal or negative retrieval gains, suggesting that LLM-based query rewriting is not cost-effective on domain-focused corpora at this scale. Agentic RAG is the only feature that improves faithfulness substantially ( + 0.05 +0.05 ) while simultaneously reducing NDCG@10 ( − 0.015 -0.015 ), illustrating the retrieval–generation tradeoff discussed in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 三项特性以适度的延迟代价带来了稳健的提升：交叉编码器重排序（+0.084）、禁用 MMR（+0.046），以及带 100 词元前缀的文档感知（+0.062）。 查询增强方法（扩展、融合、分解）增加了 2.4–2.6 秒的延迟，却只带来微弱甚至为负的检索收益，这表明在这种规模的领域专用语料上，基于大语言模型的查询改写并不划算。 智能体 RAG 是唯一能显著提升忠实度（+0.05）同时降低 NDCG@10（−0.015）的特性，这印证了第 5 节讨论的检索—生成权衡。

paragraphs.en: This appendix reports the complete results of the 122-configuration faithfulness ANOVA. Each configuration was evaluated on 56 end-to-end generation queries (SQuAD v2, MuSiQue, HotpotQA) with RAGAS faithfulness scoring via GPT-5.1 judge, totalling 6,832 individual query evaluations. All faithfulness values in this subsection use a common answer prompt ( Section C.2 ) and are not directly comparable to faithfulness reported in Tables 65 and 46 , which use a different answer prompt ( Table 26 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本附录报告了122种配置的忠实度方差分析的完整结果。 每种配置在56个端到端生成查询（SQuAD v2、MuSiQue、HotpotQA）上进行评估，并通过GPT-5.1评判模型使用RAGAS忠实度评分，共计6,832次单查询评估。 本小节中的所有忠实度数值均使用统一的答案提示（见C.2节），与表65和表46中报告的忠实度（使用不同的答案提示，见表26）不可直接比较。

sents.en: This appendix reports the complete results of the 122-configuration faithfulness ANOVA.
sents.zh: 本附录报告了122种配置的忠实度方差分析的完整结果。

sents.en: Each configuration was evaluated on 56 end-to-end generation queries (SQuAD v2, MuSiQue, HotpotQA) with RAGAS faithfulness scoring via GPT-5.1 judge, totalling 6,832 individual query evaluations.
sents.zh: 每种配置在56个端到端生成查询（SQuAD v2、MuSiQue、HotpotQA）上进行评估，并通过GPT-5.1评判模型使用RAGAS忠实度评分，共计6,832次单查询评估。

sents.en: All faithfulness values in this subsection use a common answer prompt ( Section C.2 ) and are not directly comparable to faithfulness reported in Tables 65 and 46 , which use a different answer prompt ( Table 26 ).
sents.zh: 本小节中的所有忠实度数值均使用统一的答案提示（见C.2节），与表65和表46中报告的忠实度（使用不同的答案提示，见表26）不可直接比较。

paragraphs.en: Three dimensions explain significant faithfulness variance. Query augmentation (D5) and agentic gating (D8) each explain ∼ {\sim} 22% of variance ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), while compression (D7) explains 11%. Embedding model, chunking strategy, enrichment, and retrieval mode each contribute η 2 < 0.04 \eta^{2}<0.04 and are not significant ( p > 0.18 p>0.18 ). This stands in sharp contrast with the retrieval ANOVA ( Section 5 ), where embedding and enrichment are the dominant factors, confirming that retrieval and generation quality are governed by different pipeline stages.
paragraphs.zh: 三个维度解释了显著的忠实度方差。 查询增强（D5）和智能体门控（D8）各解释约 {\sim} 22% 的方差（ p < 0.001 p<0.001 ），而压缩（D7）解释了 11%。 嵌入模型、分块策略、增强和检索模式各自的贡献均 η 2 < 0.04 \eta^{2}<0.04 且不显著（ p > 0.18 p>0.18 ）。 这与检索 ANOVA（第 5 节）形成鲜明对比，在那里嵌入和增强是主导因素，这证实了检索质量和生成质量由流水线的不同阶段所决定。

sents.en: Three dimensions explain significant faithfulness variance.
sents.zh: 三个维度解释了显著的忠实度方差。

sents.en: Query augmentation (D5) and agentic gating (D8) each explain ∼ {\sim} 22% of variance ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), while compression (D7) explains 11%.
sents.zh: 查询增强（D5）和智能体门控（D8）各解释约 {\sim} 22% 的方差（ p < 0.001 p<0.001 ），而压缩（D7）解释了 11%。

sents.en: Embedding model, chunking strategy, enrichment, and retrieval mode each contribute η 2 < 0.04 \eta^{2}<0.04 and are not significant ( p > 0.18 p>0.18 ).
sents.zh: 嵌入模型、分块策略、增强和检索模式各自的贡献均 η 2 < 0.04 \eta^{2}<0.04 且不显著（ p > 0.18 p>0.18 ）。

sents.en: This stands in sharp contrast with the retrieval ANOVA ( Section 5 ), where embedding and enrichment are the dominant factors, confirming that retrieval and generation quality are governed by different pipeline stages.
sents.zh: 这与检索 ANOVA（第 5 节）形成鲜明对比，在那里嵌入和增强是主导因素，这证实了检索质量和生成质量由流水线的不同阶段所决定。

paragraphs.en: Decomposition-based query augmentation reduces faithfulness (mean = 0.645 =0.645 ) relative to no augmentation ( 0.778 0.778 ) and step-back prompting ( 0.781 0.781 ), likely because multi-part queries dilute the retrieval focus, yielding less relevant contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 基于分解的查询增强相较于无增强（0.778）和 step-back 提示（0.781）降低了忠实度（均值 = 0.645），这很可能是因为多部分查询稀释了检索焦点，导致上下文相关性降低。

paragraphs.en: Speculative-RAG gating achieves the highest faithfulness ( 0.811 0.811 ), while CRAG ( 0.692 0.692 ) and no gating ( 0.691 0.691 ) perform worst. Self-RAG ( 0.760 0.760 ) falls between.
paragraphs.zh: Speculative-RAG 门控取得了最高的忠实度（ 0.811 0.811 ），而 CRAG（ 0.692 0.692 ）和无门控（ 0.691 0.691 ）表现最差。 Self-RAG（ 0.760 0.760 ）介于两者之间。

paragraphs.en: LLMLingua compression hurts faithfulness ( 0.702 0.702 vs. 0.775 0.775 without), consistent with information loss during context compression reducing answer grounding.
paragraphs.zh: LLMLingua 压缩损害了忠实性（0.702 对比不压缩时的 0.775），这与上下文压缩过程中信息丢失导致答案依据减少相一致。

paragraphs.en: Table 33 reports all 28 two-way interactions sorted by partial η 2 \eta^{2} . Only Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate is highly significant ( η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 , Type III SS, F = 5.47 F=5.47 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The second-strongest faithfulness interaction is Enrichment × \times Reranking ( η 2 = 0.105 \eta^{2}=0.105 , raw p = 0.044 p=0.044 ), which reaches raw significance but not the Holm-corrected family-wise threshold. We attribute the interaction to a coupling between the two stages: enrichment (contextual prefixes, RAPTOR summaries) changes the surface form of each chunk so that the reranker scores a candidate whose distribution differs from its untyped training distribution, while the reranker simultaneously reorders chunks in a way that can disturb the document-level coherence enrichment was meant to preserve for the answer LLM; whether the joint effect helps or hurts faithfulness depends on which of these two channels dominates for a given configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 表 33 按偏 η 2 \eta^{2} 排序列出了全部 28 个两两交互效应。 只有 Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate 高度显著（ η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 ，III 型平方和， F = 5.47 F=5.47 ， p < 0.001 p<0.001 ）。 第二强的忠实度交互效应是 Enrichment × \times Reranking（ η 2 = 0.105 \eta^{2}=0.105 ，原始 p = 0.044 p=0.044 ），该效应达到原始显著性水平，但未达到经 Holm 校正的族错误率阈值。 我们将这一交互效应归因于两个阶段之间的耦合：增强（上下文前缀、RAPTOR 摘要）改变了每个文本块的表面形式，使得重排序器所评分的候选项的分布与其无类型标注的训练分布不同；与此同时，重排序器对文本块的重新排序又可能破坏增强原本希望为答案 LLM 保留的文档级连贯性；这种联合效应究竟是有助于还是有损于忠实度，取决于在给定配置下这两个通道中哪一个占主导地位。

paragraphs.en: The 122-configuration faithfulness ANOVA covers 3 of 4 embedding models (MiniLM-L6 excluded due to API timeouts during RAPTOR ingestion) and 3 of 4 enrichment levels (GraphRAG excluded). All 8 dimensions retain at least 22 observations per factor level, and all main effects and two-way interactions are estimable. The unbalanced design requires caution in interpreting aggregate η 2 \eta^{2} values; individual interaction p p -values are more reliable indicators.
paragraphs.zh: 这项包含122种配置的忠实度方差分析覆盖了4个嵌入模型中的3个（MiniLM-L6因RAPTOR摄入期间API超时被排除）以及4个增强级别中的3个（GraphRAG被排除）。 全部8个维度在每个因子水平上至少保留22个观测值，且所有主效应和双向交互均可估计。 这种非平衡设计要求在解读汇总 η 2 \eta^{2} 值时需谨慎；单个交互 p p 值是更可靠的指标。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 plots retrieval-track NDCG@10 against e2e RAGAS faithfulness for the 113 113 configurations evaluated on both factorial tracks (joined by config_id ). The two metrics are statistically uncorrelated (Pearson r = − 0.01 r=-0.01 ): 5 % 5\% of configurations achieve faithfulness > 0.80 >0.80 at NDCG@10 < 0.45 <0.45 , and 6 % 6\% show the inverse pattern (NDCG@10 > 0.49 >0.49 at faithfulness < 0.65 <0.65 ). A configuration optimized on either metric alone offers no guarantee on the other, motivating the dual-axis evaluation used throughout this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 绘制了在两个析因轨迹上均被评估的 113 种配置（通过 config_id 连接）的检索轨迹 NDCG@10 与端到端 RAGAS 忠实度之间的关系。 这两个指标在统计上不相关（Pearson r = −0.01）：5% 的配置在 NDCG@10 < 0.45 时达到忠实度 > 0.80，另有 6% 呈现相反的模式（NDCG@10 > 0.49 而忠实度 < 0.65）。 仅依据任一指标进行优化的配置都无法保证在另一指标上的表现，这为本文通篇采用的双轴评估提供了动机。

paragraphs.en: The pooled retrieval-faithfulness r = − 0.01 r=-0.01 could hide within-family patterns (Simpson-style aggregation), so we stratify by the faithfulness benchmark and pair each configuration’s overall retrieval NDCG@10 with its per-benchmark faithfulness ( N = 113 N{=}113 configurations per stratum): HotpotQA r = − 0.03 r=-0.03 ( p = 0.72 p=0.72 ), MuSiQue r = − 0.05 r=-0.05 ( p = 0.63 p=0.63 ), SQuAD v2 r = + 0.10 r=+0.10 ( p = 0.30 p=0.30 ). No stratum reaches | r | > 0.10 |r|>0.10 or p < 0.30 p<0.30 , and the pooled coefficient lies inside the within-family range with no sign reversal, so the pooled statistic attenuates rather than misleads: retrieval quality and faithfulness are decoupled within each task family, not merely across them.
paragraphs.zh: 汇总的检索忠实度 r = −0.01 可能掩盖同族内部模式（Simpson 式聚合问题），因此我们按忠实度基准分层，并将每个配置的整体检索 NDCG@10 与其在该基准上的忠实度配对（每层 N = 113 个配置）：HotpotQA r = −0.03（p = 0.72），MuSiQue r = −0.05（p = 0.63），SQuAD v2 r = +0.10（p = 0.30）。 没有任一分层达到 |r| > 0.10 或 p < 0.30，且汇总系数位于同族内部区间之内、没有符号反转，因此汇总统计量只是弱化而非误导：检索质量与忠实度在每个任务族内部是解耦的，而不仅仅是在任务族之间解耦。

paragraphs.en: To verify that the sequential one-at-a-time ANOVA does not produce spurious interactions, we fit a joint LASSO-penalized regression with all 192 main-effect and interaction features simultaneously (5-fold CV repeated 3 × \times , α = 0.006 \alpha=0.006 ). The LASSO achieves R 2 = 0.77 R^{2}=0.77 and selects 34 non-zero features, of which 31 are interaction terms. Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate is the strongest surviving interaction pair (4 terms selected, total | β | = 0.074 |\beta|=0.074 ), confirming the sequential ANOVA finding. The specific decomposition × \times Self-RAG interaction ( β = − 0.034 \beta=-0.034 ) is the single largest coefficient, consistent with the mechanistic explanation that multi-part queries overwhelm CRAG/Self-RAG gating. For retrieval, LASSO ( R 2 = 0.84 R^{2}=0.84 , 81 features selected) confirms Embedding × \times Enrichment as the strongest interaction (total | β | = 0.016 |\beta|=0.016 ) and Embedding × \times Reranking as the third strongest ( | β | = 0.012 |\beta|=0.012 ), matching the ANOVA results.
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证逐个进行的串行方差分析（ANOVA）不会产生虚假的交互效应，我们同时拟合了一个包含全部192个主效应和交互特征的联合LASSO惩罚回归（5折交叉验证重复3 × \times 次，α = 0.006 \alpha=0.006）。 LASSO取得 R 2 = 0.77 R^{2}=0.77，并选出34个非零特征，其中31个是交互项。 Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate 是存留的最强交互对（4个项被选出，总 | β | = 0.074 |\beta|=0.074），证实了串行方差分析的发现。 具体的分解 × \times Self-RAG 交互项（β = − 0.034 \beta=-0.034）是单个最大的系数，这与多部分查询使 CRAG/Self-RAG 门控机制不堪重负的机理解释一致。 对于检索任务，LASSO（R 2 = 0.84 R^{2}=0.84，选出81个特征）证实 Embedding × \times Enrichment 是最强的交互（总 | β | = 0.016 |\beta|=0.016），Embedding × \times Reranking 是第三强的交互（| β | = 0.012 |\beta|=0.012），与方差分析的结果相符。

paragraphs.en: All faithfulness evaluations (both the factorial ANOVA and the profile comparisons) use the same GPT-5.1 judge model with identical RAGAS v0.4 configuration ( T = 0 T{=}0 , deterministic seed, batch_size = 4 {}=4 ). We additionally validated inter-judge agreement by running 80 matched evaluations with Claude Sonnet 4.5 as an alternative judge (Kendall τ b = 0.38 \tau_{b}=0.38 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; 66% of scores agree within 0.1; details in Section C.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 所有忠实度评估（包括因子方差分析和画像比较）均使用同一个 GPT-5.1 评判模型，并采用完全相同的 RAGAS v0.4 配置（ T = 0 T{=}0 、确定性随机种子、batch_size = 4 {}=4）。 我们还通过使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 作为替代评判模型运行 80 次匹配评估来验证了评判者之间的一致性（Kendall τ b = 0.38 \tau_{b}=0.38，p < 0.001 p<0.001；66% 的分值在 0.1 范围内一致；详见 C.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: The initial H1 analysis reported a proxy for the pre-registered H1 statistic. The preregistration ( paper/preregistration/preregistration_body.tex L357–358; OSF §189) specifies partial η 2 \eta^{2} for the joint set of all 28 two-way interactions in a mains-plus-28-interactions model, tested against F ⁡ ( 209 , ⋅ ) F(209,\cdot) and thresholded at η 2 = SS int / ( SS int + SS resid ) ≥ 0.20 \eta^{2}=\text{SS}_{\text{int}}/(\text{SS}_{\text{int}}+\text{SS}_{\text{resid}})\geq 0.20 . That analysis fit a reduced model containing mains plus only one interaction (Query Aug × \times Agentic Gate) and reported the resulting η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 , F ⁡ ( 12 , 279 ) = 5.47 F(12,\,279)=5.47 as the H1 decision statistic. The per-sample RAGAS faithfulness table used to produce that fit ( n ≈ 292 n\approx 292 observations at df den = 279 {}_{\text{den}}=279 ) is unavailable, motivating the reconstruction below.
paragraphs.zh: 初步的 H1 分析报告的是预注册 H1 统计量的一个替代指标。 预注册文档（paper/preregistration/preregistration_body.tex 第 357–358 行；OSF §189）规定，在「主效应加 28 个交互项」模型中，对全部 28 个两两交互项的联合集合计算偏 η 2 \eta^{2} ，以 F ⁡ ( 209 , ⋅ ) F(209,\cdot) 检验，并以 η 2 = SS int / ( SS int + SS resid ) ≥ 0.20 \eta^{2}=\text{SS}_{\text{int}}/(\text{SS}_{\text{int}}+\text{SS}_{\text{resid}})\geq 0.20 作为阈值。 该分析拟合的是一个仅包含主效应加单个交互项（Query Aug × \times Agentic Gate）的简化模型，并将由此得到的 η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 、 F ⁡ ( 12 , 279 ) = 5.47 F(12,\,279)=5.47 作为 H1 的判定统计量。 用于产生该拟合的逐样本 RAGAS 忠实度表（在分母自由度 df den = 279 {}_{\text{den}}=279 下约有 n ≈ 292 n\approx 292 个观测值）已无法获取，这促使我们在下文进行重构。

sents.en: The initial H1 analysis reported a proxy for the pre-registered H1 statistic.
sents.zh: 初步的 H1 分析报告的是预注册 H1 统计量的一个替代指标。

sents.en: The preregistration ( paper/preregistration/preregistration_body.tex L357–358; OSF §189) specifies partial η 2 \eta^{2} for the joint set of all 28 two-way interactions in a mains-plus-28-interactions model, tested against F ⁡ ( 209 , ⋅ ) F(209,\cdot) and thresholded at η 2 = SS int / ( SS int + SS resid ) ≥ 0.20 \eta^{2}=\text{SS}_{\text{int}}/(\text{SS}_{\text{int}}+\text{SS}_{\text{resid}})\geq 0.20 .
sents.zh: 预注册文档（paper/preregistration/preregistration_body.tex 第 357–358 行；OSF §189）规定，在「主效应加 28 个交互项」模型中，对全部 28 个两两交互项的联合集合计算偏 η 2 \eta^{2} ，以 F ⁡ ( 209 , ⋅ ) F(209,\cdot) 检验，并以 η 2 = SS int / ( SS int + SS resid ) ≥ 0.20 \eta^{2}=\text{SS}_{\text{int}}/(\text{SS}_{\text{int}}+\text{SS}_{\text{resid}})\geq 0.20 作为阈值。

sents.en: That analysis fit a reduced model containing mains plus only one interaction (Query Aug × \times Agentic Gate) and reported the resulting η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 , F ⁡ ( 12 , 279 ) = 5.47 F(12,\,279)=5.47 as the H1 decision statistic.
sents.zh: 该分析拟合的是一个仅包含主效应加单个交互项（Query Aug × \times Agentic Gate）的简化模型，并将由此得到的 η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 、 F ⁡ ( 12 , 279 ) = 5.47 F(12,\,279)=5.47 作为 H1 的判定统计量。

sents.en: The per-sample RAGAS faithfulness table used to produce that fit ( n ≈ 292 n\approx 292 observations at df den = 279 {}_{\text{den}}=279 ) is unavailable, motivating the reconstruction below.
sents.zh: 用于产生该拟合的逐样本 RAGAS 忠实度表（在分母自由度 df den = 279 {}_{\text{den}}=279 下约有 n ≈ 292 n\approx 292 个观测值）已无法获取，这促使我们在下文进行重构。

paragraphs.en: We reconstructed the per-sample table locally from 117 .checkpoints/*.json experiment artifacts under the research/results/factorial_experiments/ artifact tree, extracting 4,948 per-sample rows (4,820 after deduplication on (config_id, sample_id)). This recovers 113 of the 122 recorded configurations × \times 3 QA benchmarks ( hotpotqa , musique , squad_v2 ) = 339 =339 long-form (config × \times benchmark) cells; the remaining nine configurations are absent from the local checkpoint pool. The per-config faithfulness field in the reconstruction matches the recorded factorial_gen_collected.json within mean | Δ | = × 10 − 4 |\Delta|=1.1\!\times\!10^{-4} across all 113 shared configurations, confirming the reconstruction is faithful.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在本地从 research/results/factorial_experiments/ 工件目录树下的 117 个 .checkpoints/*.json 实验工件重建了逐样本表格，提取出 4,948 行逐样本数据（按 (config_id, sample_id) 去重后为 4,820 行）。 这恢复了 122 个已记录配置 × \times 3 个问答基准（ hotpotqa 、 musique 、 squad_v2 ）= 339 =339 个长文本（配置 × \times 基准）单元格中的 113 个；其余九个配置在本地检查点库中缺失。 重建结果中的逐配置 faithfulness 字段与已记录的 factorial_gen_collected.json 在全部 113 个共享配置上的平均 | Δ | = × 10 − 4 |\Delta|=1.1\!\times\!10^{-4} 范围内一致，证实重建是忠实的。

paragraphs.en: Verdict. H1 is not confirmed at the pre-registered η 2 ≥ 0.20 \eta^{2}\!\geq\!0.20 joint threshold. We withdraw the per-sample specification as pseudo-replication (within-config RAGAS samples are not independent trials of component-composition effects); the aggregated fit ( η 2 = 0.428 \eta^{2}{=}0.428 ) is retained as sensitivity only (BIC Δ = + 347 \Delta{=}+347 favors mains-only). Additivity is nonetheless affirmatively rejected at the 5 % 5\% floor in both tracks ( p ≪ 0.001 p{\ll}0.001 ). Under the pre-registered per-pair Bonferroni procedure, reportable as an independent inferential path rather than as a substitute for the joint test , D5 × \times D8 clears both criteria ( η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}{=}0.201 , p = × 10 − 10 p{=}3.8\!\times\!10^{-10} ) and is retained as a pre-registered large-effect follow-up finding.
paragraphs.zh: 裁定。 H1 未在预注册的 η²≥0.20 联合阈值上得到确认。 我们撤回逐样本设定，视其为伪重复（同一配置内的 RAGAS 样本并非组件组合效应的独立试验）；聚合拟合（η²=0.428）仅作为敏感性分析予以保留（BIC Δ=+347 支持仅主效应模型）。 尽管如此，在两条分析路径中，可加性均在 5% 的下限上被明确拒绝（p≪0.001）。 在预注册的逐对 Bonferroni 程序下——该程序可作为一条独立的推断路径予以报告，而非作为联合检验的替代——D5×D8 同时满足两项标准（η²=0.201，p=3.8×10⁻¹⁰），并被保留为一项预注册的大效应后续发现。

paragraphs.en: Under the joint fit, the strongest individual pairs are D5 × \times D8 (Query Aug × \times Agentic Gate, partial η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}=0.201 ), D5 × \times D6 (Query Aug × \times Reranking, 0.127 0.127 ), D2 × \times D8 (Chunking × \times Agentic, 0.098 0.098 ), and D3 × \times D5 (Enrichment × \times Query Aug, 0.091 0.091 ); the remaining 24 pairs each contribute η 2 < 0.07 \eta^{2}<0.07 . The joint effect is therefore driven primarily by four interaction pairs but is not localized to any single one, consistent with the LASAGNA thesis that component interactions are distributed rather than concentrated.
paragraphs.zh: 在联合拟合下，最强的个体配对为 D5 × D8（Query Aug × Agentic Gate，偏 η² = 0.201）、D5 × D6（Query Aug × Reranking，0.127）、D2 × D8（Chunking × Agentic，0.098）以及 D3 × D5（Enrichment × Query Aug，0.091）；其余 24 个配对各自的 η² 均小于 0.07。 因此，联合效应主要由四个交互配对驱动，但并不局限于其中任何一个，这与 LASAGNA 的论点一致，即组件间的交互是分布式的而非集中于某处。

paragraphs.en: A natural question is how a 232-column joint model can be estimated from 167 or 122 configuration observations. Table 34 answers by tabulating ( df int , df resid ) (\text{df}_{\text{int}},\text{df}_{\text{resid}}) , their sum, and n − 1 n{-}1 for every specification we fit. Row 4 is the erroneous additive Type-II SS aggregation: 172 + 226 = 398 > 338 = n − 1 172{+}226{=}398>338{=}n{-}1 is arithmetically impossible under a single OLS fit, revealing the double-counting of shared variance. Rows 1–3 and 5 satisfy df int + df resid = n − 1 \text{df}_{\text{int}}{+}\text{df}_{\text{resid}}{=}n{-}1 exactly (up to the mains block absorbed into the intercept), confirming each fit is identified. The pre-registered 232-column joint at per-config n = 113 n{=}113 (row 3) is rank-deficient, this is why we escalate to per-sample n = 4,820 n{=}4{,}820 (row 5) for the primary H1 verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的问题是：如何用 167 或 122 个配置观测来估计一个含 232 列的联合模型。 表 34 通过列出我们拟合的每个设定的 (df int , df resid ) (\text{df}_{\text{int}},\text{df}_{\text{resid}}) 、其总和以及 n − 1 n{-}1 来回答这个问题。 第 4 行是错误的加性 II 型平方和聚合：172 + 226 = 398 > 338 = n − 1 172{+}226{=}398>338{=}n{-}1 在单次 OLS 拟合下在算术上不可能成立，这揭示了对共享方差的双重计算。 第 1–3 行和第 5 行精确满足 df int + df resid = n − 1 \text{df}_{\text{int}}{+}\text{df}_{\text{resid}}{=}n{-}1 （在被截距吸收的主效应块范围内），确认每次拟合均可识别。 在每配置 n = 113 n{=}113 下预先注册的 232 列联合模型（第 3 行）是秩亏的，这就是我们转向每样本 n = 4,820 n{=}4{,}820 （第 5 行）来得出主要 H1 结论的原因。
