paragraphs.en: Our primary ANOVA operates on configuration aggregates; we also verify that the D5 × \times D8 verdict survives a model that treats query variability as a random effect. We refit the per-sample data (n=2,425 rows with faithfulness scores present, 43 unique queries, 57 configs) with two more conservative specifications sharing the same fixed part (D1–D8 mains plus the D5 × \times D8 interaction block): (i) a MixedLM with a query random intercept, and (ii) an OLS with cluster-robust standard errors clustered on sample_id . The MixedLM yields χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 4.27 \chi^{2}(4){=}4.27 , p = 0.371 p{=}0.371 for the joint D5 × \times D8 Wald test, ICC = 0.284 {=}0.284 (query intercept), marginal R 2 = 0.224 R^{2}{=}0.224 , conditional R 2 = 0.445 R^{2}{=}0.445 ; the cluster-robust OLS yields F ⁡ ( 4 , 2402 ) = 1.62 F(4,2402){=}1.62 , p = 0.168 p{=}0.168 on the same block. The largest individual interaction coefficient (D5=decomposition × \times D8=Speculative-RAG, β ^ ≈ 0.09 \hat{\beta}{\approx}0.09 ) is common to both fits. The naive aggregated F ⁡ ( 12,306 ) = 6.40 F(12,306){=}6.40 , p = × 10 − 10 p{=}3.8\!\times\!10^{-10} was inflated by treating the 43 queries as 306 residual df; once the 28.4 % 28.4\% of variance absorbed by the query intercept is modeled, the D5 × \times D8 confirmation does not survive the hierarchical analysis at Bonferroni or nominal α = 0.05 \alpha{=}0.05 . We accordingly downgrade the per-pair D5 × \times D8 result to the same not confirmed status that the joint 28-two-way form already carries, and treat the cell-level composition patterns in Table 42 as descriptive rather than preregistered evidence. Reproducer, available from the authors on request: paper/scripts/m7_mixed_effects.py , outputs paper/data/m7_mixed_effects.json .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主ANOVA基于配置聚合值进行；我们还验证了D5 × \times D8的结论在将查询变异视为随机效应的模型中是否依然成立。 我们用两种更保守的设定（共享相同的固定部分，即D1–D8主效应加上D5 × \times D8交互块）重新拟合逐样本数据（n=2,425行含忠实度得分，43个唯一查询，57个配置）：（i）带查询随机截距的MixedLM，以及（ii）以sample_id聚类的聚类稳健标准误的OLS。 MixedLM在D5 × \times D8联合Wald检验中给出χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 4.27 \chi^{2}(4){=}4.27 ，p = 0.371 p{=}0.371 ，ICC = 0.284 {=}0.284 （查询截距），边际R 2 = 0.224 R^{2}{=}0.224 ，条件R 2 = 0.445 R^{2}{=}0.445 ；聚类稳健OLS在同一交互块上给出F ⁡ ( 4 , 2402 ) = 1.62 F(4,2402){=}1.62 ，p = 0.168 p{=}0.168 。 最大的单个交互系数（D5=分解 × \times D8=Speculative-RAG，β ^ ≈ 0.09 \hat{\beta}{\approx}0.09 ）在两种拟合中均相同。 朴素的聚合F ⁡ ( 12,306 ) = 6.40 F(12,306){=}6.40 ，p = × 10 − 10 p{=}3.8\!\times\!10^{-10} 之所以被夸大，是因为将43个查询视为306个残差自由度；一旦对查询截距吸收的28.4 % 28.4\% 方差进行建模，D5 × \times D8的确认在Bonferroni或名义α = 0.05 \alpha{=}0.05 水平下的分层分析中便不再成立。 因此，我们将逐对的D5 × \times D8结果降级为与联合28个双向形式已经具有的相同的“未确认”状态，并将表42中的单元级组合模式视为描述性结果而非预注册证据。 复现脚本可向作者索取：paper/scripts/m7_mixed_effects.py ，输出为paper/data/m7_mixed_effects.json 。

paragraphs.en: The pre-registration specified a power-law fit NDCG ⁡ ( N ) = a ⋅ N − b \mathrm{NDCG}(N)=a\cdot N^{-b} ; the main paper reports a log-linear fit NDCG ⁡ ( N ) = a + b ⋅ log 10 ⁡ ( N ) \mathrm{NDCG}(N)=a+b\cdot\log_{10}(N) . We refit both models on the same retrieval-NDCG@10 scaling points (5K, 15K, 25K, 50K, 100K, 200K) for sota_standard and sota_balanced using the identical data source ( paper/data/scaling_bootstrap_cis.json + paper/data/scaling_100k_200k.json ) and compare the fits side by side ( Tables 35 and 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 预注册中规定采用幂律拟合 NDCG ⁡ ( N ) = a ⋅ N − b \mathrm{NDCG}(N)=a\cdot N^{-b}；正文报告的是对数线性拟合 NDCG ⁡ ( N ) = a + b ⋅ log 10 ⁡ ( N ) \mathrm{NDCG}(N)=a+b\cdot\log_{10}(N) 。 我们使用完全相同的数据来源（ paper/data/scaling_bootstrap_cis.json + paper/data/scaling_100k_200k.json ），在 sota_standard 与 sota_balanced 相同的检索-NDCG@10 缩放数据点（5K、15K、25K、50K、100K、200K）上对两种模型重新拟合，并将拟合结果并排比较（表 35 和表 8）。

paragraphs.en: Across both fits, standard degrades with a magnitude of | b | ≈ 0.05 |b|\approx 0.05 and balanced with | b | ≈ 0.014 |b|\approx 0.014 : the log-linear slope and the power-law exponent match to the second decimal on both profiles, and the R 2 R^{2} values agree to within 0.02. The rank-flip finding ( balanced overtakes standard at large N N ) is therefore robust to the choice of scaling-law functional form.
paragraphs.zh: 在两种拟合中，standard 的衰减幅度为 | b | ≈ 0.05，而 balanced 为 | b | ≈ 0.014：两条曲线上的对数线性斜率与幂律指数在小数点后两位一致，且 R 2 值相差不超过 0.02。 因此，这一排名翻转的发现（balanced 在大 N 时超越 standard）对缩放律函数形式的选择是稳健的。

paragraphs.en: The main paper cites several p-values computed under different test families (Type III ANOVA on the D5 × \times D8 grid, paired- t t and Welch’s t t on scaling crossover, Wilcoxon signed-rank on H2 hypervolume, mixed-effects LRT). To make the multiple-comparisons structure explicit, Table 36 enumerates every headline p-value in the main paper together with its test family, null hypothesis, sample size (queries × \times seeds), effect size, and section reference.
paragraphs.zh: 主论文引用了在不同检验族下计算的若干p值（D5 × D8 网格上的III型方差分析、规模交叉上的配对t检验与Welch t检验、H2超体积上的Wilcoxon符号秩检验、混合效应似然比检验）。 为了明确多重比较的结构，表36列出了主论文中的每一个核心p值，并附上其检验族、零假设、样本量（查询数 × 随机种子数）、效应量以及章节引用。

paragraphs.en: We apply Holm–Bonferroni within each test family (H1 per-pair uses the pre-registered per-pair Bonferroni α / 28 \alpha/28 ; H3 scaling crossover uses Holm across 4 corpus sizes; H2 is a single Wilcoxon test with no family). A global correction across all families in Table 36 would be inappropriate because the tested hypotheses are logically independent (interaction structure vs. scaling crossover vs. Pareto dominance) and would over-inflate Type II error on the pre-registered H1 test. The two different p-values on the same H3 crossover (paired t t p = 0.003 p{=}0.003 ; Welch’s t t p = 0.004 p{=}0.004 ) reflect different assumptions about within-seed correlation, not different data; both survive within-family Holm adjustment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每个检验族内应用 Holm–Bonferroni 校正（H1 逐对比较使用预先注册的逐对 Bonferroni α / 28 \alpha/28；H3 规模化交叉使用跨 4 个语料库规模的 Holm 校正；H2 是单一 Wilcoxon 检验，无检验族）。 对表 36 中所有检验族进行全局校正是不合适的，因为所检验的假设在逻辑上是相互独立的（交互结构 vs. 规模化交叉 vs. Pareto 优势），全局校正会过度夸大预先注册的 H1 检验的第二类错误。 同一 H3 交叉上的两个不同 p 值（配对 t t 检验 p = 0.003 p{=}0.003；Welch's t t 检验 p = 0.004 p{=}0.004）反映了对种子内相关性的不同假设，而非不同的数据；两者均通过了族内 Holm 校正。

paragraphs.en: The reported H3 p-value is conditional on a single corpus realization. The three execution seeds (42/43/44) resample retrieval and generation stochasticity (HyDE draws, embedding-time nondeterminism, RAGAS judge sampling) but hold corpus composition fixed: our 100K/200K distractor set is a single deterministic realization built by paper/scripts/build_100k_corpora.py (SHA-256 dbb94ab3…ac5f9a ; see Section B.3.6 ), in which HotpotQA documents are streamed in the BEIR adapter’s native order, MD5-deduplicated, filtered against eval-relevant doc_ids , and assigned scaling_{i:06d} IDs in encounter order. The H3 confidence interval therefore does not marginalize over the family of plausible 200K HotpotQA subsets a reader could have drawn.
paragraphs.zh: 报告的 H3 p 值是以单一语料库实现为条件的。 三个执行种子（42/43/44）对检索与生成中的随机性（HyDE 抽样、嵌入阶段的非确定性、RAGAS 评判器的采样）进行了重采样，但保持语料库构成不变：我们的 100K/200K 干扰文档集是由 paper/scripts/build_100k_corpora.py（SHA-256 dbb94ab3…ac5f9a；参见 B.3.6 节）构建的单一确定性实现，其中 HotpotQA 文档按 BEIR 适配器的原生顺序流式读入，经 MD5 去重，针对评测相关的 doc_ids 进行过滤，并按出现顺序分配 scaling_{i:06d} 形式的 ID。 因此，H3 的置信区间并未对读者本可抽取的、由合理的 200K HotpotQA 子集构成的族进行边缘化。

paragraphs.en: Query-level paired bootstrap ( paper/data/scaling_bootstrap_cis.json , B = 10,000 B{=}10{,}000 resamples over per-query NDCG@10 at fixed corpus): the profile crossover between sota_standard and sota_balanced at the 100K → \!\to\! 200K boundary preserves its sign in every resample, ruling out that the rank-flip is a query-sampling artifact orthogonal to seed variance.
paragraphs.zh: 查询级配对自助法（paper/data/scaling_bootstrap_cis.json，B = 10,000 B{=}10{,}000 次重抽样，基于固定语料库上的逐查询 NDCG@10）：sota_standard 与 sota_balanced 在 100K → \!\to\! 200K 边界处的性能曲线交叉在每一次重抽样中都保持其符号，排除了该排名翻转是独立于随机种子方差的查询抽样伪影的可能性。

paragraphs.en: A fully-marginalized corpus-realization CI would require B ≥ 3 B\!\geq\!3 independently-shuffled 200K HotpotQA subsets, each re-ingested into Qdrant per profile ( ∼ \sim 4–6 h/ingest), and a two-way random-effects ANOVA on faithfulness with corpus and seed as random factors. We defer this to future work; the two bounds above cap the corpus-realization contribution to the rank-flip below the audit noise scale.
paragraphs.zh: 一个完全边缘化的语料库实现置信区间需要 B ≥ 3 个独立打乱且各含 20 万条目的 HotpotQA 子集，每个配置文件都要重新导入 Qdrant 一次（每次导入约需 4–6 小时），并对忠实度进行以语料库和随机种子为随机因素的双向随机效应方差分析。 我们将此留待未来工作；上述两个界把语料库实现因素对排名翻转的贡献限制在审计噪声尺度之下。

paragraphs.en: Multi-hop coverage. HotpotQA (2-hop) and MuSiQue ( ≥ \geq 3-hop) supply the multi-document reasoning regime in which agentic aggressive refinement is hypothesized to help and in which a single-shot retriever is hypothesized to fail; SQuAD v2 supplies the single-hop control needed to prevent the H2 contrast from collapsing on multi-hop content alone.
paragraphs.zh: 多跳覆盖率。 HotpotQA（2 跳）与 MuSiQue（≥3 跳）提供了多文档推理场景，我们假设智能体的激进式精炼在这一场景中有所帮助，而单次检索器在这一场景中会失效；SQuAD v2 提供了单跳对照，以防止 H2 的对比仅建立在多跳内容之上而失去区分度。

sents.en: Multi-hop coverage.
sents.zh: 多跳覆盖率。

sents.en: HotpotQA (2-hop) and MuSiQue ( ≥ \geq 3-hop) supply the multi-document reasoning regime in which agentic aggressive refinement is hypothesized to help and in which a single-shot retriever is hypothesized to fail; SQuAD v2 supplies the single-hop control needed to prevent the H2 contrast from collapsing on multi-hop content alone.
sents.zh: HotpotQA（2 跳）与 MuSiQue（≥3 跳）提供了多文档推理场景，我们假设智能体的激进式精炼在这一场景中有所帮助，而单次检索器在这一场景中会失效；SQuAD v2 提供了单跳对照，以防止 H2 的对比仅建立在多跳内容之上而失去区分度。

paragraphs.en: Judge-noise control. All three benchmarks have short, factual gold strings that minimize RAGAS faithfulness-judge noise on the concise-regen prompt regime declared in Table 26 , so observed NDCG × \times Faith deltas attribute to retrieval-composition changes rather than to answer-style drift.
paragraphs.zh: 裁判噪声控制。 所有三个基准测试都具有简短、事实性的标准答案字符串，这最大限度地减少了 RAS 忠实度裁判噪声在表 26 中声明的简洁再生成提示（concise-regen prompt）机制上的影响，因此观察到的 NDCG × \times Faith 差异可归因于检索组合的变化，而非回答风格的漂移。

sents.en: Judge-noise control.

paragraphs.en: Pretraining-overlap control. None of the three benchmarks appears verbatim in the reported pretraining corpus of the generator or judge to a degree that would let the faithfulness metric reward memorized answers.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练数据重叠控制。 三个基准测试中没有任何一个以足以让忠实度指标奖励记忆答案的程度逐字出现在生成器或评判者已报告的预训练语料库中。

paragraphs.en: To extend H2 from this single mixture to genuinely unrelated benchmarks, the following study grid is fully defined against corpora already ingested in our Qdrant deployment:
paragraphs.zh: 为了将 H2 从这一单一混合数据集扩展到真正不相关的基准测试，以下研究网格完全基于我们 Qdrant 部署中已导入的语料库进行定义：

paragraphs.en: Corpora : TriviaQA (single-hop retrieval-heavy; ingested for Fig. 3 and Table 22 ) and Natural Questions (single-hop web queries; ingested for the scaling sweep). No new ingestion required.
paragraphs.zh: 语料库：TriviaQA（单跳、检索密集型；已导入用于图 3 和表 22）以及 Natural Questions（单跳网络查询；已导入用于扩展性扫描）。 无需新的导入。

sents.en: Corpora : TriviaQA (single-hop retrieval-heavy; ingested for Fig. 3 and Table 22 ) and Natural Questions (single-hop web queries; ingested for the scaling sweep).
sents.zh: 语料库：TriviaQA（单跳、检索密集型；已导入用于图 3 和表 22）以及 Natural Questions（单跳网络查询；已导入用于扩展性扫描）。

sents.en: No new ingestion required.
sents.zh: 无需新的导入。

paragraphs.en: Config grid : balanced vs. max-reliable × \times 3 seeds each per corpus, 12 runs total.
paragraphs.zh: 配置网格：平衡 vs. 最大可靠性 × \times 每个语料库各 3 个随机种子，共 12 次运行。

paragraphs.en: Query slice : 300 queries per corpus, stratified by hop-count to prevent corpus difficulty from confounding the agentic-vs-retrieval contrast.
paragraphs.zh: Query slice：每个语料库 300 条查询，按跳数（hop-count）分层，以防止语料库难度混淆「智能体式 vs 检索式」的对比。

paragraphs.en: Analysis : per-corpus NDCG × \times Faith and latency deltas ( Δ = Balanced − Max-Reliable \Delta=\text{Balanced}-\text{Max-Reliable} ) with 95% CIs; pooled random-effects meta-analysis (DerSimonian–Laird) yielding a marginal cross-corpus estimate with a between-corpus τ 2 \tau^{2} heterogeneity term.
paragraphs.zh: 分析：按语料库统计的 NCG × \times 忠实度与延迟差值（ Δ = Balanced − Max-Reliable \Delta=\text{Balanced}-\text{Max-Reliable} ）及其95%置信区间；采用随机效应合并元分析（DerSimonian–Laird），得到跨语料库的边际估计值，并纳入语料库间 τ 2 \tau^{2} 异质性项。

paragraphs.en: Cost : ∼ 15 {\sim}15 GPU-hours (single overnight run).
paragraphs.zh: 代价：约 ∼ 15 {\sim}15 GPU 小时（单次通宵运行）。

A separate, post-hoc replication of the H2 pattern at 100K and 200K corpus scale, using scaling-experiment data already collected on the same SQuAD v2 / MuSiQue / HotpotQA benchmark family under two profile realizations on the H2 axis, is reported in Section D.8 . That replication tests robustness to corpus SIZE (5K → \rightarrow 100K → \rightarrow 200K) rather than to unrelated benchmark FAMILIES; the two are complementary but not substitutes.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究中未执行该预注册的网格。 第 D.8 节报告了一项单独的事后复制，在 H2 轴上的两种实现下，使用在同一 SQuAD v2 / MuSiQue / HotpotQA 基准族上已收集的扩展实验数据，在 100K 和 200K 语料库规模上复制 H2 模式。 该复制检验的是对语料库规模（5K → 100K → 200K）的稳健性，而非对无关基准族的稳健性；二者互补但不可相互替代。

paragraphs.en: Section D.7 describes a pre-registered multi-corpus H2 grid extending H2 to unrelated benchmarks (TriviaQA, NQ); that extension was not executed. This subsection reports a separate, post-hoc replication that uses scaling-experiment data already collected on the same benchmark family as the H2 headline test (HotpotQA, MuSiQue, SQuAD v2), evaluated at 100K and 200K corpus sizes with three seeds per (profile, corpus, size) cell. The replication tests robustness of the balanced > > max-reliable pattern to corpus SIZE rather than to benchmark family; it does not substitute for the deferred cross-family grid and does not modify the H2 verdict of Table 2 (which remains a single-slice test at the base corpus). Its role is descriptive: to establish whether the compositional pattern motivating H2, a lighter retrieval-focused profile providing similar faithfulness with lower response time, recurs at 100K and 200K scale on the same benchmark family.
paragraphs.zh: D.7 节描述了一个预先注册的多语料库 H2 网格，用于将 H2 扩展到不相关的基准（TriviaQA、NQ）；该扩展未被执行。 本小节报告一项单独的事后复现，使用已在与 H2 主测试相同基准家族（HotpotQA、MuSiQue、SQuAD v2）上收集的缩放实验数据，在 100K 和 200K 语料库规模下评估，每个（配置、语料库、规模）单元格使用三个随机种子。 该复现检验的是 balanced > max-reliable 模式对语料库规模而非基准家族的稳健性；它不能替代被推迟的跨家族网格，也不修改表 2 的 H2 结论（该结论仍是在基础语料库上的单切片测试）。 其作用是描述性的：确认激发 H2 的组合模式——一种更轻量、以检索为中心的配置，以更低的响应时间提供相近的忠实度——是否在同一基准家族的 100K 和 200K 规模下重现。

paragraphs.en: Both realizations sit on the H2 compositional axis and share the embedding model, chunker, and generation LLM used in the H2 headline run. The balanced -tier realization uses hybrid retrieval ( α = 0.3 \alpha{=}0.3 ), top- k = 20 k{=}20 retrieval breadth, extractive context compression at 0.5 0.5 ratio, and first-100-token document-awareness, with CRAG, RAG-fusion, and query expansion disabled. Its mean per-sample latency across the three benchmarks is 6.4 6.4 s at 100K and 8.3 8.3 s at 200K. The max-reliable -tier realization uses hybrid retrieval ( α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 ), a neural reranker ( mxbai-rerank-large-v1 ), HyDE query expansion at three draft documents, extractive compression, and first-100-token document-awareness. Its mean per-sample latency is 69.3 69.3 s at 100K and 134.3 134.3 s at 200K. Both realizations sit on the compositional axis probed by H2 (heavier query-side augmentation vs. broader retrieval with light post-processing); they are two operating points on that axis and are not identical to the profile pair in Tables 2 and I.1 , which is why we report this as pattern replication rather than direct replication of the headline test. Specifically, the balanced -tier realization used here differs from the balanced profile specified in Section I.1 in three ways (hybrid α = 0.3 \alpha{=}0.3 vs. 0.5 0.5 , HyDE disabled vs. three-variant, no neural reranker vs. mxbai-rerank-large-v1 ), and the max-reliable -tier realization used here omits the agentic gate that Section I.1 enables for the headline max-reliable profile; per-sample latency comparisons below should therefore not be read against the p95 numbers in Section I.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 两种实现都位于 H2 的组合轴上，并且共享 H2 主线运行中使用的嵌入模型、分块器和生成 LLM。 平衡层实现使用混合检索（ α = 0.3 \alpha{=}0.3 ）、top- k = 20 k{=}20 的检索广度、0.5 0.5 比例的抽取式上下文压缩以及前 100 个词元的文档感知，并禁用 CRAG、RAG 融合与查询扩展。 其在三个基准上的单样本平均延迟在 100K 时为 6.4 6.4 秒，在 200K 时为 8.3 8.3 秒。 最大可靠层实现使用混合检索（ α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 ）、神经重排序器（ mxbai-rerank-large-v1 ）、基于三份草稿文档的 HyDE 查询扩展、抽取式压缩以及前 100 个词元的文档感知。 其单样本平均延迟在 100K 时为 69.3 69.3 秒，在 200K 时为 134.3 134.3 秒。 两种实现都位于 H2 所探查的组合轴上（更重的查询侧增强 vs. 更广检索加轻量后处理）；它们是该轴上的两个工作点，与表 2 和表 I.1 中的配置对并不完全相同，因此我们将其报告为模式复现，而非主线测试的直接复现。 具体而言，此处使用的平衡层实现与第 I.1 节中规定的平衡配置在三个方面不同（混合 α = 0.3 \alpha{=}0.3 vs. 0.5 0.5 、禁用 HyDE vs. 三个变体、无神经重排序器 vs. mxbai-rerank-large-v1 ），而此处使用的最大可靠层实现则省略了第 I.1 节为主线最大可靠配置启用的智能体门控；因此，下文的单样本延迟比较不应与第 I.1 节中的 p95 数字对照解读。

paragraphs.en: Across 12 12 (metric, benchmark, size) quality cells and 336 336 paired-sample response-time comparisons, the balanced -tier realization provides comparable measured quality with a consistent response-time advantage over the max-reliable -tier realization. Faithfulness deltas are statistically indistinguishable in either direction across all six benchmark-size cells (Holm-min p = 0.750 p=0.750 ; Table 37 ), as are token- F 1 F_{1} deltas (Holm-min p = 0.398 p=0.398 ). The lighter realization is faster on every sample tested ( 336 / 336 336/336 ; Table 38 ), with a speedup ratio that grows from 10.0 10.0 – 12.7 × 12.7\times at 100K to 14.6 14.6 – 20.0 × 20.0\times at 200K. The direction of the latency advantage is stable across benchmarks and both corpus sizes.

paragraphs.en: This replication uses profile realizations that sit on the H2 compositional axis but are not identical to the pair in Table 2 . It is therefore not a direct replication of the H2 headline test; the pre-registered multi-corpus comparison in Section D.7 remains unexecuted. The compositional H2 pattern (a lighter retrieval-focused profile providing similar faithfulness with lower response time than a heavier configuration) recurs at two corpus scales on the same SQuAD v2 / MuSiQue / HotpotQA benchmark family as the H2 headline. Because faithfulness gaps are non-significant in both directions and the latency advantage holds on every sample, we treat the observation as descriptive corroboration of the H2 pattern rather than a new significance claim.

paragraphs.en: The exploratory factorial identified Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate as the only interaction to survive Bonferroni on faithfulness with a Cohen-large effect ( η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}=0.201 , aggregated). Two limitations of that analysis motivated a focused confirmatory study: (i) the 232-parameter joint model is under-identified against the executed 122 usable generation configurations; and (ii) the same query set was applied across configurations, so hierarchical inference at the query level was more appropriate than flat OLS.
paragraphs.zh: 探索性因子分析发现，Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate 是唯一在真实性指标上通过 Bonferroni 校验且达到 Cohen 大效应的交互项（聚合后 η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}=0.201 ）。 该分析的两个局限性促使我们开展了一项聚焦的验证性研究：(i) 相对于实际执行的 122 个可用生成配置，232 参数的联合模型是欠识别的；(ii) 同一查询集被应用于所有配置，因此在查询层面采用层次化推断比扁平的 OLS 更为合适。

sents.en: The exploratory factorial identified Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate as the only interaction to survive Bonferroni on faithfulness with a Cohen-large effect ( η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}=0.201 , aggregated).
sents.zh: 探索性因子分析发现，Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate 是唯一在真实性指标上通过 Bonferroni 校验且达到 Cohen 大效应的交互项（聚合后 η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}=0.201 ）。

sents.en: Two limitations of that analysis motivated a focused confirmatory study: (i) the 232-parameter joint model is under-identified against the executed 122 usable generation configurations; and (ii) the same query set was applied across configurations, so hierarchical inference at the query level was more appropriate than flat OLS.

paragraphs.en: The pre-analysis plan defined a focused, hierarchically analyzed study (henceforth E1) isolating the Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate subspace.
paragraphs.zh: 预分析计划定义了一项聚焦的、分层分析的研究（以下简称 E1），用于分离 Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate 子空间。

paragraphs.en: The pre-analysis design specified 5 × 4 = 20 5\times 4=20 configurations (Query Augmentation levels { \{ none, HyDE, query-expansion, query-decomposition, RAG-Fusion } \} crossed with Agentic Gate levels { \{ none, CRAG, Self-RAG (quality gates + refinement), Speculative-RAG } \} ), holding all other six pipeline dimensions constant at the Standard-profile defaults. It specified the same 200 stratified queries for each configuration (40 per benchmark from SQuAD v2, MuSiQue, HotpotQA, TriviaQA, FiQA), across three seeds, for a total of N = 12,000 N{=}12{,}000 per-sample observations.
paragraphs.zh: 预分析设计规定了 5 × 4 = 20 5\times 4=20 种配置（查询增强级别 { \{ none、HyDE、query-expansion、query-decomposition、RAG-Fusion } \} 与智能体门控级别 { \{ none、CRAG、Self-RAG（质量门控 + 精炼）、Speculative-RAG } \} 交叉组合），同时将流水线的其余六个维度全部固定在 Standard 档的默认值上。 该设计为每种配置指定了相同的 200 个分层查询（来自 SQuAD v2、MuSiQue、HotpotQA、TriviaQA、FiQA 各 40 个），跨三个种子，共计每样本观测 N = 12,000 N{=}12{,}000 条。

paragraphs.en: The primary test was a hierarchical mixed-effects likelihood-ratio test of full ( 𝚏𝚊𝚒𝚝𝚑𝚏𝚞𝚕𝚗𝚎𝚜𝚜 ∼ 𝙲 ⁡ ( 𝙳𝟻 ) + 𝙲 ⁡ ( 𝙳𝟾 ) + 𝙲 ⁡ ( 𝙳𝟻 ) : 𝙲 ⁡ ( 𝙳𝟾 ) + ( 𝟷 | 𝚚𝚞𝚎𝚛𝚢 ​ _ ​ 𝚒𝚍 ) \mathtt{faithfulness\sim C(D5)+C(D8)+C(D5)\!:\!C(D8)+(1|query\_id)} ) vs. reduced ( 𝚏𝚊𝚒𝚝𝚑𝚏𝚞𝚕𝚗𝚎𝚜𝚜 ∼ 𝙲 ⁡ ( 𝙳𝟻 ) + 𝙲 ⁡ ( 𝙳𝟾 ) + ( 𝟷 | 𝚚𝚞𝚎𝚛𝚢 ​ _ ​ 𝚒𝚍 ) \mathtt{faithfulness\sim C(D5)+C(D8)+(1|query\_id)} ) at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . At the planned N = 12,000 N{=}12{,}000 , Cohen’s f = 0.10 f=0.10 was detectable at > 99 % >99\% power against α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ; the exploratory η 2 = 0.20 \eta^{2}=0.20 estimate corresponds to Cohen’s f = 0.50 f=0.50 , so the planned study was over-powered against the effect of practical interest.

paragraphs.en: The pre-registered decision rule ( Section D.9 ) treats significance and magnitude as separable criteria. On the executed E1 read, the null of additivity is rejected at p = 0.007 p=0.007 , but the observed partial η 2 = 0.033 \eta^{2}=0.033 is well below the pre-registered η 2 ≥ 0.20 \eta^{2}\geq 0.20 Cohen-large bar. We therefore report E1 as confirmed as directional (the interaction between Query Augmentation and the Agentic Gate is statistically robust under hierarchical inference) and not confirmed at the pre-registered magnitude (the per-pair interaction on this axis is small, not the Cohen-large effect implied by the exploratory η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}=0.201 estimate on the same sub-space). Substantively, this refines H1 rather than overturning it: composed RAG pipelines do exhibit real interactions between stages, but on the specific Query Augmentation × \times Agentic Gate axis those interactions are small on top of the additive main effects, and the exploratory η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}=0.201 estimate on this sub-space is superseded by the confirmatory η 2 = 0.033 \eta^{2}=0.033 .
paragraphs.zh: 预注册的决策规则（第 D.9 节）将显著性与效应量作为可分离的判定标准。 在已执行的 E1 读取中，可加性原假设在 p = 0.007 处被拒绝，但观测到的偏 η² = 0.033 远低于预注册的 η² ≥ 0.20 的 Cohen-large 门槛。 因此我们将 E1 报告为：方向性得到确认（Query Augmentation 与 Agentic Gate 之间的交互作用在分层推断下统计上稳健），但预注册的效应量未得到确认（该维度上每对组合的交互作用很小，而非在同一子空间上探索性估计 η² = 0.201 所暗示的 Cohen-large 效应）。 从实质上看，这是对 H1 的细化而非推翻：组合式 RAG 流水线的各阶段之间确实存在真实的交互作用，但在 Query Augmentation × Agentic Gate 这一特定维度上，这些交互作用在加性主效应之上很小，且该子空间上探索性的 η² = 0.201 估计已被验证性的 η² = 0.033 所取代。

paragraphs.en: Two caveats apply, and are echoed in the main paper’s Limitations section: (i) query-count shortfall relative to plan ( 43 43 unique queries × \times 3 3 seeds ≈ 2,550 {\approx}2{,}550 per-sample observations, versus the pre-registered 200 200 queries × \times 3 3 seeds = 12,000 {=}12{,}000 ), a deviation driven by GPT-5.1 rate-limit budget ( Appendix A ); seed replication itself matches plan; (ii) the E1 grid holds all other six pipeline dimensions at Standard-profile defaults, so generalization to other stage settings is a scoped rather than universal claim.
paragraphs.zh: 需要注意两点限制，且在主文的“局限性”部分中也有呼应：(i) 查询数量相对于计划存在不足（ 43 43 个唯一查询 × \times 3 3 个随机种子 ≈ 2,550 {\approx}2{,}550 条逐样本观测，而预注册计划为 200 200 个查询 × \times 3 3 个随机种子 = 12,000 {=}12{,}000 ），这一偏差是由 GPT-5.1 速率限制预算所致（ 附录 A ）；种子重复本身与计划相符；(ii) E1 网格将流水线其余六个维度均保持在标准配置（Standard-profile）默认值，因此对其他阶段设置的泛化是有范围的结论，而非普遍性结论。

paragraphs.en: While the aggregate D5 × \times D8 interaction is small on the E1 grid, cell-level departures from the additive main-effects prediction reveal specific compositional patterns that isolated single-component ablations cannot see. Table 42 lists the top five antagonistic and top five synergistic cells ranked by | | residual | | ; ten of twenty cells deviate from the additive prediction by ≥ 0.02 {\geq}0.02 faithfulness, evenly split (five antagonistic, five synergistic), with residuals spanning [ − 0.050 , + 0.047 ] [-0.050,+0.047] . Two structural patterns are visible: (i) Query Decomposition synergizes with the active agentic gates: its two largest positive residuals are with CRAG ( + 0.039 +0.039 ) and Speculative-RAG ( + 0.047 +0.047 ), but it antagonizes the no-gate condition ( − 0.050 -0.050 ), i.e. multi-part queries need an active verifier downstream to pay off; (ii) Speculative-RAG antagonizes passive or lightly-augmented queries (residuals of − 0.041 -0.041 with both raw queries and Query Expansion) yet synergizes with structured decomposition ( + 0.047 +0.047 ), i.e. its parallel draft-and-verify mechanism is worth the latency only when the upstream query already carries structure. Both patterns are invisible to single-factor ablations: a practitioner who tunes D5 and D8 independently would predict the additive main-effects surface and miss up to ± 5 \pm 5 -point cell-level swings against that prediction. This is the compositional evidence that motivates factorial testbeds like lasagna even when the aggregate interaction term is small. The seven cells whose D8 level lies in {CRAG, Self-RAG, Speculative-RAG} were re-scored by the pairwise-BTL follow-up in Section C.5 , which on a subsample deliberately biased toward small RAGAS deltas returned 79 % 79\% ties and Spearman ρ = − 0.36 \rho=-0.36 between BTL and RAGAS configuration ranks; those seven cell-level directions should therefore be read as protocol-dependent descriptive patterns rather than judge-invariant orderings. The five D8 = = none cells of the 5 × 4 5{\times}4 grid, including the Query-Decomposition × \times none residual of − 0.050 -0.050 named above, sit outside the BTL sample and are not certified by BTL either way.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 D5 × \times D8 的总体交互在 E1 网格上很小，但在单元层面，相对于加性主效应预测的偏离揭示了一些特定的组合模式，而这些模式是孤立的单组件消融无法看到的。 表 42 列出了按 | | 残差 | | 排序的前五个拮抗单元和前五个协同单元；二十个单元中有十个偏离加性预测达 ≥ 0.02 {\geq}0.02 的忠实度，且分布均衡（五个拮抗、五个协同），残差范围为 [ − 0.050 , + 0.047 ] [-0.050,+0.047] 。 可以看到两种结构性模式：(i) 查询分解与处于激活状态的智能体门控产生协同：其两个最大的正残差出现在与 CRAG ( + 0.039 +0.039 ) 和 Speculative-RAG ( + 0.047 +0.047 ) 的组合中，但它与无门控条件相拮抗 ( − 0.050 -0.050 )，即多部分查询需要下游有一个激活的验证器才能产生收益；(ii) Speculative-RAG 与被动或轻度增强的查询相拮抗（与原始查询和查询扩展组合的残差均为 − 0.041 -0.041 ），但与结构化分解产生协同 ( + 0.047 +0.047 )，即只有当上游查询已带有结构时，其并行草拟-验证机制才值得付出延迟代价。 这两种模式对单因素消融都是不可见的：一个独立调优 D5 和 D8 的实践者会预测出加性主效应曲面，并错过相对于该预测高达 ± 5 \pm 5 分的单元层面波动。 这正是促使我们构建像 lasagna 这样的因子化测试床的组合性证据，即使总体交互项很小。 D8 取值属于 {CRAG, Self-RAG, Speculative-RAG} 的七个单元已由 C.5 节中的成对 BTL 后续实验重新评分；该实验在一个刻意偏向小 RAGAS 差值的子样本上返回了 79 % 79\% 的并列以及 BTL 与 RAGAS 配置排序之间 ρ = − 0.36 \rho=-0.36 的 Spearman 相关系数；因此，这七个单元层面的方向应被解读为依赖协议的描述性模式，而非与评判器无关的排序。 5 × 4 5{\times}4 网格中 D8 = = none 的五个单元，包括上文提到的查询分解 × \times none 的 − 0.050 -0.050 残差，均位于 BTL 样本之外，因而无论哪种方向都未获得 BTL 的认证。

paragraphs.en: The strongest probe (Reranking × \times Hybrid Alpha, DiD = − 0.110 =-0.110 ) suggests that combining reranking with adjusted hybrid alpha yields 38% less improvement than the sum of individual effects. HyDE × \times Reranking (DiD = − 0.066 =-0.066 ) suggests that cross-encoder reranking subsumes much of HyDE’s benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 最强的探针（重排序 × 混合 Alpha 调整，双重差分 = −0.110）表明，将重排序与调整后的混合 Alpha 相结合，其提升比两者单独效果之和低 38%。 HyDE × 重排序（双重差分 = −0.066）表明，交叉编码器重排序涵盖了 HyDE 的大部分收益。

sents.en: HyDE × \times Reranking (DiD = − 0.066 =-0.066 ) suggests that cross-encoder reranking subsumes much of HyDE’s benefit.

paragraphs.en: We tested the two strongest probes on the held-out BEIR test split (96 queries across 5 domains). Reranking × \times MMR replicated exactly (test DiD = − 0.058 =-0.058 ), confirming the reranker’s subsumption of MMR diversity effects. Reranking × \times Hybrid Alpha showed a sign reversal (test DiD = + 0.027 =+0.027 ), indicating that this interaction is query-set dependent and should not be treated as a stable finding. This instability motivated the full 167-configuration factorial ANOVA ( Section 5 ), which provides more robust interaction estimates across the full 8-dimensional design space.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在留出的 BEIR 测试集划分（5 个领域共 96 个查询）上测试了两个最强的探针。 重排序 × \times MMR 的结果完全复现（测试集双重差分 = − 0.058 =-0.058 ），证实了重排序器对 MMR 多样性效应的涵盖。 重排序 × \times 混合 Alpha 出现了符号反转（测试集双重差分 = + 0.027 =+0.027 ），表明该交互效应依赖于查询集，不应被视为稳定的发现。 这种不稳定性促使我们进行了完整的 167 种配置的析因方差分析（第 5 节），从而在完整的 8 维设计空间上提供了更稳健的交互效应估计。

paragraphs.en: To probe interaction effects between features and pipeline profiles, we conduct a feature dropout analysis: for each of the four composed profiles, we disable one feature at a time and measure the change in NDCG@10. Table 44 reports the results. A negative Δ \Delta NDCG indicates that removing the feature hurts performance (i.e., the feature is beneficial in that profile); a positive Δ \Delta NDCG indicates that removing the feature helps (i.e., the feature is harmful in that profile). This analysis is exploratory.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究特征与流水线配置之间的交互效应，我们进行了一项特征剔除分析：对于四个组合配置中的每一个，我们每次禁用一个特征，并测量 NDCG@10 的变化。 表 44 报告了结果。 负的 Δ \Delta NDCG 表示移除该特征会损害性能（即该特征在该配置中是有益的）；正的 Δ \Delta NDCG 表示移除该特征有帮助（即该特征在该配置中是有害的）。 该分析是探索性的。

paragraphs.en: Several features exhibit profile-dependent behavior, providing evidence of non-zero interactions. HyDE improves NDCG@10 in the Max-Reliable profile (dropout Δ = − 0.031 \Delta=-0.031 ) but marginally hurts the balanced profile (dropout Δ = + 0.008 \Delta=+0.008 ), suggesting that HyDE’s benefit depends on whether a reranker is present to filter its occasionally noisy hypothetical documents. Context reordering helps in Max-Reliable ( − 0.003 -0.003 ) but hurts in balanced ( + 0.015 +0.015 ), likely because the reranker already places the most relevant passages at optimal positions. Query expansion consistently hurts when enabled ( + 0.018 +0.018 on removal), confirming the single-feature ablation finding ( Section D.1 ). Agentic RAG removal improves NDCG@10 by + 0.021 +0.021 in Max-Reliable, consistent with the aggressive refinement effect discussed in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 若干特征表现出依赖配置文件的行为，提供了非零交互的证据。 HyDE 在 Max-Reliable 配置下提升了 NDCG@10（弃用 Δ = −0.031），但在 balanced 配置下略有损害（弃用 Δ = +0.008），这表明 HyDE 的收益取决于是否存在一个重排序器来过滤其偶尔带噪声的假设文档。 上下文重排在 Max-Reliable 中有帮助（−0.003），但在 balanced 中有害（+0.015），这很可能是因为重排序器已经把最相关的段落放在了最佳位置。 查询扩展在启用时始终有害（移除后 +0.018），证实了单特征消融的发现（见 D.1 节）。 移除 Agentic RAG 在 Max-Reliable 中使 NDCG@10 提升了 +0.021，这与第 5 节讨论的过度激进细化效应相符。

paragraphs.en: Disabling MMR (i.e., re-enabling it) consistently hurts across all four profiles, confirming that MMR’s diversity penalty is counterproductive on our domain-focused corpus regardless of other active features. Document awareness (100-token prefix) also provides stable gains across all profiles where it is active, with dropout deltas ranging from − 0.041 -0.041 to − 0.055 -0.055 .
paragraphs.zh: 禁用 MMR（即重新启用它）在所有四种配置中都一致地造成性能下降，这证实了无论其他哪些功能处于激活状态，MMR 的多样性惩罚在我们面向领域的语料库上都是适得其反的。 文档感知（100-token 前缀）在其激活的所有配置中也能带来稳定的增益，其 dropout 差值范围为 −0.041 到 −0.055。

paragraphs.en: We report per-domain results across the five BEIR subsets used in our evaluation. Table 45 presents NDCG@10 and Table 46 presents faithfulness, both on the test split. These breakdowns are exploratory; per-domain sample sizes (11–19 queries) are too small for reliable statistical comparisons.

paragraphs.en: nfcorpus (biomedical) is the most challenging domain across all profiles, with NDCG@10 values 0.10–0.17 below the best-performing domain. We attribute this to the specialized vocabulary and complex information needs characteristic of biomedical queries. scifact benefits most from cross-encoder reranking (balanced profile: + 0.078 +0.078 over standard), consistent with the observation that scientific claims require precise passage-level relevance matching. hotpotqa shows the largest gain from HyDE-enhanced retrieval (Max-Reliable: + 0.088 +0.088 over standard), likely because multi-hop questions benefit from the bridging context that hypothetical documents provide.
paragraphs.zh: nfcorpus（生物医学）在所有配置中都是最具挑战性的领域，其 NDCG@10 比表现最佳的领域低 0.10–0.17。 我们将此归因于生物医学查询所特有的专业词汇和复杂信息需求。scifact 从交叉编码器重排序中获益最多（均衡配置：比标准方法高 +0.078），这与科学论断需要精确的段落级相关性匹配的观察结果一致。

paragraphs.en: Faithfulness is consistently high across all profiles ( > 0.94 >0.94 ), with smaller inter-domain variance than NDCG@10. The speed profile achieves surprisingly strong faithfulness, particularly on scifact (0.991), which we attribute to the concise answer style encouraged by speed-optimized prompting. nfcorpus again shows the lowest faithfulness values, suggesting that biomedical context is more prone to generating unsupported claims. The SOTA max reliable profile achieves the highest faithfulness on three of five domains, consistent with its quality-gate design, although the margins are narrow (0.003–0.008 above SOTA balanced).
paragraphs.zh: 忠实度在所有配置中始终较高（>0.94），且跨领域方差小于 NDCG@10。 速度配置取得了出人意料的强忠实度，尤其是在 scifact 上（0.991），我们将其归因于速度优化提示所鼓励的简洁回答风格。nfcorpus 再次显示出最低的忠实度值，表明生物医学语境更容易生成缺乏依据的论断。 SOTA max reliable 配置在五个领域中的三个取得了最高忠实度，这与其质量门控设计一致，尽管优势幅度很小（比 SOTA balanced 高出 0.003–0.008）。

paragraphs.en: This appendix visualizes the central finding of the paper: that composing individually beneficial RAG components yields smaller improvements than the sum of their independent effects.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录可视化了论文的核心发现：将各自有益的 RAG 组件组合起来，所获得的提升小于其各自独立效果之和。

paragraphs.en: The waterfall in Fig. 9 illustrates why single-factor ablations are misleading for RAG pipeline design. Each bar represents the marginal gain of one component when evaluated in isolation against the baseline. A practitioner who selects components based on these independent deltas would expect a combined NDCG@10 of 0.667 ( = 0.412 + 0.084 + 0.062 + 0.046 + 0.037 + 0.026 =0.412+0.084+0.062+0.046+0.037+0.026 ). The actual composed result is 0.483, a shortfall of 0.184 ( 72 % 72\% of the expected improvement is lost to interactions).
paragraphs.zh: 图 9 的瀑布图说明了为什么单因素消融实验会误导 RAG 流水线设计。 每根柱子表示在孤立条件下相对基线评估时某个组件的边际增益。 如果实践者基于这些独立的增量来选择组件，会预期组合后的 NDCG@10 为 0.667（= 0.412 + 0.084 + 0.062 + 0.046 + 0.037 + 0.026 =0.412+0.084+0.062+0.046+0.037+0.026）。 实际组合后的结果是 0.483，短缺了 0.184（预期提升的 72% 72\% 因交互作用而损失）。

sents.zh: 图 9 的瀑布图说明了为什么单因素消融实验会误导 RAG 流水线设计。

The actual composed result is 0.483, a shortfall of 0.184 ( 72 % 72\% of the expected improvement is lost to interactions).

paragraphs.en: This penalty arises because several components partially duplicate each other’s function. For example, both HyDE and cross-encoder reranking improve query-passage alignment, and when both are active the marginal gain of each is smaller than when either operates alone. Similarly, disabling MMR removes a diversity penalty that the reranker already subsumes, so the independent gain from disabling MMR overlaps with the gain from adding a reranker.
paragraphs.zh: 这一惩罚之所以出现，是因为若干组件在功能上彼此部分重复。 例如，HyDE 和交叉编码器重排序都能改进查询—段落的对齐，当两者同时启用时，各自带来的边际增益要小于其单独运行时的情况。 类似地，禁用 MMR 可以消除一种重排序器已经涵盖的多样性惩罚，因此禁用 MMR 所带来的独立增益与添加重排序器所带来的增益相互重叠。

paragraphs.en: The factorial probes in Section 5 quantify these pairwise interactions, and the waterfall shows their aggregate effect on the composed system.
paragraphs.zh: 第5节中的因子探针量化了这些两两交互作用，而瀑布图则展示了它们对组合系统产生的总体影响。

paragraphs.en: We compare marginal faithfulness effects across the 113 113 configurations with complete generation-side records. Four positive one-component contrasts contribute + 0.014 +0.014 for BGE-large embedding, + 0.036 +0.036 for hierarchical chunking, + 0.018 +0.018 for hybrid-BM25 retrieval, and + 0.126 +0.126 for Speculative-RAG gating. Adding these marginals to a reference score of 0.692 0.692 predicts 0.886 0.886 ( + 28 % +28\% ); the best observed complete configuration reaches 0.911 0.911 ( + 32 % +32\% ). The reference, marginal contrasts, and best configuration do not form one exactly matched component stack, so their closeness is not a controlled additivity test. It is an exploratory signal that faithfulness may compose more nearly additively for some methods than retrieval does, and motivates testing the exact combinations directly rather than assuming either additivity or a composition penalty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在113 113个具有完整生成侧记录的配置之间比较边际忠实度效应。 四个正向单组件对比分别贡献了：BGE-large嵌入 + 0.014 +0.014、分层分块 + 0.036 +0.036、混合BM25检索 + 0.018 +0.018，以及Speculative-RAG门控 + 0.126 +0.126。 将这些边际值加到0.692 0.692的参考分数上，预测结果为0.886 0.886（+ 28 % +28\%）；观察到的最佳完整配置达到0.911 0.911（+ 32 % +32\%）。 由于参考配置、边际对比与最佳配置并不构成一个完全匹配的组件堆栈，因此它们的接近程度并非受控的可加性检验。 这是一个探索性信号，表明某些方法的忠实度可能比检索更接近可加地组合，这也促使我们直接检验确切的组合，而不是假设可加性或组合惩罚的存在。

paragraphs.en: This appendix complements the quality-focused scaling analysis in Section 5 with latency measurements across corpus sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录通过跨语料库规模的延迟测量，补充了第 5 节中聚焦质量的扩展分析。

paragraphs.en: Figure 10 shows P95 latency as a function of corpus size for both the retrieval and E2E generation tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 图 10 展示了检索和 E2E 生成两条赛道中 P95 延迟随语料库规模变化的函数关系。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval latency scales sub-linearly with corpus size: a 10 × \times expansion from 5K to 50K increases standard P95 latency by approximately 87% (not 10 × \times ), reflecting the logarithmic complexity of approximate nearest-neighbor search in vector databases. The speed profile maintains P95 < < 300 ms across all corpus sizes, confirming its suitability for latency-critical deployments. The balanced profile shows better latency scaling than standard (65% growth vs. 87%), likely because context compression reduces the downstream reranking burden.
paragraphs.zh: 检索延迟随语料库规模呈亚线性增长：从 5K 扩展到 50K 的 10 × \times 扩容使标准 P95 延迟增加约 87%（而非 10 × \times），这反映了向量数据库中近似最近邻搜索的对数复杂度。 速度配置在所有语料库规模下均保持 P95 < < 300 ms，证实其适用于延迟敏感的部署场景。 平衡配置展现出比标准配置更好的延迟扩展性（增长 65% 对比 87%），这可能是因为上下文压缩降低了下游重排序的负担。

sents.zh: 检索延迟随语料库规模呈亚线性增长：从 5K 扩展到 50K 的 10 × \times 扩容使标准 P95 延迟增加约 87%（而非 10 × \times），这反映了向量数据库中近似最近邻搜索的对数复杂度。

sents.zh: 速度配置在所有语料库规模下均保持 P95 < < 300 ms，证实其适用于延迟敏感的部署场景。

sents.zh: 平衡配置展现出比标准配置更好的延迟扩展性（增长 65% 对比 87%），这可能是因为上下文压缩降低了下游重排序的负担。

paragraphs.en: At 50K documents, practitioners choosing between standard (P95 ≈ \approx 7 s) and balanced (P95 ≈ \approx 18 s) face a latency–faithfulness trade-off: balanced offers 0.93 faithfulness at 2.6 × \times the latency of standard (0.79 faithfulness). The speed profile remains the only option for sub-second latency requirements, at the cost of substantially lower retrieval quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在 5 万篇文档的规模下，在标准模式（P95 ≈ 7 秒）与均衡模式（P95 ≈ 18 秒）之间做选择的从业者面临延迟与忠实度的权衡：均衡模式以 2.6 倍于标准模式的延迟换取 0.93 的忠实度（标准模式忠实度为 0.79）。 极速模式仍是满足亚秒级延迟要求的唯一选项，但代价是检索质量显著降低。

paragraphs.en: This appendix extends the log-linear scaling fits from Section 5 to project retrieval quality at corpus sizes beyond our measured range.

Prediction intervals are 95%, using the residual standard deviation and Student- t t critical value for n − 2 = 4 n-2=4 degrees of freedom. Table 49 reports measured values (5K–200K) alongside projections (500K, 1M ∗ ).

paragraphs.en: The measured balanced – standard gap is noisy at intermediate scales (positive at 25K but within noise; negative-trend at 15K), then firms at 200K where balanced exceeds standard by + 0.059 +0.059 NDCG@10 (Welch’s t t , p = 0.004 p=0.004 , n = 3 n=3 seeds per cell). At the 1M projection the 95% prediction intervals overlap, balanced ’s lower bound ( 0.423 0.423 ) sits below standard ’s upper bound ( 0.448 0.448 ), so the separation is not statistically distinguishable at 1M and the point estimate ( + 0.077 +0.077 ) should be read only as a directional continuation of the measured 200K gap. The interpretation that context compression and document-awareness prefixes act as implicit noise filters is therefore supported by the measured 200K result and the monotone trend 50K → \to 200K, not by the 1M extrapolation.
paragraphs.zh: 实测的均衡–标准差距在中间规模上噪声较大（在 25K 时为正但在噪声范围内；在 15K 时呈负向趋势），到 200K 时趋于稳定，均衡比标准高 +0.059 NDCG@10（Welch t 检验，p=0.004，每个单元 n=3 个种子）。 在 1M 的外推中，95% 预测区间相互重叠，均衡的下界（0.423）低于标准的上界（0.448），因此在 1M 处该分离在统计上不可区分，点估计（+0.077）只能被解读为实测 200K 差距的方向性延续。 因此，上下文压缩与文档感知前缀充当隐式噪声过滤器的这一解释，得到的是实测 200K 结果以及 50K → 200K 的单调趋势的支持，而非 1M 外推的支持。

sents.en: The measured balanced – standard gap is noisy at intermediate scales (positive at 25K but within noise; negative-trend at 15K), then firms at 200K where balanced exceeds standard by + 0.059 +0.059 NDCG@10 (Welch’s t t , p = 0.004 p=0.004 , n = 3 n=3 seeds per cell).
sents.zh: 实测的均衡–标准差距在中间规模上噪声较大（在 25K 时为正但在噪声范围内；在 15K 时呈负向趋势），到 200K 时趋于稳定，均衡比标准高 +0.059 NDCG@10（Welch t 检验，p=0.004，每个单元 n=3 个种子）。

sents.en: At the 1M projection the 95% prediction intervals overlap, balanced ’s lower bound ( 0.423 0.423 ) sits below standard ’s upper bound ( 0.448 0.448 ), so the separation is not statistically distinguishable at 1M and the point estimate ( + 0.077 +0.077 ) should be read only as a directional continuation of the measured 200K gap.
sents.zh: 在 1M 的外推中，95% 预测区间相互重叠，均衡的下界（0.423）低于标准的上界（0.448），因此在 1M 处该分离在统计上不可区分，点估计（+0.077）只能被解读为实测 200K 差距的方向性延续。

sents.en: The interpretation that context compression and document-awareness prefixes act as implicit noise filters is therefore supported by the measured 200K result and the monotone trend 50K → \to 200K, not by the 1M extrapolation.
sents.zh: 因此，上下文压缩与文档感知前缀充当隐式噪声过滤器的这一解释，得到的是实测 200K 结果以及 50K → 200K 的单调趋势的支持，而非 1M 外推的支持。

paragraphs.en: Projections assume (i) the log-linear relationship holds beyond 200K, (ii) the distractor distribution remains representative of real-world corpus growth, and (iii) the vector backend scales without architectural changes. Assumption (i) is on empirically solid ground for speed and standard ( R 2 ≥ 0.89 R^{2}\geq 0.89 ) but weaker for balanced and max-reliable , whose slopes are not distinguishable from zero, their 1M projections reflect uncertainty about whether the flat trend will hold rather than about the form of a decay law. We present 500K/1M values as directional estimates to motivate future large-scale validation, not as confirmed predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 推测假设 (i) 对数线性关系在 20 万之后仍然成立，(ii) 干扰项分布仍然能代表真实世界语料库的增长，(iii) 向量后端无需架构改动即可扩展。 假设 (i) 对速度和标准（ R 2 ≥ 0.89 R^{2}\geq 0.89 ）而言有坚实的经验基础，但对平衡和最大可靠而言较弱，后二者的斜率与零无法区分，其 100 万的推测反映的是平坦趋势能否维持的不确定性，而非衰减规律形式的不确定性。 我们将 50 万/100 万的数值作为方向性估计提出，以推动未来的大规模验证，而非作为已确认的预测。

paragraphs.en: The headline analyses in the main text rest on the 167-configuration D-optimal fractional factorial (retrieval ANOVA) and the 122-configuration faithfulness factorial. Beyond that core design, we ran 24 targeted ablation and model-comparison experiments totalling 138 distinct configurations , plus the 5K–200K corpus-scaling sweep (18 cells × \times 1–3 seeds = = 72 runs; see Sections 5 and B.3.9 ). Combined with the factorial executions this yields ∼ \sim 450 distinct configuration runs across eight benchmarks. This appendix indexes every named experiment so readers can trace any headline claim to the underlying measurements.

paragraphs.en: The SOTA-2025–2026 rerankers (Jina-v2, BGE-v2-m3, BGE-v2-gemma) underperform on our benchmark, which we attribute to domain-specialization: those models are tuned for web/MTEB-style queries whereas our evaluation set blends BEIR (nfcorpus, fiqa, scifact, arguana, hotpotqa) with QA-style prompts that favor the older MS-MARCO-trained cross-encoders. The LLM-listwise reranker underperforms on our benchmark, with both window settings dominated by older cross-encoders (window = 10 =10 : NDCG@10 = 0.405 =0.405 , 2,649 2{,}649 ms; window = 5 =5 : NDCG@10 = 0.354 =0.354 , 5,441 5{,}441 ms). The window-size effect has two compounding mechanical sources rather than a single anomaly: (i) at window = 5 =5 , reranking the top-20 requires four sequential LLM calls versus two at window = 10 =10 , doubling wall-clock latency before any quality consideration; (ii) each smaller-window call sees fewer candidates and cannot reason globally about the ranking, a known limitation of LLM listwise scoring that our results are consistent with rather than novel evidence for. We tested only two window sizes on a single 93-query benchmark with one judge model, so the directional gap should be read as confirming known LLM-listwise behavior under our specific infrastructure rather than as a generalizable scaling claim; a full sweep over windows ∈ { 3 , 5 , 8 , 10 , 15 , 20 } \in\{3,5,8,10,15,20\} with multiple seeds would be needed to characterize the curve shape.
paragraphs.zh: SOTA-2025–2026 的重排序模型（Jina-v2、BGE-v2-m3、BGE-v2-gemma）在我们的基准上表现不佳，我们将其归因于领域特化：这些模型是针对网页/MTEB 风格的查询进行调优的，而我们的评测集将 BEIR（nfcorpus、fiqa、scifact、arguana、hotpotqa）与偏向较旧的 MS-MARCO 训练的交叉编码器的问答风格提示混合在一起。 基于 LLM 的列表式（listwise）重排序模型在我们的基准上表现不佳，在两种窗口设置下都被较旧的交叉编码器所超越（window = 10：NDCG@10 = 0.405，2,649 毫秒；window = 5：NDCG@10 = 0.354，5,441 毫秒）。 窗口大小的影响有两个相互叠加的机制性来源，而非单一异常：（i）在 window = 5 时，对 top-20 进行重排序需要四次顺序 LLM 调用，而在 window = 10 时只需两次，在任何质量考量之前就使挂钟延迟翻倍；（ii）每次更小窗口的调用看到的候选数量更少，无法对排序进行全局推理，这是 LLM 列表式打分的一个已知局限，我们的结果与其一致，而非为其提供了新证据。 我们仅在单个包含 93 个查询的基准上、使用一个评判模型测试了两种窗口大小，因此这一方向性差距应被解读为确认了已知 LLM 列表式行为在我们特定基础设施下的表现，而非可泛化的扩展性结论；若要刻画该曲线的形状，需要在窗口 ∈ {3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20} 上以多个随机种子进行完整扫描。

sents.en: The SOTA-2025–2026 rerankers (Jina-v2, BGE-v2-m3, BGE-v2-gemma) underperform on our benchmark, which we attribute to domain-specialization: those models are tuned for web/MTEB-style queries whereas our evaluation set blends BEIR (nfcorpus, fiqa, scifact, arguana, hotpotqa) with QA-style prompts that favor the older MS-MARCO-trained cross-encoders.
sents.zh: SOTA-2025–2026 的重排序模型（Jina-v2、BGE-v2-m3、BGE-v2-gemma）在我们的基准上表现不佳，我们将其归因于领域特化：这些模型是针对网页/MTEB 风格的查询进行调优的，而我们的评测集将 BEIR（nfcorpus、fiqa、scifact、arguana、hotpotqa）与偏向较旧的 MS-MARCO 训练的交叉编码器的问答风格提示混合在一起。

sents.en: The LLM-listwise reranker underperforms on our benchmark, with both window settings dominated by older cross-encoders (window = 10 =10 : NDCG@10 = 0.405 =0.405 , 2,649 2{,}649 ms; window = 5 =5 : NDCG@10 = 0.354 =0.354 , 5,441 5{,}441 ms).
sents.zh: 基于 LLM 的列表式（listwise）重排序模型在我们的基准上表现不佳，在两种窗口设置下都被较旧的交叉编码器所超越（window = 10：NDCG@10 = 0.405，2,649 毫秒；window = 5：NDCG@10 = 0.354，5,441 毫秒）。

sents.en: The window-size effect has two compounding mechanical sources rather than a single anomaly: (i) at window = 5 =5 , reranking the top-20 requires four sequential LLM calls versus two at window = 10 =10 , doubling wall-clock latency before any quality consideration; (ii) each smaller-window call sees fewer candidates and cannot reason globally about the ranking, a known limitation of LLM listwise scoring that our results are consistent with rather than novel evidence for.
sents.zh: 窗口大小的影响有两个相互叠加的机制性来源，而非单一异常：（i）在 window = 5 时，对 top-20 进行重排序需要四次顺序 LLM 调用，而在 window = 10 时只需两次，在任何质量考量之前就使挂钟延迟翻倍；（ii）每次更小窗口的调用看到的候选数量更少，无法对排序进行全局推理，这是 LLM 列表式打分的一个已知局限，我们的结果与其一致，而非为其提供了新证据。

sents.en: We tested only two window sizes on a single 93-query benchmark with one judge model, so the directional gap should be read as confirming known LLM-listwise behavior under our specific infrastructure rather than as a generalizable scaling claim; a full sweep over windows ∈ { 3 , 5 , 8 , 10 , 15 , 20 } \in\{3,5,8,10,15,20\} with multiple seeds would be needed to characterize the curve shape.
sents.zh: 我们仅在单个包含 93 个查询的基准上、使用一个评判模型测试了两种窗口大小，因此这一方向性差距应被解读为确认了已知 LLM 列表式行为在我们特定基础设施下的表现，而非可泛化的扩展性结论；若要刻画该曲线的形状，需要在窗口 ∈ {3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20} 上以多个随机种子进行完整扫描。

paragraphs.en: Two findings emerge. First, Matryoshka truncation to 768 dimensions ( dim_768 , NDCG@10 = 0.489 =0.489 ) slightly exceeds the full 1024-dim embedding ( 0.478 0.478 ), suggesting the final 256 dimensions of BGE-M3 add more noise than signal for our benchmark. Second, late chunking provides a substantial uplift for BGE-large ( 0.460 → 0.493 0.460\to 0.493 , + 0.033 +0.033 ) but degrades BGE-M3 ( 0.459 → 0.361 0.459\to 0.361 , − 0.098 -0.098 ). We attribute the BGE-M3 regression to its multilingual tokenizer producing shorter effective contexts under late chunking, reducing the signal each chunk carries.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个发现。 首先，Matryoshka 截断至 768 维（dim_768，NDCG@10 = 0.489）略微超过了完整的 1024 维嵌入（0.478），这表明 BGE-M3 的最后 256 个维度在我们的基准测试中带来的噪声多于信号。 其次，late chunking 为 BGE-large 带来了显著提升（0.460 → 0.493，+0.033），但降低了 BGE-M3 的表现（0.459 → 0.361，−0.098）。 我们将 BGE-M3 的性能回退归因于其多语言分词器在 late chunking 下产生了更短的有效上下文，从而减少了每个分块所携带的信号。

paragraphs.en: Table 54 reports per-configuration NDCG@10 and generation metrics (Faith a {}_{\textsc{{a}}} , Faith r {}_{\textsc{{r}}} , EM) for the four generation-side ablations: the 17-configuration Agentic RAG sweep (varying iterations, hallucination-check gates, and answer-quality gates), the Context Compression Ablation, the CRAG Generation Ablation, and the CRAG retrieval-track variant (Exp. 07). paragraphs.en: The two-judge sensitivity analysis reported in Sections F.7 and C.1.4 covered n = 80 n{=}80 matched samples across two LLM judges (GPT-5.1, Claude Sonnet 4.5). This is an LLM-scored sensitivity extension, not additional human evaluation ; the n = 50 n{=}50 dyadic human study in Section C.4 remains the sole human-judged calibration in this paper.

paragraphs.en: Fair kappa ( 0.35 0.35 ) combined with moderate Pearson r = 0.44 r{=}0.44 demonstrates that the faithfulness signal survives judge substitution but is not judge-invariant: this is consistent with the two-judge n = 80 n{=}80 result ( τ b = 0.38 \tau_{b}{=}0.38 ) reported in Section C.1.4 , and reinforces the paper’s headline policy of reporting deltas and rankings rather than absolute faithfulness magnitudes. Because Opus 4.7 was not seen by either RAGAS or Sonnet 4.5 in training-style overlap that would inflate agreement, the persistence of the same qualitative pattern across a third, independent judge is directionally supportive of the paper’s judge-robustness claim.
paragraphs.zh: 公平 kappa（0.35 0.35）与中等的 Pearson r = 0.44 r{=}0.44 相结合，表明忠实性信号在评审替换后仍然存在，但并不具备评审不变性：这与 C.1.4 节中报告的双评审 n = 80 n{=}80 结果（τ b = 0.38 \tau_{b}{=}0.38）一致，并强化了本文的核心报告策略，即报告差值和排名而非绝对忠实性数值。 由于 Opus 4.7 并未以会造成一致性虚高的训练式重叠方式被 RAGAS 或 Sonnet 4.5 见过，因此在第三个独立评审上保持相同的定性模式，为本文关于评审鲁棒性的主张提供了方向性支持。

paragraphs.en: Every faithfulness number elsewhere in this paper uses a single answer-generating model. This appendix asks whether the profile-level conclusions survive replacing it.

paragraphs.en: For each of the four profiles we reuse the documents that profile had already retrieved, so retrieval is untouched and no pipeline is re-run. We hold the answer prompt, the RAGAS judge, and the decoding temperature ( T = 0 T{=}0 ) fixed, and change only the model that writes the answer: GPT-5.1 (generator A, the generator used throughout the paper) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (generator B). The design is 43 43 questions × \times 4 4 profiles × \times 3 3 seeds per arm, giving 510 510 paired comparisons. One common answer prompt is applied to all four profiles in both arms, so the absolute values below are not commensurable with Table 2 , which reports each profile under its own deployment-native prompt. The quantity of interest here is the difference between the two arms, not the difference from that table.
paragraphs.zh: 对于四个画像中的每一个，我们复用该画像先前已检索到的文档，因此检索环节保持不变，任何流水线都无需重新运行。 我们固定答案提示词、RAGAS 评判器以及解码温度（ T = 0 T{=}0 ），只更换撰写答案的模型：GPT-5.1（生成器 A，即全文使用的生成器）和 Claude Sonnet 4.5（生成器 B）。 实验设计为 43 43 个问题 × \times 4 4 个画像 × \times 每个分组 3 3 个种子，共产生 510 510 组配对比较。 同一个答案提示词被应用于两个分组中的全部四个画像，因此下面的绝对数值与表 2 不可直接比较，因为表 2 报告的是各画像在其自身部署原生提示词下的结果。 此处关注的是两个分组之间的差异，而不是与该表的差异。

paragraphs.en: Every profile scores higher under generator B ( Table 57 ), so absolute faithfulness is generator-dependent. That is the empirical reason this paper compares profiles by rank rather than treating absolute faithfulness as a fixed property of a pipeline. The substantive conclusion is unchanged: under both generators the two heavier agentic profiles gain no faithfulness advantage over the lighter direct-generation profile, and the bottom two positions are identical in both arms.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 （profile） 在生成器 B 下的得分都更高（表 57），因此绝对忠实度依赖于生成器。 这正是本文按排名而非将绝对忠实度视为流水线固定属性来比较各 （profile） 的实证原因。 实质性结论不变：在两种生成器下，两个更重的智能体 （profile） 相较较轻的直接生成 （profile） 均无忠实度优势，且末两位的排位在两组中完全相同。

paragraphs.en: The fine-grained ordering is not invariant. standard and balanced exchange ranks between the arms, although they differ by only 0.007 0.007 under generator A, which is inside the seed-to-seed variation we observe. Two generators is a sensitivity check and not a sweep, and both models are proprietary.

paragraphs.en: The benefit of a stronger generator is markedly uneven. It is largest for the lightest pipeline ( + 0.184 +0.184 ) and smallest for the heaviest ( + 0.027 +0.027 , not significant). Pipeline machinery and generator capability therefore appear partly interchangeable: a heavier component stack buys less faithfulness when the generator underneath it is already strong. We treat this as a composition result rather than a robustness check, which is why it also appears in the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 更强生成器带来的收益明显不均衡。 在最轻的流水线上收益最大（+0.184），在最重的流水线上收益最小（+0.027，不显著）。 因此，流水线机制与生成器能力在一定程度上可以互相替代：当底层生成器已经很强时，更重的组件堆叠换来的忠实度提升会更少。 我们将其视为一项组合结果而非稳健性检验，这也是它同时出现在正文中的原因。

paragraphs.en: Several ablation-level findings warrant flagging, all traceable to specific rows in the tables above:

paragraphs.en: HyDE with 1 document beats HyDE with 3 or 5. hyde_1doc (0.5123 NDCG@10) leads the clean HyDE sweep, whereas multi-document HyDE degrades slightly ( hyde_5docs 0.495, hyde_3docs_maxsim 0.494). Multi-doc HyDE adds averaged noise that blunts dense similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 1 个文档的 HyDE 优于使用 3 个或 5 个文档的 HyDE。hyde_1doc（0.5123 NDCG@10）在干净的 HyDE 扫描中领先，而多文档 HyDE 略有下降（hyde_5docs 为 0.495，hyde_3docs_maxsim 为 0.494）。 多文档 HyDE 引入了平均化的噪声，削弱了稠密相似度。

paragraphs.en: SPLADE underperforms BM25 on our domain. bm25_baseline (0.460) outperforms all SPLADE variants ( ≤ 0.372 \leq 0.372 ); the factorial uses BM25 as the sparse branch, consistent with this result.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares the evaluation methodology reported in each cited study. “Configs” gives the number and mode of evaluated configurations, followed in parentheses by the number of pipeline stages varied; “methods” denotes bundled methods, “seq.” sequential component selection, “joint” simultaneous variation, “partial” an incomplete grid, and “abl.” targeted ablations. “Design” gives the search strategy: library, grid, greedy search, or D-optimal fractional factorial ( d-opt ); “tech.” denotes algorithmic techniques and “mix.” a mixture of techniques and hyperparameters. “ η 2 \eta^{2} ” indicates whether effect sizes are reported, and “Interactions” counts statistically estimated two-way effects. “Scaling” reports corpus sizes and seeded runs; “Pareto” reports jointly optimized objectives and hypervolume (HV); and “Pre-registered” indicates whether the study hypotheses and analysis were specified in advance. A checkmark, cross, and open circle denote yes, no, and partial coverage. “Benchmarks” gives the number evaluated; lasagna uses 8 of the 15 benchmarks supported by the framework.
paragraphs.zh: 表1比较了各引用研究报告的评估方法。“Configs”给出被评估配置的数量和方式，括号中为变化的流水线阶段数量；“methods”指捆绑的方法，“seq.”指顺序的组件选择，“joint”指同时变化，“partial”指不完整的网格，“abl.”指针对性的消融实验。“Design”给出搜索策略：库、网格、贪婪搜索或D-最优部分因子设计（d-opt）；“tech.”指算法技术，“mix.”指技术与超参数的混合。“η²”表示是否报告了效应量，“Interactions”统计经统计估计的双向效应。“Scaling”报告语料库规模和种子运行；“Pareto”报告联合优化的目标和超体积（HV）；“Pre-registered”表示研究假设和分析是否事先确定。 对勾、叉号和空心圆分别表示完全覆盖、无覆盖和部分覆盖。“Benchmarks”给出被评估的数量；lasagna使用了该框架支持的15个基准中的8个。

paragraphs.en: We compare five retrieval methods on the BEIR evaluation split (5,132 documents, 76 queries), holding the generation pipeline constant (standard, no agentic). Table 59 reports NDCG@10, the delta relative to the BM25 baseline, and the per-query latency overhead. All methods use the same hybrid fusion ( α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 where applicable) and identical top- k = 20 k{=}20 retrieval depth.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 BEIR 评估集（5,132 篇文档，76 个查询）上比较五种检索方法，同时保持生成流水线不变（标准模式，非智能体模式）。 表 59 报告了 NDCG@10、相对于 BM25 基线的增量，以及每个查询的延迟开销。 所有方法均使用相同的混合融合（在适用的情况下 α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5）以及相同的 top- k = 20 k{=}20 检索深度。

paragraphs.en: ColBERT achieves the highest NDCG@10 (0.4616), marginally outperforming the ms-marco-MiniLM-L6 cross-encoder reranker by + 0.005 +0.005 . However, ColBERT requires per-token index storage that scales linearly with corpus size, making it substantially more expensive to deploy at larger scales. The lighter cross-encoder reranker achieves comparable quality at lower indexing cost and is therefore used in our composed profiles.
paragraphs.zh: ColBERT 取得了最高的 NDCG@10（0.4616），以 +0.005 的微弱优势超越 ms-marco-MiniLM-L6 交叉编码器重排序器。 然而，ColBERT 需要按词元存储索引，其存储量随语料库规模线性增长，使其在更大规模部署时的成本显著更高。 更轻量的交叉编码器重排序器能以更低的索引成本达到相当的质量，因此被用于我们的组合配置中。

paragraphs.en: SPLADE underperforms BM25 by − 0.012 -0.012 NDCG@10 on our domain-focused corpus. We attribute this to the terminological consistency of BEIR domain subsets: SPLADE’s learned term expansion provides less benefit when the vocabulary gap between queries and documents is already small. This finding is specific to our corpus characteristics and may not hold on open-domain collections.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的领域聚焦语料库上，SPLADE 比 BM25 低 0.012 NDCG@10。 我们将此归因于 BEIR 领域子集的术语一致性：当查询与文档之间的词汇差距已经很小时，SPLADE 学习到的词项扩展带来的收益更少。 这一发现是针对我们语料库特性的，在开放域集合上可能并不成立。

paragraphs.en: The mxbai-rerank-large model performs slightly below ms-marco-MiniLM-L6 ( − 0.009 -0.009 ), despite its larger parameter count. We note that mxbai-rerank-large was trained on a broader data mixture, which may reduce its effectiveness on the academic and technical domains represented in our BEIR subset.
paragraphs.zh: mxbai-rerank-large 模型的表现略低于 ms-marco-MiniLM-L6（−0.009），尽管其参数量更大。 我们注意到，mxbai-rerank-large 是在更广泛的数据混合上训练的，这可能降低了它在我们 BEIR 子集所代表的学术和技术领域上的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Table 60 reports four reference configurations run on our private evaluation corpus (5,132 documents, 93 retrieval queries, 56 generation queries) under identical corpus, top- k = 20 k{=}20 , tokenizer, and embedding-backbone conditions to the SOTA profiles. Parity caveat. The NDCG@10 columns for the two baseline rows are computed on the 93-query retrieval-isolation split ( private_eval/retrieval , qrels from that split), whereas the two SOTA rows report end-to-end NDCG@10 on the 56-query generation split ( private_eval/e2e_generation , distinct qrels); the two splits differ in query count and gold-label set and are therefore not strictly commensurable in absolute NDCG. On the same retrieval-isolation split, sota_standard scores 0.510 0.510 ( Section J.2.2 ) vs. 0.436 0.436 for bge-m3 recommended , a + 0.074 +0.074 composition delta that decomposes into disabling MMR ( + 0.046 +0.046 ), adding 3-variant HyDE ( + 0.026 +0.026 ), hybrid α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 vs. 0.7 0.7 , and cross-encoder top- 10 10 vs. top- 5 5 . The larger apparent gap in the table (0.860 vs. 0.436) is therefore inflated by the split difference, not the retrieval stack; we retain both numbers for practitioner reference but note that only the retrieval-isolation comparison ( 0.510 0.510 vs. 0.436 0.436 ) is implementation-parity. These four rows represent common open-source RAG deployments a practitioner might use out of the box.

paragraphs.en: The related-work discussion ( Table 1 ) positions LASAGNA against two prominent RAG benchmarking libraries, BERGEN ( Rau et al., 2024 ) and FlashRAG ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , and argues that both lack the stage isolation that controlled interaction estimation requires ( Section H.1 ). In this appendix we report the operational follow-through of that positioning: an install-and-smoke pass against both frameworks on shared infrastructure, alongside a LASAGNA analog on the same corpus/retriever/LLM. We frame the result honestly: this is a positional smoke run , not a head-to-head benchmark comparison, because the only cross-framework corpus we could stand up in the time budget is topically mismatched to the queries it ships with.
paragraphs.zh: 相关工作讨论（表1）将 LASAGNA 与两个知名的 RAG 基准测试库进行对比，即 BERGEN（Rau et al., 2024）和 FlashRAG（Jin et al., 2025），并论证二者都缺乏受控交互估计所需的阶段隔离（第 H.1 节）。 在本附录中，我们报告了这一定位的实际落实情况：在共享基础设施上对这两个框架进行安装与冒烟测试，并在相同的语料库/检索器/大语言模型上运行一个 LASAGNA 对应实现。 我们诚实地表述这一结果：这是一次定位性冒烟测试，而非正面的基准对比，因为在时间预算内我们能够搭建的唯一跨框架语料库与其自带的查询在主题上并不匹配。

paragraphs.en: The FlashRAG default Standard-RAG prompt is stricter (“Answer the question based on the given document. Only give me the answer and do not output any other words.”); the LLM correctly refuses on 11 / 17 11/17 queries because the AI-topic corpus does not contain trivia answers. LASAGNA’s concise-regen prompt is softer, and the LLM leaks parametric knowledge (e.g., predicts the first Nobel physics laureate without corpus grounding), so the EM lift is prompt-strictness against a corpus mismatch, not a RAG-quality difference. Refusal rate ( 64.7 % 64.7\% vs. 0 % 0\% ) is the only reliable signal here and simply reflects the prompt-template difference. A true head-to-head on a matched benchmark (e.g., wrapping BEIR NFCorpus behind each framework, or ingesting KILT-100w into LASAGNA) is outside the scope of this study. Accordingly, this comparison does not report matched NDCG@10, BGE-M3, or cross-framework RAGAS results and should be read only as positional smoke evidence.

paragraphs.en: BERGEN and FlashRAG expose composition but not stage isolation ( Tables 1 and H.1 ); a like-for-like factorial inside either framework would require adding the same session-config-isolated boundary that LASAGNA verifies in Table 63 and would not be a fair test of the shipped framework as released. paragraphs.en: The most critical test is session config isolation : we created two sessions with opposite HyDE settings ( enable_hyde=True vs. False ), then verified that querying the session provider returns the correct config for each session independently. In a naive pipeline without session-level isolation, toggling HyDE for one experimental configuration could leak into the next, introducing a confound that invalidates the factorial comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 最关键的测试是会话配置隔离：我们创建了两个 HyDE 设置相反的会话（一个 enable_hyde=True，另一个 enable_hyde=False），然后验证查询会话提供方时，每个会话都能独立返回正确的配置。 在一个没有会话级隔离的简单流水线中，为某个实验配置切换 HyDE 可能会泄漏到下一个配置中，引入使因子比较失效的混淆因素。

sents.en: In a naive pipeline without session-level isolation, toggling HyDE for one experimental configuration could leak into the next, introducing a confound that invalidates the factorial comparison.

paragraphs.en: The embedding dimension detection test was additionally verified during the scaling experiments, where the Speed profile (MiniLM-L6, 384-dim) correctly raised EMBEDDING DIMENSION MISMATCH DETECTED when attempting to share a collection with BGE-M3 (1024-dim) profiles, forcing separate ingestion, a confound that would otherwise silently corrupt retrieval results.
paragraphs.zh: 在扩展实验中还额外验证了嵌入维度检测测试，其中 Speed 配置文件（MiniLM-L6，384 维）在尝试与 BGE-M3（1024 维）配置文件共享集合时，正确触发了 EMBEDDING DIMENSION MISMATCH DETECTED，强制进行独立的摄取，否则这种干扰因素会悄悄污染检索结果。

paragraphs.en: This appendix demonstrates lasagna ’s practical usability through code examples drawn directly from the released codebase. We highlight five capabilities that distinguish the platform from existing RAG toolkits: (i) a configuration UI for interactive exploration, (ii) a layered plugin architecture with decorator-based registration, (iii) bring-your-own vector database support, (iv) bring-your-own agentic pipeline, and (v) agent integration via MCP. All examples are executable as shipped.

paragraphs.en: lasagna ships three browser-based interfaces. The centerpiece is the RAG Configurator ( Figs. 12 and 13 ), a profile-centric pipeline builder that lets a practitioner assemble a working configuration without writing code or YAML. The left-hand rail lists the four built-in profiles ( default , speed , standard , balanced , max-reliable ) alongside user-saved custom profiles, and the main panel groups every configuration key exposed by the SDK into four tabs, Essential, Search & Retrieval, Processing, and Advanced, each labeled with plain-language explanations of what the setting does, its cost implications, and the underlying YAML key (e.g. enable_hybrid_search , enable_reranking , use_agentic_rag ). Every change is import/export-round-trippable with the YAML contract used by the evaluation SDK ( Section H.2.5 ), so a user can prototype a profile in the UI, export it, and run the full factorial sweep on it with no translation. The Configurator is what gives researchers and practitioners who are not fluent in the 127-key configuration surface a direct path to reproducing the operational profiles in Section 5 and to iterating on them.
paragraphs.zh: lasagna 提供三个基于浏览器的界面。 核心是 RAG 配置器（图 12 和图 13），这是一个以配置为中心的流水线构建器，让从业者无需编写代码或 YAML 即可组装出可用的配置。 左侧栏列出四个内置配置（default、speed、standard、balanced、max-reliable）以及用户保存的自定义配置，主面板将 SDK 暴露的每个配置键归入四个标签页：Essential、Search & Retrieval、Processing 和 Advanced，每个设置都配有通俗语言的说明，解释其作用、成本影响以及对应的 YAML 键（例如 enable_hybrid_search、enable_reranking、use_agentic_rag）。 每次修改都可以与评估 SDK 使用的 YAML 契约（第 H.2.5 节）进行导入/导出往返转换，因此用户可以在界面中原型化一个配置，导出后直接对其运行完整的因子扫描，无需任何转换。 配置器为那些不熟悉这 127 个配置键面的研究者和从业者提供了一条直接路径，既能复现第 5 节中的运维配置，也能在其基础上进行迭代。

paragraphs.en: The other two interfaces are complementary but are not part of the public release. The Agentic Chat workspace provides a conversational front-end with inline document management and citation rendering; it consumes a Configurator-produced profile and lets changes take effect on the next query without restarting the server. The RAG Dashboard is evaluation-oriented, with six pages (Overview, Explorer, Impact, Pareto, Benchmark, Timeline) that visualize per-query evaluation scores. Together, the three interfaces let a researcher configure a pipeline, run it conversationally, and inspect its evaluation results without writing code.
paragraphs.zh: 另外两个接口是互补的，但不属于公开发布的一部分。 Agentic Chat 工作区提供了一个带内联文档管理和引用渲染的对话式前端；它消费 Configurator 生成的配置文件，并让更改在下一次查询时生效，而无需重启服务器。 RAG Dashboard 面向评估，包含六个页面（Overview、Explorer、Impact、Pareto、Benchmark、Timeline），用于可视化每次查询的评估分数。 这三个接口结合在一起，让研究人员无需编写代码即可配置流水线、以对话方式运行它并查看其评估结果。

paragraphs.en: This profile requires only a vector database and a generation endpoint; no reranker model, no HyDE LLM calls, and no agentic orchestration. It can serve as the warm-start default while heavier profiles are evaluated. We recommend against using this profile when retrieval quality (NDCG@10 > > 0.7) or faithfulness ( > > 0.6) are firm requirements, as both metrics are substantially lower than the other SOTA profiles ( Table 2 ).

paragraphs.en: General-purpose retrieval where precision is the primary concern: enterprise knowledge bases, technical documentation search, and customer support systems with moderate response times (4–7 s). HyDE generates three hypothetical documents per query, which are searched in parallel before cross-encoder reranking selects the top 10 passages.
paragraphs.zh: 以精度为主要考量指标的通用检索：企业知识库、技术文档搜索以及对响应时间要求适中（4–7 秒）的客户支持系统。 HyDE 为每个查询生成三个假设性文档，这些文档会被并行检索，然后由交叉编码器重排序选出前 10 个段落。

sents.en: General-purpose retrieval where precision is the primary concern: enterprise knowledge bases, technical documentation search, and customer support systems with moderate response times (4–7 s).

paragraphs.en: Requires a vector database with hybrid (dense + BM25) search support, a reranker model endpoint (or local GPU for mxbai-rerank-large), and one LLM call for HyDE generation. The three HyDE variants add ∼ {\sim} 2 s of latency; operators who need to stay below 3 s can reduce hyde_n_variants to 1 with a modest NDCG@10 reduction ( ∼ {\sim} 0.01–0.02 based on our ablation in Section 5 ). This profile achieves the highest NDCG@10 (0.860) on the SOTA-profile generation slice, follows the direct generation route (query routing disabled), and enables both the hallucination and answer-quality gates at the pipeline level. Pair it with application-level guardrails if a per-query faithfulness floor above 0.8 0.8 is required.

paragraphs.en: Recommended default for deployments that can tolerate ∼ {\sim} 12–18 s per-query latency and require the top-band faithfulness (batch/analyst workloads, review queues, back-office QA). Extractive context compression reduces the token count passed to the generator by 50 % 50\% , lowering generation cost while preserving the most relevant spans. Document-awareness prefixes (first 100 100 tokens) provide the generator with document-level context at negligible additional cost. On the SOTA-profile generation slice reported in Table 2 , balanced provides the stronger joint agentic tradeoff than max-reliable (higher NDCG@10, essentially tied faithfulness, 13 % 13\% lower mean latency) and takes the joint retrieval–faithfulness–latency hypervolume from standard once L ref L_{\mathrm{ref}} opens past ∼ 46 {\sim}46 s ( HV = 0.609 \mathrm{HV}{=}0.609 vs 0.579 0.579 at 60 60 s; Table 39 ). At the fixed 30 30 s reference, standard has the highest joint HV; balanced is the appropriate choice when the application can absorb the additional ∼ 7 {\sim}7 s of response time for the faithfulness advantage.
paragraphs.zh: 推荐作为可容忍每次查询约 12–18 秒延迟并要求最高档忠实度的部署场景的默认配置（批量/分析类工作负载、审阅队列、后台质量保障）。 抽取式上下文压缩将传给生成器的 token 数量减少 50%，在保留最相关片段的同时降低生成成本。 文档感知前缀（前 100 个 token）以可忽略的额外开销为生成器提供文档级上下文。 在表 2 报告的 SOTA 配置生成切片上，与 max-reliable 相比，balanced 提供了更强的联合智能体权衡（更高的 NDCG@10、基本持平的忠实度、平均延迟低 13%），并且一旦 L_ref 超过约 46 秒，便在检索–忠实度–延迟的联合超体积上超越 standard（在 60 秒时 HV=0.609 对 0.579；见表 39）。 在固定的 30 秒参考延迟下，standard 具有最高的联合 HV；当应用能够为忠实度优势承受额外约 7 秒的响应时间时，balanced 是合适的选择。

paragraphs.en: Infrastructure adds the agentic graph execution ( LangGraph ) to the sota_standard stack: 3 3 – 7 7 additional LLM calls per query for relevance classification, hallucination checking, and quality gating, plus an extractive compression step that runs locally (no additional LLM call). Disabling MMR removes one source of latency variability without harming retrieval quality in our experiments. End-to-end mean latency on the SOTA slice is ∼ {\sim} 12.3 s (p95 ∼ {\sim} 26.3 s), dominated by the agentic loop and HyDE generation. To reduce latency, operators can disable HyDE (saving ∼ {\sim} 2–3 s) at the cost of ∼ {\sim} 0.02 NDCG@10.
paragraphs.zh: 基础设施在 sota_standard 技术栈中增加了智能体图执行（LangGraph）：每次查询额外产生 3 3 – 7 7 次 LLM 调用，用于相关性分类、幻觉检查和质量把关，外加一个在本地运行的抽取式压缩步骤（不产生额外的 LLM 调用）。 在我们的实验中，禁用 MMR 消除了一个延迟波动的来源，且不损害检索质量。 SOTA 切片上的端到端平均延迟约为 ∼ {\sim} 12.3 秒（p95 约为 ∼ {\sim} 26.3 秒），主要由智能体循环和 HyDE 生成所占据。 为了降低延迟，运维人员可以禁用 HyDE（节省约 ∼ {\sim} 2–3 秒），代价是损失约 ∼ {\sim} 0.02 的 NDCG@10。

paragraphs.en: High-stakes domains where answer faithfulness must be maximized and users tolerate longer response times: medical literature review, legal contract analysis, financial due diligence, and compliance question-answering. The agentic pipeline performs up to three retrieval iterations with hallucination gating; each iteration can refine or discard unfaithful passages before the final answer is generated.
paragraphs.zh: 需要最大化答案忠实度且用户能容忍较长响应时间的高风险领域：医学文献综述、法律合同分析、财务尽职调查以及合规问答。 该智能体流水线最多执行三轮检索迭代并进行幻觉门控；在生成最终答案之前，每一轮迭代都可以修正或丢弃不忠实的段落。

sents.en: High-stakes domains where answer faithfulness must be maximized and users tolerate longer response times: medical literature review, legal contract analysis, financial due diligence, and compliance question-answering.
sents.zh: 需要最大化答案忠实度且用户能容忍较长响应时间的高风险领域：医学文献综述、法律合同分析、财务尽职调查以及合规问答。

sents.en: The agentic pipeline performs up to three retrieval iterations with hallucination gating; each iteration can refine or discard unfaithful passages before the final answer is generated.
sents.zh: 该智能体流水线最多执行三轮检索迭代并进行幻觉门控；在生成最终答案之前，每一轮迭代都可以修正或丢弃不忠实的段落。

paragraphs.en: Infrastructure matches sota_balanced_e2e (agentic graph execution, hybrid retrieval, reranker, HyDE) with additional contextual retrieval and a broader chunk-cite budget (up to 30 30 retained chunks vs. 20 20 ). Both profiles share the same agentic depth (three iterations, hallucination and answer-quality gates enabled); the differences from sota_balanced_e2e are retrieval-side (hybrid α = 0.3 \alpha=0.3 vs. 0.7 0.7 , contextual retrieval enabled, wider chunk budget). Mean latency on the SOTA-profile generation slice is ∼ {\sim} 14.2 s (p95 ∼ {\sim} 30.0 s), driven by the wider chunk pool and the agentic loop; we recommend a concurrency limit of ∼ {\sim} 10 queries per instance. Notably, this profile has a weaker joint tradeoff than sota_balanced_e2e within the agentic-route class on our headline slice ( Table 2 ): faithfulness is essentially tied ( 0.916 0.916 vs 0.911 0.911 ), NDCG@10 is 0.036 0.036 lower, and mean latency is ∼ 2 \sim{}2 s higher (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.018 p{=}0.018 ). We include it for completeness and for deployments that require the broader retrieval envelope (contextual retrieval, wider chunk budget) it provides.
paragraphs.zh: 基础设施与 sota_balanced_e2e 一致（智能体图执行、混合检索、重排序器、HyDE），并额外增加了上下文检索和更大的分块引用预算（最多保留 30 个分块，而前者为 20 个）。 两种配置共享相同的智能体深度（三次迭代，启用幻觉门控和答案质量门控）；与 sota_balanced_e2e 的差异都在检索侧（混合权重 α=0.3 而非 0.7，启用上下文检索，更宽的分块预算）。 SOTA 配置生成切片上的平均延迟约为 14.2 秒（p95 约为 30.0 秒），这是由更宽的分块池和智能体循环所导致的；我们建议每个实例的并发上限约为 10 个查询。 值得注意的是，在我们的核心切片上（表 2），该配置在智能体路由类别中的联合权衡弱于 sota_balanced_e2e：忠实度基本持平（0.916 对 0.911），NDCG@10 低 0.036，平均延迟高约 2 秒（配对 Wilcoxon 检验 p=0.018）。 我们将其纳入其中是出于完整性考虑，并面向那些需要其所提供的更宽检索范围（上下文检索、更宽的分块预算）的部署场景。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides a practitioner-oriented decision framework for selecting among the four SOTA profiles based on deployment constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了一个面向从业者的决策框架，用于根据部署约束在四种 SOTA 档案之间进行选择。

paragraphs.en: The flowchart in Fig. 15 encodes three decision criteria derived from our experimental findings:
paragraphs.zh: 图 15 中的流程图编码了源自我们实验发现的三个决策准则：

paragraphs.en: Response-time target determines the first branch. speed ( < < 1 s) uses MiniLM-L6 embeddings with dense-only retrieval and no query-time LLM calls; it is the only viable choice under a hard sub-second target and trades away the joint quality-latency tradeoff.
paragraphs.zh: 响应时间目标决定了第一分支。speed（< < 1 秒）使用 MiniLM-L6 嵌入、仅稠密检索且不进行查询时的 LLM 调用；它是在硬性亚秒级目标下唯一可行的选择，并牺牲了联合质量-延迟权衡。

paragraphs.en: Execution route + joint envelope separates the mid-to-high latency profiles. On the SOTA-profile generation slice ( Table 2 ), standard attains the highest joint retrieval–faithfulness–latency hypervolume at the fixed 30 30 s response-time reference ( HV = 0.523 \mathrm{HV}{=}0.523 ; NDCG@10 0.860 0.860 , faithfulness 0.739 0.739 , mean latency 5.3 5.3 s) and is the recommended default when interactive latency is required. balanced runs the agentic route (three iterations, hallucination and answer-quality gates enabled) at NDCG@10 0.840 0.840 , faithfulness 0.911 0.911 , mean latency 12.3 12.3 s; it provides a stronger joint tradeoff than max-reliable within the agentic-route class and takes the joint HV from standard once L ref L_{\mathrm{ref}} opens past ∼ 46 {\sim}46 s ( Table 39 ); it is the recommended default when longer response times are acceptable and the faithfulness gain is important. max-reliable shares the same agentic route as balanced with a broader retrieval envelope (contextual retrieval, wider chunk budget); it has a lower joint score than balanced .
paragraphs.zh: 执行路径加联合包络线区分了中高延迟配置。 在SOTA配置生成切片上（表2），standard在固定的30秒响应时间参考点（\mathrm{HV}{=}0.523；NDCG@10 0.860，忠实度 0.739，平均延迟 5.3 秒）取得了最高的检索–忠实度–延迟联合超体积，是要求交互式延迟时的推荐默认配置。balanced运行智能体路径（三次迭代，启用幻觉与答案质量门控），NDCG@10 0.840，忠实度 0.911，平均延迟 12.3 秒；在智能体路径类别内，它提供了比 max-reliable 更强的联合权衡，并且一旦 L_{\mathrm{ref}} 打开超过约46秒（表39），其联合超体积就超过 standard；当可接受更长的响应时间且忠实度提升很重要时，它是推荐的默认配置。max-reliable 与 balanced 共享相同的智能体路径，但具有更宽的检索包络（上下文检索、更大的块预算）；其联合得分低于 balanced。

sents.en: Execution route + joint envelope separates the mid-to-high latency profiles.
sents.zh: 执行路径加联合包络线区分了中高延迟配置。

sents.en: On the SOTA-profile generation slice ( Table 2 ), standard attains the highest joint retrieval–faithfulness–latency hypervolume at the fixed 30 30 s response-time reference ( HV = 0.523 \mathrm{HV}{=}0.523 ; NDCG@10 0.860 0.860 , faithfulness 0.739 0.739 , mean latency 5.3 5.3 s) and is the recommended default when interactive latency is required. balanced runs the agentic route (three iterations, hallucination and answer-quality gates enabled) at NDCG@10 0.840 0.840 , faithfulness 0.911 0.911 , mean latency 12.3 12.3 s; it provides a stronger joint tradeoff than max-reliable within the agentic-route class and takes the joint HV from standard once L ref L_{\mathrm{ref}} opens past ∼ 46 {\sim}46 s ( Table 39 ); it is the recommended default when longer response times are acceptable and the faithfulness gain is important. max-reliable shares the same agentic route as balanced with a broader retrieval envelope (contextual retrieval, wider chunk budget); it has a lower joint score than balanced .
sents.zh: 在SOTA配置生成切片上（表2），standard在固定的30秒响应时间参考点（\mathrm{HV}{=}0.523；NDCG@10 0.860，忠实度 0.739，平均延迟 5.3 秒）取得了最高的检索–忠实度–延迟联合超体积，是要求交互式延迟时的推荐默认配置。balanced运行智能体路径（三次迭代，启用幻觉与答案质量门控），NDCG@10 0.840，忠实度 0.911，平均延迟 12.3 秒；在智能体路径类别内，它提供了比 max-reliable 更强的联合权衡，并且一旦 L_{\mathrm{ref}} 打开超过约46秒（表39），其联合超体积就超过 standard；当可接受更长的响应时间且忠实度提升很重要时，它是推荐的默认配置。max-reliable 与 balanced 共享相同的智能体路径，但具有更宽的检索包络（上下文检索、更大的块预算）；其联合得分低于 balanced。

paragraphs.en: Within the agentic-route class, prefer balanced . balanced has 4.5 % 4.5\% higher NDCG@10 and 13 % 13\% lower mean response time than max-reliable , with a 0.005 0.005 faithfulness difference ( Tables 2 and D.8 ); max-reliable ’s broader retrieval envelope (contextual retrieval, wider chunk budget) is worth its additional cost only when a deployment specifically requires that envelope. Corpus size does not shift this ordering on the range we tested.

paragraphs.en: This flowchart is derived from experiments on five BEIR domains and may not generalize to all deployment scenarios. In particular: (i) the MMR finding (“disable MMR”) may not hold for corpora with genuinely redundant documents; (ii) the corpus-size threshold of 25K is approximate and domain-dependent; (iii) absolute latency values depend on infrastructure and will differ from our measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 本流程图源自五个 BEIR 领域上的实验，可能无法推广到所有部署场景。 具体而言：(i) 关于 MMR 的结论（「禁用 MMR」）对于确实存在冗余文档的语料库可能不成立；(ii) 25K 的语料库规模阈值是近似的，且依赖于具体领域；(iii) 绝对延迟值取决于基础设施，会与我们的测量结果有所不同。
