paragraphs.en: Several configuration comparisons in this paper differ in rank order depending on whether the reader uses the OFAT (pooled) reading or the hierarchical mixed-effects (query-clustered) reading. When the two disagree by ≥ 1 {\geq}1 rank position, defer to the hierarchical reading. It respects the query-clustering structure ( ICC = 0.284 \text{ICC}{=}0.284 on the H1 D5 × \times D8 grid; see Section D.3 ) and is our primary inferential position throughout the paper. The archetypal case is the H1 D5 × \times D8 attenuation: the OFAT estimate is η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}{=}0.201 ( p = 0.018 p{=}0.018 Holm) whereas the hierarchical LRT is χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 4.27 \chi^{2}(4){=}4.27 , p = 0.371 p{=}0.371 . The same pair reads as a large exploratory interaction under OFAT and as non-significant under hierarchical inference. The only exception is when a deployment’s per-query variance is orthogonal to query-topic clustering (rare in practice for benchmark corpora but possible in enterprise deployments with strictly independent queries); in that regime the pooled OFAT reading is closer to the deployment target. A separate, orthogonal protocol-dependence axis (point-wise RAGAS-judge vs. pairwise Bradley–Terry) affects within-tier configuration comparisons; see Section C.5 for the tier-vs-configuration scoping.
paragraphs.zh: 本文中的若干配置比较会因读者采用 OFAT（合并）读法还是层次混合效应（按查询聚类）读法而呈现不同的排名顺序。 当两种读法在排名位置上相差 ≥ 1 {\geq}1 位时，应以层次读法为准。 层次读法尊重查询聚类结构（在 H1 D5 × \times D8 网格上 ICC = 0.284 \text{ICC}{=}0.284；见 D.3 节），并且是全文的主要推断立场。 典型案例是 H1 D5 × \times D8 的衰减：OFAT 估计为 η 2 = 0.201 \eta^{2}{=}0.201（p = 0.018 p{=}0.018，Holm 校正），而层次 LRT 为 χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 4.27 \chi^{2}(4){=}4.27，p = 0.371 p{=}0.371。 同一对比较在 OFAT 下表现为较大的探索性交互效应，而在层次推断下则不显著。 唯一的例外是当部署的逐查询方差与查询主题聚类正交时（这在基准语料库中实践中罕见，但在查询严格独立的企业部署中可能出现）；在该情形下，合并的 OFAT 读法更接近部署目标。 另一个独立的正交轴——协议依赖性（逐点 RAGAS 评审 vs. 成对 Bradley–Terry）会影响同层级内部的配置比较；关于层级与配置的界定范围见 C.5 节。

paragraphs.en: During development and evaluation of the lasagna pipeline, we collected faithfulness scores (RAGAS, LLM-judged by GPT-5.1) across six pipeline profiles. Table 65 summarizes the observed faithfulness distributions. We present these data descriptively and make no causal claims about which pipeline components drive the observed differences.
paragraphs.zh: 在 lasagna 流水线的开发与评估过程中，我们在六种流水线配置上收集了忠实度得分（RAGAS，由 GPT-5.1 进行 LLM 评审）。 表 65 总结了所观察到的忠实度分布。 我们仅以描述性方式呈现这些数据，不对哪些流水线组件驱动了所观察到的差异做出因果性论断。

sents.en: Table 65 summarizes the observed faithfulness distributions.

paragraphs.en: All six profiles achieved mean faithfulness above 0.96, indicating that the generation pipeline (GPT-5.1 with retrieved context) produces grounded answers across configurations. The speed profile and SOTA max reliable profile exhibited the highest median faithfulness (1.000), suggesting that both concise answer prompting (speed) and quality-gate filtering (SOTA max reliable) are associated with reduced hallucination, though through different mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 全部六种配置的平均忠实度均高于0.96，表明该生成流程（GPT-5.1结合检索上下文）在各种配置下都能产出有依据的回答。 速度配置与SOTA最高可靠配置展现出最高的中位忠实度（1.000），这表明简洁回答提示（速度）与质量门控过滤（SOTA最高可靠）都与降低幻觉相关，尽管其作用机制不同。

paragraphs.en: The lowest observed per-query faithfulness score (0.667) occurred in the max quality profile, which uses agentic retrieval with aggressive refinement. As discussed in Section 5 , aggressive chunk filtering can leave the generation model with minimal context, increasing the risk of unsupported claims on complex queries.
paragraphs.zh: 观察到的最低单次查询忠实度得分（0.667）出现在最大质量配置中，该配置使用带有激进精炼的智能体检索。 如第 5 节所述，激进的分块过滤可能使生成模型只剩下极少上下文，从而增加在复杂查询上出现无依据论断的风险。

paragraphs.en: We emphasize that these observations reflect correlational patterns in historical logs. Controlled experiments isolating individual components’ contributions to hallucination resistance would require a dedicated factorial design that was outside the scope of this study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们强调，这些观察结果反映的是历史日志中的相关性模式。 若要通过对照实验来分离各组件对抗幻觉能力的单独贡献，需要一个专门的因子设计，这超出了本研究的范围。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides a mechanistic root cause analysis (RCA) for the performance of each SOTA profile, grounding observed successes and failures in architectural decisions, measured interaction effects, and ablation evidence. Table 66 provides a quick-reference guide; the remainder of the appendix presents the supporting analysis, following the taxonomy in Section J.1 with evidence from the 167-configuration factorial campaign, the feature dropout analysis ( Section D.12 ), and the single-feature ablations ( Section D.1 ).

paragraphs.en: We organize root causes into a two-level taxonomy. The first level distinguishes where in the pipeline the cause originates; the second level identifies the mechanism by which performance is affected. Table 67 summarizes the taxonomy with representative examples from our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将根本原因整理为一个两级分类体系。 第一级区分该原因产生于流程中的哪个环节；第二级识别影响性能的具体机制。 表 67 结合我们实验中的代表性示例对该分类体系进行了总结。

sents.en: Table 67 summarizes the taxonomy with representative examples from our experiments.
sents.zh: 表 67 结合我们实验中的代表性示例对该分类体系进行了总结。

paragraphs.en: Pipeline stage Mechanism Effect Description Evidence Retrieval-side mechanisms Reranking R1 : Reranker model selection Failure Default reranker (mxbai-rerank-large-v1, hereafter mxbai-large) underperforms smaller specialist (ms-marco-MiniLM-L6) by − 0.026 -0.026 NDCG@10 on the shared 93-query retrieval benchmark ( Table 51 , Exp. 15); composed end-to-end delta is − 0.009 -0.009 ( Table 59 ). Exp. 15 Post-retrieval R2 : Diversity–relevance conflict Failure MMR penalizes semantically similar but independently relevant passages in domain-focused corpora, reducing NDCG@10 by 0.019–0.046 depending on profile. Section D.12 Query-time R3 : Noisy query expansion † Failure LLM-generated query variants introduce off-topic terms; negative transfer outweighs coverage gain ( Δ \Delta NDCG = − 0.014 =-0.014 ). Exp. 05, Section D.1 Query-time R4 : HyDE calibration † Mixed Hypothetical documents improve passage recall in some profiles ( − 0.031 -0.031 dropout in Max-Reliable) but marginally degrade it in others ( + 0.008 +0.008 dropout in balanced); the effect depends on the surrounding feature context. Section D.12 Retrieval R5 : Hybrid alpha sensitivity Success BM25 provides lexical recall for entity-centric queries; optimal α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 balances lexical and semantic evidence. Exp. 01 Index-time R6 : Enrichment overhead Failure Contextual retrieval, RAPTOR, and GraphRAG add noise or indexing cost without retrieval gain on domain-focused corpora ( η enrichment 2 = 0.144 \eta^{2}_{\text{enrichment}}=0.144 ; best level: none ). ANOVA, Section 5 Generation-side mechanisms Agentic G1 : Aggressive refinement paradox Mixed Quality gates discard 13–14/15 chunks as not relevant, raising faithfulness but starving the generator of evidence. Exp. 07, Section 5 Compression G2 : Extractive compression benefit Success 50% token reduction removes filler without losing key spans, reducing hallucination surface ( Δ \Delta faith. = + 0.01 =+0.01 ). Section D.1 Document awareness G3 : Prefix grounding Success 100-token document prefix gives the generator file-level context at negligible cost; diminishing returns beyond 100 tokens. Exp. 17 Query augmentation G4 : Augmentation–gating synergy Success Query augmentation provides richer retrieval input; agentic gating filters low-quality results. Combined: η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 on faithfulness (near H1 threshold).

paragraphs.en: This taxonomy draws on established frameworks for pipeline failure analysis. The distinction between retrieval-side and generation-side failures follows the “retrieve-then-read” decomposition standard in RAG evaluation ( Gao et al., 2023b ) . The concept of functional duplication (C1) mirrors the known subadditivity of stacked retrieval components documented in RAG best-practice surveys ( Li et al., 2025 ) . The diversity–relevance conflict (R2) instantiates the broader tension between exploration and exploitation in information retrieval ( Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 该分类体系借鉴了已有的流水线故障分析框架。 检索侧故障与生成侧故障的区分遵循 RAG 评估中的「先检索后阅读」分解标准（Gao et al., 2023b）。 功能性重复（C1）的概念呼应了 RAG 最佳实践综述中记录的叠加检索组件的次可加性问题（Li et al., 2025）。 多样性—相关性冲突（R2）具体体现了信息检索中探索与利用之间更广泛的张力（Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998）。

paragraphs.en: Pipeline simplicity as implicit noise filter. With only 10 dense-retrieved chunks and no post-processing, the generator receives a clean, unmodified context window. The absence of MMR (R2), reranking reordering, and compression means the generator sees passages in their original embedding-similarity order, which empirically correlates with higher faithfulness ( Table 46 : speed achieves 0.991 on scifact). This aligns with findings that simpler retrieval pipelines produce fewer hallucinations because the generator has less opportunity to be confused by reordered or deduplicated context ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Note that the speed profile does not use document awareness (G3), its faithfulness advantage is entirely attributable to pipeline simplicity, not to generation-side features.
paragraphs.zh: 流水线简洁性作为隐式噪声过滤器。 仅使用10个密集检索的文本块且无后处理，生成器接收到一个干净、未经修改的上下文窗口。 由于缺少MMR（R2）、重排序以及压缩，生成器按原始的嵌入相似度顺序查看文本段落，这经经验证明与更高的忠实度相关（表46：speed在scifact上达到0.991）。 这与一些研究结果一致，即更简单的检索流水线产生更少的幻觉，因为生成器因重排序或去重后的上下文而感到困惑的机会更少（Liu et al., 2024）。 注意，speed配置并未使用文档感知（G3），其忠实度优势完全归因于流水线的简洁性，而非生成侧的特性。

sents.en: Pipeline simplicity as implicit noise filter.
sents.zh: 流水线简洁性作为隐式噪声过滤器。

sents.en: With only 10 dense-retrieved chunks and no post-processing, the generator receives a clean, unmodified context window.

sents.en: The absence of MMR (R2), reranking reordering, and compression means the generator sees passages in their original embedding-similarity order, which empirically correlates with higher faithfulness ( Table 46 : speed achieves 0.991 on scifact).

sents.en: This aligns with findings that simpler retrieval pipelines produce fewer hallucinations because the generator has less opportunity to be confused by reordered or deduplicated context ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .

sents.en: Note that the speed profile does not use document awareness (G3), its faithfulness advantage is entirely attributable to pipeline simplicity, not to generation-side features.

paragraphs.en: Concise generation prompting. The speed profile uses a concise answer prompt (“Answer in ONE sentence based only on the context”), which limits the number of atomic claims per answer. Fewer claims mean fewer opportunities for unsupported statements, mechanically improving RAGAS faithfulness ( Es et al., 2024 ) . This is a measurement artifact as much as a genuine quality improvement: a one-sentence answer with one correct claim scores higher than a three-sentence answer with two correct claims and one hallucinated claim.
paragraphs.zh: 简洁生成提示。 速度评估配置使用了简洁回答提示（“仅基于上下文用一句话回答”），这限制了每个回答中原子论断的数量。 论断越少，出现无依据陈述的机会就越少，从而机械地提高了 RAGAS 忠实度（Es et al., 2024）。 这既是一种测量上的假象，也是一种真实的质量提升：一个包含一条正确论断的单句回答，其得分会高于一个包含两条正确论断和一条幻觉论断的三句回答。

sents.en: Concise generation prompting.
sents.zh: 简洁生成提示。

sents.en: The speed profile uses a concise answer prompt (“Answer in ONE sentence based only on the context”), which limits the number of atomic claims per answer.
sents.zh: 速度评估配置使用了简洁回答提示（“仅基于上下文用一句话回答”），这限制了每个回答中原子论断的数量。

sents.en: Fewer claims mean fewer opportunities for unsupported statements, mechanically improving RAGAS faithfulness ( Es et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 论断越少，出现无依据陈述的机会就越少，从而机械地提高了 RAGAS 忠实度（Es et al., 2024）。

sents.en: This is a measurement artifact as much as a genuine quality improvement: a one-sentence answer with one correct claim scores higher than a three-sentence answer with two correct claims and one hallucinated claim.
sents.zh: 这既是一种测量上的假象，也是一种真实的质量提升：一个包含一条正确论断的单句回答，其得分会高于一个包含两条正确论断和一条幻觉论断的三句回答。

paragraphs.en: Embedding capacity ceiling. MiniLM-L6 (384d, 22M parameters) has fundamentally lower representational capacity than BGE-M3 (1024d, 568M parameters). The factorial ANOVA confirms embedding choice as the strongest main effect on NDCG@10 ( η 2 = 0.164 \eta^{2}=0.164 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Section 5 ). On nfcorpus (biomedical), the capacity gap manifests as − 0.050 -0.050 NDCG@10 versus SOTA balanced ( Table 45 ).
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入容量上限。 MiniLM-L6（384 维，2200 万参数）的表征容量在本质上低于 BGE-M3（1024 维，5.68 亿参数）。 析因方差分析证实，嵌入选择是对 NDCG@10 影响最强的主要效应（ η 2 = 0.164 \eta^{2}=0.164 ， p < 0.001 p<0.001 ；见第 5 节）。 在 nfcorpus（生物医学）上，这一容量差距表现为相比 SOTA 平衡方案低 − 0.050 -0.050 的 NDCG@10（见表 45）。

sents.en: Embedding capacity ceiling.
sents.zh: 嵌入容量上限。

sents.en: MiniLM-L6 (384d, 22M parameters) has fundamentally lower representational capacity than BGE-M3 (1024d, 568M parameters).
sents.zh: MiniLM-L6（384 维，2200 万参数）的表征容量在本质上低于 BGE-M3（1024 维，5.68 亿参数）。

sents.en: The factorial ANOVA confirms embedding choice as the strongest main effect on NDCG@10 ( η 2 = 0.164 \eta^{2}=0.164 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 析因方差分析证实，嵌入选择是对 NDCG@10 影响最强的主要效应（ η 2 = 0.164 \eta^{2}=0.164 ， p < 0.001 p<0.001 ；见第 5 节）。

sents.en: On nfcorpus (biomedical), the capacity gap manifests as − 0.050 -0.050 NDCG@10 versus SOTA balanced ( Table 45 ).
sents.zh: 在 nfcorpus（生物医学）上，这一容量差距表现为相比 SOTA 平衡方案低 − 0.050 -0.050 的 NDCG@10（见表 45）。

paragraphs.en: No lexical fallback (R5 absent). Dense-only retrieval ( α = 1.0 \alpha{=}1.0 ) has no BM25 component to capture exact entity matches. The hybrid ablation (Exp. 01) shows that adding BM25 at α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 yields + 0.037 +0.037 NDCG@10, a gain entirely unavailable to this profile.
paragraphs.zh: 无词汇回退（缺少 R5）。 纯稠密检索（α = 1.0）没有 BM25 组件来捕获精确的实体匹配。 混合消融实验（实验 01）表明，在 α = 0.5 时加入 BM25 可带来 +0.037 的 NDCG@10 提升，而该配置完全无法获得这一收益。

paragraphs.en: Rapid scaling degradation (C3). Speed degrades at − 0.115 -0.115 NDCG/decade ( R 2 = 0.900 R^{2}=0.900 , 95% CI [ − 0.168 , − 0.062 ] [-0.168,-0.062] ), the steepest slope of any profile ( Table 23 ). Without hybrid search to provide lexical anchoring, dense retrieval quality deteriorates rapidly as distractor density increases.
paragraphs.zh: 快速扩展退化（C3）。 速度以每十年 −0.115 NDCG 的幅度退化（R² = 0.900，95% CI [−0.168, −0.062]），是所有画像中最陡的斜率（表 23）。 在没有混合搜索提供词法锚定的情况下，随着干扰项密度增加，稠密检索的质量会迅速恶化。

sents.en: Rapid scaling degradation (C3).
sents.zh: 快速扩展退化（C3）。

sents.en: Speed degrades at − 0.115 -0.115 NDCG/decade ( R 2 = 0.900 R^{2}=0.900 , 95% CI [ − 0.168 , − 0.062 ] [-0.168,-0.062] ), the steepest slope of any profile ( Table 23 ).
sents.zh: 速度以每十年 −0.115 NDCG 的幅度退化（R² = 0.900，95% CI [−0.168, −0.062]），是所有画像中最陡的斜率（表 23）。

paragraphs.en: The speed profile is well-calibrated for its stated purpose (sub-second latency) but exhibits a fundamental retrieval ceiling that makes it unsuitable when NDCG@10 > 0.5 >0.5 is required. Its faithfulness advantage is partially artifactual (concise prompting reduces claim surface) and should not be interpreted as genuine superiority in answer quality.
paragraphs.zh: 该速度配置文件针对其声明的用途（亚秒级延迟）校准良好，但存在根本性的检索上限，使其在需要 NDCG@10 > 0.5 >0.5 时不适用。 它在忠实度上的优势部分是人为造成的（简洁的提示词减少了断言面），不应被解读为在答案质量上具有真正的优越性。

paragraphs.en: BGE-M3 (1024d), hybrid search ( α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 ), cross-encoder reranking ( mxbai-rerank-large-v1 , top- 5 5 ), HyDE ( 3 3 variants), no MMR, direct generation route (query routing disabled, standard tier default) with the hallucination and answer-quality gates enabled at the pipeline level, top- k = 20 k{=}20 ( Section I.1.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: BGE-M3（1024 维），混合检索（ α = 0.5 \alpha{=}0.5 ），交叉编码器重排序（ mxbai-rerank-large-v1 ，top- 5 5 ），HyDE（ 3 3 个变体），不使用 MMR，直接生成路径（禁用查询路由，标准层默认配置），并在流水线层面启用幻觉检测与答案质量门控，top- k = 20 k{=}20 （见 Section I.1.2 ）。

paragraphs.en: Highest NDCG@10 at small scale (0.510 at 5K; 0.860 on E2E at 5.5K). Degrades to 0.456 at 50K and 0.432 at 200K, overtaken by balanced, with the gap becoming statistically significant only at 200K ( Δ = + 0.059 \Delta=+0.059 , p = 0.004 p=0.004 ). Faithfulness: 0.739 (E2E, 5.5K), lower than all other SOTA profiles except Max-Reliable at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 在小规模下取得最高 NDCG@10（5K 时为 0.510；5.5K 时 E2E 为 0.860）。 在 50K 时降至 0.456，在 200K 时降至 0.432，被 balanced 超越，且差距仅在 200K 时具有统计显著性（ Δ = + 0.059 \Delta=+0.059 ， p = 0.004 p=0.004 ）。 忠实度：0.739（E2E，5.5K），在规模上低于除 Max-Reliable 之外的所有其他 SOTA 配置。

paragraphs.en: Optimal retrieval stack for small corpora. The standard profile combines four high-impact retrieval features: (a) cross-encoder reranking (which our ablation shows adds up to + 0.084 +0.084 NDCG@10 with the best model, ms-marco-MiniLM-L6; the default mxbai-large used by standard provides a smaller gain, see failure analysis below); (b) hybrid search ( + 0.037 +0.037 ; R5 exploited); (c) MMR disabled ( + 0.046 +0.046 ; R2 avoided); (d) HyDE ( + 0.026 +0.026 ; R4 ). Despite the suboptimal reranker choice, the four features jointly lift the profile to 0.510 NDCG@10 at 5K, the highest retrieval score among SOTA profiles, confirming that the retrieval stack is well-chosen even if individual components are not individually optimal ( Section D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 小型语料库的最优检索技术栈。 标准配置组合了四项高影响力的检索特性：(a) 交叉编码器重排序（我们的消融实验显示，最佳模型 ms-marco-MiniLM-L6 可带来高达 +0.084 的 NDCG@10 提升；standard 所使用的默认模型 mxbai-large 带来的增益较小，见下文失败分析）；(b) 混合检索（+0.037；R5 利用了该特性）；(c) 禁用 MMR（+0.046；R2 避免了该问题）；(d) HyDE（+0.026；R4）。 尽管重排序器的选择并非最优，这四项特性共同将该配置在 5K 规模下提升至 0.510 NDCG@10，是 SOTA 配置中最高的检索得分，这表明即使个别组件并非单独最优，整体检索技术栈的选择依然得当（见 D.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: HyDE as bridging context (R4 positive mode). HyDE generates hypothetical documents that bridge the vocabulary gap between short queries and long passages. On hotpotqa (multi-hop), the standard profile achieves + 0.088 +0.088 NDCG@10 over the baseline ( Table 45 ), consistent with HyDE’s demonstrated effectiveness on multi-hop queries ( Gao et al., 2023a ) . The cross-encoder reranker acts as a noise filter for HyDE’s occasionally hallucinated passages, preventing degradation (R4 positive mode in the taxonomy).
paragraphs.zh: HyDE 作为桥接上下文（R4 正向模式）。 HyDE 生成假设性文档，以弥合短查询与长段落之间的词汇差距。 在 hotpotqa（多跳）上，标准配置相比基线取得了 +0.088 +0.088 的 NDCG@10 提升（表 45），这与 HyDE 在多跳查询上已证明的有效性一致（Gao et al., 2023a）。 交叉编码器重排序器充当过滤器，过滤 HyDE 偶尔产生的幻觉段落，防止性能退化（分类法中的 R4 正向模式）。

paragraphs.en: Reranker model suboptimality (R1). The standard profile uses mxbai-rerank-large-v1, which our reranker model ablation (Exp. 15) identified as underperforming the smaller specialist ms-marco-MiniLM-L6 on the shared 93-query retrieval-isolation benchmark (NDCG@10 = 0.470 =0.470 vs 0.496 0.496 , a − 0.026 -0.026 gap; Table 51 ). The SOTA evaluation configs retain mxbai-large because it was the framework default and the profile configs were frozen before the reranker comparison was conducted. Note that the reranker is a query-time knob (not in _INGESTION_TIME_KEYS ; experiment.py :60–87), so re-running with the swapped reranker requires no re-ingestion of the corpus. The isolated model-swap delta ( + 0.026 +0.026 ; Table 51 ) shrinks to + 0.009 +0.009 NDCG@10 when measured end-to-end on the BEIR generation split with the full SOTA_Std stack composed ( Table 59 ), consistent with functional-duplication interactions (C1). The swap remains the single easiest available improvement for the standard profile.
paragraphs.zh: 重排序模型非最优（R1）。 标准配置使用 mxbai-rerank-large-v1，我们的重排序模型消融实验（实验 15）发现，在共享的 93 查询检索隔离基准上，其表现不如更小的专用模型 ms-marco-MiniLM-L6（NDCG@10 = 0.470 =0.470 对 0.496 0.496，差距为 − 0.026 -0.026；表 51）。 SOTA 评估配置保留 mxbai-large，因为它是框架默认值，且这些配置文件在重排序模型对比实验开展之前就已经冻结。 需要注意的是，重排序器是查询时的调节项（不在 _INGESTION_TIME_KEYS 中；experiment.py:60–87），因此换用重排序器后重新运行无需重新摄取语料库。 隔离的模型替换增益（+ 0.026 +0.026；表 51）在 BEIR 生成集上以完整 SOTA_Std 栈端到端测量时缩小为 + 0.009 +0.009 NDCG@10（表 59），这与功能重复的交互作用一致（C1）。 对标准配置而言，此次替换仍是现有最简单的单项改进。

paragraphs.en: Scale fragility (C3). The standard profile degrades log-linearly at − 0.055 -0.055 NDCG/decade ( R 2 = 0.895 R^{2}=0.895 , p = 0.004 p=0.004 ), a 3.7 × 3.7\times steeper slope than balanced ( − 0.015 -0.015 /decade; slope not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.175 p=0.175 ; Table 23 ). The root cause is the absence of generation-side defenses: without context compression (G2) or document awareness (G3), the generator receives 5 full-length passages (up to 4,000 tokens) whose relevance quality degrades as corpus size increases. At 50K documents, the proportion of near-miss distractors in the top-20 candidate set increases, and without compression to distil the most relevant spans, the generator is more likely to attend to irrelevant context. This mechanism is consistent with the “lost in the middle” phenomenon ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , where generators struggle to utilize relevant information when it is embedded in a long, partially irrelevant context window.
paragraphs.zh: 规模脆弱性（C3）。 标准配置的性能以 −0.055 NDCG/十年的速度呈对数线性下降（R²=0.895，p=0.004），斜率比均衡配置陡 3.7 倍（−0.015/十年；其斜率与零无显著差异，p=0.175；表 23）。 根本原因在于缺乏生成侧的防御机制：在没有上下文压缩（G2）或文档感知（G3）的情况下，生成器会接收到 5 篇完整长度的段落（最多 4,000 个词元），而其相关性质量会随着语料库规模的增大而下降。 当文档数达到 5 万时，前 20 候选集中近似干扰项的比例上升，且由于缺少压缩机制来提炼最相关的片段，生成器更容易关注到无关的上下文。 这一机制与「迷失在中间」现象（Liu 等，2024）一致，即当相关信息被嵌入长且部分无关的上下文窗口时，生成器难以加以利用。

sents.en: The root cause is the absence of generation-side defenses: without context compression (G2) or document awareness (G3), the generator receives 5 full-length passages (up to 4,000 tokens) whose relevance quality degrades as corpus size increases.
sents.zh: 根本原因在于缺乏生成侧的防御机制：在没有上下文压缩（G2）或文档感知（G3）的情况下，生成器会接收到 5 篇完整长度的段落（最多 4,000 个词元），而其相关性质量会随着语料库规模的增大而下降。

sents.en: At 50K documents, the proportion of near-miss distractors in the top-20 candidate set increases, and without compression to distil the most relevant spans, the generator is more likely to attend to irrelevant context.
sents.zh: 当文档数达到 5 万时，前 20 候选集中近似干扰项的比例上升，且由于缺少压缩机制来提炼最相关的片段，生成器更容易关注到无关的上下文。

sents.en: This mechanism is consistent with the “lost in the middle” phenomenon ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , where generators struggle to utilize relevant information when it is embedded in a long, partially irrelevant context window.
sents.zh: 这一机制与「迷失在中间」现象（Liu 等，2024）一致，即当相关信息被嵌入长且部分无关的上下文窗口时，生成器难以加以利用。

paragraphs.en: No faithfulness safeguards. The standard profile achieves the lowest faithfulness among SOTA profiles (0.739 at 5.5K; Table 2 ). Without agentic quality gates (G1), hallucination checks, or context compression (G2), the generator operates on raw retrieved context with no verification layer. The faithfulness ANOVA shows that query augmentation and agentic gating together explain η 2 = 0.191 \eta^{2}=0.191 of faithfulness variance ( Section 5 ), variance that the standard profile cannot capture because it lacks both components.

paragraphs.en: The standard profile is optimally designed for small-corpus, retrieval-focused deployments where generation quality is less critical. Its scale fragility is a direct consequence of its retrieval-only optimization strategy: the features that maximize NDCG@10 at 5K (HyDE, reranking) do not address the generation-side challenges that emerge at scale. This explains the rank crossover observed by 200K ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ) and provides causal grounding for the H3 hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 标准配置专为小语料库、以检索为核心的部署场景优化设计，适用于生成质量要求不高的场景。 其规模脆弱性是其仅针对检索优化的策略的直接后果：在 5K 规模下最大化 NDCG@10 的特性（HyDE、重排序）并不能解决规模化后出现的生成侧挑战。 这解释了在 200K 规模下观察到的排名交叉（ p = 0.004 p=0.004 ），并为 H3 假设提供了因果依据。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval foundation partially shared with standard , with retrieval-visible additions. balanced and standard share embedding model (BAAI/bge-m3), reranker (mxbai-large), hybrid alpha, MMR settings, chunker parameters, and top- k k ; balanced additionally enables hierarchical parent/child indexing (index-stage), structured-graph post-retrieval merge , a wider chunk-cite keep count (max_chunks = = 20 vs. 15 for standard ), and adaptive query routing . These four retrieval-visible additions, rather than the compression or document-awareness features below, drive the small-scale retrieval parity (0.504 vs. 0.510; Δ = − 0.006 \Delta=-0.006 , within noise) and the widening gap at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 检索基础与 standard 部分共享，并增加了若干检索侧可见的扩展。balanced 与 standard 共享嵌入模型（BAAI/bge-m3）、重排序器（mxbai-large）、混合 alpha、MMR 设置、分块器参数以及 top- k k；balanced 额外启用了分层父/子索引（index-stage）、结构化图检索后合并、更宽的分块引用保留数量（max_chunks = = 20，而 standard 为 15），以及自适应查询路由。 正是这四项检索侧可见的扩展，而非下文所述的压缩或文档感知特性，驱动了小规模检索上的持平表现（0.504 对 0.510；Δ = − 0.006 \Delta=-0.006，在噪声范围内）以及规模扩大后不断拉开的差距。

paragraphs.en: Context compression as generation-side noise filter (G2). Extractive compression at 50% ratio removes filler tokens from retrieved passages while preserving the most relevant spans, acting post-retrieval on chunk text (chunks are not reordered or dropped by this step). The generator receives a denser, higher-signal context window, reducing the “lost in the middle” failure mode and lowering the token budget available for hallucination, improving faithfulness ( Δ = + 0.01 \Delta=+0.01 ; Section D.1 ). The dropout analysis reports a small − 0.006 -0.006 NDCG@10 delta when compression is removed ( Section D.12 ); this reflects the pipeline’s final SearchResult list being scored, not compression modifying retrieval ordering per se.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文压缩作为生成侧的噪声过滤器（G2）。 50% 比率的抽取式压缩在保留最相关片段的同时，从检索到的段落中移除填充词元，该压缩在检索后作用于分块文本（此步骤不会对分块进行重排序或丢弃）。 生成器接收更稠密、信号更强的上下文窗口，从而减少“中间迷失”这一失效模式，并降低可用于幻觉的词元预算，提升忠实度（ Δ = + 0.01 \Delta=+0.01 ；参见 D.1 节）。 消融分析报告显示，移除压缩后 NDCG@10 仅有 − 0.006 -0.006 的小幅变化（参见 D.12 节）；这反映的是对流水线最终的 SearchResult 列表进行评分的结果，而非压缩本身修改了检索排序。

paragraphs.en: Document awareness as cheap grounding (G3). The 100-token document prefix provides file-level metadata (filename, structure, opening sentences) at negligible cost ( + 15 +15 ms latency). Exp. 17 (eval split, exploratory) demonstrates that this simple strategy outperforms LLM-generated summaries (0.411 vs. 0.341 NDCG@10) and longer prefixes (300 tokens: 0.347). The mechanism is information-theoretic: the first 100 tokens of a document contain high-entropy information (title, abstract, introduction) that helps the generator contextualize retrieved chunks. Longer prefixes add boilerplate that dilutes signal.
paragraphs.zh: 文档感知作为廉价的基础依据（G3）。 100 词元的文档前缀以可忽略的成本（+15 词元、+15 毫秒延迟）提供文件级元数据（文件名、结构、开头句子）。 实验 17（评测集划分，探索性）表明，这种简单策略优于 LLM 生成的摘要（0.411 对 0.341 NDCG@10）以及更长的前缀（300 词元：0.347）。 其机制可从信息论角度解释：文档的前 100 个词元包含高熵信息（标题、摘要、引言），有助于生成器对检索到的片段进行情境化理解。 更长的前缀会引入套话式内容，从而稀释信号。

paragraphs.en: Scale robustness from generation-side defenses (C3 mitigated). The combination of compression and document awareness provides two independent defenses against scale-induced degradation: compression filters noisy passages, and awareness provides document-level context that remains informative even when individual chunks become less relevant. The balanced profile’s degradation slope ( − 0.015 -0.015 NDCG/decade, not significantly different from zero, p = 0.175 p=0.175 ) is 3.7 × 3.7\times flatter than standard’s ( − 0.055 -0.055 , p = 0.004 p=0.004 ), directly attributable to these features. On E2E faithfulness, balanced maintains 0.935 at 50K vs. standard’s 0.793, a + 0.142 +0.142 gap that widens with scale.
paragraphs.zh: 从生成侧防御实现的规模鲁棒性（C3 已缓解）。 压缩与文档感知的结合提供了两道针对规模引发退化的独立防御：压缩过滤噪声段落，而感知提供文档级上下文，即使单个分块相关性下降时仍能保持信息量。 平衡型的退化斜率（−0.015 NDCG/十倍规模，与零无显著差异，p=0.175）比标准型的（−0.055，p=0.004）平缓 3.7 倍，这可直接归因于上述特性。 在端到端忠实度上，平衡型在 50K 时保持 0.935，而标准型为 0.793，差距为 +0.142，且随规模扩大而进一步拉大。

paragraphs.en: Composition penalty minimized by complementary features. Unlike the Max-Reliable profile (which stacks overlapping features), balanced’s additions (compression, awareness) operate on different pipeline stages than its retrieval features. Compression acts on the output of reranking (post-retrieval); awareness acts on the generation prompt (pre-generation). Neither duplicates the function of HyDE, reranking, or hybrid search. The dropout analysis ( Section D.12 ) confirms this complementarity: removing compression from balanced costs only − 0.006 -0.006 NDCG@10, and removing document awareness costs − 0.055 -0.055 , while removing the reranker costs − 0.072 -0.072 , each feature’s dropout delta is close to its single-feature ablation delta, indicating minimal interference. By contrast, the full five-feature stack ( Section D.14 ) incurs a 72% composition penalty precisely because retrieval-side features overlap in function.

paragraphs.en: The balanced profile’s strong agentic tradeoff arises from a principled design: it exhausts the retrieval stack (where the largest gains are available) and adds generation-side defenses that address different failure modes (noise filtering, context grounding) rather than amplifying the same capability. This complementary design minimizes the composition penalty and provides scale robustness that retrieval-only profiles lack.
paragraphs.zh: 平衡型配置之所以具备强大的智能体权衡表现，源于其有原则的设计：它充分利用了检索栈（那里可获得最大的收益），并增加了针对不同失效模式的生成侧防御（噪声过滤、上下文锚定），而非放大同一能力。 这种互补式设计将组合惩罚降到最低，并提供了纯检索型配置所缺乏的规模鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Hallucination gating (G1 positive mode). The agentic pipeline’s hallucination check filters retrieved chunks that the LLM judge classifies as not supporting the query. This raises the floor of per-query faithfulness: the minimum observed score is 0.812 ( Table 65 ), compared to 0.750 for balanced and 0.714 for standard. For safety-critical deployments, raising the floor matters more than improving the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉门控（G1 正向模式）。 智能体流水线中的幻觉检查会过滤掉 LLM 判定不支持查询的检索块。 这提高了每次查询忠实度的下限：最低观测得分为 0.812（表 65），而均衡模式为 0.750，标准模式为 0.714。 对于安全攸关的部署而言，提高下限比提高均值更重要。

paragraphs.en: Quality gate as safety net (G4). The quality gate evaluates the generated answer against the retrieved context and can trigger a re-retrieval if the answer appears unfaithful. paragraphs.en: Aggressive refinement paradox (G1 negative mode). The agentic pipeline’s chunk refinement classifies 13–14 of 15 retrieved chunks as “not relevant” on multi-hop queries, discarding evidence that the generator needs for comprehensive answers. When all chunks are discarded, a single fallback chunk is returned. This starves the generator: with one chunk of ∼ 800 {\sim}800 tokens, the answer is necessarily incomplete. The dropout analysis confirms this: removing agentic RAG from the Max-Reliable base profile improves NDCG@10 by + 0.021 +0.021 ( Table 44 ). Separately, the cross-profile comparison shows E2E exact match at 0.163 (standard) vs. 0.101 (Max-Reliable), consistent with reduced answer completeness.
paragraphs.zh: 激进精炼悖论（G1 负面模式）。 智能体流水线中的分块精炼环节在多跳查询上把 15 个检索到的分块中的 13–14 个判定为“不相关”，从而丢弃了生成器给出全面答案所需的证据。 当所有分块都被丢弃时，会返回一个单一的后备分块。 这导致生成器“挨饿”：仅凭一个约 800 个 token 的分块，答案必然不完整。 消融分析证实了这一点：从 Max-Reliable 基础画像中移除智能体 RAG 可使 NDCG@10 提升 +0.021（表 44）。 此外，跨画像比较显示端到端完全匹配率为 0.163（标准）对比 0.101（Max-Reliable），这与答案完整性下降的情况一致。

paragraphs.en: Mechanistic detail. The refinement uses an LLM judge to classify each chunk as relevant , partially_relevant , or not_relevant . The judge operates on individual chunks without cross-chunk context, so a chunk that provides necessary bridging evidence for a multi-hop query may be classified as not relevant because it does not directly answer the query. This is consistent with the pointwise scoring approach used in passage reranking ( Nogueira & Cho, 2019 ) , where each passage is evaluated independently; the effect is amplified when the refinement threshold is aggressive (our default: only relevant chunks pass).
paragraphs.zh: 机制层面的细节。 该精炼步骤使用一个 LLM 评判器将每个分块分类为 relevant（相关）、partially_relevant（部分相关）或 not_relevant（不相关）。 该评判器在单个分块上独立运行，没有跨分块的上下文，因此一个为多跳查询提供必要桥接证据的分块可能会被判定为不相关，因为它没有直接回答该查询。 这与段落重排中使用的逐点评分方法（Nogueira & Cho, 2019）是一致的，其中每个段落都被独立评估；当精炼阈值设置得较为激进时，这种影响会被放大（我们的默认设置：只有相关分块能通过）。

paragraphs.en: Latency cost without proportional quality gain. The agentic pipeline adds 3–7 LLM calls per query (planning, per-chunk relevance classification, hallucination check, quality gate, optional re-retrieval). Each call adds ∼ 1 {\sim}1 –3 s via the API gateway, contributing to the + 2.0 +2.0 s p95 latency increase over balanced. The faithfulness gain ( + 0.005 +0.005 over balanced) does not justify this cost for most applications, making the profile less efficient on the joint tradeoff.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟成本高但质量提升不成正比。 该智能体流水线在每次查询中增加 3–7 次大语言模型调用（规划、逐块相关性分类、幻觉检查、质量门控、可选的重新检索）。 每次调用通过 API 网关会增加约 1–3 秒，导致相比 balanced 配置的 p95 延迟增加了 2.0 秒。 忠实度的提升（相比 balanced 配置仅 +0.005）对大多数应用而言不足以证明该成本的合理性，使得该配置在联合权衡上的效率较低。

sents.en: Latency cost without proportional quality gain.
sents.zh: 延迟成本高但质量提升不成正比。

sents.en: The agentic pipeline adds 3–7 LLM calls per query (planning, per-chunk relevance classification, hallucination check, quality gate, optional re-retrieval).
sents.zh: 该智能体流水线在每次查询中增加 3–7 次大语言模型调用（规划、逐块相关性分类、幻觉检查、质量门控、可选的重新检索）。

sents.en: Each call adds ∼ 1 {\sim}1 –3 s via the API gateway, contributing to the + 2.0 +2.0 s p95 latency increase over balanced.
sents.zh: 每次调用通过 API 网关会增加约 1–3 秒，导致相比 balanced 配置的 p95 延迟增加了 2.0 秒。

sents.en: The faithfulness gain ( + 0.005 +0.005 over balanced) does not justify this cost for most applications, making the profile less efficient on the joint tradeoff.
sents.zh: 忠实度的提升（相比 balanced 配置仅 +0.005）对大多数应用而言不足以证明该成本的合理性，使得该配置在联合权衡上的效率较低。

paragraphs.en: Composition penalty from feature stacking (C1). Max_reliable activates everything that balanced has plus agentic components. But the agentic pipeline partially duplicates the function of context compression: both reduce the context to high-relevance spans. When both are active, the marginal benefit of each is reduced. The waterfall analysis ( Section D.14 ) already shows a 72% composition penalty for balanced’s five-feature stack, meaning only 28% of the predicted additive improvement is realized. Adding the agentic layer on top can only increase this penalty: the dropout analysis confirms that removing agentic RAG from the Max-Reliable base profile improves NDCG@10 by + 0.021 +0.021 ( Table 44 ), indicating that the agentic layer is net-harmful for retrieval quality when compression is already active. Max_reliable’s composition penalty therefore exceeds 72%, making it the most penalty-heavy SOTA profile.
paragraphs.zh: 特征叠加带来的组合惩罚（C1）。 Max_reliable 激活了 balanced 所包含的一切，外加智能体组件。 但智能体流水线与上下文压缩的功能部分重复：二者都把上下文缩减为高相关片段。 当两者同时启用时，各自的边际收益都会降低。 瀑布分析（第 D.14 节）已经显示 balanced 的五特征叠加存在 72% 的组合惩罚，即预测的累加改进只有 28% 得以实现。 在此之上再加智能体层只会进一步加重这一惩罚：dropout 分析证实，从 Max-Reliable 基础配置中移除智能体 RAG 可使 NDCG@10 提升 +0.021（表 44），表明在压缩已经启用的情况下，智能体层对检索质量是净有害的。 因此 Max_reliable 的组合惩罚超过 72%，使其成为惩罚最重的 SOTA 配置。

sents.en: Composition penalty from feature stacking (C1).
sents.zh: 特征叠加带来的组合惩罚（C1）。

sents.en: Max_reliable activates everything that balanced has plus agentic components.
sents.zh: Max_reliable 激活了 balanced 所包含的一切，外加智能体组件。

sents.en: But the agentic pipeline partially duplicates the function of context compression: both reduce the context to high-relevance spans.
sents.zh: 但智能体流水线与上下文压缩的功能部分重复：二者都把上下文缩减为高相关片段。

sents.en: When both are active, the marginal benefit of each is reduced.
sents.zh: 当两者同时启用时，各自的边际收益都会降低。

sents.en: The waterfall analysis ( Section D.14 ) already shows a 72% composition penalty for balanced’s five-feature stack, meaning only 28% of the predicted additive improvement is realized.
sents.zh: 瀑布分析（第 D.14 节）已经显示 balanced 的五特征叠加存在 72% 的组合惩罚，即预测的累加改进只有 28% 得以实现。

sents.en: Adding the agentic layer on top can only increase this penalty: the dropout analysis confirms that removing agentic RAG from the Max-Reliable base profile improves NDCG@10 by + 0.021 +0.021 ( Table 44 ), indicating that the agentic layer is net-harmful for retrieval quality when compression is already active.
sents.zh: 在此之上再加智能体层只会进一步加重这一惩罚：dropout 分析证实，从 Max-Reliable 基础配置中移除智能体 RAG 可使 NDCG@10 提升 +0.021（表 44），表明在压缩已经启用的情况下，智能体层对检索质量是净有害的。

sents.en: Max_reliable’s composition penalty therefore exceeds 72%, making it the most penalty-heavy SOTA profile.
sents.zh: 因此 Max_reliable 的组合惩罚超过 72%，使其成为惩罚最重的 SOTA 配置。

paragraphs.en: Reranker inheritance (R1) and no query expansion benefit. Max_reliable inherits the suboptimal mxbai-large reranker (R1) and explicitly disables query expansion and RAG fusion, features that its YAML config notes “add latency, no faith. gain.” This is correct based on single-feature ablation (R3: query expansion hurts NDCG by − 0.014 -0.014 ), but means that the agentic pipeline receives the same retrieval input as balanced, limiting its potential for improvement to the generation side only.
paragraphs.zh: 重排序器继承（R1），且查询扩展没有收益。 Max_reliable 继承了次优的 mxbai-large 重排序器（R1），并明确禁用了查询扩展和 RAG 融合，其 YAML 配置中注明这些功能“增加延迟，无忠实度收益”。基于单特征消融实验，这一选择是正确的（R3：查询扩展使 NDCG 降低了 −0.014），但这意味着该智能体化流水线接收到的检索输入与 balanced 相同，从而将其改进潜力限制在了生成侧。

sents.en: Reranker inheritance (R1) and no query expansion benefit.
sents.zh: 重排序器继承（R1），且查询扩展没有收益。

sents.en: Max_reliable inherits the suboptimal mxbai-large reranker (R1) and explicitly disables query expansion and RAG fusion, features that its YAML config notes “add latency, no faith. gain.” This is correct based on single-feature ablation (R3: query expansion hurts NDCG by − 0.014 -0.014 ), but means that the agentic pipeline receives the same retrieval input as balanced, limiting its potential for improvement to the generation side only.
sents.zh: Max_reliable 继承了次优的 mxbai-large 重排序器（R1），并明确禁用了查询扩展和 RAG 融合，其 YAML 配置中注明这些功能“增加延迟，无忠实度收益”。基于单特征消融实验，这一选择是正确的（R3：查询扩展使 NDCG 降低了 −0.014），但这意味着该智能体化流水线接收到的检索输入与 balanced 相同，从而将其改进潜力限制在了生成侧。

paragraphs.en: Max_reliable is a specialized profile whose design is optimized for raising the faithfulness floor rather than the mean. Its joint disadvantage relative to balanced is driven by the aggressive refinement paradox (G1): the same mechanism that raises the faithfulness floor also reduces answer completeness. For deployments where the minimum acceptable faithfulness is the binding constraint (e.g., medical, legal), Max-Reliable’s + 0.062 +0.062 floor improvement over balanced (0.812 vs. 0.750) may justify the latency cost. For all other deployments, balanced provides a stronger joint quality–response-time trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: Max_reliable 是一个专门化的配置档，其设计旨在提升忠实度下限而非均值。 它相对于 balanced 的联合劣势由激进精炼悖论（G1）驱动：提升忠实度下限的同一机制同时也降低了答案完整性。 对于以最低可接受忠实度为约束条件的部署场景（如医疗、法律领域），Max-Reliable 相比 balanced 的 +0.062 下限提升（0.812 对 0.750）或许足以证明其延迟代价是值得的。 对于其他所有部署场景，balanced 提供了更强的质量–响应时间联合权衡。

sents.en: Max_reliable is a specialized profile whose design is optimized for raising the faithfulness floor rather than the mean.
sents.zh: Max_reliable 是一个专门化的配置档，其设计旨在提升忠实度下限而非均值。

sents.en: Its joint disadvantage relative to balanced is driven by the aggressive refinement paradox (G1): the same mechanism that raises the faithfulness floor also reduces answer completeness.
sents.zh: 它相对于 balanced 的联合劣势由激进精炼悖论（G1）驱动：提升忠实度下限的同一机制同时也降低了答案完整性。

sents.en: For deployments where the minimum acceptable faithfulness is the binding constraint (e.g., medical, legal), Max-Reliable’s + 0.062 +0.062 floor improvement over balanced (0.812 vs. 0.750) may justify the latency cost.
sents.zh: 对于以最低可接受忠实度为约束条件的部署场景（如医疗、法律领域），Max-Reliable 相比 balanced 的 +0.062 下限提升（0.812 对 0.750）或许足以证明其延迟代价是值得的。

sents.en: For all other deployments, balanced provides a stronger joint quality–response-time trade-off.
sents.zh: 对于其他所有部署场景，balanced 提供了更强的质量–响应时间联合权衡。

paragraphs.en: The per-profile analyses above identify several recurring interaction patterns. We consolidate these into three principal interaction mechanisms, each grounded in the factorial ANOVA and DID probes.
paragraphs.zh: 上文针对各配置的分析识别出了若干反复出现的交互模式。 我们将其归纳为三种主要的交互机制，每一种均以因子方差分析和双重差分检验为依据。

sents.en: The per-profile analyses above identify several recurring interaction patterns.
sents.zh: 上文针对各配置的分析识别出了若干反复出现的交互模式。

sents.en: We consolidate these into three principal interaction mechanisms, each grounded in the factorial ANOVA and DID probes.
sents.zh: 我们将其归纳为三种主要的交互机制，每一种均以因子方差分析和双重差分检验为依据。

paragraphs.en: η 2 = 0.102 \eta^{2}=0.102 , F = 4.48 F=4.48 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 on NDCG@10 (167 configs; Section 5 ). This is the strongest two-way interaction in the retrieval ANOVA.
paragraphs.zh: 在 NDCG@10 上 η²=0.102，F=4.48，p<0.001（167 个配置；见第 5 节）。 这是检索 ANOVA 中最强的双向交互效应。

sents.en: This is the strongest two-way interaction in the retrieval ANOVA.
sents.zh: 这是检索 ANOVA 中最强的双向交互效应。

paragraphs.en: Enrichment methods (contextual retrieval, RAPTOR) prepend synthetic context to document chunks before embedding. The quality of the resulting embedding depends on how well the embedding model can encode this prepended context:
paragraphs.zh: 增强方法（上下文检索、RAPTOR）会在文档分块进行嵌入之前，为其前置合成上下文。 由此得到的嵌入质量取决于嵌入模型能否很好地编码这些前置的上下文：

sents.en: Enrichment methods (contextual retrieval, RAPTOR) prepend synthetic context to document chunks before embedding.
sents.zh: 增强方法（上下文检索、RAPTOR）会在文档分块进行嵌入之前，为其前置合成上下文。

sents.en: The quality of the resulting embedding depends on how well the embedding model can encode this prepended context:
sents.zh: 由此得到的嵌入质量取决于嵌入模型能否很好地编码这些前置的上下文：

paragraphs.en: High-capacity embedders (E5-large, BGE-M3, 1024d): The additional context provides useful signal, and the model has sufficient capacity to encode it. However, our results show that even with high-capacity embedders, enrichment does not improve over the none baseline ( η enrichment 2 = 0.144 \eta^{2}_{\text{enrichment}}=0.144 , best level: none). This suggests that on domain-focused corpora, the original document text already provides sufficient embedding signal.
paragraphs.zh: 高容量嵌入模型（E5-large、BGE-M3，1024 维）：额外的上下文提供了有用的信号，且模型具有足够的容量来对其进行编码。 然而，我们的结果表明，即使使用高容量嵌入模型，增强的效果也没有超过 none 基线（η²_enrichment = 0.144，最佳水平为 none）。 这表明在面向特定领域的语料库上，原始文档文本本身已经提供了足够的嵌入信号。

sents.en: High-capacity embedders (E5-large, BGE-M3, 1024d): The additional context provides useful signal, and the model has sufficient capacity to encode it.
sents.zh: 高容量嵌入模型（E5-large、BGE-M3，1024 维）：额外的上下文提供了有用的信号，且模型具有足够的容量来对其进行编码。

sents.en: However, our results show that even with high-capacity embedders, enrichment does not improve over the none baseline ( η enrichment 2 = 0.144 \eta^{2}_{\text{enrichment}}=0.144 , best level: none).
sents.zh: 然而，我们的结果表明，即使使用高容量嵌入模型，增强的效果也没有超过 none 基线（η²_enrichment = 0.144，最佳水平为 none）。

sents.en: This suggests that on domain-focused corpora, the original document text already provides sufficient embedding signal.
sents.zh: 这表明在面向特定领域的语料库上，原始文档文本本身已经提供了足够的嵌入信号。

paragraphs.en: Low-capacity embedders (MiniLM-L6, 384d): The prepended context overwhelms the model’s limited representational capacity, diluting the embedding of the original text. This produces a negative interaction: enrichment hurts more with weaker embedders.
paragraphs.zh: 低容量嵌入模型（MiniLM-L6，384维）：前置的上下文会压垮该模型有限的表示能力，稀释原始文本的嵌入。 这产生了一种负向交互：嵌入模型越弱，增强造成的伤害越大。

sents.en: Low-capacity embedders (MiniLM-L6, 384d): The prepended context overwhelms the model’s limited representational capacity, diluting the embedding of the original text.
sents.zh: 低容量嵌入模型（MiniLM-L6，384维）：前置的上下文会压垮该模型有限的表示能力，稀释原始文本的嵌入。

sents.en: This produces a negative interaction: enrichment hurts more with weaker embedders.
sents.zh: 这产生了一种负向交互：嵌入模型越弱，增强造成的伤害越大。

paragraphs.en: All SOTA profiles either use BGE-M3 (standard, balanced, Max-Reliable) or MiniLM-L6 (speed), and none use enrichment. This is the correct design choice: the interaction analysis confirms that enrichment provides no benefit and may actively harm weaker embedders. Future work should evaluate whether enrichment becomes beneficial on open-domain corpora where document text alone may be insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 SOTA 配置要么使用 BGE-M3（standard、balanced、Max-Reliable），要么使用 MiniLM-L6（speed），且均不使用 enrichment。 这是正确的设计选择：交互分析证实 enrichment 没有带来任何收益，甚至可能主动损害较弱的嵌入模型。 未来工作应评估在开放领域语料库上 enrichment 是否会变得有益，因为在这类语料库中仅靠文档文本可能不够。

sents.en: All SOTA profiles either use BGE-M3 (standard, balanced, Max-Reliable) or MiniLM-L6 (speed), and none use enrichment.
sents.zh: 所有 SOTA 配置要么使用 BGE-M3（standard、balanced、Max-Reliable），要么使用 MiniLM-L6（speed），且均不使用 enrichment。

sents.en: This is the correct design choice: the interaction analysis confirms that enrichment provides no benefit and may actively harm weaker embedders.
sents.zh: 这是正确的设计选择：交互分析证实 enrichment 没有带来任何收益，甚至可能主动损害较弱的嵌入模型。

sents.en: Future work should evaluate whether enrichment becomes beneficial on open-domain corpora where document text alone may be insufficient.
sents.zh: 未来工作应评估在开放领域语料库上 enrichment 是否会变得有益，因为在这类语料库中仅靠文档文本可能不够。

paragraphs.en: Cross-encoder rerankers operate on (query, passage) pairs and produce calibrated relevance scores. Their effectiveness depends on the quality of the candidate set provided by the first-stage retriever:
paragraphs.zh: 交叉编码器重排序器作用于（查询，段落）对，并生成经过校准的相关性分数。 它们的有效性取决于第一阶段检索器所提供的候选集的质量：

sents.en: Cross-encoder rerankers operate on (query, passage) pairs and produce calibrated relevance scores.
sents.zh: 交叉编码器重排序器作用于（查询，段落）对，并生成经过校准的相关性分数。

sents.en: Their effectiveness depends on the quality of the candidate set provided by the first-stage retriever:
sents.zh: 它们的有效性取决于第一阶段检索器所提供的候选集的质量：

paragraphs.en: Strong first-stage retrieval (BGE-M3 + hybrid): The candidate set already contains mostly relevant passages; the reranker refines their ordering but has limited room for improvement. The marginal gain of reranking is moderate.
paragraphs.zh: 强大的第一阶段检索（BGE-M3 + 混合检索）：候选集本身已包含大量相关段落；重排序器只是优化其排序，提升空间有限。 重排序带来的边际收益较为有限。

sents.en: Strong first-stage retrieval (BGE-M3 + hybrid): The candidate set already contains mostly relevant passages; the reranker refines their ordering but has limited room for improvement.
sents.zh: 强大的第一阶段检索（BGE-M3 + 混合检索）：候选集本身已包含大量相关段落；重排序器只是优化其排序，提升空间有限。

sents.en: The marginal gain of reranking is moderate.
sents.zh: 重排序带来的边际收益较为有限。

paragraphs.en: Weak first-stage retrieval (MiniLM-L6, dense-only): The candidate set contains more noise; the reranker can rescue relevant passages from lower ranks, providing a larger marginal gain.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段检索较弱（MiniLM-L6，仅稠密检索）：候选集合包含更多噪声；重排序器能够从较低排名中挽救相关段落，带来更大的边际收益。

paragraphs.en: This produces a compensatory interaction: reranking benefits weaker embedders more than stronger ones. The practical consequence is that practitioners with strong embeddings should invest less in reranking and more in other dimensions (compression, awareness).
paragraphs.zh: 这会产生一种补偿性交互：重排序对较弱的嵌入模型的收益大于对较强的嵌入模型的收益。 实际结果是，拥有强大嵌入模型的从业者应在重排序上少投入，而更多投入其他维度（压缩、感知）。

sents.en: This produces a compensatory interaction: reranking benefits weaker embedders more than stronger ones.
sents.zh: 这会产生一种补偿性交互：重排序对较弱的嵌入模型的收益大于对较强的嵌入模型的收益。

sents.en: The practical consequence is that practitioners with strong embeddings should invest less in reranking and more in other dimensions (compression, awareness).
sents.zh: 实际结果是，拥有强大嵌入模型的从业者应在重排序上少投入，而更多投入其他维度（压缩、感知）。

This is the strongest interaction on faithfulness and near the pre-registered H1 threshold ( η 2 = 0.20 \eta^{2}=0.20 ).
paragraphs.zh: η²=0.191（III 型；原始 η²=0.259），F(12,279)=5.47，p<0.001，在忠实度上；经 Holm 校正后 p=0.018（122 种配置；第 5 节）。 这是忠实度上最强的交互效应，且接近预注册的 H1 阈值（η²=0.20）。

sents.en: This is the strongest interaction on faithfulness and near the pre-registered H1 threshold ( η 2 = 0.20 \eta^{2}=0.20 ).

paragraphs.en: Query augmentation (HyDE, RAG fusion) expands the retrieval input, producing a richer but noisier candidate set. The agentic gate (CRAG, self-RAG, speculative RAG) filters this candidate set by evaluating each passage’s support for the generated answer:
paragraphs.zh: 查询增强（HyDE、RAG fusion）扩展了检索输入，产生更丰富但更嘈杂的候选集。 智能体门控（CRAG、self-RAG、speculative RAG）通过评估每个段落对生成答案的支持程度来过滤该候选集：

sents.en: Query augmentation (HyDE, RAG fusion) expands the retrieval input, producing a richer but noisier candidate set.
sents.zh: 查询增强（HyDE、RAG fusion）扩展了检索输入，产生更丰富但更嘈杂的候选集。

sents.en: The agentic gate (CRAG, self-RAG, speculative RAG) filters this candidate set by evaluating each passage’s support for the generated answer:
sents.zh: 智能体门控（CRAG、self-RAG、speculative RAG）通过评估每个段落对生成答案的支持程度来过滤该候选集：

paragraphs.en: Augmentation alone (no gating): Noisy candidates pass through to the generator, which may hallucinate from irrelevant passages. Faithfulness does not improve ( Δ = 0.00 \Delta=0.00 for RAG fusion; Section D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 仅增强（无门控机制）：带噪声的候选内容会直接传递给生成器，生成器可能基于不相关的段落产生幻觉。 忠实度没有提升（RAG融合的 Δ = 0.00；参见D.1节）。

sents.en: Augmentation alone (no gating): Noisy candidates pass through to the generator, which may hallucinate from irrelevant passages.
sents.zh: 仅增强（无门控机制）：带噪声的候选内容会直接传递给生成器，生成器可能基于不相关的段落产生幻觉。

sents.en: Faithfulness does not improve ( Δ = 0.00 \Delta=0.00 for RAG fusion; Section D.1 ).
sents.zh: 忠实度没有提升（RAG融合的 Δ = 0.00；参见D.1节）。

paragraphs.en: Gating alone (no augmentation): The gate filters a standard candidate set, which may already be insufficient. Faithfulness improves modestly ( Δ = + 0.05 \Delta=+0.05 for agentic RAG).
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用门控（无增强）：门控对标准候选集进行筛选，而该候选集本身可能已经不够充分。 忠实度有适度提升（智能体 RAG 的 Δ=+0.05）。

sents.en: Gating alone (no augmentation): The gate filters a standard candidate set, which may already be insufficient.
sents.zh: 仅使用门控（无增强）：门控对标准候选集进行筛选，而该候选集本身可能已经不够充分。

sents.en: Faithfulness improves modestly ( Δ = + 0.05 \Delta=+0.05 for agentic RAG).
sents.zh: 忠实度有适度提升（智能体 RAG 的 Δ=+0.05）。

paragraphs.en: Augmentation + gating : The enriched candidate set provides the gate with more material to work with; the gate filters aggressively, leaving only high-confidence passages. The combined effect is superadditive: the gate’s precision increases because augmentation provides better recall.
paragraphs.zh: 增强 + 门控：扩充后的候选集为门控提供了更多可用的素材；门控进行严格过滤，只留下高置信度的段落。 两者的组合效果是超可加的：由于增强带来了更好的召回率，门控的精确率得以提升。

sents.en: Augmentation + gating : The enriched candidate set provides the gate with more material to work with; the gate filters aggressively, leaving only high-confidence passages.
sents.zh: 增强 + 门控：扩充后的候选集为门控提供了更多可用的素材；门控进行严格过滤，只留下高置信度的段落。

sents.en: The combined effect is superadditive: the gate’s precision increases because augmentation provides better recall.
sents.zh: 两者的组合效果是超可加的：由于增强带来了更好的召回率，门控的精确率得以提升。

paragraphs.en: This is the only positive (superadditive) interaction we observe; all other significant interactions are subadditive (composition penalty). It operates across the retrieval–generation boundary, confirming that the composition problem manifests asymmetrically: within-stage interactions are typically subadditive (overlapping function), while cross-stage interactions can be synergistic (complementary function).
paragraphs.zh: 这是我们观察到的唯一正向（超可加）交互；所有其他显著的交互都是次可加的（组合惩罚）。 它作用于检索与生成的边界，证实了组合问题以不对称的方式呈现：阶段内交互通常是次可加的（功能重叠），而跨阶段交互可能是协同的（功能互补）。

sents.en: It operates across the retrieval–generation boundary, confirming that the composition problem manifests asymmetrically: within-stage interactions are typically subadditive (overlapping function), while cross-stage interactions can be synergistic (complementary function).

paragraphs.en: Max_reliable is the only SOTA profile that activates both query augmentation (via HyDE) and agentic gating, which explains its faithfulness advantage. However, the aggressive refinement paradox (G1) limits the practical benefit: the gate is too aggressive, discarding passages that would improve answer completeness. A promising direction is to relax the refinement threshold ( partially_relevant passes) while maintaining the hallucination check, which would preserve the I3 synergy without triggering G1.
paragraphs.zh: Max_reliable 是唯一同时激活查询增强（通过 HyDE）与智能体门控的 SOTA 配置，这解释了它在忠实度上的优势。 然而，激进精炼悖论（G1）限制了其实际收益：门控过于激进，丢弃了原本能提升答案完整性的段落。 一个有前景的方向是放宽精炼阈值（让 partially_relevant 通过），同时保留幻觉检查，从而在不触发 G1 的情况下保持 I3 协同效应。

sents.zh: Max_reliable 是唯一同时激活查询增强（通过 HyDE）与智能体门控的 SOTA 配置，这解释了它在忠实度上的优势。

sents.en: However, the aggressive refinement paradox (G1) limits the practical benefit: the gate is too aggressive, discarding passages that would improve answer completeness.
sents.zh: 然而，激进精炼悖论（G1）限制了其实际收益：门控过于激进，丢弃了原本能提升答案完整性的段落。

sents.en: A promising direction is to relax the refinement threshold ( partially_relevant passes) while maintaining the hallucination check, which would preserve the I3 synergy without triggering G1.
sents.zh: 一个有前景的方向是放宽精炼阈值（让 partially_relevant 通过），同时保留幻觉检查，从而在不触发 G1 的情况下保持 I3 协同效应。

paragraphs.en: The corpus scaling experiments ( Section 5 ) reveal two phenomena that require mechanistic explanation: (1) log-linear degradation for retrieval-side profiles ( speed , standard ) contrasted with effectively flat behavior for generation-oriented profiles ( balanced , max-reliable ), and (2) a rank crossover between standard and balanced that is visible from 25K and statistically significant at 200K ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ).
paragraphs.zh: 语料库规模实验（第 5 节）揭示了两个需要机理解释的现象：(1) 检索侧配置（speed、standard）呈现对数线性退化，而面向生成的配置（balanced、max-reliable）则表现出基本平坦的行为；(2) standard 与 balanced 之间出现了排名交叉，该交叉从 25K 起即可观察到，并在 200K 处具有统计显著性（p = 0.004 p=0.004）。

paragraphs.en: As corpus size increases from 5K to 50K documents, distractor density in the candidate set increases proportionally. For a fixed top- k k retrieval, the probability that a given candidate slot is occupied by a distractor increases as 1 − R / N 1-R/N , where R R is the number of relevant documents and N N is the corpus size. Since R R is fixed (the same queries target the same documents), the signal-to-noise ratio in the candidate set degrades logarithmically with N N .
paragraphs.zh: 随着语料库规模从 5K 增加到 50K 篇文档，候选集中的干扰项密度成比例地增加。 对于固定的 top-k 检索，某个候选槽位被干扰项占据的概率随 1 − R / N 增加，其中 R 是相关文档的数量，N 是语料库规模。 由于 R 是固定的（相同的查询指向相同的文档），候选集中的信噪比随 N 呈对数式退化。

sents.en: As corpus size increases from 5K to 50K documents, distractor density in the candidate set increases proportionally.
sents.zh: 随着语料库规模从 5K 增加到 50K 篇文档，候选集中的干扰项密度成比例地增加。

sents.en: For a fixed top- k k retrieval, the probability that a given candidate slot is occupied by a distractor increases as 1 − R / N 1-R/N , where R R is the number of relevant documents and N N is the corpus size.
sents.zh: 对于固定的 top-k 检索，某个候选槽位被干扰项占据的概率随 1 − R / N 增加，其中 R 是相关文档的数量，N 是语料库规模。

sents.en: Since R R is fixed (the same queries target the same documents), the signal-to-noise ratio in the candidate set degrades logarithmically with N N .
sents.zh: 由于 R 是固定的（相同的查询指向相同的文档），候选集中的信噪比随 N 呈对数式退化。

paragraphs.en: The degradation rate varies by profile because different features provide different levels of noise robustness:
paragraphs.zh: 不同特征的噪声鲁棒性水平不同，因此退化率随特征配置而变化：

paragraphs.en: Speed ( − 0.115 -0.115 /decade, R 2 = 0.90 R^{2}=0.90 ): No noise filtering; degradation rate matches the raw retriever’s sensitivity to distractors.
paragraphs.zh: 速度（ − 0.115 -0.115 /十年，R 2 = 0.90 R^{2}=0.90 ）：无噪声过滤；退化速率与原始检索器对干扰项的敏感度相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Standard ( − 0.055 -0.055 /decade, R 2 = 0.89 R^{2}=0.89 ): HyDE and reranking provide partial noise filtering, but the reranker sees the same degraded candidate set.
paragraphs.zh: 标准版（ − 0.055 -0.055 /十年， R 2 = 0.89 R^{2}=0.89 ）：HyDE 和重排序提供了部分噪声过滤，但重排序器看到的仍是同一组已退化的候选集。

paragraphs.en: Balanced ( − 0.015 -0.015 /decade): Context compression and document awareness provide generation-side noise filtering that is independent of candidate set quality; even when the retriever returns noisier candidates, compression distils the relevant spans.
paragraphs.zh: 平衡（ − 0.015 -0.015 /十年）：上下文压缩和文档感知提供了独立于候选集质量的生成侧噪声过滤；即使检索器返回更嘈杂的候选，压缩也能提炼出相关片段。

paragraphs.en: Max reliable : Not measured at 50K due to computational budget, but the agentic pipeline’s iterative refinement provides an additional noise filter.
paragraphs.zh: 最大可靠值：由于计算预算限制，未在 50K 规模下测量，但智能体流程（agentic pipeline）的迭代优化提供了额外的噪声过滤。

paragraphs.en: The standard profile’s advantage over balanced at 5K ( + 0.006 +0.006 NDCG@10) reverses between 15K and 25K. The gap trends in the predicted direction at 50K–100K but is not statistically significant through 100K ( p > 0.17 p>0.17 , Welch’s t t , n = 3 n=3 seeds per cell); it firms at 200K ( Δ = + 0.059 \Delta=+0.059 ; p = 0.004 p=0.004 ). The root cause is the asymmetric scaling of retrieval-side vs. generation-side defenses:
paragraphs.zh: 标准配置在 5K 时相对于均衡配置的优势（+0.006 NDCG@10）在 15K 到 25K 之间发生逆转。 在 50K–100K 时差距呈现预测方向的趋势，但在 100K 以内未达到统计显著性（p > 0.17，Welch's t 检验，每个单元格 n = 3 个种子）；在 200K 时差距趋于稳固（Δ = +0.059；p = 0.004）。 根本原因在于检索侧防御与生成侧防御的不对称扩展：

sents.en: The standard profile’s advantage over balanced at 5K ( + 0.006 +0.006 NDCG@10) reverses between 15K and 25K.
sents.zh: 标准配置在 5K 时相对于均衡配置的优势（+0.006 NDCG@10）在 15K 到 25K 之间发生逆转。

sents.en: The gap trends in the predicted direction at 50K–100K but is not statistically significant through 100K ( p > 0.17 p>0.17 , Welch’s t t , n = 3 n=3 seeds per cell); it firms at 200K ( Δ = + 0.059 \Delta=+0.059 ; p = 0.004 p=0.004 ).
sents.zh: 在 50K–100K 时差距呈现预测方向的趋势，但在 100K 以内未达到统计显著性（p > 0.17，Welch's t 检验，每个单元格 n = 3 个种子）；在 200K 时差距趋于稳固（Δ = +0.059；p = 0.004）。

sents.en: The root cause is the asymmetric scaling of retrieval-side vs. generation-side defenses:
sents.zh: 根本原因在于检索侧防御与生成侧防御的不对称扩展：

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-side defenses (HyDE, reranking) operate on the candidate set, whose quality degrades with scale. HyDE’s hypothetical documents are generated from the query, not the corpus, so they do not adapt to increasing distractor density. The reranker scores each candidate independently, so its effectiveness degrades linearly with the fraction of distractors in the candidate set.
paragraphs.zh: 检索侧的防御方法（HyDE、重排序）作用于候选集，而候选集的质量会随着规模增大而下降。 HyDE 生成的假设性文档来自查询而非语料库，因此无法适应干扰项密度的增加。 重排序器对每个候选独立打分，因此其效果会随候选集中干扰项所占比例的增加而线性下降。

sents.en: Retrieval-side defenses (HyDE, reranking) operate on the candidate set, whose quality degrades with scale.
sents.zh: 检索侧的防御方法（HyDE、重排序）作用于候选集，而候选集的质量会随着规模增大而下降。

sents.en: HyDE’s hypothetical documents are generated from the query, not the corpus, so they do not adapt to increasing distractor density.
sents.zh: HyDE 生成的假设性文档来自查询而非语料库，因此无法适应干扰项密度的增加。

sents.en: The reranker scores each candidate independently, so its effectiveness degrades linearly with the fraction of distractors in the candidate set.
sents.zh: 重排序器对每个候选独立打分，因此其效果会随候选集中干扰项所占比例的增加而线性下降。

paragraphs.en: Generation-side defenses (compression, awareness) operate on the output of retrieval, after reranking has already selected the top-10. Even when these top-10 passages contain more noise at scale, compression can extract the relevant spans, and document awareness provides stable grounding that does not degrade with corpus size.
paragraphs.zh: 生成侧的防御手段（压缩、文档感知）作用于检索的输出，而此时重排序已经选出了前 10 篇。 即使这些前 10 篇文档在大规模语料下包含更多噪声，压缩仍能提取相关片段，而文档感知提供了不会随语料库规模增大而退化的稳定依据。

sents.en: Generation-side defenses (compression, awareness) operate on the output of retrieval, after reranking has already selected the top-10.
sents.zh: 生成侧的防御手段（压缩、文档感知）作用于检索的输出，而此时重排序已经选出了前 10 篇。

sents.en: Even when these top-10 passages contain more noise at scale, compression can extract the relevant spans, and document awareness provides stable grounding that does not degrade with corpus size.
sents.zh: 即使这些前 10 篇文档在大规模语料下包含更多噪声，压缩仍能提取相关片段，而文档感知提供了不会随语料库规模增大而退化的稳定依据。

paragraphs.en: This analysis provides causal support for the H3 hypothesis premise: profile rankings are not scale-invariant because different features have different scaling slopes. A profile optimized for small-scale retrieval (standard) will be overtaken by a profile with better generation-side defenses (balanced) as scale increases.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析为 H3 假设的前提提供了因果支持：由于不同特征具有不同的缩放斜率，画像排序并不具备尺度不变性。 针对小规模检索优化的画像（标准型）会随着规模增大而被具有更好生成侧防御的画像（均衡型）超越。

sents.zh: 该分析为 H3 假设的前提提供了因果支持：由于不同特征具有不同的缩放斜率，画像排序并不具备尺度不变性。

sents.en: A profile optimized for small-scale retrieval (standard) will be overtaken by a profile with better generation-side defenses (balanced) as scale increases.
sents.zh: 针对小规模检索优化的画像（标准型）会随着规模增大而被具有更好生成侧防御的画像（均衡型）超越。

paragraphs.en: Three actionable principles emerge from this root cause analysis:
paragraphs.zh: 从这一根本原因分析中，可以得出三条可操作的原则：

paragraphs.en: Complement, don’t duplicate. Features that operate on different pipeline stages (retrieval vs. generation) compose better than features within the same stage. The balanced profile exemplifies this by pairing retrieval features (HyDE, reranking, hybrid) with generation features (compression, awareness).
paragraphs.zh: 互补，而非重复。 作用于不同流水线阶段（检索 vs. 生成）的功能，比同一阶段内的功能组合效果更好。 均衡型配置体现了这一点：它将检索类功能（HyDE、重排序、混合检索）与生成类功能（压缩、感知）搭配使用。

sents.en: Complement, don’t duplicate.
sents.zh: 互补，而非重复。

sents.en: Features that operate on different pipeline stages (retrieval vs. generation) compose better than features within the same stage.
sents.zh: 作用于不同流水线阶段（检索 vs. 生成）的功能，比同一阶段内的功能组合效果更好。

sents.en: The balanced profile exemplifies this by pairing retrieval features (HyDE, reranking, hybrid) with generation features (compression, awareness).
sents.zh: 均衡型配置体现了这一点：它将检索类功能（HyDE、重排序、混合检索）与生成类功能（压缩、感知）搭配使用。

paragraphs.en: Validate composed configurations end-to-end. Single-feature ablations consistently overestimate composed performance (composition penalties of 7–72% are observed; Section 5 ). The only reliable guide is factorial evaluation of the composed system.
paragraphs.zh: 对组合后的配置进行端到端验证。 单一特征的消融实验始终会高估组合后的性能（观测到 7–72% 的组合惩罚；见第 5 节）。 唯一可靠的指南是对组合后的系统进行因子化评估。

sents.en: Validate composed configurations end-to-end.
sents.zh: 对组合后的配置进行端到端验证。

sents.en: Single-feature ablations consistently overestimate composed performance (composition penalties of 7–72% are observed; Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 单一特征的消融实验始终会高估组合后的性能（观测到 7–72% 的组合惩罚；见第 5 节）。

sents.en: The only reliable guide is factorial evaluation of the composed system.
sents.zh: 唯一可靠的指南是对组合后的系统进行因子化评估。

paragraphs.en: Choose features for your scale. Retrieval-side features (HyDE, reranking) provide the largest gains at small scale ( < < 10K documents) but degrade faster. Generation-side features (compression, awareness) provide smaller gains initially but maintain their effectiveness at scale. Profile selection should account for the target corpus size.
paragraphs.zh: 为您的规模选择特性。 检索侧特性（HyDE、重排序）在小规模（< < 10K 文档）下收益最大，但退化得更快。 生成侧特性（压缩、感知）初期收益较小，但在大规模下仍能保持其有效性。 档案选择应考虑目标语料库的规模。

sents.en: Choose features for your scale.
sents.zh: 为您的规模选择特性。

sents.en: Retrieval-side features (HyDE, reranking) provide the largest gains at small scale ( < < 10K documents) but degrade faster.
sents.zh: 检索侧特性（HyDE、重排序）在小规模（< < 10K 文档）下收益最大，但退化得更快。

sents.en: Generation-side features (compression, awareness) provide smaller gains initially but maintain their effectiveness at scale.
sents.zh: 生成侧特性（压缩、感知）初期收益较小，但在大规模下仍能保持其有效性。

sents.en: Profile selection should account for the target corpus size.
sents.zh: 档案选择应考虑目标语料库的规模。

paragraphs.en: This appendix catalogs the techniques associated with the eight component dimensions varied in the factorial experiment. These dimensions sit within the nine-stage workflow described in Section 3 : document processing and the base answer generator were held fixed, while D8 varies agentic control around generation. Practitioners seeking implementation details for any method can refer to the cited papers; our implementations follow the original algorithms unless noted.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录编目了因子实验中所变化的八个组件维度相关的技术。 这些维度位于第3节所述的九阶段工作流之内：文档处理和基础答案生成器保持固定，而D8则变化生成周围的智能体控制。 寻求任何方法实现细节的从业者可参考所引论文；除非另有说明，我们的实现遵循原始算法。

sents.en: This appendix catalogs the techniques associated with the eight component dimensions varied in the factorial experiment.
sents.zh: 本附录编目了因子实验中所变化的八个组件维度相关的技术。

sents.en: These dimensions sit within the nine-stage workflow described in Section 3 : document processing and the base answer generator were held fixed, while D8 varies agentic control around generation.
sents.zh: 这些维度位于第3节所述的九阶段工作流之内：文档处理和基础答案生成器保持固定，而D8则变化生成周围的智能体控制。

sents.en: Practitioners seeking implementation details for any method can refer to the cited papers; our implementations follow the original algorithms unless noted.
sents.zh: 寻求任何方法实现细节的从业者可参考所引论文；除非另有说明，我们的实现遵循原始算法。

paragraphs.en: A lightweight sentence-transformer distilled from MiniLM ( Wang et al., 2020 ) via knowledge distillation on 1B sentence pairs. Fast inference ( ∼ {\sim} 10K sentences/s on GPU) at the cost of lower representation capacity. Used in the speed profile.
paragraphs.zh: 一个通过知识蒸馏在 10 亿句对上从 MiniLM（Wang et al., 2020）蒸馏而来的轻量级句子Transformer模型。 推理速度快（GPU 上约 10K 句/秒），代价是表示能力较低。 用于速度配置。

sents.en: A lightweight sentence-transformer distilled from MiniLM ( Wang et al., 2020 ) via knowledge distillation on 1B sentence pairs.
sents.zh: 一个通过知识蒸馏在 10 亿句对上从 MiniLM（Wang et al., 2020）蒸馏而来的轻量级句子Transformer模型。

sents.en: Fast inference ( ∼ {\sim} 10K sentences/s on GPU) at the cost of lower representation capacity.
sents.zh: 推理速度快（GPU 上约 10K 句/秒），代价是表示能力较低。

sents.en: Used in the speed profile.
sents.zh: 用于速度配置。

paragraphs.en: A unified embedding model supporting dense, sparse (lexical weights), and ColBERT-style multi-vector retrieval ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . Trained on multilingual data with 8K context window. Our default embedding for all non-speed profiles.
paragraphs.zh: 一个支持稠密、稀疏（词法权重）和 ColBERT 式多向量检索的统一嵌入模型（Chen 等，2024a）。 在多语言数据上训练，具有 8K 上下文窗口。 我们在所有非速度配置中使用的默认嵌入模型。

sents.en: A unified embedding model supporting dense, sparse (lexical weights), and ColBERT-style multi-vector retrieval ( Chen et al., 2024a ) .
sents.zh: 一个支持稠密、稀疏（词法权重）和 ColBERT 式多向量检索的统一嵌入模型（Chen 等，2024a）。

sents.en: Trained on multilingual data with 8K context window.
sents.zh: 在多语言数据上训练，具有 8K 上下文窗口。

sents.en: Our default embedding for all non-speed profiles.
sents.zh: 我们在所有非速度配置中使用的默认嵌入模型。

paragraphs.en: A text embedding model trained with contrastive learning on large-scale text pairs, achieving strong performance on the MTEB benchmark ( Wang et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个在大规模文本对上通过对比学习训练的文本嵌入模型，在 MTEB 基准上取得了强劲的性能（Wang et al., 2022）。

paragraphs.en: An English-focused embedding model from the BGE family ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) , optimized for retrieval via retromae pre-training and contrastive fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 来自 BGE 系列的面向英语的嵌入模型（Xiao et al., 2024），通过 retromae 预训练和对比微调针对检索进行了优化。

paragraphs.en: Splits documents into fixed-length segments (512 tokens in our experiments) with configurable overlap. Simple and deterministic.
paragraphs.zh: 将文档切分为固定长度的分段（在我们的实验中为 512 个 token），并支持可配置的重叠。 简单且具有确定性。

sents.en: Splits documents into fixed-length segments (512 tokens in our experiments) with configurable overlap.
sents.zh: 将文档切分为固定长度的分段（在我们的实验中为 512 个 token），并支持可配置的重叠。

sents.en: Simple and deterministic.
sents.zh: 简单且具有确定性。

paragraphs.en: Groups consecutive sentences whose embeddings are within a similarity threshold, producing semantically coherent chunks ( Chen et al., 2024b ) . Chunk boundaries align with topic shifts.
paragraphs.zh: 将相邻句子中嵌入向量相似度在阈值范围内的句子分组，生成语义连贯的分块（Chen et al., 2024b）。 分块边界与主题转换对齐。

sents.en: Groups consecutive sentences whose embeddings are within a similarity threshold, producing semantically coherent chunks ( Chen et al., 2024b ) .
sents.zh: 将相邻句子中嵌入向量相似度在阈值范围内的句子分组，生成语义连贯的分块（Chen et al., 2024b）。

sents.en: Chunk boundaries align with topic shifts.
sents.zh: 分块边界与主题转换对齐。

paragraphs.en: Each chunk centers on a single sentence but includes a configurable window of surrounding sentences as context. Preserves local coherence while maintaining fine-grained retrieval units.
paragraphs.zh: 每个分块以单个句子为中心，但包含一个可配置的周围句子窗口作为上下文。 在保持细粒度检索单元的同时，保留局部连贯性。

sents.en: Each chunk centers on a single sentence but includes a configurable window of surrounding sentences as context.
sents.zh: 每个分块以单个句子为中心，但包含一个可配置的周围句子窗口作为上下文。

sents.en: Preserves local coherence while maintaining fine-grained retrieval units.
sents.zh: 在保持细粒度检索单元的同时，保留局部连贯性。

paragraphs.en: Creates parent chunks (2000 tokens) containing child chunks (400 tokens). Retrieval operates on children; auto-merge promotes to parents when multiple children from the same parent are retrieved, recovering broader context ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 创建包含子块（400 tokens）的父块（2000 tokens）。 检索在子块上进行；当同一父块的多个子块被检索到时，自动合并会提升至父块，从而恢复更广泛的上下文（Sarthi et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Creates parent chunks (2000 tokens) containing child chunks (400 tokens).
sents.zh: 创建包含子块（400 tokens）的父块（2000 tokens）。

sents.en: Retrieval operates on children; auto-merge promotes to parents when multiple children from the same parent are retrieved, recovering broader context ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 检索在子块上进行；当同一父块的多个子块被检索到时，自动合并会提升至父块，从而恢复更广泛的上下文（Sarthi et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Splits documents along structural boundaries extracted during document parsing (headings, sections, tables, code blocks) rather than by fixed token counts. Preserves layout semantics from the source format (Markdown, HTML, PDF) and keeps related structural units, table rows, list items, code blocks, in a single chunk; parsed via Docling ( Auer et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 根据文档解析过程中提取的结构边界（标题、章节、表格、代码块）来切分文档，而不是按固定的 token 数量切分。 保留源格式（Markdown、HTML、PDF）的版式语义，并将相关的结构单元（如表格行、列表项、代码块）保持在同一个分块中；通过 Docling（Auer et al., 2024）进行解析。

sents.en: Splits documents along structural boundaries extracted during document parsing (headings, sections, tables, code blocks) rather than by fixed token counts.
sents.zh: 根据文档解析过程中提取的结构边界（标题、章节、表格、代码块）来切分文档，而不是按固定的 token 数量切分。

sents.en: Preserves layout semantics from the source format (Markdown, HTML, PDF) and keeps related structural units, table rows, list items, code blocks, in a single chunk; parsed via Docling ( Auer et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 保留源格式（Markdown、HTML、PDF）的版式语义，并将相关的结构单元（如表格行、列表项、代码块）保持在同一个分块中；通过 Docling（Auer et al., 2024）进行解析。

paragraphs.en: Splits documents hierarchically using a prioritized list of separators (paragraph → \to sentence → \to clause → \to token), recursively subdividing any segment that exceeds the target chunk size. Produces variable-length chunks that respect natural text boundaries while bounding chunk size, a pattern popularized by LangChain and LlamaIndex as the default general-purpose splitter.
paragraphs.zh: 使用按优先级排列的分隔符列表（段落 → 句子 → 子句 → 词元）对文档进行层级拆分，递归地细分任何超过目标块大小的片段。 生成长度可变、尊重自然文本边界的文本块，同时限制块的大小；这种模式由 LangChain 和 LlamaIndex 推广，成为默认的通用拆分器。

sents.en: Splits documents hierarchically using a prioritized list of separators (paragraph → \to sentence → \to clause → \to token), recursively subdividing any segment that exceeds the target chunk size.
sents.zh: 使用按优先级排列的分隔符列表（段落 → 句子 → 子句 → 词元）对文档进行层级拆分，递归地细分任何超过目标块大小的片段。

sents.en: Produces variable-length chunks that respect natural text boundaries while bounding chunk size, a pattern popularized by LangChain and LlamaIndex as the default general-purpose splitter.
sents.zh: 生成长度可变、尊重自然文本边界的文本块，同时限制块的大小；这种模式由 LangChain 和 LlamaIndex 推广，成为默认的通用拆分器。

paragraphs.en: Chunks are indexed as-is without additional processing.
paragraphs.zh: 块（chunks）按原样进行索引，无需额外处理。

paragraphs.en: Prepends a brief document-level summary (generated by an LLM) to each chunk before embedding, improving retrieval precision without changing the retrieval model ( Anthropic, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在嵌入前为每个分块添加一段由大语言模型生成的简短的文档级摘要，从而在不更换检索模型的情况下提高检索精度（Anthropic，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval. Clusters chunks and generates recursive summaries at multiple levels of abstraction, enabling retrieval at varying granularity ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 面向树状组织的检索的递归抽象处理。 对文本块进行聚类，并在多个抽象层次上生成递归摘要，从而支持不同粒度的检索（Sarthi et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval.
sents.zh: 面向树状组织的检索的递归抽象处理。

sents.en: Clusters chunks and generates recursive summaries at multiple levels of abstraction, enabling retrieval at varying granularity ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 对文本块进行聚类，并在多个抽象层次上生成递归摘要，从而支持不同粒度的检索（Sarthi et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Extracts entities and relationships from documents to build a knowledge graph. Graph traversal augments vector search with structured reasoning over entity connections ( Edge et al., 2024 ) . Excluded from the factorial experiment due to entity-extraction cost ( ∼ {\sim} 14h per ingestion combo).
paragraphs.zh: 从文档中抽取实体和关系，以构建知识图谱。 图遍历通过对实体连接进行结构化推理来增强向量搜索（Edge et al., 2024）。 由于实体抽取的成本较高（每次摄入组合约需14小时），未纳入析因实验。

sents.en: Extracts entities and relationships from documents to build a knowledge graph.
sents.zh: 从文档中抽取实体和关系，以构建知识图谱。

sents.en: Graph traversal augments vector search with structured reasoning over entity connections ( Edge et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 图遍历通过对实体连接进行结构化推理来增强向量搜索（Edge et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Excluded from the factorial experiment due to entity-extraction cost ( ∼ {\sim} 14h per ingestion combo).
sents.zh: 由于实体抽取的成本较高（每次摄入组合约需14小时），未纳入析因实验。

paragraphs.en: Approximate nearest-neighbor search over embedding vectors using cosine similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 使用余弦相似度对嵌入向量进行近似最近邻搜索。

paragraphs.en: The classical Okapi BM25 ranking function ( Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009 ) , a term-frequency / inverse-document-frequency score with length normalization and saturation parameters. Serves as the sparse baseline in our executable comparisons ( Table 60 ) and as the lexical component of all hybrid retrieval modes below.
paragraphs.zh: 经典的 Okapi BM25 排序函数（Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009），一种带长度归一化与饱和参数的词频/逆文档频率得分。 它在我们的可执行对比实验（表 60）中充当稀疏检索基线，并作为下文所有混合检索模式的词法组件。

sents.en: The classical Okapi BM25 ranking function ( Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009 ) , a term-frequency / inverse-document-frequency score with length normalization and saturation parameters.
sents.zh: 经典的 Okapi BM25 排序函数（Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009），一种带长度归一化与饱和参数的词频/逆文档频率得分。

sents.en: Serves as the sparse baseline in our executable comparisons ( Table 60 ) and as the lexical component of all hybrid retrieval modes below.
sents.zh: 它在我们的可执行对比实验（表 60）中充当稀疏检索基线，并作为下文所有混合检索模式的词法组件。

paragraphs.en: A learned sparse expansion model ( Formal et al., 2021 ; Formal et al., 2022 ) that produces weighted term vectors by expanding queries and documents over a BERT vocabulary, enabling lexical match on semantically related terms.
paragraphs.zh: 一种学习型稀疏扩展模型（Formal et al., 2021; Formal et al., 2022），通过在 BERT 词表上扩展查询和文档来生成加权词项向量，从而实现语义相关词项上的词汇匹配。

paragraphs.en: Combines dense retrieval with BM25 lexical matching ( Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009 ) via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) . The fusion weight α \alpha controls the dense–sparse balance.
paragraphs.zh: 通过倒数排名融合（RRF）将稠密检索与 BM25 词汇匹配相结合（Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009）（Cormack et al., 2009）。 融合权重 α \alpha 控制稠密检索与稀疏检索之间的平衡。

sents.en: Combines dense retrieval with BM25 lexical matching ( Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009 ) via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) .
sents.zh: 通过倒数排名融合（RRF）将稠密检索与 BM25 词汇匹配相结合（Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009）（Cormack et al., 2009）。

sents.en: The fusion weight α \alpha controls the dense–sparse balance.
sents.zh: 融合权重 α \alpha 控制稠密检索与稀疏检索之间的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Replaces BM25 with SPLADE ( Formal et al., 2021 ) , combined with dense retrieval via RRF.
paragraphs.zh: 将 BM25 替换为 SPLADE（Formal et al., 2021），并通过 RRF 与稠密检索相结合。

paragraphs.en: Reciprocal Rank Fusion ( Cormack et al., 2009 ; Bruch et al., 2023 ) is the rank-aggregation algorithm that underlies all lasagna hybrid modes: each result list contributes a score 1 / ( k + r i ) 1/(k+r_{i}) for document at rank r i r_{i} (we use the standard k = 60 k=60 ), and the fused ranking sorts by summed score. Robust to per-retriever score scales and the default fusion for combining dense and sparse signals.
paragraphs.zh: 倒数排名融合（Reciprocal Rank Fusion）（Cormack 等，2009；Bruch 等，2023）是所有 lasagna 混合模式所依赖的排名聚合算法：每个结果列表为排名为 r_i 的文档贡献一个分数 1/(k+r_i)（我们使用标准的 k=60），融合后的排名按总分排序。 它对各个检索器的分数尺度具有鲁棒性，是组合稠密与稀疏信号的默认融合方法。

sents.en: Reciprocal Rank Fusion ( Cormack et al., 2009 ; Bruch et al., 2023 ) is the rank-aggregation algorithm that underlies all lasagna hybrid modes: each result list contributes a score 1 / ( k + r i ) 1/(k+r_{i}) for document at rank r i r_{i} (we use the standard k = 60 k=60 ), and the fused ranking sorts by summed score.
sents.zh: 倒数排名融合（Reciprocal Rank Fusion）（Cormack 等，2009；Bruch 等，2023）是所有 lasagna 混合模式所依赖的排名聚合算法：每个结果列表为排名为 r_i 的文档贡献一个分数 1/(k+r_i)（我们使用标准的 k=60），融合后的排名按总分排序。

sents.en: Robust to per-retriever score scales and the default fusion for combining dense and sparse signals.
sents.zh: 它对各个检索器的分数尺度具有鲁棒性，是组合稠密与稀疏信号的默认融合方法。

paragraphs.en: Augments vector retrieval with traversal over a knowledge graph extracted at index time. For a query, entities and neighbors within k k hops are materialized as additional passages alongside the top- k k vector hits, broadening recall on multi-hop questions ( Edge et al., 2024 ) . Shares the ingestion pipeline with the GraphRAG enrichment ( GraphRAG ) and was excluded from the factorial on cost grounds ( Section A.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在向量检索的基础上，增加对索引时抽取的知识图谱的遍历。 对于一个查询，k 跳范围内的实体和邻居会被具体化为额外的段落，与 top-k 向量命中结果并列，从而扩大多跳问题的召回范围（Edge et al., 2024）。 它与 GraphRAG 增强共享同一摄取流水线，并因成本原因被排除在因子实验之外（A.4 节）。

sents.en: Augments vector retrieval with traversal over a knowledge graph extracted at index time.
sents.zh: 在向量检索的基础上，增加对索引时抽取的知识图谱的遍历。

sents.en: For a query, entities and neighbors within k k hops are materialized as additional passages alongside the top- k k vector hits, broadening recall on multi-hop questions ( Edge et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 对于一个查询，k 跳范围内的实体和邻居会被具体化为额外的段落，与 top-k 向量命中结果并列，从而扩大多跳问题的召回范围（Edge et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Shares the ingestion pipeline with the GraphRAG enrichment ( GraphRAG ) and was excluded from the factorial on cost grounds ( Section A.4 ).
sents.zh: 它与 GraphRAG 增强共享同一摄取流水线，并因成本原因被排除在因子实验之外（A.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work replaces flat vector retrieval with graph- or schema-based indexes: HippoRAG ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) runs personalized PageRank over an entity graph, KAG ( Liang et al., 2024 ) fuses schema-aware knowledge-graph traversal with a semantic layer, and hierarchical extensions such as TreeRAG ( Tao et al., 2025 ) add document-tree structure. These systems are complementary to lasagna : each replaces the retrieval-stage internals while preserving the stage-isolation interface, so they can be dropped in as an additional D4 (retrieval) level and evaluated under the same factorial protocol. We did not include them in the 242-cell design because the D-optimal set was locked at pre-registration; a natural extension is to test whether graph-based indexing changes the D5 × \times D8 composition patterns reported in Table 42 .
paragraphs.zh: 另一条并行的研究路线用基于图或基于模式的索引取代扁平向量检索：HippoRAG（Gutiérrez et al., 2024）在实体图上运行个性化 PageRank，KAG（Liang et al., 2024）将模式感知的知识图谱遍历与语义层相融合，而 TreeRAG（Tao et al., 2025）等层次化扩展则增加了文档树结构。 这些系统与 lasagna 互为补充：它们各自在保留阶段隔离接口的同时替换检索阶段的内部实现，因此可以作为额外的 D4（检索）层级直接接入，并在相同的因子化实验方案下进行评估。 我们没有将它们纳入 242 格的设计中，因为 D 最优集合已在预注册时锁定；一个自然的扩展是检验基于图的索引是否会改变表 42 中报告的 D5 × \times D8 组合模式。
