paragraphs.en: The original query is used as-is for retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 原始查询被原样用于检索。

paragraphs.en: An LLM generates hypothetical answer documents; their embeddings are averaged with the query embedding to improve recall for underspecified queries ( Gao et al., 2023a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型生成假设性的答案文档，并将这些文档的嵌入与查询嵌入进行平均，以提升对欠明确查询的召回效果（Gao et al., 2023a）。

paragraphs.en: Generates multiple query variants via an LLM, retrieves for each, and merges results via RRF ( Rackauckas, 2024 ) . Broadens the retrieval scope at the cost of additional LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: 通过大语言模型生成多个查询变体，对每个变体分别检索，并通过 RRF 合并结果（Rackauckas, 2024）。 以额外的 LLM 调用为代价来扩大检索范围。

sents.en: Generates multiple query variants via an LLM, retrieves for each, and merges results via RRF ( Rackauckas, 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 通过大语言模型生成多个查询变体，对每个变体分别检索，并通过 RRF 合并结果（Rackauckas, 2024）。

sents.en: Broadens the retrieval scope at the cost of additional LLM calls.
sents.zh: 以额外的 LLM 调用为代价来扩大检索范围。

paragraphs.en: Decomposes complex queries into sub-questions, retrieves for each, and aggregates evidence. Effective for multi-hop reasoning ( Press et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 将复杂查询分解为子问题，为每个子问题进行检索，并聚合证据。 对多跳推理有效（Press et al., 2023）。

sents.en: Decomposes complex queries into sub-questions, retrieves for each, and aggregates evidence.
sents.zh: 将复杂查询分解为子问题，为每个子问题进行检索，并聚合证据。

sents.en: Effective for multi-hop reasoning ( Press et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 对多跳推理有效（Press et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: Generates a more abstract “step-back” question that captures the high-level intent, retrieves for both the original and abstracted queries ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生成一个更抽象的「退后一步」问题以捕捉高层意图，并对原始查询和抽象后的查询分别进行检索（Zheng et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Retrieved passages are returned in their original retrieval order.
paragraphs.zh: 检索到的段落按其原始检索顺序返回。

paragraphs.en: A cross-encoder model (mxbai-rerank-large-v1 in our experiments) scores each query–passage pair jointly, reranking the top- k k results ( Nogueira & Cho, 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个交叉编码器模型（在我们的实验中为 mxbai-rerank-large-v1）对每个查询–段落对进行联合评分，对前 top- k k 个结果进行重排（Nogueira & Cho, 2019）。

paragraphs.en: Combines scores from multiple rerankers (cross-encoder + ColBERT-style) via score fusion.
paragraphs.zh: 通过分数融合（score fusion）的方式，将多个重排序器（reranker）（交叉编码器 + ColBERT 风格）的分数进行组合。

paragraphs.en: Iteratively selects passages that are both relevant and diverse, penalizing redundancy ( Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998 ) . Our experiments find this consistently hurts NDCG@10 in domain-focused corpora ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 迭代式地选择既相关又多样的段落，并对冗余进行惩罚（ Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998 ）。 我们的实验发现，在以领域为重点的语料库上，这种方法始终会损害 NDCG@10（见第 5 节）。

sents.en: Iteratively selects passages that are both relevant and diverse, penalizing redundancy ( Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998 ) .
sents.zh: 迭代式地选择既相关又多样的段落，并对冗余进行惩罚（ Carbonell & Goldstein, 1998 ）。

sents.en: Our experiments find this consistently hurts NDCG@10 in domain-focused corpora ( Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 我们的实验发现，在以领域为重点的语料库上，这种方法始终会损害 NDCG@10（见第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Full retrieved passages are passed to the generator.
paragraphs.zh: 完整检索到的段落会被传递给生成器。

paragraphs.en: Extractive compression that removes tokens with low information content according to a small language model, reducing context length while preserving key information ( Jiang et al., 2023a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一种抽取式压缩方法，根据小型语言模型移除信息含量低的词元，在保留关键信息的同时缩短上下文长度（Jiang et al., 2023a）。

paragraphs.en: Single-pass generation without quality verification.
paragraphs.zh: 单次生成，未经质量验证。

paragraphs.en: A lightweight evaluator grades retrieval quality; if confidence is low, the system triggers web search or knowledge refinement ( Yan et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个轻量级评估器对检索质量进行评分；若置信度较低，系统将触发网络搜索或知识精炼（ Yan et al., 2024 ）。

paragraphs.en: The generator emits reflection tokens that gate retrieval and self-assess generation quality, iteratively refining the answer through multi-turn retrieval and verification ( Asai et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生成器会发出反思标记（reflection tokens）来控制检索并对生成质量进行自我评估，通过多轮检索与验证迭代地优化答案（Asai et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Generates multiple draft answers from different retrieved subsets and uses a verifier to select the best, trading latency for answer diversity ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 从不同的检索子集生成多个草稿答案，并使用验证器选择最佳答案，以延迟换取答案多样性 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) 。

paragraphs.en: A gate that sits between retrieval and generation and accepts a chunk only if an LLM judge classifies it as supporting the question; chunks below the threshold are dropped. Shared machinery across CRAG, Self-RAG, and Speculative-RAG, and used directly in the max-reliable profile ( Section I.1.4 ). Raises the faithfulness floor but can starve the generator on multi-hop queries ( Section J.2.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个位于检索与生成之间的闸门，只有当 LLM 评审器判定某个文本块支持该问题时才接受它；低于阈值的文本块会被丢弃。 这是 CRAG、Self-RAG 和 Speculative-RAG 共用的机制，并在 max-reliable 配置（见第 I.1.4 节）中被直接使用。 提高了忠实度的下限，但在多跳查询上可能让生成器“挨饿”（见第 J.2.4 节）。

sents.en: A gate that sits between retrieval and generation and accepts a chunk only if an LLM judge classifies it as supporting the question; chunks below the threshold are dropped.
sents.zh: 一个位于检索与生成之间的闸门，只有当 LLM 评审器判定某个文本块支持该问题时才接受它；低于阈值的文本块会被丢弃。

sents.en: Shared machinery across CRAG, Self-RAG, and Speculative-RAG, and used directly in the max-reliable profile ( Section I.1.4 ).
sents.zh: 这是 CRAG、Self-RAG 和 Speculative-RAG 共用的机制，并在 max-reliable 配置（见第 I.1.4 节）中被直接使用。

sents.en: Raises the faithfulness floor but can starve the generator on multi-hop queries ( Section J.2.4 ).
sents.zh: 提高了忠实度的下限，但在多跳查询上可能让生成器“挨饿”（见第 J.2.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: An iterative retrieve–refine–generate loop: after an initial retrieval and draft answer, the system issues follow-up retrievals based on what the draft is missing, repeats for up to K K iterations (3 in our experiments), and generates the final answer from the aggregated context. Related schemes include IRCoT ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) and FLARE ( Jiang et al., 2023b ) ; our implementation runs inside the same agentic graph as the quality-gate filter.
paragraphs.zh: 一个迭代式的检索–精炼–生成循环：在初次检索并生成草稿答案后，系统根据草稿缺失的内容发起后续检索，最多重复 K K 次迭代（在我们的实验中为 3 次），并基于聚合后的上下文生成最终答案。 相关方案包括 IRCoT（Trivedi et al., 2023）和 FLARE（Jiang et al., 2023b）；我们的实现运行在与质量门控过滤器相同的智能体图（agentic graph）中。

sents.en: An iterative retrieve–refine–generate loop: after an initial retrieval and draft answer, the system issues follow-up retrievals based on what the draft is missing, repeats for up to K K iterations (3 in our experiments), and generates the final answer from the aggregated context.
sents.zh: 一个迭代式的检索–精炼–生成循环：在初次检索并生成草稿答案后，系统根据草稿缺失的内容发起后续检索，最多重复 K K 次迭代（在我们的实验中为 3 次），并基于聚合后的上下文生成最终答案。

sents.en: Related schemes include IRCoT ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) and FLARE ( Jiang et al., 2023b ) ; our implementation runs inside the same agentic graph as the quality-gate filter.
sents.zh: 相关方案包括 IRCoT（Trivedi et al., 2023）和 FLARE（Jiang et al., 2023b）；我们的实现运行在与质量门控过滤器相同的智能体图（agentic graph）中。

paragraphs.en: This appendix gathers the paper’s terms in one place, answers the questions a reader is likely to bring to it, each with a pointer to the full account, and lists what is released.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录将论文中的术语集中于一处，回答读者可能带着来阅读的问题——每个问题均附有指向完整论述的指引，并列出所发布的内容。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG); RAG evaluation; compositionality of RAG techniques; ablation study; factorial design; pre-registration; corpus scaling; reranking; hybrid retrieval; query augmentation; agentic RAG; answer faithfulness; NDCG@10; BEIR.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）；RAG 评估；RAG 技术的组合性；消融实验；析因设计；预注册；语料库规模扩展；重排序；混合检索；查询增强；基于智能体的 RAG（agentic RAG）；答案忠实度；NDCG@10；BEIR。

paragraphs.en: An open-source framework for evaluating new RAG components inside a complete modern pipeline, with a fixed interface per stage that the framework enforces, so a new component drops into one stage and is measured against the same surrounding stack used by every reported configuration ( Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个开源框架，用于在完整的现代化流水线中评估新的 RAG 组件。该框架对每个阶段强制执行固定接口，因此新组件只需放入其中一个阶段，即可在与所有已报告配置相同的周边技术栈中进行度量（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: One of the eight experimental factors of the study ( Table 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的八个实验因素之一（表 10）。

paragraphs.en: One of the four operational RAG compositions distilled from the factorial and ablation sweeps as the best-observed configurations for distinct points on the retrieval-faithfulness-latency envelope: speed , standard , balanced and max-reliable ( Section I.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 从因子扫描和消融扫描中提炼出的四种运行级 RAG 组合之一，作为在检索-忠实度-延迟包络上不同最优点所观察到的最佳配置：speed、standard、balanced 和 max-reliable（第 I.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: One of the two evaluation surfaces: retrieval or end-to-end ( Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 两个评估维度之一：检索或端到端（ 第 4 节 ）。

paragraphs.en: The retrieval-quality metric: whether the right documents are retrieved, following the BEIR convention ( Thakur et al., 2021 ) ( Section C.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 检索质量指标：按照 BEIR 惯例（Thakur et al., 2021）（C.1 节），衡量是否检索到了正确的文档。

paragraphs.en: Whether the generated answer is grounded in the retrieved context, scored with RAGAS ( Es et al., 2024 ) ( Section C.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 生成的答案是否立足于检索到的上下文，使用 RAGAS（Es et al., 2024）进行评分（第 C.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: How far a combined pipeline’s gain falls below the gain predicted by adding up its techniques measured one at a time; 63 % 63\% for the three strongest retrieval techniques ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 组合流水线的实际增益低于其各技术单独测量时增益之和的预测值的差距；对三种最强的检索技术而言为 63% 63\%（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: NDCG ​ @ ​ 10 × Faith × max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − latency / L ref ) \mathrm{NDCG@10}\times\mathrm{Faith}\times\max(0,1-\mathrm{latency}/L_{\mathrm{ref}}) at L ref = 30 L_{\mathrm{ref}}{=}30 s, the joint quality-latency envelope used to compare profiles ( Zitzler et al., 2003 ) ( Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: NDCG ​ @ ​ 10 × Faith × max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − latency / L ref ) \mathrm{NDCG@10}\times\mathrm{Faith}\times\max(0,1-\mathrm{latency}/L_{\mathrm{ref}})，其中 L ref = 30 L_{\mathrm{ref}}{=}30 秒，这是用于比较不同配置（ Zitzler et al., 2003 ）的联合质量-延迟包络指标（ 表 2 ）。

paragraphs.en: Not reliably for retrieval. The three strongest single-component retrieval improvements predict + 47 % +47\% NDCG@10, and the pipeline containing all three realizes + 17 % +17\% , a 63 % 63\% shortfall. Across 17 tested combinations the shortfall ranges from 7 % 7\% to 72 % 72\% , with a median of 41 % 41\% . Faithfulness gains combine nearly as measured: + 28 % +28\% predicted, + 32 % +32\% realized ( Sections 5 and D.14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 并不能可靠地用于检索。 三个最强的单组件检索改进预测可带来 +47\% NDCG@10，而包含这三者的流水线实际只实现了 +17\%，存在 63\% 的落差。 在测试的 17 种组合中，该落差范围为 7\% 到 72\%，中位数为 41\%。 忠实度方面的提升几乎按测量值叠加：预测为 +28\%，实际实现为 +32\%（见第 5 节和 D.14 节）。

sents.en: Not reliably for retrieval.
sents.zh: 并不能可靠地用于检索。

sents.en: The three strongest single-component retrieval improvements predict + 47 % +47\% NDCG@10, and the pipeline containing all three realizes + 17 % +17\% , a 63 % 63\% shortfall.
sents.zh: 三个最强的单组件检索改进预测可带来 +47\% NDCG@10，而包含这三者的流水线实际只实现了 +17\%，存在 63\% 的落差。

sents.en: Across 17 tested combinations the shortfall ranges from 7 % 7\% to 72 % 72\% , with a median of 41 % 41\% .
sents.zh: 在测试的 17 种组合中，该落差范围为 7\% 到 72\%，中位数为 41\%。

sents.en: Faithfulness gains combine nearly as measured: + 28 % +28\% predicted, + 32 % +32\% realized ( Sections 5 and D.14 ).
sents.zh: 忠实度方面的提升几乎按测量值叠加：预测为 +28\%，实际实现为 +32\%（见第 5 节和 D.14 节）。

paragraphs.en: No. In the factorial study, embedding, enrichment and reranking dominate the retrieval-quality metric (NDCG@10), whereas query augmentation and agentic gating dominate answer faithfulness, which measures whether generated claims are supported by the retrieved context. Optimizing a RAG pipeline for one metric can hurt the other, so new components should be evaluated on both ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 不。 在因子研究中，嵌入、富化和重排主导检索质量指标（NDCG@10），而查询增强和智能体门控主导答案忠实度，该指标衡量生成的论断是否得到检索上下文的支持。 针对一个指标优化 RAG 流水线可能会损害另一个指标，因此新组件应在两个指标上都进行评估（第 5 节）。

sents.en: No.
sents.zh: 不。

sents.en: In the factorial study, embedding, enrichment and reranking dominate the retrieval-quality metric (NDCG@10), whereas query augmentation and agentic gating dominate answer faithfulness, which measures whether generated claims are supported by the retrieved context.
sents.zh: 在因子研究中，嵌入、富化和重排主导检索质量指标（NDCG@10），而查询增强和智能体门控主导答案忠实度，该指标衡量生成的论断是否得到检索上下文的支持。

paragraphs.en: Not necessarily. Across corpora from 5K to 200K documents, standard leads at 5K and 15K, while balanced leads from 25K through 200K, where it exceeds standard by 13.7 % 13.7\% relative NDCG@10 ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 , three seeds). Rankings from small-corpus ablation studies should therefore be revalidated at the corpus scale a deployment will use ( Sections 5 and B.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 不一定。 在从 5K 到 200K 篇文档的语料库上，标准方法在 5K 和 15K 时领先，而均衡方法从 25K 到 200K 领先，在 200K 时其相对 NDCG@10 超过标准方法 13.7%（p=0.003，三个随机种子）。 因此，小语料消融研究得到的排名应当在部署实际使用的语料规模上重新验证（见第 5 节和 B.3 节）。

sents.en: Not necessarily.
sents.zh: 不一定。

sents.en: Across corpora from 5K to 200K documents, standard leads at 5K and 15K, while balanced leads from 25K through 200K, where it exceeds standard by 13.7 % 13.7\% relative NDCG@10 ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 , three seeds).
sents.zh: 在从 5K 到 200K 篇文档的语料库上，标准方法在 5K 和 15K 时领先，而均衡方法从 25K 到 200K 领先，在 200K 时其相对 NDCG@10 超过标准方法 13.7%（p=0.003，三个随机种子）。

paragraphs.en: No complete RAG profile is best on every metric. speed is fastest, standard leads NDCG@10 and achieves the highest joint hypervolume ( 0.523 0.523 at a 30 30 s reference), and the agentic balanced and max-reliable profiles lead faithfulness at a higher response time. The best configuration depends on the target metrics, and adding components does not guarantee a better pipeline ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 没有一个完整的 RAG 配置能在所有指标上都表现最佳。speed 配置速度最快，standard 配置在 NDCG@10 上领先并取得最高的联合超体积（在 30 30 秒参考下为 0.523 0.523），而 agentic 的 balanced 和 max-reliable 配置在更高的响应时间下在忠实度上领先。 最佳配置取决于目标指标，并且增加组件并不保证得到更好的流水线（见第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Three hypotheses were pre-declared before the experiments ran ( van Miltenburg et al., 2021 ) . The study tests 450 configurations across eight benchmarks: a 167-configuration D-optimal design ( Fedorov et al., 1972 ) over the eight dimensions, 138 non-factorial ablation configurations across 24 targeted ablations, and a corpus-scaling sweep from 5K to 200K documents. Deviations from the pre-registration are reported ( Sections 4 and A ).
paragraphs.zh: 在实验运行之前预先声明了三个假设（ van Miltenburg et al., 2021 ）。 该研究在八个基准上测试了450种配置：包括覆盖八个维度的167种配置的D最优设计（ Fedorov et al., 1972 ）、针对24项定向消融的138种非因子消融配置，以及从5K到200K文档的语料库规模扫描。 与预注册的偏差已有报告（第4节和附录A）。

paragraphs.en: Five BEIR retrieval sets ( Thakur et al., 2021 ) : NFCorpus ( Boteva et al., 2016 ) , FiQA ( Maia et al., 2018 ) , SciFact ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) , ArguAna ( Wachsmuth et al., 2018 ) and HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) ; and three question-answering sets: SQuAD v2 ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) , HotpotQA and MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) . Retrieval is scored with NDCG@10 and answers with RAGAS faithfulness ( Es et al., 2024 ) , judged by GPT-5.1. A generator-substitution check replaces GPT-5.1 with Claude Sonnet 4.5 ( Sections B.2 , C.1 and F.9 ).

paragraphs.en: Inside a representative complete pipeline, on both retrieval quality and answer faithfulness, and at the corpus scale it will be used at. Gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance. lasagna supports this: a component registered with one decorator is measured against the same surrounding stack as every reported configuration, with a paired statistical test ( Sections 3 and 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在一个具有代表性的完整流水线内部，同时评估检索质量和答案忠实度，并在其将要实际使用的语料库规模上进行评估。 孤立测得的收益并不能可靠地预测真实场景下的性能。lasagna 支持这一点：通过一个装饰器注册的组件，会在与每个被报告配置相同的外围技术栈中进行度量，并进行配对统计检验（第 3 节和第 6 节）。

sents.en: Gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance. lasagna supports this: a component registered with one decorator is measured against the same surrounding stack as every reported configuration, with a paired statistical test ( Sections 3 and 6 ).

paragraphs.en: The evaluation uses one constructed English multi-domain test bed, at most 93 retrieval queries and 200 generation queries per experiment, in five focused domains. It does not test multilingual corpora, real enterprise or private data, open-weight generators, or cross-organizational large corpora. Faithfulness is measured under two generator models, a sensitivity check rather than a sweep, and absolute faithfulness scores rest on one judge’s calibration ( Limitations , after Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估使用一个构建的英语多领域测试平台，在五个专注领域中，每次实验最多进行 93 次检索查询和 200 次生成查询。 它没有测试多语言语料库、真实的企业或私有数据、开放权重生成器，或跨组织的大型语料库。 忠实度在两个生成器模型下进行测量，这是一种敏感性检查而非全面扫描，且绝对忠实度得分依赖于单一评判者的校准（局限性，第 6 节之后）。

paragraphs.en: The paper sits between RAG methods research ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2023b ) , RAG evaluation frameworks and metrics ( Es et al., 2024 ; Saad-Falcon et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) , retrieval benchmarking ( Thakur et al., 2021 ) , toolkits that compose RAG pipelines ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Rau et al., 2024 ) or search over them ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , and the design of experiments for comparing many configurations ( Montgomery, 2021 ; Fedorov et al., 1972 ) . Its contribution is a measurement of how techniques compose, not a new technique.
paragraphs.zh: 该论文处于 RAG 方法研究（Lewis 等，2020；Gao 等，2023b）、RAG 评估框架与指标（Es 等，2024；Saad-Falcon 等，2024；Yu 等，2024）、检索基准测试（Thakur 等，2021）、组合 RAG 流水线的工具包（Jin 等，2025；Rau 等，2024）或对其执行搜索的工具（Kim 等，2024），以及用于比较大量配置的实验设计（Montgomery，2021；Fedorov 等，1972）之间。 其贡献在于对各种技术如何组合的度量，而非一种新技术。
